title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
summary: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.

AI.tldr: PalmLeaf-VQA提出面向南亚与东南亚棕榈叶手稿的多脚本VQA基准，聚焦保存相关与版面推理，含923图与7,384问答。评测多种MLLM，最优仅58%准确率，显示当前模型在稀有文字、退化版面与保存导向理解上存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准很少覆盖历史手稿，尤其是多脚本、非拉丁、受损与文化多样性的文档；需要一个能驱动对保存相关视觉要素与布局感知推理的标准化评测，以检验MLLM在真实文博场景中的能力缺口。
AI.method: 构建PalmLeaf-VQA数据集：来自巴厘、格兰塔、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、卡纳达、高棉、巽他与泰米尔八类收藏，共923幅图像与7,384问答；问题覆盖物理状况、行结构、材质/涂层、装订孔、边距、符号、绘图与局部伪影等。对多种专有与开源MLLM在开放回答与受限回答两种提示下进行评测，并做按收藏、题型与任务类别的细粒度分析。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，最强模型仅达58.00%精确匹配准确率；不同收藏、问题类别与任务类型上表现分化明显，揭示当前模型在稀有脚本、退化布局与保存导向文档理解方面能力不足。
AI.conclusion: PalmLeaf-VQA填补了历史多脚本文档VQA基准的空白，提供面向文化语境与版面感知的标准化评测框架，可作为推动更鲁棒、更具文化与布局敏感度的MLLM与文档分析方法研发的基准。

title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
summary: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文对视频扩散Transformer中的时间注意力在训练过程中何时、何处形成结构进行逐检查点普查，发现整体平均值掩盖了稀疏但显著集中的少数头（约4–13%），主要出现在首个时间块，且注意力图收敛为“自帧对角线”和“相邻帧带”两类局部路由模式；未能证明其与生成质量存在因果关系，但给出可迁移的方法学。
AI.motivation: 已有认识多来自已训练完成的模型，且群体平均会掩盖少数专精头的结构化行为，导致我们不知道时间注意力结构在训练过程中何时、何处出现及其可复现性。
AI.method: 对九次Open-Sora STDiT训练运行（3种规模，306M–1.03B参数）进行逐检查点、逐注意力头的普查。使用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC）指标，并按预注册的变点与效应量规则选择“显著集中”的头；分析在不同随机种子下的再现性、位置（块/头坐标）分布、注意力图模式；并进行相关性与消融以检验与生成质量的关系。
AI.result: 总体（平均）CFAC在各运行中持平或下降，但少数头（约4–13%）形成显著跨帧集中；这些头可再现的信号体现在“块级位置”，尤其集中在第一个时间块，而具体头坐标在控制块后不可复现。被选头的注意力图收敛到有限的局部路由母题：自帧对角线与相邻帧带；不同运行中负责的具体头可不同。相关与消融未能确立与视频质量的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 时间注意力的结构化是稀疏且位置上偏向首个时间块，非头坐标级可复现；平均统计会掩盖这种稀疏组织。作者提供了可迁移的方法：基于固定选择规则的逐检查点、逐头分析与路由度量，可用于其它因子化视频扩散Transformer，亦可扩展到时空联合架构（需适配度量）。

title: One Evaluation, Any Operating Point: Hypernetwork-Amortized MeanFlow for 3D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Generative priors reconstruct accelerated 3D MRI well but pay heavily at deployment: tens of network evaluations per volume, and protocol-specific hyperparameter tuning. A third hidden cost is the scanner's fixed sampling pattern. We treat the whole operating point as an input. A 3D MeanFlow patch network (a one-step flow model) is fine-tuned end-to-end through a warm-started, five-iteration differentiable conjugate-gradient projection. A small hypernetwork maps the operating point (data-consistency weight, acceleration, and the Cartesian sampling pattern itself) to the network's per-channel modulation. Three findings follow. (i) Learning the acquisition is worth more than any other operating point: on clinical knee data, the learned mask gains up to +2.34 dB over the protocol's variable-density mask. This gain requires the solver: with a feed-forward reconstructor the same learned mask hurts at 4x (-1.7 dB), but with the data-consistency projection it adds +4.6 dB. (ii) One evaluation is highly effective: it beats a 20-step patch-diffusion prior by up to +3.1 dB on brain and +2.9 dB on knee. Three to five evaluations extend the front to +6 dB while using a quarter of the prior's network calls. (iii) Fully sampled targets are optional: trained self-supervised on a split of acquired samples, the reconstructor matches its supervised twin at 4x on real data. Finally, we report what failed and why: subject-adaptive acquisition from measured energy, combining self-supervision with learned acquisition, and amortising the data-consistency weight.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将采集参数（采样模式、加速率、数据一致性权重）作为“操作点”输入，并端到端联合优化重建网络与采样的3D MRI方法：用单步MeanFlow补丁网络，经5步可微共轭梯度投影；再用小型超网络把操作点映射到通道调制，实现一次或少次评估即可高质量重建，并可自监督训练、无需全采样真值。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式先验在3D加速MRI重建上效果好但代价高：推理需多次网络评估、对协议依赖强且需调参；同时临床扫描仪使用固定采样模式，限制性能。作者希望把“操作点”（采样模式、加速率、数据一致性权重）融入模型，联合优化采集与重建，在保持或提升重建质量的同时显著降低推理成本，并减少对全采样数据的依赖。
AI.method:
- 模型：3D MeanFlow补丁网络（单步flow）作为先验；外接5步可微共轭梯度（CG）数据一致性投影（warm-start）。
- 超网络：将操作点（数据一致性权重λ、加速率R、笛卡尔采样掩膜本身）映射为主网络的逐通道调制系数，实现对不同协议的条件化；可端到端微分。
- 学习采集：将采样掩膜参数化并与重建网络联合训练，探索学习到的掩膜相较于临床变量密度掩膜的收益。
- 评估策略：一次评估（单步）即可重建；也可进行3–5次评估迭代，仍显著少于扩散先验的多步；并比较监督与自监督（使用已采样k-space子集拆分）训练。
AI.result:
(i) 学习采集最关键：在临床膝关节数据上，学习到的掩膜相对协议变量密度掩膜最高提升+2.34 dB。该收益依赖CG投影：纯前馈重建在4×时同一掩膜反而-1.7 dB，但加入数据一致性后+4.6 dB。
(ii) 单次评估已很强：相较20步patch-diffusion先验，在脑部最高+3.1 dB、膝部+2.9 dB；进行3–5次评估可再扩展至+6 dB，同时仅用其约1/4的网络调用数。
(iii) 无需全采样真值：在真实数据4×加速下，用自监督（分裂观测）训练的模型与有监督版本性能持平。
此外，作者报告失败尝试与原因：基于能量的个体自适应采集、将自监督与学习采集同时使用、以及摊销数据一致性权重均未奏效。
AI.conclusion: 将“操作点”作为条件并联合优化采集与重建，配合单步MeanFlow与可微CG投影，可在显著降低推理成本的同时提升或匹配最先进重建质量；学习到的采样掩膜在有数据一致性约束下尤为有效；自监督训练在4×加速下可替代全采样标签。对失败方向的披露为后续研究提供了边界与改进线索。

title: Enhancing Foundation Models for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification via Targeted Oversampling
summary: Remote-sensing foundation models offer strong representations for SAR imagery, but their behavior under severe long-tail class imbalance is still not well characterized. We benchmark DOFA and SAR-JEPA on the imbalanced OpenSARShip dataset and compare them with ImageNet-pretrained baselines under a fixed, training-efficient protocol that keeps the backbone frozen. To mitigate imbalance without fine-tuning, we apply four oversampling methods in embedding space exclusively to minority classes and train a lightweight classifier head on the augmented embeddings. Across both foundation models, oversampling improves Macro-F1 and test accuracy relative to their respective baselines, with the largest Macro-F1 gains observed for DOFA using ADASYN (34.39 to 38.56) and for SAR-JEPA using SVM-SMOTE (25.89 to 32.30). We also report class-wise behavior, showing that aggregate improvements can coexist with persistent failures on specific rare classes. Code for embedding extraction and reproducible multi-seed evaluation is provided to support rapid experimentation on free-tier hardware.

AI.tldr: 在OpenSARShip长尾不平衡场景下，冻结主干，只训练轻量分类头，并在嵌入空间对少数类进行过采样，能显著提升宏平均F1与准确率；最佳增益出现在DOFA+ADASYN与SAR-JEPA+SVM-SMOTE；但极少数类仍存在持续失效。
AI.motivation: SAR遥感基础模型在长尾不平衡条件下的鲁棒性尚未系统评估。实际应用常面临类别极不均衡且算力/数据有限，无法全面微调主干，因此需要一种训练高效、可在冻结主干下缓解不平衡的策略与基线。
AI.method: 固定训练协议：冻结DOFA与SAR-JEPA主干，仅提取嵌入并训练轻量分类头；对少数类在嵌入空间进行四种过采样（含ADASYN、SVM-SMOTE等），不进行微调；在不平衡的OpenSARShip上进行基准测试，报告整体与类别级别指标，并提供多种随机种子复现实验与代码。
AI.result: 相较各自的冻结基线，两种基础模型在过采样下均提升Macro-F1与测试精度。最大增益：DOFA+ADASYN宏F1从34.39→38.56，SAR-JEPA+SVM-SMOTE从25.89→32.30。尽管总体改进明显，某些极稀有类别仍表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结主干、轻量训练设置下，对少数类在嵌入空间过采样是缓解长尾不平衡的有效手段，适用于资源受限环境；然而仍需针对极稀有类的专门策略（如代价敏感学习/层次化建模/更强的数据合成或选择性微调）以进一步弥补性能短板。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.

AI.tldr: 评测6个预训练模型在两套SAR舰船数据集上的域内分类、跨数据集迁移与未知类检测；域内还行，跨域显著失效；未知类检测中基于任务的不确定性优于MC-dropout但受类与数据集影响。
AI.motivation: 实际部署常遇到训练/测试分布不一致，SAR舰船分类在跨数据集泛化与未知类检测方面缺乏系统性理解与基准。
AI.method: 在FUSARShip与OpenSARShip上，以6个预训练模型进行三种设置：1) 域内分类；2) 跨数据集迁移（训练于一集测试于另一集）；3) 未知类检测（一次性留出一个类别）并比较不确定性指标（MC-dropout与任务特定分数）。
AI.result: 域内：SARDet100K最佳，FUSARShip平衡准确率73.4%，OpenSARShip为53.2%。跨域：出现强失败，存在总体准确率看似尚可但平衡准确率接近随机（如从OpenSARShip到FUSARShip为64.5%准确率却仅33.3%平衡准确率）。未知类检测：性能随留出类与数据集大幅波动；MC-dropout方差常接近随机，任务特定不确定性更有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 当前SAR舰船分类跨数据集泛化性有限；评估应关注平衡准确率与未知类检测；相较MC-dropout，任务特定不确定性更有效但受数据集与类别影响，需开发更稳健的跨域与开放集方法。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 提出ForensicZoom：一种具备自适应“放大取证”能力的工业级多模态大模型框架，用以在身份核验中高效且可解释地检测人脸伪造；在低FPR下实现高TPR，并优于专业检测器与现有MLLM。
AI.motivation: 身份核验对人脸伪造检测既要求极低漏报保障安全，又要求低误报保证用户体验。传统取证模型准确但可解释性弱；MLLM可解释强但在伪造检测上偏弱。关键瓶颈在于视觉证据获取：细微取证伪影在标准分辨率下难以表现，而全量高分辨率处理成本高。
AI.method: 构建ForensicZoom框架：1) 为通用MLLM注入“取证感知”视觉表征并与语言模型对齐；2) 设计NEED_ZOOM机制，让模型在初始证据不足时自主请求对可疑区域放大，形成多轮自适应推理；3) 通过奖励塑形训练其放大策略，在准确性与不必要放大间权衡，将额外计算聚焦于困难样本；4) 最后进行归因优化，提升自然语言取证报告质量且不损害检测性能。
AI.result: 在大规模工业级身份核验数据上，ForensicZoom在FPR=0.1%时实现TPR>97%，显著优于专业取证检测器与现有MLLM方法，并能产出可操作的取证归因报告。
AI.conclusion: 自适应放大取证结合MLLM能在保证可解释性的同时实现高准确、可扩展的人脸伪造检测，展示了面向实际身份核验场景的有效路径。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 提出CARPM-FIQA，通过在训练全过程累计相对点边距（类内紧致/类间分离之比）的平均，稳定FR集成的人脸图像质量评估，降低方差、改进MSE与排序稳定性，并在多基准对比中接近SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: FR集成的FIQA方法在训练中因特征空间不断演化导致单epoch质量估计不稳定，目标值随时间漂移，影响可靠预测与泛化。需要一种能缓解时序不稳定、又保留FR集成优势的策略。
AI.method: 提出CARPM-FIQA：在整个训练轨迹上对“相对点边距”（类内紧致度与类间分离度之比）进行累计平均，而非依赖单epoch估计。该时间聚合带来方差缩减、MSE改进与收敛的理论保证；通过SynFIQA有标注质量组的受控实验与不同训练配置的消融验证其一致收益。
AI.result: 在8个基准、4个FR模型、2个FMR阈值、与12种FIQA方法对比下，CARPM-FIQA的两种规模版本在17种方法中按pAUC-EDC与AUC-EDC综合排名分列第4与第6；经逐基准归一化后，对所有FR模型其平均性能与最佳方法仅差几个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 跨时间累计的质量估计可稳定FR集成FIQA的训练目标，在不牺牲性能的情况下缓解时序不稳定；更一般地，时间聚合是应对深度学习中因表征演化导致目标波动的有效范式。

title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/mahsa7290/language-augmented-action-anticipation
summary: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于“动作预判”研究的系统综述，提出一张“证据感知的设计地图”，将任务范式与语言信息（LLM/VLM/语义）介入点对应起来，并给出对照实验、失败诊断与证据边界；配套提供审计协议、证据画像与可复现实验工具（BCAP），以将现有“增益”从结论改为待验证假设。
AI.motivation: 现有把LLM/VLM或语言语义引入动作预判的工作常同时改变任务设定、视觉预训练、监督信号、解码器和评测代码，导致增益难以解释与复现。作者动机是：建立一个统一、可审计、可对照的框架，明确“在哪个环节引入语言信息、在什么任务条件下有效、应与什么反事实比较、证据主张的边界是什么”。
AI.method: 1) 定义六个轴刻画动作预判任务范式，并据此将文献归为五大家族：单动作、序列、物体交互、跨视角、规划取向；2) 定义四类语言介入位点C1–C4：情境构建、目标/意图建模、未来解码、以及面向可执行/落地的扩展；3) 为每个介入点绑定相应的反事实基线、失败诊断与可宣称证据的范围，形成“设计地图”；4) 对Ego4D-LTA与EPIC-KITCHENS-100进行协议级审计，给出多维证据画像；5) 提出“骨干感知的比较与消融协议”（BCAP），并提供包含证据编码、溯源、协议元数据与版本化目录的伴随软件包。
AI.result: 形成一套证据感知的设计地图与评测协议：在不混淆视觉骨干、解码器与评测差异的前提下，能够对语言介入的真实贡献进行对照与诊断；对EK-100的既有“最优纪录”进行可比性案例分析而非榜单化；综合文献后，目前关于LLM带来的收益、目标歧义影响与时间跨度效应的主张，仅能作为需要匹配验证的可检验假设。
AI.conclusion: 这篇综述将动作预判中语言介入的位置、任务条件与证据边界系统化，提供可复现的比较/消融协议与数据集审计，呼吁社区以匹配的反事实与统一协议来验证LLM/VLM增益，避免将相关性或实现差异误当因果结论。

title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed.
  In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM.
  We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在多选题场景下的“答案感知”视频帧选择方法：把选项语义并入查询，用与帧的最大余弦相似度打分，选出最相关帧，在固定token预算下提升MLLM的视频问答表现。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM视频理解受限于帧数过多与固定token预算，通常仅均匀采样少量帧且与问题无关，导致与问题相关的关键信息被遗漏。训练-free、模型无关的帧选取方法虽有，但普遍未利用多选题的答案选项信息作为推理时线索。
AI.method: 面向多选题：1) 将问题与各答案选项拼接，形成多组“问题-答案”查询；2) 先按固定速率子采样构建候选帧池；3) 用文本与帧的嵌入计算余弦相似度，对每帧取其与所有问答对中最大相似度作为该帧得分；4) 依得分选取Top-K帧送入下游MLLM，保持固定token预算。
AI.result: 在MLVU、Video-MME、LongVideoBench三大基准上，结合LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-Video三种MLLM评测，答案感知的帧选择在相同帧预算下普遍优于均匀采样与现有训练-free方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用答案选项作为推理线索进行帧选择可在不改动下游模型、保持token预算的前提下，提升视频多选题的理解与回答效果；方法简单、模型无关、可即插即用。

title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 论文发现：在无标签（无需干净真值）的去噪场景中，一步回归读出即可达到MMSE最优，而多步流式积分反而偏离最优并降低 fidelity。关键在于去相关的成对噪声配对，而非多步流方法本身。实验证明在CTDenoiser基准上，一步方法优于多步，且常见无监督方法表现受噪声相关性假设影响。PSNR/SSIM亦可能与临床可探测性不一致。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍相信“多步迭代与生成式方法优于单步回归”，但在无标签去噪设置下这一假设未被系统检验。作者想澄清：在没有干净标签、仅有成对噪声观测的条件下，最优解究竟是一步还是多步；并评估不同无监督/弱监督方法在现实CT低剂量噪声上的有效性与局限，尤其是经典指标与临床可探测性间的差异。
AI.method: 理论：分析无条件rectified flow在成对噪声（Noise2Noise式）训练下的极小化器，证明其一步读出等价于MMSE去噪；而多步积分因流终止于噪声分布而非干净分布，必然偏离MMSE。提供可解的高斯模型做精确对比。实验：在CTDenoiser基准上跨五种架构与多类方法（有监督、相似性、盲点、逐图像）评测；比较一步读出、欧拉多步积分、直接回归与不同无标签方法（Noise2Sim、Noise2Void）。同时用通道化Hotelling观察者评估低对比分辨病灶可探测性。
AI.result: 理论：一步读出=MMSE，无需干净标签；多步积分越精确越把样本推向噪声末端分布，fidelity 下降更明显。高斯模型中偏离为精确可解。实验：一步flow与直接回归匹配；多步欧拉积分步数增加→性能持续下降。使用去相关噪声配对的一步回归拿到最佳无标签成绩（+1.99 dB）。在CTDenoiser上：在无标签方法里，仅考虑相关噪声的Noise2Sim优于噪声基线；Noise2Void因CT噪声非像素独立而持平或变差。有监督方法虽提升约4 dB PSNR，但通道化Hotelling观察者显示低对比病灶可探测性下降。
AI.conclusion: 在无标签去噪中，多步生成/流式细化并非天然更优；恰当的去相关噪声配对加上一步回归即可达到MMSE并在实践中更稳健。训练更好的速度场会加剧多步积分偏向噪声分布的缺陷。评价上应超越PSNR/SSIM，引入任务驱动可探测性指标。对CT等相关噪声场景，需使用能建模噪声相关性的无标签方法或直接采用匹配噪声对的一步回归。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 在DVS-PedX基准上，用无监督的SNN特征学习（WTA-STDP字典学习）+简单线性读出，实现接近全监督SNN的行人过街检测性能（90.3%准确率、AUROC 0.936），且性能对读出策略极其敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件相机的行人过街检测常用全监督反向传播训练SNN，需昂贵的帧级标签。作者想验证：能否在不使用标注进行特征学习的前提下，仍保持高性能，并厘清无监督SNN被认为性能弱的原因是否来自学习规则本身还是读出策略。
AI.method: 用单层脉冲神经元通过赢家通吃的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（WTA-STDP）在未标注的事件帧小块上学习字典；整帧以与已学滤波器的余弦相似度编码并做空间池化；最后用线性分类器作为唯一监督模块进行判别。比较不同可塑性规则与不同读出协议（包括经典神经元指派读出）。
AI.result: 在DVS-PedX测试集24,454帧上：无监督方法准确率90.3%、AUROC 0.936；端到端全监督SNN为92.0%、0.943；恶劣天气下AUROC 0.913。结果对可塑性规则不敏感，但对读出协议高度敏感：经典神经元指派读出仅0.70 AUROC。在基准的真实转换子集上，通过重新拟合读出从0.53（接近随机）提升到0.67 AUROC，落在已发表的监督范围内。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上，移除特征学习阶段的标签仅带来小幅性能损失。无监督SNN被报道的弱点主要可能源自读出协议而非无监督学习规则本身；选择合适的读出与后处理对性能至关重要。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 比较三种预训练CNN骨干（ResNet‑50、VGG‑16、FaceNet）在SoF数据集上的部分人脸识别微调，统一预处理与训练设置；FaceNet（PFN）显著领先，测试准确率97.4%，宏平均精确率87.04%、召回84.61%、F1为84.17，刷新SoF的准确率与召回。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中人脸常被眼镜、遮挡物或裁剪边缘部分遮挡，导致常规模型性能骤降。需要系统比较并找到在部分人脸条件下更鲁棒的识别方案。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces数据集上，以统一协议（160×160输入，冻结骨干，仅训练顶层头部；固定epoch；不做逐骨干超参搜索）对ResNet‑50、VGG‑16、FaceNet进行迁移学习微调，比较三者在112个身份类别上的分类表现。
AI.result: FaceNet变体PFN显著优于ResNet‑50与VGG‑16：测试准确率97.4%；宏平均精确率87.04%、召回84.61%、F1 84.17，为SoF上已报道的最高准确率与召回。
AI.conclusion: 在严格对齐的训练设置下，FaceNet作为骨干对部分人脸识别更具鲁棒性与泛化能力；统一的迁移学习框架可作为PFR基准，提示后续工作可在FaceNet系或其改进上进一步优化以应对遮挡与裁剪。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 评估通用多模态大模型用于家禽球虫（Eimeria）物种级诊断：不给候选标签时输出泛化且分类学不一致；给定类列表时总体准确率14.9%，偏向将样本判为E. tenella；部分物种零正确。生成的治疗报告虽通顺但未经验证；分割不完整。结论：当前通用多模态模型单独用于Eimeria诊断不可靠，需领域微调与专家把关。
AI.motivation: 家禽球虫病造成较大经济损失，防控依赖准确到物种级的诊断；希望评估现成通用多模态大模型是否能胜任，以减少昂贵的人工与专用模型需求。
AI.method: 使用Google Gemini对4225张显微图像在两种提示条件下进行分类：无候选标签、提供预定义7类列表；另评估其病理/治疗报告生成能力。并用BiomedParse进行寄生虫分割。比较输出的正确性与一致性，统计分类准确率与偏置。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出范围宽泛且与分类学不一致；提供类列表时总体准确率仅14.9%，强烈偏向E. tenella（占74%预测），对E. acervulina、E. mitis、E. praecox无正确分类；生成的治疗报告连贯但未经验证；分割仅部分成功。
AI.conclusion: 通用多模态模型目前不足以独立完成Eimeria物种级诊断；需要领域特定微调、严格验证与专家参与，方可在实际诊断流程中应用。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 微调微软TrOCR模型，实现高精度的手写天城文字符识别；在约5000张字符数据上训练，CER 3.95%、字符准确率96.05%，优于以往CNN方法，并提供<5秒延迟的可扩展Web部署。
AI.motivation: 手写天城文（Devanagari）字符因笔画复杂、形变多样、连写和噪声等因素导致识别困难，传统CNN方法受限；作者希望利用Transformer型OCR（TrOCR）的强表征与序列建模能力，提升识别精度并实现实际可用的在线服务。
AI.method:
- 采用预训练的 microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten 作为基础模型。
- 预处理：将输入图像标准化为RGB、批量分词（tokenization）并与Hugging Face Dataset整合。
- 数据集：约5000张字符级图像，按8:1:1划分训练/验证/测试。
- 训练策略：混合精度训练、梯度检查点、早停以加速并防止过拟合。
- 部署：使用Vite.js前端、Golang与FastAPI后端，提供在线识别服务。
AI.result: 在测试集上达到字符错误率（CER）3.95%，字符级准确率96.05%，优于先前CNN基线；在线推理延迟<5秒/请求。
AI.conclusion: 微调TrOCR可在较小规模数据上获得高精度的手写天城文字符识别，并能工程化部署为可扩展Web服务；为后续基于Transformer的天城文识别研究奠定基础。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 论文比较多种深度学习模型在显微血涂片疟疾检测上的效果，并提出新模型；最佳权衡为MobileNetV2体积最小、推理最快，拟议模型准确率最高并通过XAI进行可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 疟疾致死人数高且可能上升，早期、准确诊断至关重要。传统显微镜诊断依赖专家且劳动密集，亟需自动化、准确、可部署的AI方法。
AI.method: 基于NIH Malaria数据集，对ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19进行基线评估，并提出自研模型；比较准确率、AUC、模型大小与推理延迟；对自研模型进行剪枝优化；使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME提供可解释性可视化与特征重要性分析。
AI.result: MobileNetV2以8.49 MB模型、1.35 ms推理达96.35%准确率；提出的模型达97.67%准确率、AUC 0.9756，但推理最慢为13.17 ms；更大架构并未带来更高准确率且模型更大；剪枝后自研模型在准确率与延迟上略有提升。
AI.conclusion: 轻量模型在资源受限环境具最佳性价比，而自研模型可达最高精度但代价为更长延迟与更大体积；XAI工具有助于增强模型可信度与临床应用可解释性。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 提出面向制造业非技术用户（如一线质检工人）的可解释视觉目标检测界面，基于微调后的视觉-语言模型，显著提升解释的清晰度、依指性、贴图性与情境感知。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI多为技术专家设计，难以被生产线蓝领等非专家理解与采纳；开箱即用的多模态大模型在制造场景的解释往往不清晰、不贴合情境。
AI.method: 基准评测多种现成视觉-语言模型，发现其在非专家可解释性上不足；随后对选定的视觉-语言模型进行领域微调，并将其集成到一个面向对象检测任务的XAI人机界面，强调生成直观、情境化、可操作的解释。
AI.result: 在专有与公开机器人/制造数据集上，相比GPT-4o-mini，微调模型在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像落地性与情境感知方面有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过领域微调与专用界面设计，可将XAI从“专家导向”转变为“面向非专家实用”，提升制造业场景中AI解释的可达性与可用性。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个面向架构的系统化评估协议，比较九种常用XAI方法在四类深度模型（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）上的可解释性表现，以乳腺超声数据集为基准。结果显示：解释质量取决于“模型架构×XAI方法”的交互，没有单一方法在所有架构与指标上稳定最优；混合架构更稳健、空间一致性更好；轻量与Transformer模型在不同方法间波动较大。论文给出实践性选型指南与公开代码。
AI.motivation: 医学影像诊断需要可解释性以获得临床信任，但当前在乳腺癌识别领域对XAI技术的选型多为临时经验，缺乏跨模型、系统化的客观比较，难以指导实际部署。
AI.method: 构建一个架构感知的评估协议：在包含780张乳腺超声图像的数据集上，对九种主流XAI方法在四类DL架构（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）上进行统一评测；采用与临床一致的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化解释与专家病灶标注的一致性；比较不同架构与方法的交互效应。
AI.result: 总体无“通吃”的XAI：解释质量主要受模型架构与XAI方法的交互影响；混合架构产生更连贯、空间一致的热力图；轻量与Transformer模型表现随方法变化更大；不同指标下最佳方法并不一致。
AI.conclusion: XAI选型不能与模型设计分离，需联合选择模型与解释方法；不存在跨架构与评价标准通用最优的XAI。论文提供结构化评估流程与实践建议，助力更透明的临床决策支持；代码公开以促进复现与扩展。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 提出DnD攻击：将带水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与残差分支，丢弃残差以去除水印；在多种水印上以单一设置实现高保真去除，提示应以表示级学习型移除来评估鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有水印评估多关注压缩、缩放、模糊、色彩等良性后处理，忽视能保留语义同时学习性去除载荷证据的对手；需检验水印在表示层面对适应性移除的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Disentangle and Drop (DnD)：将水印图像解耦为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，通过抑制/丢弃残差以降低水印证据；训练时采用潜空间频谱扰动与低强度扩散暴露，确保在自适应重建下丢弃操作的稳定性；方法与具体水印算法无关、统一设置运行；进行操作扫描与消融，区分有效攻击与损伤图像的设置。
AI.result: 在七类代表性水印家族上，一个共享的运行设置即可实现具有竞争力的去除效果并保持高视觉保真度；发现更强噪声或扩散虽能提高去除分数但会破坏图像，实际可用的效果来自丢弃残差潜变量。
AI.conclusion: 水印鲁棒性评测应纳入针对表示级的学习型去除攻击，而非仅限于传统图像编辑；DnD展示了与方法无关、低破坏性的有效移除路径。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文指出“去除不可见水印”和“隐藏去除操作的取证痕迹”是两件不同的事，并提出面向特定攻击的少样本取证框架与模型RemTraceNet，能在少量样本下高效检测水印移除痕迹，优于多种重训基线。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要关注水印抑制和感知质量，忽略了去除过程是否能被取证检测到。一旦验证失败，移除痕迹可为溯源与归属提供补充证据；若无痕迹则原因成谜。因此需要专门评估与检测“水印移除痕迹”的可取证性与隐蔽性。
AI.method: 提出“面向水印攻击的少样本取证”设定：针对每条已知移除流水线，训练一个专家分类器区分其输出与成对的Clean或未攻击的Watermarked对照，采用分开的Attack-vs-Clean与Attack-vs-Watermarked评估以避免捷径。对照选择依据后处理或生成器内集成方案分别使用图像对齐与提示匹配。核心模型RemTraceNet在原生分辨率上融合多源证据：受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar统计、分块DCT特征。输入分辨率含256×256与512×512，每条流水线仅用100张被攻击图像进行训练，三种随机种子取平均。
AI.result: 在23条移除流水线与10种水印配置上，宏平均TPR@1%FPR为82.75%–88.17%（跨分辨率与对照类型）。在相同标签与协议下，RemTraceNet较重训的SRNet、ZhuNet、SiaStegNet高出10.80–15.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 去除水印与抹除去除痕迹是两个独立难题；在有限监督下，水印移除痕迹依然可被学习并稳定检测。RemTraceNet为评估与对抗水印移除取证提供了有效基线与方法论。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量不确定性感知的表示校正框架，在低光视频中纠正VideoChat2的中间表示以改进动作描述，无需微调VLM；用稀疏高斯过程预测残差并以不确定性自适应缩放，少量数据即可训练，推理开销小，定量/定性验证有效，具可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 低光环境显著降低VLM对视频人类动作的描述准确性，而直接微调大型VLM代价高、数据难得、泛化性差。需要一种无需改动主模型、能用极少标注数据快速提升低光鲁棒性的校正方法。
AI.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入轻量稀疏高斯过程（SVGP）残差估计模块：学习从原始投影表示到“验证过的目标表示”的残差；采用分区的组合核设计以更好拟合异质特征；用新定义的不确定性感知系数对残差自适应缩放并加回原表示。训练仅用ARID数据集的44个样本；推理阶段仅增加小量计算。
AI.result: 在低光视频上，对残差预测的定量指标显示准确改正；生成字幕的定性分析表现更符合真实动作语义。尽管只在VideoChat2上实验，方法本身与兼容架构可通用。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调VLM即可在低光条件下显著改善动作描述：通过SVGP残差校正与不确定性缩放、分区组合核，以极少数据和低开销实现有效增强，并具可迁移性。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 提出Residual Patch Adapter（RPA），用ViT中间层全部patch token对齐M/EEG与视觉表征，显著提升EEG/MEG到图像对齐并达SOTA；实验证明保留完整patch更优，CLS作用有限，低/高层视觉与语义特征均重要；框架轻量、可替换、适用于多种脑编码器与BCI场景。
AI.motivation: 现有M/EEG视觉解码多以单一全局嵌入（如CLS）对齐，忽略ViT中间层patch的细粒度信息，尚不清楚保留中间patch是否能改进对齐与解码性能，也缺少系统性分析哪些视觉特征（低级到高级）对脑信号对齐最关键。
AI.method: 提出RPA：一种轻量残差适配器，从ViT中间层提取全部patch token并与EEG/MEG表征对齐；进行消融（池化、掩码、仅CLS等）与六类定量特征分析（涵盖颜色、纹理等低级特征与高级语义）；在THINGS-EEG2与THINGS-MEG上评测；测试不同脑编码器（含EEG大模型）与可插拔替代模块（卷积、注意力、ConvNeXt）。
AI.result: 保留全部patch显著优于池化/掩码/仅CLS；CLS几乎不提供独特信息；低级（颜色、纹理）与高级语义特征均对对齐重要。达到SOTA：THINGS-EEG2 Top-1 95.4%（被试内）、35.5%（跨被试）；THINGS-MEG 65.2%与6.7%。方法适用于多种脑编码器，RPA可被其他模块替换而保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 利用ViT中间层全部patch token进行脑—图像对齐是关键设计原则；RPA为通用、模块化、轻量的适配方案，推进M/EEG到图像表征学习与非侵入式BCI，并为未来在视觉编码器潜空间的利用提供新方向。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary:
Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint?
  We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work.
  Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 研究在压缩域视频描述（仅用I-frames、运动向量、残差）中，CoCap 的准确率受限于哪两个关键部件：视觉编码器与多模态解码器，并在同等训练与采样预算下做替换对比。主要发现：升级视觉编码器到 SigLIP2显著提升指标；再把解码器换成预训练 GPT-2 反而因小数据过拟合而回退；并报告各配置推理时延以量化速度-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 压缩域标注能极大提速，但 CoCap 依赖较旧的 CLIP 编码器与浅BERT式解码器。想厘清现有性能瓶颈究竟在编码器还是解码器，从而指导在不牺牲速度的前提下提升准确率。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：在相同数据（VATEX 子集4999段）、相同采样预算与优化日程下，比较三种配置：（1）原始CoCap（CLIP+浅BERT）、（2）仅替换视觉编码器为 SigLIP2、（3）在（2）基础上再把解码器换为 GPT-2。评估 BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr，并报告推理时延；与作者自复现实验对齐，而非出版版绝对数值。
AI.result: 自复现与原文指标接近：CIDEr/METEOR略高（54.9 vs 52.7；23.4 vs 23.2），BLEU-4/ROUGE-L略低（29.7 vs 31.4；48.9 vs 49.4），差异归因于评估子集。仅换 SigLIP2 时全部指标提升（CIDEr +4.5）。再加入 GPT-2 解码器后收益被侵蚀，因预训练解码器在4999样本、两轮内过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 在压缩域视频描述中，现阶段的主要瓶颈更偏向视觉编码器：更强的图像编码器（SigLIP2）能稳健增益；而直接换用较大的预训练文本解码器（GPT-2）在小规模数据上易过拟合、适得其反。报告推理时延对于衡量“速度换精度”的真实收益必不可少。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 提出混合残差注意力网络（HRAN）与自适应动量优化器（IAMO），在六类家蚕健康/病害图像分类上达98.67%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有家蚕病害早期检测难、细微差异不易捕捉且训练收敛效率不足，需要兼顾高精度与高效收敛的模型。
AI.method: 构建融合残差块的深层特征提取与空间/通道双重注意力以突出病灶特征；采用图像归一化、重采样、去噪与数据增强；提出集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO）以加速收敛与稳定训练。
AI.result: 在六分类家蚕图像数据集上，使用IAMO训练的HRAN获得98.67%准确率，能识别细微类别差异并支持早期病害检测。
AI.conclusion: HRAN结合空间与通道注意力以及IAMO显著提升家蚕病害分类性能，具备早期检测潜力；未来将提升跨环境可扩展性与效率。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 提出一种对YOLOv8/YOLOv5-seg原型头的精简改进——通道局部对比（CLC），在4个乳腺超声数据集上稳定提升分割Dice（+1.1–3.1pp），代价极小（+64参数，+0.0049 GFLOPs，约+0.097 ms/T4 FP16）。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割需要精确边界，且评估需避免患者或重复图像跨数据划分导致的信息泄漏。现有原型分割头在边界细节上不足，且改动不能显著增加计算或破坏部署效率。
AI.method: 在YOLO分割原型头中加入Channel Local Contrast（CLC）：对特征图施加固定的局部高通残差，并用64个通道门控（零初始化、取值受限）控制注入强度；这是一个极小参数与算力开销的精炼模块。采用严格的分组/患者不泄漏的五折匹配评估：BUS-BRA（患者隔离外测+内验证）、BUS-UCLM与BrEaST（按患者分组的验证折）、BUSI（因缺少ID而按重复组件分组）。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上Group-macro Dice分别提升+1.68、+3.11、+1.12、+2.45个百分点；仅BUS-BRA的成对95%置信区间显著不含零。推理代价极小：仅+64参数、+0.0049 GFLOPs；在640分辨率、单T4、batch=1、FP16 TensorRT下，前向延迟从2.0512 ms增至2.1478 ms，增加约0.0966 ms。
AI.conclusion: CLC以几乎可忽略的参数与延迟开销，统一提升多个乳腺超声数据集的分割Dice，且在最严格的患者隔离设置上也有统计学显著改进（BUS-BRA）。该方法易于集成到YOLO分割头，适合对实时性与边界精度同时敏感的应用。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary:
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model.
  This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain.
  On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 提出MDL-SG，一种无需预设词表规模的BPE改进算法，通过显著性增益与MDL在分割数据上自动决定合并停止点，带来更低的语言模型BPC。
AI.motivation: 传统BPE需预设合并步数/词表大小，且仅以频次为准，可能与语言建模效用不一致。SG-BPE引入统计显著性，但仍缺乏自动停止与效用对齐。作者希望用统计检验与编码效率准则，自动、稳健地选择子词合并，提高下游LM性能。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：1) 发现：在发现分区按Significance-Gain对字符对排序；2) 复现：在独立分区用单侧超几何精确检验，并在每轮合并应用Benjamini–Hochberg校正筛选通过候选；3) 效用：在保留分区上用最小描述长度(MDL)评估每次合并的持出增益；当无复现候选带来正的MDL增益时自动停止。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103上，对应12万/25万/50万字符训练样本，MDL-SG分别在209/433/847次合并时停止；在50万字符时得到1017个token的词表（未预设大小）。在TinyGPT等算力设置下（约202万参数、500步），MDL-SG的验证/测试BPC为3.2612/3.2436，优于SG-BPE(测试3.2894)与频次BPE(3.3493)。频次BPE压缩率更强，但MDL-SG在BPC上更佳。
AI.conclusion: 通过显著性驱动的候选生成、严格复现检验与MDL效用校准，MDL-SG可在不预设词表规模的情况下自动终止合并，并提升语言模型BPC；压缩导向与语言模型效用并不必然一致，MDL是更贴近下游目标的选择准则。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个评测框架与两项指标，系统剖析VLM在高分辨率输入下的退化原因，并给出三类主要失败模式与改进建议。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在多任务上表现强，但对高分辨率图像常失灵，尤其当关键信息分布在小区域或拥挤细节中。已有方法各自为政，缺乏统一、可控的分析以区分“分辨率带来的影响”与“任务本身难度”。作者希望建立受控评测与通用指标，解释为什么模型在高分辨率下退化，并指导架构与数据策略。
AI.method: 构建语义保持的图像变换以控制变量，只改变分辨率与相关因素；提出两项指标：AUSC（Scaling曲线下面积）衡量在不同分辨率下的鲁棒性且不依赖基线精度，PVS（预测方差分数）量化分辨率引起的预测不稳定；在5个模型家族、5个基准上大规模实验，分析不同架构在高分辨率处理中的误差来源。
AI.result: 发现三类主要失败模式：(1) 受视觉token上限影响的下采样信息丢失；(2) token化伪影，来源于patch边界位移与非标准长宽比下位置编码脆弱；(3) 随token数增多而出现的注意力稀释。即便SOTA模型在高分辨率时也显著降级，且退化模式随架构系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率处理并非简单扩大输入即可，需在架构与训练上针对三类失败模式优化。建议包括：放宽/自适应视觉token配额或多尺度提取、稳健位置编码与抗patch偏移的token化、改进注意力机制（如稀疏/聚合/分层注意力）与相应数据增强策略，以提升高分辨率鲁棒性。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 在三个人工采集的孟加拉水稻叶片病害数据集间做系统迁移基准：跨数据集性能显著下降；强数据增强可显著缓解；分割去除非叶片背景有方向性收益但未达显著；自监督ViT同样崩塌，归因于采集条件偏移；自适应BN有害且与标签先验差异、模型深度相关；常见归因方法难以诊断失效。
AI.motivation: 农业视觉中同一任务在不同数据集/场景间泛化差，实际部署时常“掉线”。需要一个系统、可复现实证基准来量化问题规模、定位原因，并评估常见适配策略（增强、分割、AdaBN、自监督等）的有效性。
AI.method: 在三个人工收集的孟加拉水稻叶病数据集上构建6个跨数据集迁移对，选择3个CNN骨干并设3个随机种子，系统评估：强数据增强；基于两种独立方法的叶片分割以去除背景；自监督ViT（DINOv2线性探针）作为对照；自适应BatchNorm（AdaBN）；Grad-CAM进行归因分析。使用宏F1、Wilcoxon检验、Spearman相关等统计方法；公开冻结结果与可重复性工件。
AI.result: 强增强带来跨数据集宏F1平均+0.070，p<0.001（18个迁移对中15个为正）；分割去背景平均+0.066，p=0.062（方向一致但未达显著）；DINOv2线探与CNN一样在跨数据集场景崩塌，排除架构归纳偏置为主因，指向采集条件偏移；AdaBN一致性伤害迁移性能，其伤害程度与源-目标标签先验差异及模型深度正相关（rho=0.621, p=0.009）；Grad-CAM在12个样本上无法区分对错预测（p=0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据集泛化失效主要来自采集条件分布偏移而非架构差异。强数据增强是简单有效的手段；去背景分割可能有益但证据不足；AdaBN在此场景有害；常见归因工具在小样本下不足以诊断分布偏移。论文提供了严谨的经验基线与可复现资产，为农业计算机视觉的跨域泛化研究提供参考。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 提出在注意力MIL中，对高注意力实例的解释进行统计检验，用选择性推断获得有效p值，证明控一类错误并具更高功效。
AI.motivation: 注意力MIL把高注意力实例当作“关键区域”，但仅凭注意力分数无法判断这些实例是否显著区别于正常，从而影响可解释性与可信度。需要一种在弱监督设定下，对被选中的实例进行有效统计显著性评估的方法。
AI.method: 将“高注意力实例是否异常”的评估建模为统计假设检验：对每个高注意力目标实例，基于特征相似性自适应选取一个代表性的正常参考实例，检验二者差异是否显著。关键难点在于目标与参考均由数据依赖的选择过程产生。为此，引入选择性推断（Selective Inference, SI）框架，显式建模注意力选择与自适应参考选择的选择事件，条件化于这些事件计算有效的选择性p值；并与过度条件化基线对比。
AI.result: 在合成数据与基于MNIST的实验中实现一类错误控制；在病理WSI上展示实用性，并较过度条件化方法获得更高统计功效。
AI.conclusion: 通过将注意力MIL的实例级解释纳入选择性推断，能够对高注意力实例给出具有有效显著性保证的统计结论，在保持Type-I错误控制的同时提升检验功效，增强病理WSI解释的可靠性。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦“视频理解智能体”，梳理从固定的视频-语言推理转向能主动选择与交互的代理式系统的最新进展，并提出统一的代理循环与挑战→设计的分类框架，讨论状态空间/学习范式/监督与评测，并展望面向时间与视频原生的智能体方向。
AI.motivation: LLM在多模态与长时序方面能力增强，但传统固定管线难以应对视频中长上下文、稀疏证据、因果与多模态歧义等挑战，需要能主动取证、记忆与决策的“代理”来提升视频理解的有效性与效率。
AI.method: 提出“视频理解智能体”概念与形式化的智能体循环（感知→构建/更新状态→选择行动→验证/执行→反馈），并以挑战到设计的分类法将关键难题映射到对应机制：用分层证据记忆应对上下文瓶颈，用主动证据获取应对稀疏性，用状态与过程跟踪应对时序因果，用角色分工式多代理协调应对模态歧义；同时综述状态空间建模、学习范式（监督/强化/自监督/指令调优等）、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 系统性地整合并对比现有文献，明确不同任务与挑战下有效的智能体设计要素与训练评测做法，形成一套组织框架与研究地图；给出资源汇总与项目页以便复现与延展。
AI.conclusion: 视频理解需要从被动推理走向代理式、时间与视频原生的建模：更强的层次记忆与状态跟踪、更高效的主动取证、跨模态角色协作与稳健评测体系是关键；未来应探索原生时序代理结构与专为视频设计的智能体学习与基准。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向物理证据的全模态（音频+视觉）字幕框架：构建物理丰富数据、证据对齐评测、并训练Captioner，显著提升捕捉接触/支撑/形变/状态变化等细粒度物理线索的能力，SOTA表现并优于开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态字幕更关注一般语义，忽视转瞬即逝或局部的物理证据（如接触、支撑、形变、状态转变），导致描述不够精细、跨模态物理一致性差。需要一种能显式采集与利用物理证据的统一方案。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：设计流水线自动发现“物理丰富”片段；用OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具，收集可追溯、时空对齐的跨模态证据；其中PPM（Physical Perception Model）在约200万张图像上微调，用于抽取物体交互与状态变化线索。2) 数据集与评测：构建Daily-Physics 50K；提出基于证据驱动的OPC基准，用于衡量生成字幕对物理与跨模态证据的恢复度。3) 训练模型：用上述证据强化数据训练OmniFysics-Captioner。4) 消融：对PPM证据与组件进行消融分析。
AI.result: OmniFysics-Captioner在音视频字幕任务上与Gemini 3.1 Pro相当；在多项视频字幕基准上达SOTA；显著优于其他开源模型。消融显示引入PPM证据能提升物理覆盖度与跨模态描述的细粒度与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 显式采集并对齐物理证据、并以此驱动训练与评测，可显著提升全模态字幕对接触、支撑、形变与状态变化等物理现象的捕捉与表达；所建数据与基准为后续物理感知字幕研究提供基础。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出Fysiverse-3D-SimReady，从单张RGB图生成可物理仿真的多物体场景，经过相机对齐、接触/支撑校正与可微渲染优化，使得场景在物理引擎中稳定并可执行任务。
AI.motivation: 单图3D方法多产出“看起来对”的独立资产，但组装后常与输入相机不对齐、违背重力、物体互穿、在物理仿真中不稳定，无法支撑感知-推理-行动闭环中的可执行交互。
AI.method: 给定单张图像及实例与地面提示：1) 将生成的物体网格放入重力对齐的共享场景；2) 用可微渲染优化各物体的相机空间位姿以对齐输入视图；3) 在场景层面修正支撑与接触关系，消除互穿并提升稳定性；4) 将得到的场景接入代理仿真流水线，把场景特定的任务目标转化为从原相机视角可执行的物理滚动。
AI.result: 相较单图重建与场景生成基线，显著提升输入视图对齐度、接触/支撑可信度与物理稳定性；并首次从单张图实现面向目标的物理交互执行。
AI.conclusion: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady将单图多物体重建从“视觉上逼真”推进到“仿真就绪”，为代理在真实感场景中进行目标条件的物理交互提供可行途径。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.

AI.tldr: 提出PanOVOcc：一个无需训练的全景序列开放词汇语义体素地图系统，在线融合SLAM、感知与长时空间记忆，显著提升占用与语义mIoU，并发布两套全景RGB-D基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视角相机方法覆盖有限；全景方法多为单帧、局部体素预测，难以长期、可查询地累计几何与语义信息。需要一个可持续、开放词汇、全景覆盖的语义占用建图框架与标准化评价基准。
AI.method: 构建PanOVOcc：训练免疫（training-free）的在线架构，联合全景SLAM、开放词汇感知（语言可查询）、以及全局体素记忆。系统将连续全景RGB-D序列中的几何与语义证据持续融合到统一的三维体素地图中，可用自然语言查询。并建立两套配对基准（Pan-Replica、Pan-Holo360D），包含连续全景RGB-D与场景级语义占用真值，覆盖仿真与真实场景。
AI.result: 在Pan-Replica上，相比各指标最强基线，Occupancy IoU与语义mIoU分别提升+20.03与+7.06；在Pan-Holo360D上分别提升+43.26与+20.16。代码与基准将开源。
AI.conclusion: PanOVOcc实现了无需训练的全景开放词汇语义占用长期建图，统一几何与语义并支持语言查询；在两个新基准上大幅优于强基线，验证其实用性与普适性。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.

AI.tldr: PanoFuse通过全景+腕部视角融合与解耦语义/几何路由，缓解传统VLA视野受限与遮挡问题，在多场景操控任务上显著超越基线（平均52.9%成功率）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA多用窄视角相机，缺乏全局上下文，易受遮挡、干扰物与环境变化影响，导致操控不稳定。需要一种能在不破坏任务语义的前提下引入全局全景感知的方法。
AI.method: 提出PanoFuse：在标准VLA骨干外新增全景分支，利用预训练全景基础模型从全向图像提取语义与几何表征；通过“解耦语义-几何路由”(DSGR)保持两种表征为独立上下文流，并以结构化分块注意力选择性路由到下游状态与动作表示，既提供全局空间上下文又保留与任务相关的语义信息；配套同步数据采集，构建含全景RGB、腕部视角、语言指令、机器人状态与动作的真实数据集。
AI.result: 在7种评测设置中，PanoFuse平均成功率52.9%，在新物体、未知背景和强干扰场景下均稳定优于多种基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入全景增强与解耦路由，PanoFuse有效融合全局空间与任务语义，提升在遮挡与环境变化下的鲁棒操控表现，并具备可复现的数据与代码资源。

title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, extracted from final dissertation
summary: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentReRig：用学习到的几何潜空间方向来转移姿态变形，实现跨几何/拓扑角色的变形复用。用SDF-VAE加双解码器：一解重建隐式场，另一解基于源几何与潜变量预测目标网格顶点。实验证明广义关节运动存在可复用的潜方向，可指导未见角色的变形，但局部与校正类变形精度欠佳；改进需更稳的局部条件与更准的网格解码。
AI.motivation: 传统绑定/骨骼/权重等依赖角色特定结构与对应关系，跨角色（几何与拓扑不同）迁移变形困难。作者探究能否不依赖显式绑定，而用学习到的“姿态相关潜方向”作为可复用表征来实现通用变形转移。
AI.method: 构建基于SDF的变分自编码器作为几何潜空间：编码器将几何（可为中性或已变形）嵌入潜向量；两个解码器并联：1）隐式场解码器重建SDF以复原几何；2）变形解码器在给定源几何与潜变形条件下预测目标网格顶点位置。通过对受控的人形数据集训练与分析，比较跨身份的一致潜方向，并与重复SDF采样的基线变异性作诊断对比。
AI.result: 发现多种姿态（尤其大范围的关节动作）在不同身份间诱导出一致、可对齐的潜空间方向，可用于引导未见角色的变形转移；但对局部、细节或纠正性变形的显式顶点预测精度较差。诊断表明：不同身份间的潜距离通常显著大于同几何重复采样的变异；不同姿态信号相对该基线的裕度各异。
AI.conclusion: 存在可复用的姿态相关潜结构，能部分支持跨角色变形转移。要进一步提升，需要（a）更稳定的局部条件建模，（b）更高精度的网格解码。二者是互补改进方向。

title: Where Does the Watermark Hide? Push-Pull Disentanglement for Invisible Watermark Removal
summary: Fixed image distortions do not cover an attacker that learns from paired clean and watermarked images. We study this paired-training threat with single-image inference: deployment uses neither the clean reference nor the watermark key, payload, or decoder. An encoder maps each image to a structural latent $g$ and an auxiliary residual latent $u$. Push supervision reconstructs the watermarked image from $D(g_w,u_w)$. Pull supervision trains the zero-auxiliary output $D(A_g(g_w;k),0)$ toward the paired clean image. At $k=1.10,u=0$, the four-method sweep gives an average BER of $0.3958$, PSNR of $31.07$ dB, and SSIM of $0.9554$. Restoring $u$ from $0$ to $0.15$ moves average BER from $0.3893$ to $0.3357$, while PSNR falls from $30.99$ to $28.23$ dB. The intervention supports decoder dependence on the auxiliary input in the evaluated setting. The accompanying theory is a conditional, post-hoc account of this behavior rather than an experimentally verified information-relocation result.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨一种更强攻击者：可用成对的干净图像与带水印图像训练，并在推理时仅用单张图像。提出结构-残差双潜变量编码与“推/拉”监督，使解码器在无辅助输入时逼近干净图像，在有辅助输入时重构水印图像。实验展示在不同辅助残差设置下BER与感知质量的权衡，并指出理论为事后条件性解释而非信息转移已证实。
AI.motivation: 现有固定失真假设不足以覆盖能够获取成对(干净/带水印)数据并据此学习的攻击者。实际部署常无法访问干净参考或水印密钥/负载/解码器，故需研究仅凭单图像推理的成对训练威胁模型，以及水印系统在此情形下的脆弱性与潜在解法。
AI.method: 构建编码器将图像分解为结构潜变量g与辅助残差潜变量u；解码器D从(g_w,u_w)重建带水印图像(推监督)，并通过对零辅助输入D(A_g(g_w;k),0)施加“拉”监督，使其朝配对的干净图像逼近。A_g以强度k作用于结构潜变量。通过调整k与将u从0提升到0.15，观察解码器对辅助输入的依赖性与性能变化。
