AI.result: 在k=1.10且u=0时，四种方法平均BER=0.3958、PSNR=31.07 dB、SSIM=0.9554；当从u=0恢复到u=0.15时，平均BER从0.3893降至0.3357（更易提取/攻击），但PSNR由30.99 dB降至28.23 dB（感知质量下降）。结果表明在该设定下解码器对辅助输入u具有显著依赖。
AI.conclusion: 提出的结构/辅助潜变量与推/拉监督框架揭示：在成对训练威胁下，即使推理仅用单图像，攻击者也可通过操控辅助潜变量提升水印提取而牺牲图像质量，显示系统的脆弱性。作者的理论解释是条件性的事后分析，并未经实验证实的信息重定位定理，需谨慎解读与进一步验证。

title: Frequency-Domain AI-Generated Image Detection: Exploring Decoder and Channel Attention for Feature Refinement
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Optics, Machine Learning and Emerging Technology (OMLET)
summary: With the rapid progress of AI, the number of AI-generated images has increased significantly in recent years. However, the increasing variety of image generation models makes detection more difficult. In this work, we use Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) representation with EfficientNet-B0 for AI-generated image detection. EfficientNet-B0 provides a lightweight architecture that can be useful for resource-limited applications. Most frequency-domain detectors use a standard encoder to extract features from the FFT spectrum and directly pass them to a classifier. We explored a different approach by investigating ECA, U-Net, and Attention U-Net as alternatives to this direct encoder-to-classifier approach. ECA applies channel attention, while U-Net and Attention U-Net use decoder-based architectures to recover and refine spatial information in the extracted frequency features. We used a balanced subset of the MS COCOAI dataset that includes AI-generated images from five different models. Three runs were carried out for each experiment, and the average values were recorded. Experimental results indicate that EfficientNet-B0 obtained an accuracy of 84.64%, which is 4.50 percentage points higher than the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper. EfficientNet-B0 with U-Net provided a small improvement, achieving an accuracy of 84.85%, while ECA did not increase the overall performance. EfficientNet-B0 with Attention U-Net achieved the best overall performance, with an accuracy of 85.51% and an ROC-AUC of 92.99%. This represents an improvement of 0.87 percentage points in accuracy compared to the EfficientNet-B0 baseline and 5.37 percentage points over the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper.

AI.tldr: 提出用FFT频域表征+EfficientNet-B0检测AI生成图像，并在此基础上引入ECA、U-Net、Attention U-Net改进，最佳为Attention U-Net：Acc 85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，优于ResNet-50与纯EfficientNet-B0。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像激增且模型多样导致检测难度上升；需要在资源受限场景中也可用的轻量、鲁棒的检测器，并能跨不同生成模型泛化。
AI.method: 将图像转换到频域（FFT谱），以EfficientNet-B0作为主干特征提取；比较四种头部/结构：1) 直接编码器+分类器；2) 加入ECA通道注意力；3) U-Net解码器以恢复/细化频域空间信息；4) Attention U-Net在U-Net基础上加注意力门控。使用MS COCOAI平衡子集（含5种生成模型），每个实验重复3次取平均，评估准确率与ROC-AUC。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B0基线Acc 84.64%（比数据集论文的ResNet-50高4.50pp）。EfficientNet-B0+U-Net Acc 84.85%（小幅提升）。ECA无整体增益。Attention U-Net最佳：Acc 85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，较EfficientNet-B0提升0.87pp，较ResNet-50提升5.37pp。
AI.conclusion: 频域特征结合轻量EfficientNet-B0可有效检测AI生成图像；在频域上引入解码器与注意力（Attention U-Net）能进一步提升性能，而单纯通道注意力（ECA）帮助有限。方法在多生成模型场景下展现稳健性，适合资源受限应用。

title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git](https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git).

AI.tldr: 提出SWT：在静态图像上自监督训练的视频目标分割框架，结合滑动窗口对比学习、离散小波变换扩感受野与最优传输做全局匹配，在无需视频像素标注的情况下，在多份VOS数据集上达SOTA级表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VOS需大量逐像素视频标注，且在稀疏场景和全局形变/长距离依赖下适应性差。希望用仅静态数据训练与更强全局/非刚性匹配能力来降低标注成本并提升泛化。
AI.method: 1) 滑动窗口/滚动样本缓冲：跨更新重用重叠的独立采样图像组，进行对比学习以模拟跨帧一致性。2) 小波变换模块：在卷积网络中引入小波分解以扩展感受野与多尺度表征，缓解简单卷积难以长距离建模的问题。3) 最优传输：在伪“帧对”间进行全局代价最小匹配，增强目标在非刚性形变与全局变化下的关联与掩码传播能力。整体在COCO上一次性训练，无需视频标注。
AI.result: 仅用COCO训练的模型，在五个VOS数据集与一个人体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果（文中宣称接近/达到SOTA），表现出良好泛化与对非刚性变化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SWT证明了用静态图像进行自监督训练也能获得强VOS性能；小波扩感受野与OT全局匹配协同提升长程建模与形变鲁棒性，减少对视频标注的依赖。代码即将开源。

title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
summary: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at https://github.com/ElieThellier/high-capacity-robust-medical-image-exfiltration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高容量、鲁棒的神经隐写攻击：将医疗影像以连续潜表示嵌入模型初始化权重中，使模型在受限平台外可从权重重建病人影像，现有轻量化清洗与统计审计难以防御。
AI.motivation: 协作式医疗AI平台限制数据导出，但训练后模型本身可能成为隐蔽载体，泄露受保护的影像数据。现有防御多为剪枝/量化/微调与简单统计检测，对内鬼型外流风险不足，且以往比特级隐写易被干扰、容量受限。
AI.method: 构建基于StyleGAN2的对抗自编码器，将医疗影像编码为连续潜码，并将潜码正则化为与标准权重初始化统计一致；将潜码直接写入模型初始化参数作为“载体权重”。在训练中加入噪声注入以增强对导出端缓解措施（微调、剪枝、量化等）的鲁棒性。载体模型仍能执行原任务，导出后可仅凭权重重建影像。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiTS等多模态与多架构上验证：可在30MB模型中嵌入多达99个脑MRI体数据；在微调、剪枝、量化等干预下仍能恢复，且优于以往比特级方案；重建图像非逐像素精确但解剖结构可辨识。
AI.conclusion: 参数级清洗与基础统计审计不足以阻止模型携带并泄露大规模医疗影像。需要超越参数层面的结构性防御与更强的审计机制，以缓解协作式医疗AI环境中的隐私外流风险。

title: GERIS: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Filtering Instance-Dependent Label Noise in License Plate Data Augmentation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. To appear in AUT Journal of Mathematics and Computing (AUT J Math Comput)
summary: In this paper, we propose GERIS, a game-theoretic framework for instance selection in the data augmentation phase of license plate recognition systems. During augmentation, synthetic license plate images are generated and transformed using stochastic noise to simulate real-world conditions. However, certain noise configurations lead to highly distorted, unreadable images that degrade model performance by introducing instance-dependent label noise. GERIS formulates a non-cooperative game in which each noise vector competes for inclusion in the training set based on its similarity to labeled data and its contribution to model reliability. By identifying and pruning low-quality instances, GERIS improves the overall quality of the augmented dataset. Unlike traditional black-box learning methods, GERIS offers a transparent, theoretically grounded mechanism for data filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that GERIS outperforms existing instance selection methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出 GERIS：在车牌识别数据增强阶段，用博弈论筛选合成样本，剔除由噪声导致的低质、不可读实例，从而提升准确率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 数据增强会引入随机噪声以模拟真实环境，但某些噪声配置生成的车牌图像严重失真、标签不可靠，造成实例依赖的标签噪声，拉低模型性能。需要一种可解释、可理论分析的机制，在增强阶段自动筛除劣质样本。
AI.method: 将每个噪声向量视为非合作博弈中的“玩家”，依据其与有标注数据的相似度以及对模型可靠性的贡献来竞争进入训练集。通过博弈均衡或评分机制识别并剪除低质量实例，从而提升增强数据集质量。方法强调透明、可解释的博弈建模而非黑盒筛选。
AI.result: 实验显示，GERIS 在分类准确率与鲁棒性上优于现有实例选择方法，能有效减少因失真样本带来的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 在车牌识别的增强阶段引入博弈论实例选择可有效过滤劣质样本，提升模型总体表现，并提供比传统黑盒方法更具理论依据的筛选机制。

title: When Retrieval Hurts: Measuring and Explaining Retrieval-Induced Hallucination in Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is an attractive way to improve chest X-ray reporting, because reports from similar prior studies supply clinical context a general vision-language model lacks. We show the same mechanism is a reliable source of clinical error. Over 100 MIMIC-CXR studies with a frozen LLaVA-1.5 generator and BioMedCLIP retrieval, CheXbert clinical F1 doubles under relevant retrieval (0.201 to 0.402) and collapses to 0.043 under clinically mismatched retrieval, a fifth of the image-only score; the retrieval-induced hallucination rate, counting only unsupported findings traceable to retrieved evidence, rises from 0.00 to 0.76 and 0.98. To show this is not an artefact of evidence-set coverage, we introduce a coincidental-overlap control that scores image-only generations against evidence they never saw, placing the chance base rate at 0.18, four to five times below the observed rates. The generator does not merely acquire findings, it transcribes text: 95% of reports produced under relevant retrieval contain an eight-word span occurring verbatim in the retrieved evidence but absent from the reference, against 0% without retrieval. We then explain the mechanism: a normal chest X-ray retrieves at least one abnormal precedent in 24 of 28 cases, because medical image-embedding similarity is dominated by anatomy and acquisition rather than by the presence of disease. This has a direct design consequence. Retrieval similarity does not predict harm (RIH rates 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84 across similarity quartiles), so relevance gates conditioned on embedding similarity cannot work; gating on predicted pathology agreement removes 61% of unsupported evidence at no cost to useful coverage. We argue that retrieval-augmented clinical systems must be evaluated under retrieval failure, not only under retrieval success.

AI.tldr: 论文发现：在胸部X光报告生成中，简单用图文嵌入做检索再让大模型生成，既能显著提高指标，也会在检索失配时大幅注入临床错误与“转录式”幻觉；相似度门控不可靠，应以病理一致性门控，并在评测中覆盖检索失败情形。
AI.motivation: 临床放射报告需要上下文与先验病例。RAG被视为补足通用视觉-语言模型缺乏临床语境的途径，但其在医学场景中的安全性与错配风险未被系统量化。作者动机是：量化RAG在胸片报告中的收益与危害来源，并提出可行的门控设计与评测协议。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-CXR上，固定生成器为LLaVA-1.5，检索器为BioMedCLIP；以CheXbert临床F1评价报告质量；构造三种检索条件：相关检索、临床不匹配检索、无检索（图像仅）；定义“检索诱导幻觉”(RIH)：报告中可追溯到检索证据但不受图像支持的陈述；设立“偶然重叠”对照，将图像仅生成与其未见过的证据比对，估计文本重叠的机会基线；分析嵌入相似度与病灶是否主导的关系，并按相似度分位评估伤害；提出以“预测病理一致性”做门控并测试其对覆盖与错误的影响。
AI.result:
- 相关检索时CheXbert F1从0.201翻倍至0.402；临床不匹配检索时跌至0.043，仅为图像仅的1/5。
- RIH率从0上升至0.76与0.98（在相关/不匹配检索下）。
- 偶然重叠基线为0.18，显著低于观测RIH，排除证据覆盖伪影。
- 95%带相关检索的报告包含至少一个8词的逐字片段，且该片段来自检索证据而不在参考报告；无检索时为0%。
- 正常片常检索到异常先例（28例中24例），因医学图像嵌入相似度更受解剖/采集影响，而非病灶存在。
- 相似度分位不预测伤害（RIH在四分位为0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84）。
- 以病理一致性门控可在不损失有用覆盖的前提下，移除61%的不受支持证据。
AI.conclusion: 医学RAG能提升指标但极易在检索失配时诱发可追溯的临床幻觉，且生成器会“转录”证据文本；嵌入相似度不是有效安全门槛。应采用基于病理一致性的门控，并在评测中纳入检索失败情境，而非只看成功检索。

title: Measuring the evolution of camera distance across a century of film
summary: The rise of computer vision and artificial intelligence has made possible new forms of large-scale computational measurement. We apply these techniques to a deep collection of 5,205 digitized films viewed in theaters between 1922-2025 (covering popular, prestigious, and independent movies) to trace the development of one of the most fundamental ways through which film communicates: by manipulating the space between the camera and its subject. This work finds abrupt changes with the rise of new technologies in sound and television, and allows us to shed an empirical light on gender disparity (women, despite having substantially less screentime than men, are disproportionately the subject of closer shots), and illustrate how animated films both inherit and break free from the norms of live-action filmmaking.

AI.tldr: 用计算机视觉与AI分析1922-2025年间5,205部院线电影，量化镜头到主体的空间（景别）变化；发现声画技术与电视兴起带来突变；女性尽管出场更少，却更常被近景拍摄；动画片既沿袭又偏离真人电影规范。
AI.motivation: 用大规模客观度量方法研究电影如何通过“镜头与主体的空间关系”传达意义，填补以往依赖小样本或主观分析的不足，并检验技术变迁与性别呈现差异。
AI.method: 对5,205部1922-2025年数字化院线电影应用计算机视觉/AI，自动识别与量化镜头景别（相机与主体距离），并按时期、技术节点（有声化、电视时代）、类型（动画/真人）、性别等维度统计比较。
AI.result: 检测到在有声电影出现及电视普及时期，镜头距离分布发生明显跃迁；女性角色虽总体镜头时长较少，却更频繁成为近景/特写对象；动画电影在景别模式上既继承真人片常规，也展现出偏离。
AI.conclusion: 镜头距离作为电影语言核心维度在技术更迭中出现结构性变化；性别呈现存在系统性不对称；动画与真人的规范既连续又分化。研究展示了计算机视觉在电影史与文化研究中的实证力量。

title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
summary: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出LukeNet轻量级CNN与XAI用于IoMT场景下的ALL（急淋）检测与管理，在三数据集与五折交叉验证上达99%准确度并优于多种SOTA与集成模型，且能在边缘设备上高效运行并提供可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有ALL检测需快速准确以便及时治疗；多数CNN方法计算开销大、不适合IoMT/边缘设备；需要在资源受限环境下兼顾高精度、低延迟与可解释性的模型。
AI.method: 设计LukeNet轻量级CNN：采用深度可分离卷积、平衡网络深度与效率、缓解深层梯度消失，兼顾全局与局部特征提取；集成XAI以在显微图像中高亮判别区域；使用3个ALL数据集、五折交叉验证进行训练评估，并与DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16及迁移学习与两个集成模型比较。
AI.result: LukeNet在训练与未见测试集上均达99%准确率，整体优于六种SOTA CNN与两种集成方法；在资源受限设备上具备较低计算与内存开销（文中侧重轻量结构论证）。
AI.conclusion: LukeNet在IoMT智能医疗环境中实现高精度且可部署的ALL检测，并通过XAI提升可解释性；其架构在准确率与算力效率间取得平衡，适合实时患者监测与临床辅助决策。

title: Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery
summary: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/seeheat

AI.tldr: 提出从木材RGB图像直接生成高分辨率热响应的端到端框架：以光学强度映射到体积分数、经FEM合成热数据并用作DINOv3基础上的神经代理监督，实现像素级高精度热推断并绕过昂贵仿真。
AI.motivation: 红外热成像分辨率低且噪声大，难以进行像素级热行为分析；木材热-结构耦合强、三维各向异性复杂，现有方法缺乏把语义外观与热物理量精确连接的手段，制约先进材料装配中的热设计。
AI.method: 1) 物理联系：将木材RGB图像的光强作为细胞解剖导致的局部实心体积分数代理；2) 自动化FEM数据引擎：把像素光强映射为3D热动力学体素网格，生成高保真合成热响应；3) 机理发现：分析厚度向导热均匀/线性与随机两种情形对形态相似性的影响；4) 以合成热响应监督DINOv3基础上的神经代理，学习热力学规律，实现高分辨率热推断。
AI.result: - 若厚度向导热系数均匀或线性：RGB与热响应呈强形态相似，平面内扩散充当低通滤波，抹平高频细节；- 若厚度向导热系数随机：形态相似性破坏，3D结构主导热响应；- 训练后的神经代理能内化热学规律，在无需昂贵仿真的情况下，从RGB高精度推断像素级热场。
AI.conclusion: 通过将光学纹理与热物性建立映射、用FEM合成数据并训练大模型神经代理，实现木材热响应的像素级高分辨率推断，连接语义与热力学领域，为木材与类似多孔各向异性材料的热设计与快速评估提供新途径。

title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 他们提出以“表面匹配”而非体素重叠来评估与训练CCTA冠脉分割，能区分虚假分支与遗漏分支，并通过可微表面损失在多骨干与两数据集上提高表面F1，同时保持Dice不降。
AI.motivation: Dice等体积重叠指标不适合细长管状解剖：多数体素来自近端粗段，远端细分支即使缺失，对Dice影响很小，却严重破坏连通性和临床可用性；且Dice对虚假与遗漏对称，无法区分。
AI.method: 1) 设计基于双边匹配的表面度量：在按局部血管半径设定的容差内，将预测与参考的表面点做二分图匹配，计算精确率、召回率与F1，从而解耦假阳性（伪分支）与假阴性（漏分支）。2) 提出可微的表面损失，将该度量思想用于训练，以同时抑制伪体积并恢复缺失结构。3) 在nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三种骨干上微调，并在Image-CAS与ASOCA两公开基准上做对照实验（匹配训练轮数）。
AI.result: 与仅用Dice训练的强基线相比：新表面度量揭示其“漏多于幻”的非对称错误模式；使用表面损失微调后，在两数据集与三骨干上显著提升表面F1，主要体现在更多恢复远端细小血管分支，同时总体Dice保持相当。
AI.conclusion: 对于冠脉分割，应优先度量与优化“血管表面/连通结构”而非体素体积重叠。表面度量与可微表面损失能更好地指导模型减少漏检并维持连通性，提升临床相关性。

title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary:
Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms.
  The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出PEEL-DDPM，用物理先验与证据学习使扩散重建中的不确定性可辨识，并将总不确定性分解为测量、扩散采样与认知三部分，实验显示区间覆盖与方差校准良好。
AI.motivation: NIG回归从边缘Student-t似然不可辨识，四参中仅三组合可由数据确定，剩一自由度，导致扩散重建中的不确定性分解含糊、难以物理解释与校准。作者希望在扩散模型中实现可辨识、可物理解释的不确定性量化，并避免手调损失权重。
AI.method: 先训练并冻结测量条件的DDPM（epsilon-MSE）。对每个观测，执行完整反向扩散得到重建；其与已知训练对象的残差由最终图像证据网络（evidential head）建模，仅学习Student-t可辨识坐标。通过重复扫描噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹，做嵌套蒙特卡洛估计最终图像的随机（aleatoric）方差，并分解为扫描器诱发与采样器诱发两部分。利用实测方差解开NIG剩余歧义，实现对测量、扩散与认知（epistemic）不确定性的分解。采用顺序训练，无需跨损失加权系数。
AI.result: 在8个留出对象上，名义50/80/90/95%区间的经验覆盖率为49.3/80.3/90.1/95.6%；均方残差为预测方差的0.967倍；单图像aleatoric头与独立嵌套参考的合并Spearman相关0.785。跨5个剂量层级，扫描器诱发方差的对数-对数剂量斜率为-1.15，采样器诱发方差近乎与剂量无关，斜率-0.01。
AI.conclusion: PEEL-DDPM在扩散式图像重建中实现了NIG参数的可辨识化与物理可解释的不确定性分解，校准与覆盖良好，且训练流程简单实用，为临床/工程中的剂量依赖分析与不确定性管理提供了可行路径。

title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
summary: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向设备端小型视觉语言模型（~0.5B参数）的诊断驱动后训练流程，并配合视觉token策略，兼顾准确率、效率和行为可靠性：在保持高精度的同时显著缩短首token延迟（从138秒降到6.1秒，约23倍），并降低“厄环”生成风险。
AI.motivation: 仅仅把VLM做小并不足以在手机等设备端可用：即使模型很小，首token延迟仍可能超过两分钟。真实可用性取决于准确率、效率与行为可靠性三方面，而现有基准常忽视第三点（答案过短难暴露厄环，提示过温和难测安全）。需要一种能系统发现并修复小模型行为失真与安全问题的训练范式。
AI.method: 提出“诊断驱动”的后训练：用教师VLM对学生模型进行压力测试，自动挖掘超出人工先验的失败模式，并将这些失败转化为有针对性的监督与偏好对齐数据，结合常规数据扩展进行“以错促优”的优化。同时设计两种视觉token策略，形成两个精度-效率取舍的变体。
AI.result: 在相同架构与token预算下，NanoFull在17项基准的归一化平均分达到62.3，较基线提升+7.4，且厄环（doom-loop）率不高于最强基线；FlashFull在得分61.4的同时，将Pixel 9上的首token等待从138秒降至6.1秒（约23×）。
AI.conclusion: 通过教师驱动的失败发现与定向对齐，结合视觉token策略，小型VLM可同时提升精度、推理效率与行为可靠性，显著推进其在移动端的实用性。

title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

AI.tldr: 提出GazeEarth：在固定像素预算下，将问句引导的证据区域经拓扑保持的“中心注视”重采样到固定画布，使局部放大、周边压缩，用最多两次冻结MLLM调用即可显著提升UHR遥感问答表现。
AI.motivation: UHR遥感图像需要兼顾全局上下文与局部细节，但视觉输入预算有限。现有方法要么基于相关性打分裁剪token/patch（丢失连贯全景），要么反复裁切回看（与上下文割裂、代价高）。作者发现冻结MLLM能提出有用的空间关注请求，但传统裁切式检查并不稳定提升答案，因此需要一种在整幅图内重新分配像素的方式。
AI.method: 将UHR理解表述为“在固定像素预算下该把像素花在哪里”。框架GazeEarth包括：1）从索引化总览图中由问句引导选择“证据单元”；2）对原图执行确定性、保持拓扑的warping，将证据单元及其邻域在固定大小画布上放大、将远周压缩（类似注视/中心凹采样）；3）在该聚焦视图上用同一冻结MLLM作答。全流程训练免、无需外部选择器与迭代搜索，最多两次模型调用。
AI.result: 在三个UHR遥感基准与四个冻结MLLM主干上，相比直接作答提升平均准确率4.6–9.4个百分点，相比仅用总览作答提升3.4–4.3个百分点，并超过若干任务特训方法。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的MLLM已能自发指引“看哪儿”，而其推理效能强烈依赖证据呈现方式。通过问句引导的区域选择与全景内的注视式重采样，能在固定像素预算下高效提升UHR遥感多模态理解，无需训练与复杂搜索。

title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
summary:
We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.
  We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

AI.tldr: 论文复盘一个已部署的AI生成图像检测“堆叠集成”系统：3个开源检测器输出5个分数，用梯度提升元学习器融合，并将检测器失效当作缺失值处理。事后对三项应先做的对照实验进行评估，修正了早先结论：跨域直接套用的融合不比最佳单模型强；同域重训的融合略胜；小样本域上无法得出显著结论；缺失与相关失效被元模型错误处理；数据集存在严重JPEG头部类条件偏差。
AI.motivation: 原先部署了一个常规堆叠集成用于AIGC图像检测，但缺少关键对照与鲁棒性检验，导致结论可能失真。作者回头补做控制实验，验证：融合是否值得、域外/域内拟合差异、在小规模新域的可判别性、缺失与相关失效的影响、以及数据集偏差对评估的污染。
AI.method:
- 模型：3个开源检测器→5个分数；梯度提升元学习器做融合，缺失值视为NaN。
- 评估：
  1) 跨域：用在异域语料训练的元模型测试于2000张StyleGAN人脸，与最佳单模型比较（AUC与McNemar检验）。
  2) 同域重训：在目标域重拟合堆叠，与“最佳单模型+后校准”比较（ΔAUC与置信区间、p值）。
  3) 小样本域：80张截图，比较AUC区间是否包含0.5及与单模型差异区间。
  4) 缺失/失效：分析检测器集体沉默与相关失效；检查元学习器对全NaN输入的异常高P(AI)。提出基于两种不同架构达成法定人数(quorum)的规则以避免失效。
  5) 数据偏差：发现Corpus A存在类条件JPEG头部偏差，可仅凭头信息分离类别，影响所有域内指标的可信度。
- 工程：发布代码、评测框架、哈希标识的产物与更正。
AI.result:
- 跨域：已部署的元学习器不如最佳单模型（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961；McNemar p=1.000）。
- 同域重训：重拟合堆叠略优于“最佳单模型+后校准”（ΔAUC +0.0025，CI [+0.0014, +0.0038]；p=3.4e-4）。此前声称单模型最好是混淆了评估体制，现予更正。
- 小样本域：在80张截图上所有模型AUC区间含0.5，无法声称有判别力；堆叠相对最佳单模型的跌幅区间为[-0.185, +0.115]。
- 缺失/失效：4/5检测器沉默且幸存者报“真实”时，系统仍输出P(AI)=0.9985；因元学习器从未见过缺失，给全NaN输入打0.9995。三份AIDE检查点因共享预处理而共失败。引入“至少两种不同架构达成一致”的法定人数规则，无需重训即可避免两类失效。
- 数据偏差：Corpus A存在严重类条件JPEG偏差，限制了所有域内结果的外推价值。
AI.conclusion:
- 融合并非免费午餐：只有在目标域内重训，才可能相对最佳单模型获得小幅增益；跨域直接套用不如用最强单模型+校准。
- 单一语料的高分并不可靠；小样本或域移情况下，AUC不显著即不能下结论。
- 必须显式建模缺失与相关失效；在训练中覆盖缺失模式，或用结构化规则（如跨架构法定人数）防止灾难性输出。
- 数据集应严查类条件偏差（如JPEG头部差异），否则评估被污染。
- 发布代码与更正以推动可复现与正确对比。

title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
summary: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

AI.tldr: 论文发现DAiSEE课堂情绪识别的类别不均衡是“按维度而异”的，而非常见的整体长尾问题；提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS），在可控不均衡的维度做四分类、在极端长尾的维度做二分类，并用空类占位压缩逆频权重范围，大幅稳定多任务训练；在极轻量网络上获得全维度最高Macro-F1，并显示策略比单纯放大骨干更能提升少数类识别，同时指出数据集在少数情绪上的标注密度限制。
AI.motivation: 现有课堂情绪识别受严重类别不均衡影响，且主流做法默认各情绪维度可统一处理；作者认为DAiSEE中的不均衡具有维度特异性，导致统一的重加权、focal loss或统一二值化在不同维度上失效，需要按维度自适应的策略。
AI.method: 提出AHLS：对不均衡可控的维度保留四级分类，对极端长尾的维度改为二分类；在多任务框架中引入“空类占位”与自适应损失加权，将最大有效逆频权重比从约79×压到≤8.5×；使用轻量FERShuffleNetV2+LTCN作为骨干进行验证，并与SOTA深度模型与传统方法对比；同时进行跨模型行为分析与对数据集标注密度的诊断。
AI.result: 在仅0.39M参数、0.07 GFLOPs的模型上，于DAiSEE四个情绪维度取得平均Macro-F1=47.70%的最佳成绩，优于11种对比方法（含参数量大至其167×的SOTA）；显示分类策略对少数类识别的提升作用强于单纯扩大骨干；发现DAiSEE在少数情绪状态上的标注密度不足，可能限制进一步进展。
AI.conclusion: 类别不均衡在DAiSEE中具有维度特异性，需采用按维度自适应的标签与损失设计；AHLS稳定了多任务优化并提升总体与少数类表现；未来改进应同时关注策略设计与基准数据的注释质量与密度。

title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EgoTSR框架，让VLM在自我视角任务中以“状态证据”而非时间顺序来判断进度，并通过新基准、数据与训练课程显著降低输入顺序偏置，长时程准确率达92.4%，前后顺序差仅0.1。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM擅长静态理解，却难以可靠评估任务进度，常受时间呈现顺序影响；而真实操控存在回退与重试，进度非单调，需要基于目标条件的状态比较能力。
AI.method: 1) SpatialLogic-Bench：对同一状态对进行正序/倒序评测，短/长时程，检测是否依赖顺序捷径。2) 数据管线：将成功近似单调的操控与第一人称轨迹转为双向监督；LongTag保留中间子任务结构用于长时程；加入失败感知数据覆盖回退与恢复。3) 课程学习：先用CoT监督抽取基于证据的任务相关状态变化，再用仅标签的大规模训练巩固比较规则（CoT-to-Tag）。
AI.result: 发现主流VLM存在显著输入顺序偏置。EgoTSR在长时程任务比较上达92.4%准确率，正反序Gap仅0.1；在非单调轨迹上，失败感知监督使准确率提升11.8个百分点、恢复准确率提升11.2个百分点，同时保持通用视觉与空间能力。
AI.conclusion: 将“面向目标的状态比较”明确化为自我视角时空推理问题，通过基准、数据与课程式训练可显著缓解顺序偏置并提升对回退/恢复的鲁棒理解能力。

title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需校准的基于通用光度立体（Universal Photometric Stereo, UPS）神经网络的方法，从视觉触觉传感器图像估计接触表面法向；在多种传感器与控制实验中达到与校准方法接近的角度误差（约6.6°–10.7°），显示跨传感器可迁移性与对高频纹理的恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 传统高精度法向/深度估计依赖以已知几何探针逐点压痕进行传感器特定校准，成本高、流程繁琐且难以在不同形状与光学系统的触觉传感器间迁移。需要一种能在不同传感器上通用、减少或消除校准依赖的方法。
AI.method: 利用通用光度立体神经网络从单次或多次照明下的触觉图像直接回归接触面法向，无需为每个传感器进行物理探针校准；以合成数据训练并在真实传感器上测试，涵盖平面与穹顶（Digit 360）等不同光学设计与照明配置。
AI.result: 在三种不同光学系统的触觉传感器上均能稳定估计法向：金属球控实验中平均角误差约6.56°，自然纹理物体整体平均角误差约10.66°；在穹顶型Digit 360上相对经校准基线的角度差约10.18°，表明在恰当照明下仅用合成数据训练也可获得可靠法向估计与高频细节恢复。
AI.conclusion: UPS为不同视觉触觉传感器提供统一的接触面表示与无校准法向估计能力，显著降低部署成本并促进触觉感知在不同传感器间的可迁移性与可扩展性。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
comment: 23 pages. Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GE-RPE来解决全景360°场景理解中因相机旋转导致的分割性能骤降问题，通过对相对位置偏置做有限循环群Cn上的Reynolds平均，实现无参数、低延迟的规变不变性；结合教师token置换π_R与iBOT+MAE的EquiSSL框架，显著提高旋转稳健性与低标注微调效果，并在深度估计与零样本分割上同样有效。
AI.motivation: 现有基于球面的Transformer（如SphereUFormer）对摄像机旋转极其敏感，90°旋转可致分割准确率下降超过一半。消融显示，根源在于相对位置偏置的规范（gauge）依赖性，即模型对坐标系选择不等变/不不变，破坏了几何对称性需求。需要一种在不增加参数和显著开销的前提下，使相对位置编码对旋转具有规等变/不变性的方案。
AI.method: 提出GE-RPE（Gauge-Equivariant Relative Position Encoding）：对相对位置偏置在SO(2)的有限循环子群Cn上做参数无关的Reynolds平均，使偏置对这些离散旋转规不变；理论上与连续SO(2)平均的误差为O(n^{-2})。将GE-RPE无缝接入SphereUFormer骨干；另提出教师token置换π_R，使自监督多视图（SSL）中教师与被旋转的学生帧对齐；整合iBOT+MAE预训练，形成EquiSSL（GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE）。
AI.result: 部署无新增参数，推理延迟仅+1.5–4.4%。在相同三种随机种子下，加入GE-RPE的模型在旋转压力测试下降幅仅1.3%，而已发布的SphereUFormer检查点在不同训练配方下下降达53%。引入π_R并配合iBOT+MAE后，EquiSSL将下降收紧到0.8%，验证集mIoU达68.30%。在1%标注微调中，测试集（N=373）提升+2.39 mIoU，较小验证集（N=40）提升+4.10。方案同样提升单目深度与Structured3D零样本分割表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过对RPE进行Cn上的Reynolds平均并对齐SSL视图，消除了规范依赖，显著增强了360°球面Transformer对旋转的稳健性和低标注可迁移性；方法零参数、低开销、可证明Cn不变且逼近SO(2)平均，成为全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移的实用基础组件。

title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
summary: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.

AI.tldr: 提出3DGS-SC数据集与基准，专门评估3D高斯泼溅在屏幕内容上的可读性，发现高影像保真度并不等于可读文本。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS评估多以整幅图像保真度（如PSNR）为主，忽略屏幕区域文本可读性，导致方法选择可能失真。需要一个可控的数据与协议来拆解整体保真与可读性之间的差异。
AI.method: 构建受控静态屏幕内容数据集3DGS-SC：10个程序化场景，提供固定多视角划分、精确相机、屏幕掩膜、文本框与转录。评测协议分离四项：整图保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR可读性、边缘保留。用五种方法对比并统计方法两两排序一致性。
AI.result: 在示例对比中，LightGaussian的屏幕PSNR仅比Mip-Splatting高0.08 dB，但OCR准确率却低12.7个百分点；在10组方法对中，屏幕PSNR与OCR排序有7组不一致。显示仅凭保真度指标的评估会误导方法选择。
AI.conclusion: 高图像保真不必然带来可读屏幕文本。3DGS-SC为屏幕内容提供了可控、精确标注的评测基准，补充文本感知3DGS研究；但其场景鲁棒性与采集影响仍待进一步验证。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出HGPTrans，从车辆表面网格直接快速预测阻力系数C_D，结合GNN卷积、物理感知切片注意力与层级池化，在DrivAerNet系数据集上误差最低、推理0.293秒，较CFD快数个数量级，并具备良好迁移到实车（轿车/SUV）。
AI.motivation: CFD精确但计算代价高，不适合早期造型阶段的大规模方案筛选；车辆气动受局部几何与远程相互作用共同影响，需要既能编码细节又能捕捉全局依赖、且高效可扩展的模型。
AI.method: 提出层级图池化+Transolver注意力的图网络：1）Graph Isomorphism Convolutions提取判别性的局部几何特征；2）基于物理切片（沿流向等）构造的线性复杂度全局注意力，捕捉相距较远表面区域的相互作用；3）考虑信息冗余的层级池化，逐步移除冗余节点、保留关键结构。并在DrivAerNet/DrivAerNet++训练评估，并做迁移学习到实车数据。
AI.result: 在基线中取得最低MAE与MSE；迁移到包含轿车与SUV的实车数据集时，相对L1误差分别为1.56%与2.12%；单车推理约0.293秒，相比高保真CFD加速数个数量级，同时维持与CFD参考相差在数个百分点内。消融显示三大组件均有贡献，并分析网络深度与池化率的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans能以近实时速度从表面网格准确预测车辆阻力，兼顾局部与全局气动效应、具备良好泛化与工程适用性，为早期造型与大规模设计探索提供高效替代CFD的工具。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出UNMATCH方法，通过方向性多尺度覆盖（Directional Multiscale Coverage, DMC）对图像-文本（主张）对的局部对应关系进行紧凑表征，解决“图文错配/断章取义/视觉篡改”识别中全局打分掩盖关键局部不一致的问题；在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上取得SOTA水平（Macro-F1 69.82、平衡准确率71.05），并通过配对重置实验验证表征的因果关联。
AI.motivation: 现有图-文配对检测器要么将两模态压缩为单一全局相容分数，要么使用高度灵活的交互模块；二者都可能“淹没”决定性局部错配信号，尤其在图像断章取义或经过局部篡改时。需要一种既能捕获局部不一致、又能以低成本融入全局判别的表征。
AI.method: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖（DMC）表征：在三个空间尺度上，分别计算图→文与文→图两个方向的局部亲和度覆盖统计。每个尺度、每个方向提取：均值、下四分位数、以及两个阈值化支持比（support ratios）；再计算两方向均值的带符号差，构成每尺度9维描述子；三尺度串联形成紧凑的局部表示，并与轻量级全局-局部分类器结合（UNMATCH）。采用“泄漏感知”的三折三种随机种子评测协议。
AI.result: 在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上，UNMATCH获得Macro-F1 69.82与平衡准确率71.05，超过MCOT改编版分别2.60与2.16点。干预实验（matched-reassigned）显示：打破真实图文配对会降低覆盖、提高差异度，并增加被判为假配对的概率。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑且可解释的方向性多尺度覆盖能有效捕捉图-文局部错配信号，优于依赖全局压缩或高自由度交互的方案；其统计特征与“真配对/假配对”的变化呈一致因果趋势，表明方法稳健、可推广于图文错配检测。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: PSP-DiT 将“全景场景程序”作为一等潜变量，与图像潜变量联合扩散去噪，通过实例对齐与循环一致性目标显著提升合成中计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系与长复杂提示的正确性，同时保持画质与推理开销可控。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在组合性理解方面薄弱，如实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间与角色关系等；以外部控制或事后解析难以稳健对齐文本-视觉的细粒度约束。
AI.method: 提出 PSP-DiT：在扩散-Transformer架构中，将“全景场景程序”作为与图像并行的潜变量流，使用耦合的 Transformer 双流联合去噪；通过全景落地（panoptic grounding）和循环一致性损失将对象、属性、关系、计数与生成画面中的视觉证据强绑定；训练与推理一致，支持不完美场景程序的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在与强基线（仅平面文本）相同设置下，于 GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score、DetailMaster 上全面提升，尤其在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系、长结构化提示方面收益最大；图像质量基本不降，推理仅有小幅开销。
AI.conclusion: 将场景程序升格为一等潜变量并与图像潜变量耦合联合去噪，可系统性缓解文生图中的组合性失配问题，在保持画质的同时显著提升可控性与一致性，并对不完美程序具鲁棒性。

title: SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows
summary: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

AI.tldr: 论文发现3D CT报告生成模型在“隐状态→文本”阶段丢失了已捕获的异常信息，并提出SelfCue对比式解码与其蒸馏版SelfCue-KD以减少信息流失、提升临床有效性与LLM评估分数。
AI.motivation: 现有提升多依赖更复杂架构与更大数据，但作者观察到模型隐状态已包含丰富异常信号，真正的损失发生在将隐状态解码为文本时，导致临床关键信息遗漏，需一种方法在生成时更好地显化隐状态中的证据。
AI.method: 提出SelfCue：基于对比式解码，鼓励与隐状态支持一致的候选、抑制不被隐状态支持的内容；并进一步将该解码行为蒸馏到模型权重，形成无需额外推理开销、可无缝替换基线的SelfCue-KD。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE 18类异常上，隐状态层面的宏AUROC为0.848，而最终报告文本仅为0.739，表明显著的信息流失。应用SelfCue后，临床效能F1提升至0.481，LLM判定的GREEN得分提升至0.510。SelfCue-KD在无需额外推理负担的前提下保留了大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 关键瓶颈在解码阶段的信息流失。通过对比式解码将隐状态证据“自我提示”到文本层，并通过知识蒸馏固化该行为，可在不更换架构或增加推理开销的情况下显著提升临床与LLM评估表现。

title: Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images
summary: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

AI.tldr: 参赛系统针对0.025 BPP极低码率的AIGC图像压缩，将感知质量与比特率在多候选之间全局最优化：用四个速率专用的一步扩散编解码器检查点生成候选，含一次带熵条件刷新 的编码端TTO细化，实际rANS熵编后，以多选背包在真实文件大小上择优，解码端再接零额外比特的残差恢复网络。最终在LoViF 2026测试集以0.02495 BPP取得PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390，DISTS第二、总榜第5。
AI.motivation: AIGC图像包含字体、合成边缘、重复纹理、UI布局与风格化微纹理，传统失真导向编解码在极低码率会抹除这些结构；而无约束生成式解码虽能补细节却可能与原始几何/符号不匹配。需在极低全局码率下平衡语义与结构的“率-感知”分配问题。
AI.method: 1) 以AEIC一步扩散编解码器，微调得到四个“码率专用”检查点；2) 对每幅图从四模型均生成候选，其中一条通过编码端测试时优化(TTO)并周期性刷新熵条件以稳定码长；3) 对所有候选用实际rANS熵编码得到真实比特流大小；4) 在数据集全局预算下用精确多选背包在真实文件大小上选每图唯一比特流；5) 解码端统一接一个固定、零额外比特的残差恢复网络；6) 保证每条提交比特流可由发布解码器独立解码，无需原图或外部信息。
AI.result: 在挑战测试阶段得分31.527739；客观指标：PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390，平均码率0.02495 BPP。DISTS指标为排行榜第二，综合排名第5。
AI.conclusion: 多候选与全局背包选择在超低码率AIGC压缩中有效提升感知质量与结构一致性；零比特残差复原进一步增强感知。受限于架构，PSNR难与传统率失真法持平，作者给出消融与负结果供后续改进。整体方案在严格码率预算下实现可独立解码与强感知表现。

title: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
summary:
Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

AI.tldr: 提出SURGE外科基础模型，在3千万+帧的SurgSpectrum-30M+上预训练，跨5类任务15基准系统评估标注效率；在所有基准上刷新SOTA，并揭示任务依赖的标注规模规律：场景理解少量标注即饱和，细粒度推理需更多标注持续提升。
AI.motivation: 外科AI面临专家标注昂贵且稀缺的问题，尽管自监督基础模型在少标注适配上表现良好，但不同外科任务之间的“标注效率”差异与扩展规律尚未被系统量化和理解。
AI.method: 构建最大规模的外科视频预训练数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+（>3000万帧），训练通用的自监督外科基础模型SURGE；在5类任务、15个基准上统一评测，覆盖时间/空间场景理解、器械-解剖交互的细粒度推理与安全关键操作；对比任务特定模型与SOTA，并进行标注预算-性能的扩展实验以刻画标注效率。
AI.result: SURGE在全部基准上优于现有SOTA，甚至在复杂推理任务上超越任务特定模型；实验显示不同任务对标注规模的敏感性不同：场景理解任务用很少标注即可达到饱和，而细粒度推理任务在更大的标注预算下仍持续提升。
AI.conclusion: SURGE作为大规模预训练的外科基础模型，实现全面SOTA并提供任务依赖的标注扩展规律；该规律为在复杂外科领域如何分配有限专家标注资源提供实践蓝图；发布模型检查点与代码以促进后续研究。

title: SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

AI.tldr: 提出SynDORBench：首个以物理约束为基础、与人类视觉DORI标准对齐的LVLM感知鲁棒性基准；系统操控距离/光照/视角/像素密度，含5.4万QA；并给出可扩展的可辨识度标注框架。评测17个LVLM与YOLO11x，发现像素密度与成像物理约束主导感知失败，小模型在远距低光下可胜过大商业模型与YOLO；为现实感知约束下的系统性对比与与人类阈值对照提供范式。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态评测多假设理想成像，对相机距离、照明、视角、像素密度等物理条件如何影响语义可恢复性缺乏刻画；需要与人类可见性标准对齐的基准来评估LVLM在真实受限成像条件下的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建SynDORBench：基于可控的合成数据管线，系统改变观看距离、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，并以可物理解读的像素密度分档（DORI标定）生成>54k问答；提出可辨识度标注框架，以掩码条件的统计特征与集成学习，将人类感知标签在低可见性样本上扩展；在递增退化条件下评测16个开源LVLM、一个商业LVLM与YOLO11x，涵盖有人体存在分类与动作识别。
AI.result: 发现LVLM的感知失败主要由像素密度与成像物理约束决定，而非仅由模型规模决定；多款紧凑开源LVLM在远距离与弱光条件下优于更大的商业基线，且显著强于YOLO11x的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SynDORBench确立了以物理约束与人类可见性标准为锚点的多模态评测新范式，能系统分析LVLM在真实感知约束下的可靠性，并实现与人类可见性阈值的直接对照与模型间公平比较。

title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

AI.tldr: 提出CueKFS：一种用于长视频问答的无训练关键帧选择方法，通过动态生成与问题相关的“视觉线索”分配采样预算，较现有方法在多基准上显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 传统关键帧选取多依赖与问题的直接相似度，难以处理需要多主体/多时刻组合或隐含信息的问题；基于子查询分解的方法又因静态初始上下文导致分解不准。需要一种能在视频中主动探索、动态修正查询表示的机制。
AI.method: 1) 从视频中获取初始显著帧；2) 将问题分解为一组视觉线索（cues）；3) 每条线索并行在视频中检索其证据；4) 利用具推理能力的VLM依据证据自我修正、扩展或删除线索，实现“能动”重探索；5) 根据幸存线索的重要性与证据质量，分配关键帧预算，输出问题相关的关键帧集合。方法无需训练，仅依赖推理式VLM调用，调用次数控制在较低水平。
AI.result: 在三个基准、27个可比设定上取得SOTA，预算平均提升最高达+4.54%，且中位VLM调用仅为2次；行为分析显示，能动线索精炼可带来相对相似度最高+92%的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将问答匹配转化为“帧-线索”对齐并引入能动的线索迭代，CueKFS在长视频问答中实现更高效且鲁棒的关键帧选择，兼顾性能与计算成本。

title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
summary: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现施工场景中机器人难以检测“低姿态”（弯腰/下跪）工人：数据管线的质量过滤与检测器本身共同导致低姿态样本稀缺且易被漏检，因此仅依赖边界框或姿态信息无法有效进行长尾人类数据的整理与扩充。
AI.motivation: 施工机器人需要可靠地感知各类人体姿态以保证安全与协作，但自动标注与数据筛选流程常忽略弯腰、下跪等“低姿态”工人，导致训练数据长尾与漏检风险。
AI.method: 构建检测-关节估计（NLF）-姿态聚类的管线；统计“低姿态”在保留样本中的占比并分析质量过滤器（基于检测置信度与关节不确定性）的影响；设计四种替代姿态线索（边界框形状、垂直身体跨度、与场景竖直方向对齐的姿态聚类、图像外观）评估过滤偏差；在可控仿真场景中测试并微调基于公共施工数据集的人体检测器，比较在匹配站立者高度的条件下对低姿态的召回。
AI.result: 低姿态仅占约2%的保留样本；四种替代线索一致表明质量过滤更频繁地拒绝低姿态；即使控制边界框高度，微调后的检测器在仿真中对低姿态仍显著漏检。
AI.conclusion: 低姿态在数据中稀缺且难以被现有检测与过滤流程发现；仅依赖边界框或姿态进行长尾样本整理不可行，需针对低姿态的专门采集、更鲁棒的过滤与检测策略。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向医学影像报告生成的“可验证推理”框架：将解剖区域、检测框与区域级文本描述纳入推理链，并结合空间与事实奖励，用强化学习在SFT之上进一步减少幻觉并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: SFT侧重与参考报告的词面相似，难以保证临床正确性，导致幻觉；而RL在可验证奖励领域效果显著，但在开放式医学任务上应用受限，且既有方法只评估最终答案，忽视推理过程本身的正确性与可视化对齐。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基座，先进行医学域SFT，再通过“冷启动SFT”引入结构化推理能力；设计结合解剖区域与检测框的视觉对齐链路与区域级文字描述，构建空间奖励（视觉定位/区域一致性）与事实奖励（临床事实正确性），在RL阶段同时验证推理步骤与最终输出；并分析RL中的奖励黑客模式。
AI.result: RL在SFT之上带来额外提升；同时验证“推理步骤+最终输出”优于只验证其一；识别出多种奖励黑客模式；模型生成的结构化思维轨迹提升了解释性与可审计性。
AI.conclusion: 将可验证推理融入医学报告生成能有效降低幻觉并提高临床可靠性；联合空间与事实奖励、同时约束过程与答案，是优于单点监督的路线，且结构化思维轨迹有助于临床审核与部署。

title: PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement
comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/jianhai-zhang/RredRA
summary: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

AI.tldr: PredRA提出将确定性预测作为基准，再对残差进行受控的生成式细化，兼顾逼真度与感知质量，实现高效、稳健的医学图像翻译。
AI.motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，目标的大部分可被源图像确定性预测得到，但纯确定性方法会抹平细节；生成式方法能补细节却可能引入无用或有害的随机变化。需要一种既保真又具备感知细节、同时可控且高效的方案。
AI.method: 将残差生成视为一个受约束的优化问题：先用确定性网络得到稳定参考；在生成式残差建模中进一步提取可确定成分，并对不可可靠估计的体素级残差采用全局控制门控，只允许有限度的随机细化注入；采用32步的flow采样器，较1000步DDPM显著减采样步数；整体框架实现“确定性成分提取 + 受控随机细化”。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，相比完全残差细化，受控细化能更贴近成对目标，同时保留生成式方法的感知优势；在模型规模与效率上，PredRA以1.4–11.9倍更少总参数、3.1–26.2倍更少可训练参数达到或超越SOTA性能；32步采样比匹配的1000步DDPM少31.25倍采样步数。
AI.conclusion: 通过把残差生成过程形式化为可控优化并融合确定性与随机成分，PredRA在医学图像翻译中实现快速、保真且具感知质量的结果，减少不必要不确定性，并以显著更小、更高效的模型达到竞争或更优表现。

title: Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在常规硬件上运行的混合量子-经典人脸识别流程：经典预处理+八量子比特可变参数量子分类器+经典匹配；在大型数据集上优于CPU版FaceNet，且训练更高效，并在真实考勤场景中具备鲁棒与低时延。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限（尤其仅有CPU）的环境中，人脸识别需要更高效的训练与推理；现有混合量子方法在此场景研究不足，需验证其在现实硬件与部署中的可行性与优势。
AI.method: 构建混合管线：对图像进行伽马校正、对比度增强、PCA降维；将特征编码到8量子比特的变分量子分类器（VQC）中进行二分类/特征判别；随后用经典图像匹配完成身份识别。对比CPU训练的FaceNet基线，并在CPU、GPU与量子硬件上评测；在真实考勤系统中进行部署测试。
AI.result: 在包含5万张图像（CelebA人脸2.5万与CIFAR-10非人脸2.5万）的实验中，所提方法在准确率与训练效率上均优于报告的CPU版FaceNet基线；实际部署中CPU推理0.2–0.5秒/人，对佩戴眼镜具有鲁棒性；亦完成在GPU与量子硬件的评估。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子-经典方法在现有CPU硬件上可行且有效，能在资源受限场景实现具竞争力的人脸识别，为量子辅助视觉在真实应用中的落地提供了证据。

title: CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena
summary: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

AI.tldr: 提出CaptchaArena大规模细粒度交互式验证码数据集与统一9B策略模型CaptchaAgent，通过SFT+RL在20类、5种交互模式上达到71%+ Pass@1，并泛化到外部基准，显示大规模计算机使用监督对交互式验证码代理的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式验证码数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度及轨迹监督之间存在权衡，缺乏可执行验证与细粒度标注，限制了统一、多类型交互代理的训练与评测。
AI.method: 构建CaptchaArena：包含5万道题、20种验证码类型、5种交互模式；每个解答经环境执行验证；提供等量截图-动作轨迹，其中4.6万带逐步推理标注，并对不规则目标给出像素级掩码。基于此，训练单一9B策略模型CaptchaAgent，先监督微调（SFT），再利用环境验证器作为奖励进行强化学习（RL）优化，同一策略覆盖全部类型。
AI.result: SFT达到70.5的Pass@1，经RL提升至71.7；同时在两个外部基准上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、可执行验证的交互数据与统一策略结合SFT+RL能显著提升交互式验证码求解能力与泛化。作者开源数据集与模型，为后续研究提供标准化环境与强基线。

title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
summary: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 研究分析2011-2021年CNN与福克斯新闻近70万条图文片段与两项预注册实验，发现：女议员在新闻中更常被置于分屏而非独立镜头；静态分屏降低对女议员的政治胜任感评价（对男议员无影响）；动态视频中该效应消失，但“愤怒语调/措辞”对女议员“温暖度”打击更大；女性观众在看到女议员独立出镜后，外在政治效能感略有提升（边缘显著）。
AI.motivation: 女性在国会与电视新闻中的可见度与权威感受限，但既有研究多关注“是否出现”，较少探究“如何被呈现”的视觉框架效应。本研究旨在揭示视觉呈现方式如何系统性影响公众对女议员能力与特质的判断。
AI.method: 1) 大规模计算机视觉+文本匹配：对2011-2021年CNN与福克斯新闻695,464个图文片段进行人脸识别与镜头类型判定，比较女/男议员在独立镜头与分屏中的出现比例；2) 两项预注册实验（N=6,220）：a) 静态画面条件测试分屏 vs. 独立镜头对政治胜任感的影响及性别差异；b) 动态视频条件测试分屏与情绪化（愤怒）语言对胜任感与温暖度的影响。
AI.result: - 观察性证据：女议员显著更常出现在分屏而非独立镜头中。- 静态实验：分屏降低受众对女议员政治胜任感的评价，对男议员无显著影响。- 动态实验：分屏的胜任感惩罚不再显著；相反，愤怒语言显著降低对女议员的温暖度，影响幅度约为男议员的三倍。- 探索性结果：女性受众在观看女议员独立镜头后，自报外在政治效能感略增（p=0.057）。
AI.conclusion: 新闻视觉框架不仅影响女议员被看见的方式，也影响其被认为“能否胜任”与“是否温暖”。分屏在静态环境中削弱对女议员能力的感知；在动态情境下，情绪化语言对性格特质（温暖）造成性别不对称伤害。提升女议员的独立镜头呈现，或有助于提高女性观众的政治效能感与对女议员能力的认可。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 研究比较不同空间粒度的视觉-语言预训练目标在胸部X光任务中的影响，发现任务粒度与预训练粒度在极端情况下最匹配，但不存在通用最优目标；目标类型、粒度与任务三者交互决定下游表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言预训练（对比学习、描述生成等）在监督信号的空间粒度上差异显著，但其对胸片解读（从全局分类到局部异常检测与报告生成）的系统性影响缺乏对照研究。需要在控制编码器与数据不变的条件下，隔离“预训练目标”这一因素，明确何种目标更适配不同粒度任务。
AI.method: 固定同一编码器与同一预训练数据，系统训练九种预训练目标，覆盖全局与局部对比学习、图文描述生成（captioning）及其组合；随后在五类按空间粒度递增的胸片任务上评估，包括全局分类、问答与报告生成、分布内与零样本设置，以及更细粒度的异常检测等。
AI.result: 1) 在粒度极端处出现匹配：局部目标在异常检测上最佳，全局目标在图像级分类上领先；2) 局部目标在全局级生成与VQA上意外具有竞争力；3) captioning与对比学习的优劣随粒度而反转；4) 组合目标中，“captioning+对比学习”对分类与分布内生成最强，而“两个captioning目标”的配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最好。
AI.conclusion: 不存在单一通吃的预训练目标；下游表现由目标类型、监督粒度与任务粒度的相互作用共同决定。应依据目标任务粒度选择或组合预训练目标，并在临床应用中权衡分类、检测与生成等不同需求。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

AI.tldr: 提出一个无需共享原始图像的联邦式视觉读表框架，用于多场景多类型指针式仪表读数，并发布MeterFL数据集与评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现实中指针表计分布在不同站点与环境，表型多样、标签稀缺且数据因隐私与治理限制难以集中，现有自动读表方案需为每个场景单独开发，维护成本高。需要一种在不汇聚原始数据的前提下，能适应多域、多表型且可协作学习的读表方法。
AI.method: 提出四阶段端到端读表管线：（1）表盘定位；（2）细薄结构分割（跨客户端进行联邦训练）；（3）极坐标展开；（4）刻度计数解码得到最终读数。引入联邦学习以在多站点间共享模型更新而非原始图像。提供MeterFL数据集：1,382张带掩膜标注图像，基于视觉属性按确定性规则划分伪客户端；分割训练/测试间用dHash控制近重复。评估分割质量与端到端读数精度。
AI.result: 在MeterFL上验证了联邦训练的细结构分割及整体读表流程的有效性，报告了分割性能与端到端读数准确率，相较于非联邦或单站点训练在多域设置下更稳健（摘要中未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 联邦式读表框架在不共享原始数据的前提下实现跨站点协同学习，提升了多环境多表型的通用性；MeterFL为该问题提供了系统化评测基准与数据资源。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO是一个多模态、无监督的世界模型，联合利用相机/激光雷达/毫米波雷达作为输入与自监督信号，预测4D占据、障碍分割、流场与激光雷达点云；无需人工标注，跨数据集在占据、流、LiDAR预测与零样本道路障碍分割上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有开放集感知/占据建模常受限于单一或双模态与有监督标注，难以分割长尾或未知障碍物，且对动态场景的时空一致性与4D理解不足。需要一种能在无标注条件下，从多传感器互补信息中学习，统一预测占据、运动与障碍的世界模型。
AI.method: 构建多模态世界模型TriO：以相机、LiDAR、RADAR为输入，并将它们同时作为自监督信号来源。通过跨模态对齐与时空一致性约束，联合学习4D占据（体素/时序）、障碍物分割、流场以及LiDAR预测。关键是新颖的自监督方案，使模型能从可驾驶区域中识别并剥离任意占据（含长尾未知）。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2与Spotting the Unexpected等数据集上，TriO在3D/4D占据、光流/场景流、LiDAR预测等任务上取得SOTA，并在零样本道路障碍分割上显著优于现有开放集方法，尤其在长尾目标上更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 利用三模态互监督可在无标注下学习统一的4D世界模型，显著提升占据、运动与障碍理解，并有效解决开放集与长尾问题，具备跨数据集的泛化与零样本分割能力。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
