comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出Depth Any Seen，以多伯努利（Multi-Bernoulli）深度集合建模同一视线上多个可见表面的存在与度量深度，并用无辅助的ExactMB目标通过边缘化一对一匹配来同时学习“是否存在”和“多层深度”。在多数据集上显著减少过预测，同时保持序关系与度量误差。
AI.motivation: 单幅图像在同一光线方向上可能穿过多层可见表面（遮挡/半透明/层叠结构），传统深度或层深方法易发生过预测或无法可靠区分“存在”与“深度”。需要一种既能建模目标数目不定、又能联合学习存在性与精确深度的概率化表示与训练目标。
AI.method: 将每条射线的潜在表面集合表示为“图像条件的多伯努利深度集合”：每个组件要么产生一个深度样本（该层存在），要么缺席。训练时使用Exact Multi-Bernoulli（ExactMB）目标，对所有一对一组件-目标分配进行精确边缘化，以无辅助监督同时学习存在概率与度量深度。分析发现仅匹配期望计数会造成组件-表面对应不确定。提出在真实与合成的分层深度基准上评测深度准确度、支持恢复与过预测；并进行有序分配与计数正则等消融。
AI.result: 相较深度堆叠（depth stacking），ExactMB在LD-Real上将过预测相对减少88.2%，在MD-3K上减少80.5%，同时保留大部分序关系准确度；在LD-Syn上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示：有序分配较完全边缘化可提升深度相关的召回与精度；而加入计数正则的配置在召回较低时获得更高的深层级（更高rank）的精度。
AI.conclusion: 多伯努利集合表示结合ExactMB训练，能在多层可见场景下有效联合估计层的存在与深度，显著抑制过预测且不牺牲序与度量精度；不同分配/正则策略在召回-精度与层级精度上提供可调权衡。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ScreenHaystack 是一个用于评估 GUI 定位（grounding）空间可靠性的动态“草堆找针”基准，通过在高分辨率界面背景上系统重定位相同目标图标，检测模型在不同位置的一致性并揭示“盲区”。它发现多款前沿模型在特定空间区域准确率骤降；这种盲区可迁移，且与训练数据空间覆盖不均有关。作者提出面向盲区的数据增广策略，显著提升 ScreenSpot-Pro 上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测常固定目标位置，难以诊断模型是否在不同屏幕区域保持一致定位能力；实际应用中 GUI 元素位置多变，若模型存在空间盲区会严重影响可靠性。因此需要一个能系统操控目标位置、衡量空间一致性并分析错误来源的基准。
AI.method: 提出 ScreenHaystack：在高分辨率 GUI 背景上，将受控目标图标在网格/多位置上系统重定位，保持目标视觉外观与指令不变，测量各位置的定位准确率并绘制空间性能地图；在真实基准 ScreenSpot-Pro 上验证盲区可迁移性；通过合成数据控制训练空间覆盖度，分析盲区成因；提出“盲区导向增广”，向盲区区域添加监督/样本，与原始与随机增广的 Click-100k 微调进行对比。
AI.result: 多款领先模型（如 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus）均存在明显盲区；在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上，处于盲区内的目标更难被定位，Qwen3-VL-8B 准确率下降达 16.1 个百分点；通过受控重定位验证：将目标移入盲区降低准确率、移出则提升；合成实验显示训练数据空间覆盖不均会诱发盲区；采用盲区导向增广后，ScreenSpot-Pro 表现优于原始与随机增广的 Click-100k 微调。
AI.conclusion: GUI grounding 模型存在系统性空间脆弱性（盲区），其来源与训练数据空间覆盖不均相关。ScreenHaystack 提供了诊断与量化该问题的工具；面向盲区的定向数据增广是一种简单而有效的缓解策略，可提升跨界面与真实任务的定位可靠性。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: 提出ControlGS：将XR渲染后的后处理与显示光学链路纳入端到端优化，并在运行时依据下游参数动态生成高斯原语，从而稳定提升XR端到端视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯渲染（3DGS）默认下游后处理与显示光学不会劣化质量，或无法随运行时变化自适应；而XR中相机位姿、功耗/亮度预算等会动态改变后处理与光学效应，导致最终到眼图像与渲染输出不一致，需端到端建模与自适应。
AI.method: 构建ControlGS管线：显式建模从渲染输出到人眼的完整“后处理+显示-光学”链路，并将其集成进损失函数进行端到端优化；在推理阶段，根据运行时下游处理参数（如相机姿态、显示功耗限制等）条件化，动态生成/调节高斯原语，以匹配当前管线；兼容多种神经高斯后端，额外开销小。
AI.result: 在多数据集与不同神经高斯骨干上，ControlGS相较传统3DGS稳定提升经后处理与光学后的端到端XR图像质量，同时保持最小化的计算/延迟开销。
AI.conclusion: 端到端建模并条件化自适应下游处理是提升XR视觉质量的关键；ControlGS实现了这一点，能够在实际运行条件变化下持续提供更高的到眼画质，且易集成、成本低。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前文档AI是“无状态”的：每次处理新文档都从零开始，无法保留先前的结构、模式和经验；作者提出“持久、证据可溯源的文档状态”作为统一框架，并设计审计与基准来评估跨会话的状态演化与风险收益。
AI.motivation: 现实业务中，合同、修订、表格等文档具有持续性与版本演化；但现有系统仅作为一次性函数，处理后不保留知识，导致重复成本高、无法检测矛盾、难以积累经验。现有手段（扩参数、加上下文、检索增强）无法把观测固化为可治理的知识状态，形成“无状态瓶颈”。
AI.method: 1) 形式化提出“持久、证据支撑的文档状态”（persistent evidence-grounded document state）框架，定义将多模态证据转化为可持久、带溯源链接的状态所需的操作与不变式；2) 进行“有状态性审计”，以8项有状态性标准对10个代表性基准进行编码，显示其未测试跨会话状态演化；3) 提出纵向基准测试工具，包含5个反事实度量：经验增益、成本效率、记忆伤害、遗忘保真度、覆盖保持，以衡量持久状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
AI.result: 审计结果表明现有基准普遍忽视跨会话状态；提出的纵向基准与度量为评估持久状态系统的效用与副作用提供了操作化路径；总结出当前文档AI缺少把持久状态与文档原生结构、来源溯证与时间有效性相耦合的机制。
AI.conclusion: 文档AI的下一个阶段将由系统在跨文档、跨会话、跨时间所能“保留什么”所定义；需构建可持久、可溯源、与结构/时间对齐的状态，并用新基准全面评估其收益、成本与风险，以突破“无状态瓶颈”。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: 提出ReFM，一种与源网格无关、能量引导的渐进式运动重定向方法，通过SO(3)规范化、对比学习的跨角色语义编码和流式优化，在无高质量配对数据下兼顾语义一致、物理可行与时间连贯。
AI.motivation: 现有重定向常把预测限制在“复制的动作”附近，初始解夹杂骨架比例与几何失配带来的伪迹；且一次前馈直接回归唯一目标不合理，因重定向本质欠定，需要在语义保真与目标角色的物理/时序约束间权衡。在缺乏高质量配对数据时，如何稳定学习语义并设定无偏的优化目标是核心难题。
AI.method: 将重定向表述为渐进式细化。1) SO(3)全局朝向规范化，去除冗余朝向变化；2) 以对比学习预训练跨角色语义编码器，获得角色无关的动作表示，用于优化引导与语义评估；3) 通过学习的flow对初始目标动作进行多步细化，联合能量项（语义一致、物理可行、时间连贯、最小修改）进行引导。框架可接入多种初始化（直接复制或Autodesk HumanIK）。
AI.result: 在无配对或弱配对场景下，相比直接回归/复制或仅IK方法，ReFM能更好地保持源动作语义、减少由骨架差异导致的伪迹，并在物理与时间上更平滑一致；兼容工业IK初始化并进一步改进其结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义对比表征与能量引导的渐进式细化，重定向无需依赖高质量配对监督即可在语义保真、物理可行与时序连贯间取得更优平衡，提供通用、可与现有管线集成的解决方案。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 论文提出将隐写信息嵌入2D高斯表示的参数（而非像素）中：用密钥选取并微调部分高斯参数来编码8位消息；在合成与自然图像上保持高保真重建且正确密钥可零误差解码，错误密钥解码接近随机。
AI.motivation: 2D高斯作为新型图像表示正流行，而传统像素域隐写在新表示里未被充分探索。作者希望在高斯参数域实现隐写，以获得更好的可转移性、隐蔽性与重建质量，并验证密钥安全性（错误密钥应近似随机）。
AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合2D高斯表示；用秘密密钥从参数中选出子集，并对选中参数（对数各向异性、不透明度、颜色亮度）进行受控微调以嵌入8位载荷；同时约束PSNR损失；用正确/错误密钥分别解码，比较BER；并评估随机选参 vs. “最小扰动”选参策略；在合成与112张自然图像（256×256，4096个高斯）上实验；还测试在去除亮度通道、仅用两类参数的降配设置（保留256个高斯）。
AI.result: 合成图30次拟合：正确密钥BER=0，错误密钥BER≈0.543；“最小扰动”选参比随机更稳健（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。自然图112张：正确密钥BER=0.000，错误密钥BER≈0.520。降配实验（去除亮度，仅两类参数、256高斯，9次拟合）：正确密钥仍BER=0，错误密钥BER从≈0.514升至≈0.571。
AI.conclusion: 在2D高斯参数域进行隐写可在极低视觉代价下实现可靠零误差解码；错误密钥解码接近或偏离随机，显示一定的安全性；基于“最小扰动”的参数选择优于随机；即便减少可用参数类型，系统仍可无误解码，但错误密钥BER可能偏离0.5，提示安全性与可用参数维度间的权衡。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出CausalDriveBench，一个基于Pearl因果层级的自动驾驶视觉-语言-行动模型因果推理评测基准，涵盖关联、干预、反事实与因果发现，通过因果场景图、结构化QA与替代轨迹验证揭示现有模型并不具备可靠因果理解。
AI.motivation: 当前驾驶VLA能输出自然语言推理和轨迹，但其推理是否反映场景因果结构未被系统检验；需要将感知显著性与因果相关性区分，并在行动层面验证推理的因果一致性。
AI.method: 构建基于nuScenes的因果场景图，标注致因（active）、休眠（dormant）与干扰（distractor）实体；围绕Pearl因果层级四阶生成结构化视觉QA，并为高阶（干预、反事实）提供指定场景改动下的参考替代轨迹；形成7,285对经验证因果QA与1,000条反事实轨迹；评测10个驾驶VLA与3个通用VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型QA准确率仅70.6%，13个模型中有4个低于随机；与共享语言骨干的通用VLM相比，驾驶微调在因果QA上带来2–34个百分点损失，差异由后训练设计导致；跨模型因果QA与轨迹准确度统计上不相关，反事实提示下轨迹易过度反应或退化为原场景基线。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的语言“合理化”或在观测场景中的高轨迹精度都不能证明因果理解；应采用因果层级覆盖的QA与行动级别验证共同评测，并重视训练与后处理设计以避免牺牲因果推理能力。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 提出PruneForget：用待遗忘样本指导剪枝，同时实现机器遗忘与模型剪枝，达到接近从头重训再剪枝的效果。
AI.motivation: 现实中模型既要满足用户/合规的遗忘请求，又受推理时延与内存预算约束。现有工作多将遗忘与剪枝割裂、顺序执行，造成互相不知情与效率/效果折损。作者观察到：编码被遗忘样本信息的参数本就是应删除的目标，遗忘与剪枝在“删除参数”这一点上天然一致。
AI.method: 提出PruneForget：利用“待遗忘集”作为剪枝信号，优先定位并裁剪承载被遗忘信息的参数，使两过程联合优化、相互促进；适用于分类器与生成模型。
AI.result: 在多组图像分类与生成任务上，PruneForget既能有效消除被遗忘样本影响，又能显著压缩模型、降低推理开销；与“先从头重训完成遗忘，再剪枝”的理想Oracle相比，性能差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模遗忘与剪枝优于分步处理：用遗忘集引导剪枝能同步满足合规性与资源约束，几乎不损精度与遗忘效果。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: 提出PQR3D：在参考条件的时间窗口内进行逐步查询精炼，无需持久记忆即可实现随机采样与独立推理，并在nuScenes上达SOTA（NDS 71.6 / mAP 64.9）。
AI.motivation: 现有相机多视角3D检测需要跨帧维护查询状态，训练需按序、推理需按时间顺序，带来内存耦合、部署复杂与鲁棒性不足的问题。作者希望在保留时序上下文收益的同时，打破对“持久查询记忆”和顺序推理的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 参考条件时间窗口：围绕目标帧构建短时窗口，不依赖全局持久状态；2) 逐步查询精炼：将早期时间戳的高置信、经运动对齐的查询逐步传播到目标帧；3) 掩码自注意力：对常规、传播、去噪三类查询的交互进行约束，并将去噪监督与检测查询解耦；4) 阶段解耦的锚点嵌入：在自注意力前只注入位置，在其后再注入尺寸、朝向、速度，降低时间不一致属性的干扰；5) ViT-L作为骨干网络实现。
AI.result: 在nuScenes测试集上达到新的SOTA：NDS 71.6，mAP 64.9；支持随机帧采样与独立推理，无需序列感知训练或持续查询内存。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D通过窗口内的渐进式、参考条件的查询传播与掩码自注意力、阶段解耦锚嵌入，兼顾时序信息利用与推理独立性，显著提升相机-only多视角3D检测性能并简化训练/部署。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: OneFixer是一种单步自回归视频扩散“修复器”，专为3D高斯喷溅在自动驾驶仿真中的渲染缺陷进行低时延修复，在保证高画质与时序一致性的同时，显著简化训练并提升闭环驾驶安全性。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在自动驾驶仿真中渲染效率高但存在视觉伪影与时序不稳；自回归视频扩散可在渲染时进行修复，但单步因果生成极易将误差累积到后续帧。现有方法依赖多阶段训练与复杂蒸馏/正则化，单步质量与部署效率仍不理想。
AI.method: 提出OneFixer：仅用一次、面向任务的适配训练。核心是“与部署一致的共享rollout”：用模型自己的一步预测作为因果上下文进行flow matching训练，同时对同一rollout施加像素级感知监督以保细节。由于用于当前帧质量优化的预测也将作为未来上下文被复用，因而同时学到保真与自回归稳健性；无需双向到因果转换或师生蒸馏。额外融合车道几何与动态体状态等仿真可得先验以提升几何一致性。
AI.result: 在Waymo及自有道路场景的900帧rollout中，OneFixer在单步设置下取得最低FVD、LPIPS、DISTS，并在时序一致性上达到或超过多阶段DMD流水线；在相同骨干与条件下，训练GPU小时不到DMD+Self-Forcing的一半且继续提升而后者停滞；闭环仿真中相较原始3DGS渲染将碰撞率降低约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 与部署一致的共享rollout和直接像素感知监督，使OneFixer在单步自回归下同时获得高保真与稳健时序，一步到位替代多阶段管线，效率更高、指标更优，并带来实用的驾驶安全收益。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种资源高效的联邦学习框架，用于在受限边缘设备上训练大规模三维高斯喷溅模型，通过自适应轻量化与结构一致性恢复，在不暴露隐私的前提下实现高效聚合与快速收敛。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting在大场景重建中高效高保真，但边缘侧训练受限于通信/算力/GPU显存，且本地模型结构不一致难以聚合，并存在原始图像与相机参数泄隐风险，需要一种兼顾资源约束与隐私的跨设备训练方案。
AI.method: 1) 设备端模型轻量化：基于高斯点重要性评估进行自适应选择与剪枝；提出“重要性-时延比”准则，在显存与算力/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量。2) 模型恢复：在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复各本地3D-GS的结构一致性，使其可有效聚合为全局模型。3) 在联邦框架下迭代训练与聚合。
AI.result: 实验显示，相比最先进的联邦3D-GS基线，该方法显著加速收敛，在保持高渲染质量的同时降低训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 通过面向资源约束与隐私保护的轻量化与结构一致性恢复机制，可在无线边缘高效训练大场景3D-GS，全局模型更快更稳且渲染质量不降。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出双耳音频-视觉实例分割（BiAVIS）任务与模型，利用双耳空间线索与查询级音视融合，在两套新标注基准上显著优于单声道AVS，尤其缓解同类实例歧义（mAP+17.22%，FSLA+7.71%）。
AI.motivation: 现有AVS多基于单声道与语义对应，难以区分外观相似、同类别的多实例；而人类依靠双耳差异与头部/耳廓滤波获取稳定的空间定位线索。作者据此引入能利用物理空间听觉信息的任务与方法。
AI.method: 1) 定义BiAVIS任务：输入同步双耳音频+视频，输出发声音源的实例级分割。2) 构建两套基准：对现有双耳数据集手工标注，并采集更具挑战性的真实场景数据BiAVIS-Bench。3) 模型：先用“仅音频”的声源定位网络，从双耳音频学习发声实例的空间与语义先验；再通过查询级音视融合，将这些先验注入实例分割解码器，实现实例级分割与消歧。
AI.result: 在两套基准上，BiAVIS显著优于单声道AVS方法，特别是在同类多实例场景中更准确；在更困难的BiAVIS-Bench上，较最佳单声道基线mAP提升17.22%，FSLA提升7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 利用双耳空间线索与查询级融合能有效缓解AVS中的实例级同类歧义，BiAVIS任务与基准促进该方向研究，方法在真实复杂场景中显著提升性能。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: KeyRec 是一个无需训练的视觉记忆构建框架，通过“近景精细缓存+历史事件库”的双存储与文本路由读出，在仅用约10%的视觉token预算下，显著提升长视频/流式理解的压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频/流式场景中视觉token随时长线性累积，导致VLM长上下文推理成本高昂。现有训练免token选择虽能降开销，但易丢失事件连贯证据，且难区分“近期细节”与“远程历史”。需要一种在不重算历史帧的前提下，既保留近期细粒度，又结构化保留历史要点的记忆机制。
AI.method: 提出 KeyRec：训练免、查询无关的写入与查询自适应读出。写入阶段：将最新观测高保真缓存到“视觉缓存”，并将更久远的证据组织为“事件库”；依据相对既有事件的新颖度提出候选事件，并用在线的添加-合并-驱逐策略维护。读出阶段：当问题到达时，用仅文本路由器在固定读出预算内自适应分配从“近期缓存”和“事件库”的读取比例，无需重新处理历史帧。KeyRec直接操作面向模型的视觉嵌入，兼容模块化编码器-投影器VLM与无编码器/投影器的NEO-ov架构。
AI.result: 在4个流式与长视频基准、3个VLM骨干上，KeyRec在15个设定中有13个获得最佳压缩性能，仅用约10%的解码端视觉token预算；在实时问答上较最强压缩基线提升2.21–18.37分；在6个长视频设定中有5个最佳；在所有 NEO-ov 2B 设定中均为最优。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec以训练免、低预算的双记忆与文本路由方案，有效兼顾近期细节与长程事件连贯性，在多基准与多骨干上取得稳定领先，表明结构化事件记忆与自适应读出是长视频VLM压缩推理的有效途径。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出面向高分辨率多物种植物影像的领域内自监督基础模型：用MAE+ViT在千万级多视角图像小块上分布式预训练，并在稀监督与复杂成像条件下显著提升密集预测与全局识别性能，优于在自然图像上预训练的对照；扩大预训练规模进一步提升迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 植物高分辨率影像像素大、条件多变且像素级标注昂贵，现有通用基础模型在密集特征表征与迁移上存在明显领域差距，限制了科学分析的可扩展性。
AI.method: 构建领域内数据集（>1000万多视角植物图像tile），采用Masked Autoencoder结合ViT骨干进行自监督预训练，使用分布式训练扩大规模；随后在多种下游任务上系统评测，覆盖少标注、跨视角与分辨率退化情景，比较与自然图像上预训练的MAE基线。
AI.result: 在密集预测任务上获得Mean Dice=0.8686、Pooled Dice=0.8959，较自然图像MAE基线分别提升0.0694与0.0613；实验显示预训练规模扩大带来持续的迁移增益，并在复杂成像条件与有限监督下保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 面向科学高像素影像，扩大领域内自监督预训练能显著缩小领域差距，提升可迁移的密集表征；建议未来继续扩大数据与模型规模，并在更多科学场景验证。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 他们提出一个消除污染的病理VQA基准（CleanSlide）和一种成对偏好学习方法（Pair-DPO），用真实反事实幻灯片对来分离并量化模型对图像证据的使用，显著提升VLM对病理证据的依赖与外部泛化表现。
AI.motivation: 现有病理VLM多以准确率评估，但准确率无法区分模型是否真正利用了图像证据，可能混杂数据集污染、题干/选项线索与先验知识。作者在淋巴结转移预测的动机实验中发现：输入整张切片、病灶框或不输入图像，模型表现差异很小，提示模型并未有效使用图像证据。
AI.method: 1）构建CleanSlide：基于TCGA的VQA多选基准，9,985张切片、149K经审计问题；在题目与图像两侧严格去污染与去捷径，病人与组织来源分割互斥，并审计选项捷径、题干泄漏、跨分割重复与盲可解性。2）提出Pair-DPO：在同一问题与同一来源的反事实切片对上进行偏好学习，抵消题目相关信号，仅保留图像证据为偏好来源；每对为真实且验证的相反发现切片，避免编辑伪影与不可靠标签，覆盖弥散或分级特征（如侵袭、坏死、肿瘤分级）。
AI.result: 在CleanSlide上，相比最佳公开模型仅2.81%的“图像证据增益”，本方法实现15.29%的增益；在外部CPTAC与BCNB队列上分别达57.6%与59.0%准确率，较次优模型分别高9.7%与3.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过CleanSlide与Pair-DPO，可有效剥离题目与污染因素，使VLM更依赖真实病理图像证据并获得更强外部泛化；基准与代码将开放，有望成为评测与训练病理VLM的更可靠范式。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出并系统研究了文本到图像模型在比喻语言下的“载体入侵”错误，构建VISTA基准与V-Score评测，并给出轻量缓解方法VISTA-Guard，显示该问题跨语言与多种修辞类型普遍存在。
AI.motivation: 当前TTI模型在直白描述下表现优秀，但遇到隐喻/转喻等修辞时常把“载体”（vehicle）误当作应显现的物体，而非服务于“本体/喻体”（tenor）的视觉引导，导致评测中“有无呈现”的忠实度指标无法识别此类错误。需要有针对性的基准与指标来揭示并度量这种角色错配。
AI.method: 1) 构建多语言基准VISTA：以修辞“形式”(Figurative Form)与“映射机制”(Mapping Mechanism)组织比喻式提示，标注本体与载体的角色要求；2) 提出角色感知的诊断式问答指标V-Score，通过QA评估生成图像对本体与载体角色的忠实度（特别是是否发生载体入侵）；3) 在多种最新高性能TTI模型上评测；4) 作为轻量缓解，引入推理时或提示层面的VISTA-Guard策略以减少载体入侵。
AI.result: 实验显示：主流TTI模型在多语言、多个修辞类别下均存在显著的载体入侵问题；V-Score能有效揭示常规存在导向评价未能检测到的角色错配；VISTA-Guard能在一定程度上降低入侵率，但并未完全消除。
AI.conclusion: 视觉呈现并不等于真实的语义忠实度；应采用角色感知的评估来衡量比喻理解。VISTA与V-Score为系统研究与诊断提供了工具，而VISTA-Guard提示了可行的低成本改进路径；该问题仍是开放挑战，资源将公开以促进行业改进。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: 提出MOXAI，一种整合甲基化与拷贝数数据的可解释多组学深度学习框架，用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分型；多模态优于单模态，XAI可定位关键CpG/基因/染色体区域，结果与已知分子特征一致。
AI.motivation: 现有模型常将DNAM与CNV分开分析，未发挥互补信息；缺乏类内风险评估与可定位至特定基因座的可解释性方法。需要一个既能融合多模态、又能提供生物学可解释性的分型框架。
AI.method: 基于TCGA队列，分别在甲基化、CNV及二者融合数据上训练ResNet50、DINOv2与GAT；构建基于CAM与Grad-CAM的XAI以定位与决策相关的CpG位点、基因与染色体区域；并进行交叉验证与独立验证评估泛化能力与可信度。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅CNV模型；DINOv2在独立验证集中泛化最佳，达到94.25%准确率（置信度>0.9）；XAI热图指向与成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型已知分子特征一致的基因组位点。
AI.conclusion: 整合DNAM与CNV的MOXAI在分型性能和生物学可解释性上均优于单模态方案，证明多组学融合与基于CAM/Grad-CAM的定位可为临床分型与潜在风险评估提供支持。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: Devol-ONE 将视觉、语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成融合到单一自回归框架中，通过与V-JEPA动力学流的联合自回归与层层跨流注意，持续用语义与物理预测塑形动作专家，较分离式WAM与传统VLA在多套机器人基基准与真实双/单臂上显著提升；消融证实动态流预测与层级统一注意的关键作用。
AI.motivation: VLA直接从当前视觉与语言上下文生成动作，缺乏对“候选动作将如何改变场景”的显式建模；现有WAM虽预测未来状态，但预测模块与策略学习架构分离，仅通过像素视频或独立潜在预测输出相连，限制了语义、物理与动作决策的深度耦合与互塑。
AI.method: 提出 Devol-ONE：一种“Transformer混合体”MoE式架构，单一自回归地联合三任务——视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测、动作生成。核心做法：1) 双流自回归：在视觉语言流与经V-JEPA预训练的动力学（潜在）流上联合滚动预测；2) 层层跨流注意：在每层对视觉语言KV缓存进行注意，使动力学预测在语言指引下外推未来潜在状态；3) 动作专家在线塑形：动作头持续接收语义与物理动态的联合信号，而非一次性固定表示；4) 通过混合/门控专家提升表达与训练稳定。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0及Flexiv真实单臂与双臂平台上取得显著提升（文中称“广泛实验”）；消融显示：去掉动态流预测或去掉层级统一注意都会显著退化，验证架构一致性与关键模块有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型预测与策略学习在同一自回归Transformer中深度融合，能让动作决策被语义理解与物理动态共同持续塑形，优于“预测-策略分离”的WAM与传统VLA范式；动态潜在预测与层层统一注意是性能提升的关键。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

AI.tldr: 提出ASK方法，将大型视觉-语言模型的相似性偏好蒸馏到CLIP，使其以紧凑图像嵌入进行高效检索，同时保持图文能力；通过核匹配与分布锚定、低秩适配器联合更新视觉与文本编码器，显著提升跨域检索并保留零样本识别。
AI.motivation: VLM能做相似性判断，但输出不可直接作为高效可比对的紧凑嵌入；现有做法或需访问教师嵌入/新增标注，或损伤CLIP的图文对齐与识别能力。需要一种无需额外人标与教师特征、可控且保持图文能力的蒸馏/微调方案。
AI.method: 提出ASK（核驱动steering）：1）在小规模图像组内，从VLM提示获得成对偏好，构造正定目标核；2）以视觉核匹配为主任务，并加入图文分布锚（保持CLIP的image–text能力）；3）对视觉与文本编码器加入低秩适配器（LoRA样式）并联合训练，同时以冻结CLIP为正则化目标；4）训练后仅用CLIP图像嵌入和余弦相似度做检索，无需再调用VLM；5）通过prompt控制教师判别准则，从而选择学生学习的区分维度。
AI.result: 在5个图像域、4个CLIP骨干、6个评判者上评测：对ViT-B/16，未参与适配类别上的检索mAP从53.8提升到75.0，优于以DINOv2+KL锚定的71.7；联合适配视觉与文本编码器后，12个基准与5个适配域平均零样本精度从61.8%升至62.4%；人标评估显示可按提示选择学习的视觉差异。
AI.conclusion: ASK能把VLM的相似性偏好转移到CLIP，得到可高效比较的嵌入并保持/小幅提升零样本能力；方法无需访问教师嵌入与额外人标，支持基于提示的准则特异学习，适用于跨域检索与可控相似性建模。

title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
summary:
Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes.
  Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接在3D点云xyz坐标上进行盲水印的端到端方法，使用八叉树网络联合学习嵌入与提取，在无原始数据的情况下可在物体级与场景级可靠恢复消息，并在常见几何处理下保持鲁棒与低失真。
AI.motivation: 点云是核心几何表示，但其不规则、无结构且常被重采样/预处理，导致难以确权与追踪。现有水印多依赖网格、法线或需原始参考，且对常见几何扰动与姿态变化不够稳健。需要一种对大规模点集有效、对常见处理鲁棒且无需原始数据的盲水印方法。
AI.method: 设计端到端盲水印框架：在xyz坐标上嵌入消息并通过仅观察到的点云进行解码。采用基于八叉树的前馈网络实现多尺度几何推理与高效处理大点集；训练中加入随机几何变换层（重采样、噪声/滤波、尺度/扰动等）以暴露解码器于常见处理；通过渐进式姿态对齐增强对姿态变化的鲁棒性；联合学习嵌入器与解码器。
AI.result: 在物体级和场景级基准上，方法在常见几何处理后仍能可靠恢复消息，同时几何失真低；定性比较显示，学习到的点位扰动更不显眼、空间结构性更弱，优于手工设计方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于八叉树、联合训练并结合随机变换与渐进姿态对齐的点云盲水印框架，可在无需原始参考的条件下对大规模点集实现稳健、低可感知度的水印嵌入与提取，适用于对象与场景级应用。

title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出GSFM：以单一条件速度场对整段未来骨架轨迹做流匹配生成，兼顾多样性与物理一致性（骨长不变、关节关系、时空耦合），在AMASS上效果佳并可零改动迁移到Human3.6M。
AI.motivation: 人体运动预测需同时满足：未来轨迹多样且与已观察动作一致，并服从骨架物理与关节时空依赖。现有方法常分别处理姿态、短时间片，或难以保持骨长与跨时间协调，且在多样性与准确性间权衡不足。
AI.method: 构建时空骨架图，将整段未来轨迹作为图节点（关节×时间）。用空间与时间注意力在图上消息传递，耦合相邻关节与跨时间步依赖。以条件流匹配（flow matching）学习单一条件速度场来“运输”轨迹：从以最后观测姿态为中心的随机轨迹，经测地路径流向真实未来。骨段用相对根关节的单位向量表示，并在切空间演化以严格保持骨长。
AI.result: 在AMASS上实现高准确度与良好多样性校准及合理运动统计；消融实证空间与时间消息传递对性能贡献。训练于AMASS的模型无需微调即可在Human3.6M骨架上取得竞争力，显示对未见骨架结构的泛化。
AI.conclusion: GSFM以图结构的条件流匹配统一建模整段时空骨架，结合空间/时间注意与球面几何约束，实现物理一致且多样的人体运动预测，并具备跨骨架的迁移能力。

title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
summary: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段步态识别框架TFTR：先将各视角GEI映射到128维视角专属嵌入，再用Transformer对多视角嵌入进行融合与判别，支持任意数量视角推理，显著提升跨视角与多视角性能。
AI.motivation: 单阶段方法易过拟合且对视角输入数目僵硬固定，难以在多视角与跨数据集场景稳健泛化，需要一种既降低过拟合又可灵活融合不同视角的框架。
AI.method: 两阶段Translate-First-Then-Reason：1) 轻量Siamese CNN+三元组损失，将GEI翻译到128维视角特定嵌入；2) 将各视角嵌入作为token输入12层Transformer编码器，进行跨视角关系建模并重投影到更具余弦可分性的表示空间，实现可变数量视角融合与判别。
AI.result: 在OU-MVLP上：单视角96.91%，三视角99.49%；跨库在CASIA-B（正常/拿包/穿外套）用三视角达到100%。表现优于既有需要固定输入视角的方案，并显示出强泛化。
AI.conclusion: TFTR通过“先翻译后推理”有效缓解过拟合与视角刚性限制，支持任意视角数量融合并显著提高跨视角与跨库识别精度，适合大规模与实际多摄像头部署。

title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

AI.tldr: RoBoSTAR提出一种从文本生成手语动作的框架，通过粗到细的分层自回归与部位量化并行预测身体与手部，实现更稳健、可复用到机器人上的手语生成。
AI.motivation: 公共场景手语翻译依赖专业译员，难以规模化与持续覆盖；需要一种可扩展、可在机器人上执行的自动手语生成方式，且能兼顾长程语义与局部细节的运动建模。
AI.method: 提出RoBoSTAR：1) 文本条件的手语生成；2) 将人体分部件进行有限标量量化（FSQ），为身体与双手分别离散化；3) 采用“下一尺度自回归”的粗到细序列生成策略，先在低时间分辨率建模长程结构，再逐步细化到高分辨率；4) 在每一尺度内并行预测身体与手部token，保证跨部件同步；5) 使用自条件与上下文腐化，提升跨尺度预测的鲁棒性；6) 生成的离散token解码为连续动作后，进行机器人类人形体的运动重定向；7) 可选接入ASR作为语音前端。
AI.result: 在多项定性与定量评测中优于或匹配现有方法，生成的手语动作更连贯、长程一致且细节更自然，并成功完成在实体人形机器人上的执行示范。
AI.conclusion: 粗到细的分层自回归与部位并行预测能有效兼顾长程语义与局部运动细节，结合鲁棒性训练技巧使RoBoSTAR成为可用于机器人执行的高质量文本到手语生成方案。

title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

AI.tldr: 提出FSS-UBrain：用单张已标注正样本切片作为支持，分别对WT/TC/ET进行区域级一次性分割；通过支持导出的前景/背景描述子适配查询特征并在多模块交互重建与边界细化；引入包含空目标的困难/全负查询与空查询正则以抑制虚假前景；2D配对推理，体素重建后做选择与评估；在BraTS 2020/2023与Africa上取得领先少样本分割性能，同时对支持选择与队列差异敏感。
AI.motivation: 多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割在标注稀缺、跨队列差异与目标稀疏下表现受限。现有少样本方法难以稳健处理不同肿瘤区域（WT/TC/ET）的存在性差异与跨域泛化，且易产生虚假前景。需要一种能以极少标注、区域条件化、并抑制空目标误检的框架。
AI.method: 提出区域级一击（one-shot）分割框架FSS-UBrain：对WT/TC/ET分别进行二分类分割。利用支持切片生成前景/背景描述子，驱动查询侧的特征自适应、瓶颈交互、解码重建和边界细化。训练采用情景式（episodic）构造，加入困难负样本与全负（无目标）查询，并用空查询正则抑制在目标缺失时的伪激活。推理阶段基于2D支持-查询配对进行，之后进行体积重建，再做检查点选择、阈值校准与最终评估。无目标域微调或测试时参数更新。
AI.result: BraTS 2020上体素级Dice：WT 89.82%、TC 82.14%、ET 77.42%；HD95分别为11.12、9.01、4.46 mm。在BraTS 2023与BraTS-Africa跨队列目标支持协议下，相比其他few-shot方法取得更高平均Dice和更低有限对HD95点估计。
AI.conclusion: 目标条件化的一次性分割在脑肿瘤多区域任务中有效，并能在跨队列下保持领先；但性能对支持样本选择与队列特异性敏感，提示未来需研究鲁棒的支持选择与域泛化策略。

title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
summary: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 提出HeroFrame-Bench：用VLM作为评审、结合参考链百分位与共同进化的电影特定评判量表，来公平评估“英雄帧”选择（兼顾相关性与美学），并显示与人类更高一致性，但任务仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有关键帧选择基准偏重语义相关性，忽视美学；标注有限且排除多样有效答案；基于VideoQA的评估又与下游模型能力纠缠，难以客观衡量“电影海报/封面用帧”的综合质量，亟需可扩展、可复用且更贴近人类审美与宣传需求的评测框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出VLM-as-a-Judge评测框架：利用多模态元数据构造上下文，让VLM为候选帧打分。2) Reference-anchored Percentile：将候选帧插入预先排序的参考链，计算其在链中的百分位，实现直接、可扩展、可重复的评分。3) Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution：为每部电影生成并迭代优化电影特定评判量表（rubric），用VLM打分结果反哺修订量表。4) 引入可验证的稳健性信号（含Inverted Rubric Attack）来挑选鲁棒量表。5) 构建数据集：204部电影、2,031条参考链、1,970个学习到的量表，并开发标注界面用于人类一致性研究。
AI.result: 通过人类对齐实验，VLM与人类一致率由77.56%提升到83.78%；多种方法在该基准上的评测显示英雄帧选择仍然困难，未出现压倒性强者。
AI.conclusion: HeroFrame-Bench提供了一个面向“英雄帧”选择、兼顾相关性与审美的可扩展评测标准。利用参考链百分位与电影特定量表的共同进化，可提升VLM判分与人类的对齐度；然而任务本身仍具挑战性，提示未来需在审美判别与多模态理解上继续改进。

title: One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction
summary:
Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver.
  In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.

AI.tldr: 提出“方向性交通信号理解”任务：从前视图同时预测直行/左转/右转/U 形转弯的信号颜色与通行许可，以弥补传统检测/识别到规划之间的语义鸿沟；并基于 OpenLane‑V2 构建基准与方向感知基线，证实在复杂多信号路口显著提升可通行性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅做实例级交通灯检测或颜色识别，无法回答“对自车特定机动（直行/转弯）是否允许”，导致规划前仍需额外推理，存在安全与一致性风险。
AI.method: 1) 定义方向级(机动级)信号状态：对直行、左转、右转、掉头分别输出颜色+可通行性；2) 在 OpenLane‑V2 上标注并提出评测指标：颜色准确率、通行性、全帧一致性与安全关键错误；3) 方向感知基线：融合全局上下文、局部交通灯证据与机动特定表征，进行多头预测。
AI.result: 与图像级分类器和检测为主的流水线相比，方向级建模在通行性预测上更优，尤其在多信号复杂路口显著提升鲁棒性与准确性。
AI.conclusion: 方向性交通信号理解提供了与规划直接对接、可解释的信号表示，可与拓扑、路线和周边目标信息结合，缩短感知到决策链路并减少安全关键错误。

title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
summary: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.

AI.tldr: FoundDSR提出一种在未见分布上鲁棒的深度重建基础模型，利用引导式2D Gaussian Splatting构建深度表示，并结合异构联邦学习稳定地在大规模多源数据上训练，零样本评测全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度重建模型对分布外场景泛化差，且在大规模、异构数据训练时易受主导数据源偏置与训练不稳定影响，需要一种既能表达高频结构又能稳健扩展到多源数据的通用方法。
AI.method: 1) 以高分辨率RGB为引导，对2D Gaussian Splatting的高斯参数进行优化，使高斯基元沿高频结构各向异性变形，得到“高斯上采样”的深度表示；2) 将该表示通过深度重建分支映射为高分辨率深度；3) 采用异构联邦学习，将不同数据源分配给独立客户端进行本地优化并全局聚合，以缓解分布差异导致的不稳定与偏置。
AI.result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度与含噪等多种零样本设置下，FoundDSR在鲁棒性与泛化性方面持续超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合由RGB引导的2D Gaussian Splatting与异构联邦学习，FoundDSR实现对未知场景的强泛化与鲁棒深度重建，并具备可扩展至多样化大规模数据的稳定训练能力。

title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

AI.tldr: 提出一种渐进视角的在策略蒸馏方法PVD，通过从裁剪视角逐步过渡到全图视角并进行区域优势加权，实现教师裁剪优势向学生全图推理的有效迁移，在多模态与视觉任务上显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 区域到全局的知识蒸馏中，教师在裁剪（局部）上更强，但学生需要在全图上推理，如何有效把“裁剪优势”迁移到“全图推理”是难点；同时需要在不依赖奖励或仅弱依赖奖励的设置中提升泛化与部署表现。
AI.method: 提出PVD：1）视角分布渐进迁移——通过“保纵横比的填充裁剪”（padded crop）作为中间视角，使学生从裁剪视角逐步过渡到全图视角，且该视角在视觉token网格上与全图对齐；跨阶段用视角混合分布，逐步提高全图输入的概率。2）区域优势加权——基于教师-学生在同一输入下的token级对数概率差（log-prob gap）进行轻量加权：差小则弱加权，差大则更强调该token，以便把教师在局部更强的知识优先传给学生。3）理论解释——用Jensen–Shannon散度的度量分解说明训练日程从“匹配输入的模仿”平滑过渡到“部署目标优化”。
AI.result: 在涵盖感知、视觉数学和通用多模态问答的基准上，PVD-full三种随机种子平均准确率77.51%，较无奖励蒸馏基线提升+2.01点，较奖励匹配变体提升+1.00点；在完全无奖励设置下的PVD-distill亦提升+1.16点。
AI.conclusion: 通过渐进视角迁移与区域优势加权，PVD能有效把教师的裁剪优势迁移到学生的全图推理，带来稳定且跨任务的性能增益，并与部署目标更好对齐。

title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对Diffusion Transformer的梯度引导空间信用分配方法，在Flow-GRPO框架中以token粒度计算重要性比并用MAD+温度归一化稳定梯度，从而提升人类偏好对齐质量并加速收敛，GenEval上达SOTA，优于已有Flow-GRPO方法、收敛可比DiffusionNFT。
AI.motivation: 标准Flow-GRPO在对图像生成对齐时将优势统一为单一标量，忽略了图像在空间维度上的异质性与局部结构，导致策略更新对关键区域不敏感、信用分配粗糙、样本效率受限。需要一种能在空间上细粒度分配奖励、减少梯度噪声并与DiT架构原生匹配的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将Flow-GRPO的转移级对数似然重写为与DiT patch/token对齐的token级表示，构建空间细粒度的重要性采样比；2) 基于奖励函数对图像的梯度构造连续的空间信用图，无需硬分割或边界启发式；3) 采用以中位数绝对偏差(MAD)为核心的鲁棒归一化并结合温度缩放，抑制异常值与噪声，突出与文本提示一致的功能区域；4) 在时序去噪步骤与空间token维度联合使用上述信用分配进行策略更新。
AI.result: 在GenEval基准上达到SOTA对齐质量；相较所有Flow-GRPO系方法显著提升偏好对齐分数；训练收敛速度与DiffusionNFT等顶尖方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、梯度引导且鲁棒的空间信用分配能弥补标准Flow-GRPO在空间结构建模上的不足，在保持高效性的同时显著提升DiT生成对齐效果；该范式为无评论家RL对齐提供了可扩展的空间感知更新机制。

title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
summary: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

AI.tldr: OpenMASC 提供从数据生成到部署的开源全流程：用CT物理仿真生成成对的“无金属/有金属”MRI（笛卡尔与径向），提出带DC Rectifier的MA-VarNet抑制由数据一致性带回的伪影，并用强化学习共同优化采样轨迹与重建；在4×和8×加速、两种轨迹上均优于传统与学习基线。
AI.motivation: 金属植入会在MRI的k空间全局污染，现有加速MRI方法假设干净数据，而金属伪影消除方法多依赖全采样；且缺乏同一解剖下“有/无金属”的配对k空间与图像公开数据，以及能同时面向不同采样轨迹的联合“采集+重建”框架。
AI.method: 1) 物理驱动数据生成：将公共CT体数据转换为MRI对，包括无金属与金属污染版本，产出配对图像与k空间，支持笛卡尔与径向。2) MA-VarNet：基于unrolled重建，加入每级的DC Rectifier，抑制数据一致性步骤从受污染测量中重新引入的伪影。3) 采集策略学习：强化学习智能体主动选择k空间readout，并与重建网络通过解耦的三阶段流程协同训练。4) 轨迹无关框架：除数据一致性算子外，网络不依赖轨迹，可直接用于笛卡尔与径向。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、4×与8×加速下，于笛卡尔与径向采样均稳定优于传统与深度学习基线，在图像质量指标上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: OpenMASC实现了针对金属伪影的联合采集与重建一体化方案：可生成配对数据、适配多轨迹、并以DC Rectifier与RL采样协同提升重建质量；实验验证跨加速率与轨迹的稳健优越性。

title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: [https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA](https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.

AI.tldr: 提出EyeVQA：首个覆盖广泛眼科任务的统一VQA基准，汇集21数据集、2万问答、7类题型、6类疾病，含44.5%多图推理，零样本评测14个VLM，最优仅62.8分，暴露空间定位与跨任务泛化不足。
AI.motivation: 现有眼科数据集多聚焦单一疾病或特定任务，难以系统检验VLM是否能超越简单疾病识别，具备多图比较推理与精细空间定位能力；缺少统一、可复现、覆盖面广的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建EyeVQA基准：从21个眼科数据集整合，生成约2万QA对，覆盖六大疾病组与七种问题类型（单选、多选、变选、是非、排序、点选、框选）。金标准答案由源数据的诊断、分级、临床征象、分割、检测框、解剖标志等确定式派生，避免依赖模型生成注释；44.5%问题要求跨多图推理。统一零样本协议下评测14种通用/科研/医学VLM。
AI.result: 在统一零样本评测中，最佳模型总体得分仅62.8分。模型在空间定位（点选/框选）和跨任务泛化上存在显著性能差距，多图推理仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在眼科综合视觉理解方面能力不足。EyeVQA提供了可复现、覆盖广、含空间定位与多图推理的诊断性基准，可促进更可靠、具空间落地性的眼科多模态模型研发。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出LT-OPD：在极端低视觉token预算下，通过同架构全token教师对学生的“自身生成轨迹”进行分布式监督的在策略自蒸馏训练，结合逐步降预算课程，显著恢复MLLM性能并降低计算/缓存开销。
AI.motivation: 极端视觉token压缩能加速MLLM，但会导致性能急剧下降。已有方法要么挑选少量视觉token，要么训练适配，但在极低预算下仍不足。作者思考：当学生只能看到极少视觉证据时，应如何从“自身生成所诱导的状态与分布”中学习，并利用全token模型提供信息更丰富的指导。
AI.method: 提出LT-OPD（Low-Token On-Policy Distillation）：1）学生仅用极少视觉token进行rollout，沿学生生成的对话轨迹收集中间状态与分布；2）同架构、冻结的全token副本作为教师，对这些在策略状态提供分布级监督（如对下一词分布/隐藏表征等进行蒸馏）；3）引入预算级课程学习，训练中逐步降低保留token比例，以稳定在极低证据信号下的学习；4）框架泛化到多种MLLM并保持推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上、可视token保留≤5%时，平均性能保留率从68.6%提升到82.3%，超过训练自由、训练式与RL基线；收益稳定迁移至Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B。推理阶段KV cache使用降85.2%，prefill FLOPs降85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 在策略自蒸馏结合预算课程能显著弥补极端视觉token压缩带来的能力损失，实用且通用，既保持高效（显著降算与缓存）又保证效果，在多模型/基准上稳定奏效。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出StegGNN：将图神经网络用于图像隐写的自编码框架，建模图像为图以克服CNN网格与感受野限制，实验显示在不可感知性与视觉质量上与主流CNN方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习隐写主要基于CNN，受限于规则网格建模、局部感受野与空间局部性偏置；而GNN在视觉任务中展现出强适应性（如ViG），提示以图方式表征图像或能更灵活地进行隐写嵌入。
AI.method: 将图像像素/patch建模为图节点并利用GNN构建自编码器式隐写—编码器将秘密信息嵌入到图像图结构中，解码器从载体中恢复信息；整体为cover-agnostic，借助GNN的信息传递与全局依赖建模提升嵌入表达。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，对视觉质量与不可感知性进行评测，GNN方法取得与现有CNN基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: GNN为图像隐写提供了有前景的替代表征，证明CNN之外的图建模可行并值得进一步探索GNN架构以提升深度学习隐写。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出FiST：在潜空间以少步数进行端到端生成的“先蒸馏、后细化”方法，在ImageNet 256×256上用2–3阶段达到FID≈1.1、IS≈280，竞争力强且无需显式最小化Fréchet距离。
AI.motivation: 少步（few-step）扩散/流匹配生成需要在跨步骤的联合优化中高效、端到端地提升最终分布质量；现有做法多停留在教师模仿或逐步回归，难以利用生成器自身闭环误差与分布级信号。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：1) 蒸馏（distill）：在潜空间沿教师（预训练扩散/流匹配）轨迹，对选定中间状态做教师强制回归，建立强初始化；2) 细化（refine）：改用对抗与辅助分类损失，仅作用于最终潜向量，但反向梯度贯穿所有阶段；模型FiST将少量阶段的潜状态跃迁由共享Transformer实现，可选跨阶段隐藏态通信；判别器基于冻结的SiT(REPA预训)特征，对真实/生成潜进行判别；全程不解码到像素。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成：三阶段FID 1.11（IS 282），两阶段FID 1.15（IS 280）；消融表明蒸馏初始化、预训练检查点选择、细化监督形式、跨阶段通信均显著影响质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过“蒸馏→端到端分布级细化”的闭环训练，并在潜空间使用共享Transformer阶段式滚动与强表征判别器，可在极少步实现高保真生成，竞争对手方法的显式Fréchet最小化并非必要。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: RefCompose提出一种像素空间组合条件框架，用固定分辨率“参考画布”与双流LoRA在不增加显存的前提下整合多参考，解耦布局与外观，并在高参考数量下显著提升颜色/纹理/形状/空间准确与身份保真。
AI.motivation: 现有多参考合成：1) 参考数量多时显存线性增长；2) 生成偏离参考、破坏细粒度身份；3) 需要额外LLM/布局模型或难以精确控制空间关系。需要一种可扩展、恒定内存、保持身份与空间准确的多主体影视级合成方法。
AI.method: 引入RefCompose：在像素空间使用单一固定分辨率参考画布编码所有参考，使条件大小与参考数无关；推理时用冻结的扩散Transformer与Grounding DINO提取/诱导空间布局；构造布局派生的深度图；通过双流LoRA分别注入几何（深度/布局）与局部外观（编码画布），从而解耦“在哪里”和“长什么样”。无需LLM或专用布局模型。
AI.result: 在Dense Layout协议上，相比布局基线与SOTA多参考方法，RefCompose在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确度、身份/内容保真方面持续领先，且推理显存恒定、能处理高参考数。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose是一个可在生产规模下用于多主体电影级合成的实用构件：以固定内存高保真地组合多参考，稳健保持身份与空间控制，显示出优越的可扩展性与质量。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences.
