Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: 提出Endo-TSR：在可变形高斯渲染中加入有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差（共享时间频率），并用Matérn谱先验与多尺度拉普拉斯监督，显著提升内窥镜场景的时变渲染与细节重建，PSNR达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景存在组织非刚体运动与随时间变化的外观（照明、湿度、血液反光等），而现有可变形高斯方法虽有显式轨迹，但颜色系数固定，缺乏对时变光度的专门建模，导致渲染和几何细节受限。
AI.method: 在Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting框架上：1）引入有界傅里叶颜色残差，建模局部时变外观；2）在共享时间频率上为每个高斯添加独立平移残差，用Matérn谱先验正则其运动修正；3）联合图像拟合时加入多尺度拉普拉斯金字塔监督，以恢复组织细节；4）固定高斯数量下联合优化上述参数。
AI.result: 在EndoNeRF与StereoMIS数据集上取得SOTA渲染质量，所有序列PSNR最高。消融表明：显式时变外观建模带来最大PSNR提升；外观建模与细节监督在固定高斯数下共同提升渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 专门的时间外观建模与受谱先验约束的运动残差、配合多尺度细节监督，可在内窥镜场景中显著提升可变形高斯的时空一致渲染与细节恢复，达到当前最优性能。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: 提出DELL：面向事件相机的稠密任务（光流、分割）的局部学习框架，以可学习的分层局部监督替代端到端BPTT，全脉冲U形网络上显著降内存、提精度。
AI.motivation: 深度SNN用BPTT训练内存开销大且不适配神经形态硬件；现有局部学习多用于分类，难以覆盖光流/分割等稠密预测。需要一种既保留时序动力学，又能在稠密任务上有效学习、同时降低训练内存的方案。
AI.method: DELL（Dense Event-driven Local Learning）：将网络切分为多个块，每块内部保留时序脉冲动力学，块与块之间切断全局反传；在每个尺度/分辨率引入可学习、具空间结构的本地监督头（local heads），对稠密目标进行局部监督。采用全脉冲U形（U-Net式）架构，在光流与语义分割上训练、评估；对比端到端BPTT和DECOLLE（随机读出）等基线。
AI.result: 在DSEC光流：相对端到端BPTT峰值训练显存降39.6%，EPE从1.941降至1.670（更优）；DECOLLE因固定随机读出不适于稠密回归，EPE高出3.9倍；可学习局部头可弥补并超越端到端在各光流指标。分割任务：大部分性能差距被弥补，但仍落后端到端数个mIoU点。模型参数2.3M，比最强SNN基线少24倍，整体仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将局部学习成功拓展到稠密事件视觉，显著降低训练内存并在光流上优于端到端；块级“脱钩”更像正则化而非硬约束。可学习局部头对稠密回归至关重要；在分割上接近但未完全追平端到端。方法有利于在资源受限与神经形态硬件上训练SNN。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出RefAdapt：一种针对DiT条件生成中“参考-目标”联合注意力的自适应、免训练加速框架；用目标Query变化与其对参考的注意质量联动，按block粒度跳过/复用参考计算，在超少步扩散下实现约2.1×–3.5×加速且画质近似不变。
AI.motivation: DiT在条件生成需处理长参考序列的双向联合注意，重复计算昂贵。现有方法多做静态、粗粒度复用，未区分参考与目标的动态：参考表征随扩散步往往变化缓慢，且目标对参考分配的注意质量常偏低。需要一种能依据“参考漂移程度”和“目标对参考的真实依赖”动态调度计算的机制。
AI.method: 提出RefAdapt，免训练、按block粒度控制联合注意的参考侧计算：并行监测两类信号——(1) 连续步之间目标Q的变化幅度；(2) 目标→参考的历史注意质量。若Q变化小且注意质量低，则判定参考态“陈旧但影响小”，复用或跳过参考更新；若任一指标升高，则恢复全量参考计算。整个流程在生成轨迹中自适应调整，无需修改模型权重。
AI.result: 在超少步扩散设定下：MiniMax H3 4步可达最高2.097×加速；Qwen Image Edit 8步达3.54×加速；同时保持与基线相当的视觉质量（未显著退化）。
AI.conclusion: 联合注意中的参考计算存在可预测的时空冗余。依据目标Q变化与注意质量自适应门控参考更新，可在不训练、少步扩散条件下显著提速且维持生成质量。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出CityToolVQA：将城市低空VQA任务中的定性问题交给VLM，定量问题交给外部视觉-几何工具链；零样本可插，显著提升定量表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在仅RGB条件下难以进行度量距离、尺寸等定量推理，导致城市低空VQA中定量任务准确率偏弱。
AI.method: 将7类任务按定性/定量划分：定性由VLM直接回答；定量由外部工具链完成，包括目标定位、分割、深度反投影与空间计算；当主链检测不可靠时触发DAPI深度辅助提示回退；并通过SFT让8B骨干适配工具条件输入；工具链可零样本连接多种开源VLM。
AI.result: 在Open3D-VQA-v2（73,324问）上，CityToolVQA-SFT（Qwen3-VL-8B）总体准确率67.6%；给10个开源VLM外挂工具链后，定量任务准确率提升12.7–36.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将显式3D几何计算外部化，能有效补足RGB-only VLM在度量尺度与距离估计上的能力，显著提升城市低空场景的定量VQA表现。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于骨架序列动作/交互识别的归一化方法CHASE，通过自适应原点平移到骨架凸包内来减小实体偏置，并配合成对分布距离的辅助损失与子实体策略，在多模态/多实体、多数据集和多骨干上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多采用晚融合与共享编码器，隐含“各实体独立同分布”的假设。但由于世界坐标原点选择带来的实体偏置，这一假设被破坏，导致优化不充分与识别错误。需要一种能从输入层面减小偏置、对单/多实体和多模态都适配的通用方案。
AI.method: 提出Convex Hull Adaptive Shift (CHASE)：(1) 插件式可学习平移网络，对输入骨架施加自适应位移，并约束新原点落在骨架凸包内以限制搜索空间、避免不收敛；(2) 辅助目标：利用实体对的分布距离最小化实体间偏差，引导优化；(3) 子实体策略：将人体、手、物体、机器人等拆分为一致的子实体建模，统一单/多实体场景；(4) 兼容多种体内模态（关节、骨、速度等），可无缝接入各类骨干。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上与多种主流骨干结合，均实现显著性能提升，验证CHASE的通用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将世界原点自适应平移到骨架凸包内并引入分布对齐与子实体统一建模，CHASE作为一种归一化预处理有效降低实体偏置，稳定训练并普遍提升骨架动作/交互识别性能。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: 提出QuacamFM：在整条生成轨迹中保持单位四元数约束的流匹配框架，用球面线性插值( SLERP )设计最优传输，较扩散与传统SfM在稀疏视角相机位姿估计上更准确并具更好泛化。
AI.motivation: 扩散/生成式方法为稀疏视角位姿不确定性提供多假设，但普遍将四元数当作无约束4D向量进行生成，破坏单位范数约束，导致轨迹非平滑、次优；需要一种在生成过程中严格遵守单位四元数流动的框架以提升稳定性与精度。
AI.method: 提出Quaternion-constrained Flow Matching(QuacamFM)：在流匹配中对旋转使用单位四元数流，采用球面线性插值(SLERP)来构造旋转的最优传输；整个流保持在S^3流形上，避免无约束4D空间的偏离；并与位姿估计任务结合，生成多种相机位姿假设并进行评估。
AI.result: 在CO3Dv2上，相比扩散式多假设方法与经典SfM/BA，QuacamFM在相机姿态精度上更优；同时优于对4D四元数向量直接做标准flow matching的朴素做法；在跨数据集与野外样例上表现出良好泛化。
AI.conclusion: 在多视图稀疏约束下，相机姿态生成若遵守四元数单位球流形并用SLERP进行最优传输，可获得更平滑的生成轨迹与更高的姿态精度；QuacamFM验证了流匹配+流形约束的有效性并具备较强泛化能力。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: WorldScope/WorldFlow 构建与评测在部分可观测条件下的“可能世界”推理：给出大规模证据依赖的QA数据与对照“反事实世界”监督，并提出跨视角证据格(WorldFlow)以建模新视角如何排除/保留世界状态，显著优于仅用QA训练的同背骨。
AI.motivation: 在遮挡与视野受限下，单次观测往往对应多个可能世界，需要随着新增视角逐步排除不相容的世界、强化可证结论。现有视觉QA/三维感知方法对“未观测=未知”与“新增观测=排除/收紧可能性”的语义建模不足，缺少以证据为中心的数据与监督来训练这种随视角演化的推理。
AI.method: 1) 数据：WorldScope-1.2M 含120万英文问答，覆盖8类世界属性、10种交互接口、3种观测协议；答案显式编码“已确证事实/支持的上下界/仍不确定的可能性”。另含4800组经认证的“反世界”组：共享可见基观测，但在被遮挡处配置不同物体与相应不同答案，作为训练期的世界兼容与视角排除监督。2) 表征与学习：提出 WorldFlow，将跨视角实体证据与支撑面覆盖融合为“图像子集证据格”(image-subset evidence lattice)；通过“反世界兼容性”与“视角转移(新增视图)带来的排除”目标来训练子集表示，使其反映“新观测如何约束可能世界”。3) 生成：共享的答案生成器基于子集表示输出当前证据下最强的被支持结论。4) 评测：WorldScope-Bench 测试在选择、组合、移除、排序视图时的主张判定与证据依赖结论。
AI.result: 在5000题测试集上，WorldFlow 达到64.34%精确准确率，相比同一骨干仅以QA训练提升24.88个百分点；在与训练结构不重叠(结构异构)的3000题上仍保持50.43%准确率，显示出一定的泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以“可能世界+证据格”的框架，将新增视角转化为对世界集合的约束，可显著提升部分可观测场景下的视觉推理与问答性能；反世界组提供了强力、但训练期限定的监督。该框架为面向遮挡与多视角的可验证结论生成与策略化观察选择奠定了数据与方法基础。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 提出REMEDY基准评估AI生成医学教学演示视频的“就绪度”，发现现有视频生成模型外观逼真但临床动作执行差，最优模型严格临床成功率仅28.25%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型在世界模型与教学演示上的潜力日增，医学教学需要高视觉逼真度与精确流程动作，但缺乏系统评估其是否满足临床教学需求的基准。
AI.method: 构建REMEDY基准：从真实教学演示视频中采样900个首帧，涵盖4大场景（手术室、影像、门/床旁、复苏）与12项任务；用5个开源视频生成模型基于这些首帧各生成视频共4,500个；结合任务特异的临床清单与视频/运动质量指标，四维度评估：临床动作遵循、临床特征（profiles）、视频质量、运动质量。
AI.result: 外观真实与时间一致性不足以保证正确临床动作；细粒度临床步骤最具挑战；最先进模型MiniMax-H3在严格临床成功率上仅28.25%，整体临床合规性低。
AI.conclusion: REMEDY为医学教学视频生成提供首个系统评估框架与数据，揭示当前模型在临床动作层面显著不足，并为面向医学教育的世界模型研发指明改进方向与路线图。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE基准评估动作-语言评估器的结构落地能力，揭示其在时间顺序、镜像反射与动作身份上的严重不足，并通过加入结构化困难负样本改进对比学习显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 现有动作-语言评估器常用于给运动生成或检索模型打分，但其是否真正理解语言结构（如时序、镜像、身份）不清楚；常用评测可能被文本先验或分布性指标误导，掩盖结构感知缺陷。
AI.method: 构建STRIDE基准：包含5869个三元组（动作、原始描述、扰动描述），覆盖短长文本；通过似然平衡降低纯文本偏置；在与动作无关的情景下估计评估器对标题偏好的基线，并用匹配动作时的判别增益衡量结构落地；设计三类结构扰动（时序颠倒、镜像反射、动作身份替换）；系统实验审计现有评估器与协议。
AI.result: 发现审计的评估器结构落地薄弱，尤其对镜像反射极不敏感；文本先验即可在现有数据集的朴素扰动测试上取得高分；常见的检索与分布性指标对镜像引入的结构破坏几乎无反应。
AI.conclusion: 问题源于评测与训练中缺乏结构针对性；引入结构化困难负样本作为对比学习的简单修改，可显著提升对时序与镜像的敏感度。作者将发布基准与代码。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督的视频场景文本早期检测框架：用清晰大文本的高置信检测结果反向追踪到更早、模糊小尺度帧以生成伪标签，训练学生模型在远距离和退化条件下更早更稳地发现文本。配套构建鲁棒文本跟踪器与多语种数据集SceneText50，实验显示跨场景与语言均显著提升早检性能。
AI.motivation: 常规文本检测/识别模型对远距离、小尺寸、模糊文本易漏检；视频中这些文本在稍后帧变清晰能被准确识别，如何利用这类“后帧高置信”信息来改进“前帧早期”检测是一个空白。需要无标注的方法与稳健的跟踪机制来把清晰帧信息迁移到退化帧。
AI.method: 以现有高性能文本识别/文本定位器为教师，在视频中对其在清晰帧的高置信文本实例进行时间反向回溯，借助专门设计的场景文本跟踪器维持跨帧一致ID，从而在更早、尚模糊/小目标的帧上自动生成伪标签；用这些伪标签训练学生模型，聚焦“早期检测”。同时发布多语种室外数据集SceneText50用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 与常规基线相比，该自监督框架在多场景、多语言的视频上显著提升早期文本检测的召回率与稳健性；定量实验显示在小尺度、低清晰度条件下有明显增益，并验证了所提文本跟踪器对伪标签质量的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过时间反向追踪与稳健文本跟踪生成高质量伪标签，可在无需人工标注的前提下有效增强视频中文本的早期检测能力；配套数据集与代码公开，为跨语言、复杂户外环境中的文本早检提供了可复现的解决方案。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 论文从测量理论角度解释了JEPA对掩码几何极度敏感：块状掩码优于离散散点掩码，因为块掩码在小波基下保留了不可从局部先验恢复的粗尺度内容，从而迫使模型学习有用表示；而可从低级先验恢复的目标导致“捷径”。大量实验证实了该机制在ImageNet-100与UCF101上的多项可区分预测。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA方法在不同掩码策略下表现差异巨大（块掩码好、散点掩码差），但原因多为经验性解释，缺乏统一原理。作者希望给出可度量、可预测的解释框架，以在训练前预判掩码效果并指导设计。
AI.method: 将掩码视为线性测量；在紧支撑小波基中，完全落在被遮挡区域内的原子处于测量的零空间，信息在数据中“无痕”。JEPA损失只要求上下文足以预测目标，若目标可由低层先验（如移动平均式目标编码器）恢复，模型便可走捷径。因而，关键在于掩码是否令某些粗尺度内容“不可恢复”，且每个目标仍有足够上下文“可达”。作者提出在训练前对掩码几何下的“不可恢复粗尺度内容”进行打分，并通过151次预训练实验验证：比较不同几何（块、条带、随机、视频帧移除等）、不同目标（像素/潜表示、冻结/自回归目标编码器）、以及可见/隐藏token操作。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100上：条带掩码与块在面积与连通性相当但可被恢复，线性top-1仅约40%（与随机约41%相当），明显落后块掩码的64%；同一几何族中，留下最少不可恢复内容的放置比最多者低6.5点；像素目标差距约7点，而潜表示目标可达25点；使用冻结目标编码器时，随机与块的差距由19点缩至1.5点，表明几何主要通过自产生的目标起作用。视频UCF101上：遮整帧（空间上不可恢复、但可由邻帧恢复）在两种遮挡率下都最差；对V-JEPA的掩码，按批保留其完整性与截断几乎无差（36.0% vs 35.1%）；令块内100个目标token可见大幅提升至48.7%，而隐藏块外100个上下文token无益（33.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 掩码几何影响JEPA性能的根源在测量论：有效掩码需保留使目标无法由低级先验恢复的粗尺度内容，同时保证目标对足够上下文“可达”。块掩码做到这一点，而散点/条带常可被恢复，导致捷径学习与性能崩塌。训练前的“不可恢复内容”评分可预测并指导掩码设计；目标编码器的自一致性放大了几何效应，冻结目标可缓解。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: GeoCR 是一个通用云去除模型，统一处理单/多时相、RGB/多光谱输入，并可选用SAR引导；通过冻结的RGB自编码器主干与轻量输入/输出分支共享潜空间，用单个流式Transformer学习跨数据集的云去除先验，实现零样本推理与LoRA高效适配，跨多数据集取得最优或竞争性指标（FID、DISTS）。
AI.motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集与输入配置（传感器、波段、观测设置）定制，泛化与复用性差，难以在不同数据源和任务设定间共享模型与先验。需要一个能在多源多模态、多时相场景下统一处理的通用生成式云去除框架。
AI.method: 提出GeoCR：以预训练RGB自编码器为核心，冻结其编码器/解码器主干；通过紧凑的输入/输出stem将不同谱域（RGB、非RGB多光谱）映射到共享潜空间；使用单一Flow Transformer在该潜空间联合建模清洁RGB与非RGB潜表示，条件输入为对应的带云观测流与可选SAR token；在10个数据集、共88万+无云目标图像上联合预训练，支持直接零样本推理与LoRA低秩微调。
AI.result: 在多数据集测试划分上，分别在全波段（SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New）与仅RGB（CUHK-CR2）设置下取得最佳FID与DISTS，相比通用图像复原与专用云去除方法更优；同一预训练检查点可跨数据集无微调推理，并可通过LoRA高效适配。
AI.conclusion: 共享潜空间与统一生成式建模使云去除先验可在多模态、多时相、跨数据集间复用；GeoCR展示了可重用、可扩展的通用云去除范式，兼具零样本适用性与高效适配能力，优于现有专用与通用基线。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 提出面向手写数学表达式识别（HMER）的作者自适应微调方案，分析训练与实拍图像之间的域差距，并在小样本作者特定数据上验证，显示多数子集有提升，表明写作者适配具可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER系统难以适应个体书写风格，且训练数据（数字化/理想二值化）与推理时相机实拍图像存在显著域差距，影响性能；缺乏对该差距的系统刻画与面向写作者的适配机制与验证。
AI.method: 1) 以图像碎片化与笔画宽度分析刻画数字化与实拍图像的域差距；2) 在MFH-CoMER框架上引入作者自适应微调流水线；3) 构建两个作者、五类手写类别的作者特定小数据集；4) 采用适配小样本情境的McNemar检验与置换检验评估表达式识别率与CER变化。
AI.result: 对数字化手写数据，表达式识别率上升、CER下降；对实拍手写数据结果更不稳定，尤其在基线已表现良好的样本上改进受限；总体上5个子集中的4个有提升，且在2个作者特定子集上统计检验显示改进具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 作者自适应对HMER具潜在可行性；域差距（碎片化与笔画宽度差异）值得重视；尽管在实拍和强基线样本上改进不一，但多数子集实现稳健提升，提示未来应深化实拍域适配与更稳健的小样本微调策略。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: UnStep 是一个无需再训练的推理加速框架，通过减少DiT步数并裁剪注意力KV缓存的时间窗口，同时用推理期的质量补偿与运行时优化，实现在单卡H100达50 FPS、GB200达77 FPS且无画质损失的因果视频扩散生成。
AI.motivation: 少步因果学生模型虽比教师快，但仍难以达到实时生成；希望在不再训练的前提下进一步加速，同时尽量不牺牲画质。
AI.method: 推理期两类手段：1) 质量补偿——对已生成潜变量帧进行“近洁净”程度的再加噪并利用已有的clean-cache传递进行细化；对DiT的注意力Value与输出投影做截断SVD以保留主成分、降低计算。2) 运行时栈优化——更高效的注意力与KV索引、融合的Triton RoPE并缓存系数、VAE解码采用优化的内存布局、数值精度与卷积内核；总体上减少DiT步数并限制注意力窗口。
AI.result: 在不重新训练的情况下，吞吐显著提升：单张H100可达50 FPS且无可感知质量损失，GB200达77 FPS；相较现有方法设定了新的因果视频扩散吞吐区间。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理期的步数/窗口裁剪与质量补偿，以及系统级的内核与内存优化，可在不降质的前提下大幅提高因果视频扩散模型的实时生成速度，为流式视频生成提供更高效的部署路径。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种开放提示检测框架，从集合视角进行多模态协作，避免将多示例压缩为单一嵌入，并在候选状态层面而非表示层面进行跨模态融合。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足：1) 多个视觉示例常被压缩为单个类级嵌入，相当于“文本化”视觉提示，尤其当示例稀少且异质时可能次优；2) 现有方法主要在提示或中间表示层融合，尚未在模态特定的检测状态形成后进行有效协作。
AI.method: 从集合建模出发：Set-OPD保留模态特定的解码状态，并在候选状态层面进行显式多模态协作。提出Box-and-Residual（B&R）提示：对每个带框示例连同场景上下文进行读取，将汇聚的支持证据分解为Base锚点与可学习Residual校正，形成容量与示例数无关、驱动独立视觉检测通道的视觉提示。将文-视协作重构为候选集合建模问题，并提出Paired-Query Arbitration（PQA）：文本与视觉读出器共享查询初始化，保证候选按索引成对；在形成模态特定候选后，通过可学习门在对内仲裁，再用置换等变模块在融合集合上进行关系推理。
AI.result: B&R能在少量且异质示例下更稳健地捕获类别视觉特征；PQA在保持模态专长的同时减少早期融合带来的信息干扰，实现更有效的跨模态协同；整体方法在开放提示检测中提升了候选质量与最终检测性能（摘要未给具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 通过集合视角与候选级跨模态仲裁，方法避免“文本化”视觉提示与过早融合的缺陷，提供固定容量、上下文感知的视觉提示，并在形成候选后进行精细的跨模态融合，从而改进开放提示检测。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: DepthBench系统评测不同Transformer架构在固定总参数下“深-宽”配比对有效计算深度的影响。结果：标准Pre-LN及多数归一化/缩放变体在变“深且窄”时收益小甚至退化；而HC与Full AttnRes在极深形状下仍稳定受益，并将预训练改进转化为下游与有效计算增益。结论：残差连接设计是让“结构深度→有效计算”成立的关键。
AI.motivation: 实践中加深Transformer常出现边际收益递减，社区提出多种归一化或残差改造声称能更好“用深度”。但这些改造究竟是否把建筑学意义上的更深，转化为真正的有效计算深度？已有报告的提升是否受混杂因素影响（如参数规模/训练配方变化）？需要一个受控基准来隔离宽度-深度权衡与架构差异的影响。
AI.method: 提出DepthBench：在固定总参数与一致预训练配方下，系统扫描不同宽深比（d_model/n_layer），覆盖从浅宽到深窄；跨10种代表性架构（含Pre-LN及其若干归一化/缩放变体、HC、AttnRes等）进行对比。评估包括预训练损失、领域特定下游任务与“有效计算”指标；并做逐层受控分析，观测层级利用与信息流特性。
AI.result:
- 深度容量收益高度依赖架构。
- 标准Pre-LN与大多数norm/scale变体在更深更窄形状下收益有限或性能下降。
- HC与Full AttnRes在极深形状下仍持续改进，且预训练提升能稳定迁移到下游与有效计算。
- 逐层分析显示HC与Full AttnRes更有效地利用新增层，呈现与其他架构不同的计算深度机制。
AI.conclusion: 是否能把“加层数”变成“有效计算”的关键在于残差连接的设计。要把深度作为可扩展维度，HC与Full AttnRes类残差更有前景；单纯的归一化/缩放增强对深窄模型帮助有限甚至有害。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RIPE-MambaSpike，一种分辨率无关、参数高效的脉冲-状态空间混合模型，通过多分辨率桥接替代昂贵的分辨率相关投影，将参数从数千万降到不到百万，同时保持或提升事件相机视觉任务精度。
AI.motivation: 现有Spiking-Mamba混合模型精度强，但参数量巨大，主要开销来自将脉冲前端连接到状态空间主干的分辨率依赖投影，限制了在不同输入分辨率和资源受限设备上的可扩展性与部署。
AI.method: 以固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥（取代单一分辨率相关投影）实现分辨率无关连接；采用重参数化的脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及受动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，以在紧凑参数下维持表示力和时空建模能力。参数规模在固定时间步与宽度下对输入面积变化保持恒定。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200上达到帕累托最优；基础部署规模为0.870M参数，覆盖43倍输入面积范围；在DailyDVS-200上，8.04M规模达成45.7% top-1，为当前最佳脉冲结果，并以3.0-15.1倍更少参数超越稠密ANN方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件视觉识别并不需要随分辨率线性增长的参数；通过分辨率无关的桥接与高效时空模块，Spiking-Mamba混合体可在显著更小参数下保持或提升精度，具备良好可扩展性与部署潜力；代码已开源。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 是一种用于少步自回归视频扩散的并行/流水化推理框架，直接复用每个去噪阶段生成时已计算的KV缓存，并辅以稀疏的“干净锚点”条件以稳定长视频生成，在多GPU上显著加速同时保持更好的时序一致性与质量。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散需把长视频切分为时间块并逐块生成。为保持跨块一致性，主流方法需要额外前向只为重建干净或低噪KV缓存（不推进输出潜变量），这带来可观的计算开销与延迟，限制了长视频生成的速度与稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 复用在正常去噪前向中自然产生的、特定阶段的“机上”KV缓存，避免额外的仅更新缓存的前向计算；2) 将每个去噪阶段映射到独立GPU，使不同时间块在不同阶段并行，占用对应阶段的缓存，实现流水化并行；3) 引入稀疏的“干净锚点”潜变量及其KV，在块生成前产生，用作双向条件，提供长程、结构性的稳定；4) 结合两种记忆：a) 稠密、阶段匹配但带噪的历史KV（短程、细节保真）；b) 稀疏、干净锚点KV（长程、粗粒度结构），以缓解仅用带噪历史导致的外观/运动漂移。
AI.result: 在至多4块GPU上，对于20秒及以上、16 FPS 的视频，在480p与720p、1.3B与14B主干规模下，较HiAR提速1.16–1.69倍，较Self-Forcing提速1.42–2.92倍；在VBench上，1.3B/480p设定取得更高分数并在更长时长下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: FlashForward通过阶段缓存复用与锚点双侧条件，将少步自回归视频扩散的跨块记忆从昂贵的“额外前向构建KV”转为“零额外代价的在线复用+少量稀疏锚点”，在不牺牲甚至提升时序一致性与画质的前提下显著加速长视频生成，适用于20–65秒等更长时长并具良好扩展性。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: TRACE 是一种用于文本条件的人-物交互生成的连续潜变量框架，将人体、物体与手部三条运动流分离编码、耦合更新，并用几何约束直接监督接触与相对运动；在 InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE 上提升生成与理解表现，InterAct 上接触精准率、召回率与F1领先。
AI.motivation: HOI 生成需同时处理身体、物体和手部的多尺度、不同动态，并保持接触、相对位姿与时间一致性。共享表示会抑制各流的结构差异，独立生成又难以相互响应；仅靠潜变量监督无法在解码后直接约束接触。因此需要一种既保持流的独立结构又能相互耦合并施加显式几何约束的框架。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE：将身体、物体、手部分别编码为独立连续潜变量；每一时刻根据“完整的当前交互状态”预测各流的速度（流间耦合更新）；在解码的运动上加入几何损失，约束接触和物体相对运动时序；同一模型支持缺失任一流的补全（从其余两流推断）；将冻结的流特征作为输入到语言模型以提升HOI理解。
AI.result: 在 InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE 数据集上，联合补全训练提升了生成质量；使用冻结流特征用于理解任务优于直接用原始运动编码；在 InterAct 上达到最高的接触精确率、召回率与F1，优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过分流潜表示与耦合式速度预测并辅以几何接触与相对运动约束，TRACE 同时提升了HOI生成与理解；统一模型既可生成又可进行任意单流补全，实践上在多个数据集上验证了其优势，尤其在接触一致性指标上表现突出。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对乳腺DCE‑MRI的自适应表示学习框架，通过动态分析潜在表征、校正空间/时间变异，并利用大规模病灶分割预训练，显著提升跨中心良恶性分类鲁棒性，在ODELIA与AMBL上大幅超越基线并夺得MICCAI ODELIA 2025冠军。
AI.motivation: 乳腺DCE‑MRI虽含有高分辨率与时间动态信息，但4D高维输入、小病灶、以及多中心采集协议差异导致自动分类易受空间错配与时序不一致影响，现有微调型基础模型与方法鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) 动态潜在空间分析：在潜在表征中自适应建模不同协议特征；2) 空间变异缓解：抑制背景强化并补偿软组织形变引起的错位；3) 时序特征选择：利用跨期相位潜在关系自动挑选信息量最大的时间特征，降低对具体协议时间采样的依赖；4) 任务特定先验：以大规模有监督病灶分割进行预训练，强化判别特征，然后再进行分类微调。
AI.result: 在ODELIA数据集的leave‑one‑center‑out验证与独立AMBL队列上，较最强基线平均AUROC提升近8点、平衡准确率提升4点，并在MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025中获得第一。代码开源于https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜在空间动态适配协议差异、校正空间与时间变异，并结合分割预训练，框架实现跨中心、跨协议的稳健乳腺癌分类，优于微调型放射学基础模型与既有方法。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

AI.tldr: 提出CFCH分层学习框架与AS-9K数据集，用协同粗细粒度分支与一致性约束，显著提升前节疾病分类性能。
AI.motivation: 裂隙灯前节图像受成像条件多变与解剖-疾病层级关系影响，传统将其视为扁平多分类忽略了解剖区域（角膜、结膜、晶状体）与病变语义间的结构依赖，导致鲁棒性与可解释性不足。
AI.method: 构建双分支“粗-细”协同架构CFCH：一支建模解剖上下文（粗粒度），一支刻画具体疾病语义（细粒度）。通过语义一致性与跨粒度注意力一致性约束，使两分支特征对齐且互补，强化跨层级信息交互。并发布包含8975张、12类常见疾病的AS-9K最大公开前节数据集。
AI.result: 在两个前节数据集上，CFCH优于现有SOTA；可视化显示激活更集中于病灶相关区域，证明方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模解剖-疾病层级并引入跨粒度一致性，可提升前节疾病分类精度与可解释性；AS-9K为该领域提供大规模基准与代码资源。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

AI.tldr: 论文分析零训练的LLM+开放词汇检测(OVOD)流水线中“定位准确(CAAP)”与“语义命名准确(SNAP)”长期背离的原因，基于完整COCO-Val 5k数据(27,273个检测)系统评估，发现主要症结在于标注词汇与检测器原生类别集的不一致以及数据集封闭类别带来的评测偏差，而非视觉复杂度或小目标问题。
AI.motivation: 既有工作观察到CAAP与SNAP常常不一致，但未系统追问原因，且多在小样本上评估。实际应用中，开放世界场景广泛、词汇多样，若评测基于封闭类别集，可能错误归因为“定位失败”或“幻觉”。作者动机是用更大规模更严格的评测揭示背离的根因，从而指导更合理的误差分析与评测设计。
AI.method: 在COCO-Val 5k全量上复现实验，对LLM描述与检测器原生类别集的一致性进行分组：原生内词汇、同义改写、语义不相关“噪声”、以及真正跨类别新词。比较各组的CAAP变化；进一步剖析看似完全定位失败的子集，判断是否因COCO 80类非穷尽导致“未标注真目标”；更换检测器(YOLO-World与Grounding DINO)与LLM(Gemma-3与Qwen2.5-VL)做稳健性验证。
AI.result: 视觉复杂度并非主因，小/被遮挡目标并未更差。关键因素是词汇新颖性：当LLM用词超出检测器原生类别，CAAP从80.9%跌至31.6%。但“真同义”仍达89.3%，语义不相关标签仅12.0%。在进一步失败样本中，78–88%的“彻底失败”其实是模型找到了COCO未标注的真实物体。更换骨干与LLM后，效应与幅度依旧存在，显示为该流水线族的一般属性。
AI.conclusion: CAAP与SNAP的显著落差主要源于数据集封闭类别与词汇错配引起的评测偏差，而非真正的视觉-语言对齐失败。评估应考虑开放词汇与非穷尽标注，谨慎使用封闭类基准来判定“幻觉”和“失败”，并据此改进开放世界多模态系统的误差分析与指标设计。

title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
summary: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io

AI.tldr: OmniSmartHome 是一个结合语音、视觉与空间音频的多模态智能家居评测基准，揭示当前“全模态”大模型在需依赖情境线索的任务上显著失分；作者并提供带有程序性记忆与感知工具编排的简单代理 PROME，能在多款模型上带来普遍提升。
AI.motivation: 现实家庭交互中，用户常通过指向物体、参考所见所闻等情境线索表达需求，纯文本/语音往往欠明确；而现有基准主要以语言为主，忽视了多模态情境依赖，导致模型在真实场景中的能力评估不足。
AI.method: 构建 OmniSmartHome：为每个口语请求配套场景视频与空间音频，覆盖 1,360 个合成与 272 个真实片段；评测 16 个“全模态”大模型在仅语音可判与需多模态推理两类情境下的表现；提出 PROME 代理，集成专用视听感知工具与“程序性记忆”，以计划化地收集与利用证据。
AI.result: 当用户意图仅凭语音即可判断时，模型表现强；一旦需要依赖视觉/空间音频等情境推理，性能显著下降。引入 PROME 后，六个代表性 Omni-LLM 在该基准上的成绩普遍提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态情境是智能家居理解的关键，现有 Omni-LLM 在跨模态情境推理与证据收集上仍有明显短板。提供的 OmniSmartHome 基准与 PROME 代理为诊断与改进该能力提供了有效路径。

title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
summary: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/

AI.tldr: 论文提出“Delivery（传递）”阶段在多模态记忆代理中的关键作用，并给出DeliverMem方法显著提升MemLens与DMV-Bench表现，且无需训练与修改存储记录。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态记忆研究多聚焦于“写入/更新/检索”，但忽视了“检索到的信息如何以何种形式送达模型”的传递环节。作者发现即便检索固定，信息呈现方式对最终回答影响巨大，提示评测与方法设计需显式分解并优化“传递”。
AI.method: 提出对MemLens的受控分解，固定检索证据集，分别操控交付形式以量化传递贡献。提出DeliverMem：将传递细化为三项决策——(1) 保留原始模态（如直接给像素）；(2) 为每条记忆赋予可读身份标识；(3) 标注时间戳；并在检索侧加入适配器以补足传递无法提供的属性。为每项决策设计与其变量匹配的对照设定，仅改变该变量以衡量增益。
AI.result: 在8B骨干上，在检索证据固定时，交付原始像素较“隐去像素”提升13.87点；在同一消息上把检索做到完美仅提升2.31点，显示传递贡献更大。在三种MemLens骨干上传递均为更大项，且随骨干增强而增大（检索也增大但差距未缩小）。DeliverMem在MemLens四种上下文长度上均领先已发表的最强记忆代理，并在DMV-Bench两个骨干与全部设定中胜过其最强方法；在MemLens上以1/10至1/70的输入量达成领先。各决策仅在问题缺失相应信息时才带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 多模态记忆系统的瓶颈很大程度在“传递”而非仅仅“检索”。DeliverMem通过三项可组合的传递决策，在无需训练与不改存储的前提下，稳定跨基准提升性能，建议未来评测与系统设计显式建模与优化“传递”。

title: SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory
summary: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SPACE方法，通过反事实驱逐策略在固定容量的视频流记忆中降低预测状态漂移并提升下游任务表现；并发布MABS-Bench基准以系统评测记忆对未来任务的支持与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有固定容量视频流记忆策略多以信息留存或下游准确率为指标，忽视了“多次逐出决策的长期累积效应”——即记忆反复更新如何改变可支持的未来表征（预测状态）。作者希望在更因果与预测的框架下审视并优化逐出策略，避免记忆因短视决策而漂移到不利的未来。
AI.method: 1) 将记忆的“预测状态”定义为由已保留历史所支持的未来表征空间；把逐出视作在该空间中的反事实控制。2) 提出SPACE：利用冻结的多时域JEPA模型，对不同逐出动作的未来表征进行反事实预测；以反事实效用选择有未来价值的替代方案；结合“慢变的预测盆地（attractor/basin）几何”判断何时纠偏可避免的漂移、何时适应持续变化，全程无需在线参数更新。3) 提出MABS-Bench：在匹配因果流与一致内存预算下，评估未来任务充足性、同域预测稳定性、转变响应性与扰动恢复力。
AI.result: 在多种视频数据集上，SPACE在数据集原生任务上取得稳定提升，并相较基线显著降低预测状态漂移；MABS-Bench为不同策略在未来任务支持性与稳定性上的差异提供了量化证据。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆逐出建模为预测状态空间中的反事实控制，配合冻结JEPA进行多步前瞻，可在不更新参数的前提下兼顾适应性与稳定性。SPACE在实际基准上提升任务表现并抑制漂移，MABS-Bench为后续研究提供系统评测框架。

title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
comment: 9 pages of main text plus appendices. Code: https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE
summary: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GAUGE：一种对单目视频点轨迹预测进行后处理的、无需训练且与模型无关的校正方法，通过少量度量锚点自适应估计每个运动组的径向尺度与平移，显著降低端点误差（15%–63%）。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型直接从单目视频回归稠密3D点轨迹，但即使全局对齐后仍有显著残差，且缺乏结构性解释。作者观察到误差主要沿视线方向集中，不同运动组所需的尺度修正不同，而预测的位移方向却具有较强一致性（远优于随机90°基线）。这表明系统性误差是各运动组在视线方向上的“规选”自由度（2D观测无法约束），亟需一种能按运动组消解视线方向不一致性的机制。
AI.method: 提出GAUGE：训练后、模型无关的模块。1）基于位移方向一致性与空间连通性恢复运动组；2）对每个组、每帧估计沿视线方向的径向尺度和组级平移，利用1%–5%的度量锚点求解，共四个自由度/组/帧；3）对原预测进行组内径向重标定与平移校正，从而消除组别视线不一致（group-wise view inconsistency）。
AI.result: 在8个跟踪器（含D4RT, 4RC, SM4RT等）的动态查询点上进行评测，GAUGE较未校正预测将端点误差降低15.1%–62.6%。将相同比例的锚点用于基于梯度的微调仅带来-1.1%–15.2%的改进，显著劣于GAUGE。
AI.conclusion: 单目轨迹预测的主导系统误差源于各运动组的视线向径向自由度。通过基于方向一致性的分组与少量锚点的组内径向/平移估计，GAUGE在无需训练、与模型无关的前提下显著提升多种跟踪器的精度，优于将锚点用于常规微调。

title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
summary: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.

AI.tldr: LevyMatch提出以稳定分布驱动的随机跳跃来迭代细化点云软匹配矩阵，结合网络预测的目标匹配、Brownian桥显式更新公式与Gamma随机时钟步长，并用“前置加权”的Gamma步长重排在不增加模型评估次数下显著提高匹配质量。
AI.motivation: 低重叠或非刚性形变的点云使可靠对应困难；虽然迭代细化能修正不确定匹配，但每次需网络前向，计算昂贵限制更新轮数。作者希望在固定或少量网络评估下，最大化迭代修正的效率与最终匹配精度。
AI.method: 提出LevyMatch：1) 维护软匹配矩阵；2) 在每步由网络基于当前匹配与几何信息预测目标匹配；3) 采用以Brownian参考桥推导的显式更新公式，将当前匹配向目标推进；4) 用Gamma随机时钟设定每次更新步长（对应Lévy驱动的随机跳跃）；5) 提出固定的“前置加载”Gamma策略：将同一组采样的Gamma增量重排，使较大步长优先用于早期更新，无需额外训练或更多网络评估。
AI.result: 在4DMatch与4DLoMatch数据集上，相较现有方法提升非刚性特征匹配召回（NFMR）与内点率（IR）。采用前置策略在4DMatch达NFMR 93.09%、IR 92.11%；在4DLoMatch达NFMR 82.79%、IR 79.07%。
AI.conclusion: 通过Lévy跳跃与Gamma时钟控制的迭代细化，并将较大步长前置，可在不增加网络评估的情况下显著提升非刚性点云匹配的准确性与稳健性，优于对照方法。

title: DraftAttention2: Fast Video Diffusion with Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention
summary: Video generation has broad applications in content creation and entertainment. Diffusion transformers have advanced the quality of generated videos, but attention over spatiotemporal tokens becomes increasingly expensive as video resolution and duration increase. We present DraftAttention2, a training-free framework that uses the low-resolution draft attention map to jointly select attention blocks and assign their numerical precision. Specifically, spatial 2D average- and max-pooled queries and keys capture complementary regional statistics to estimate block importance, and a shared ranking assigns higher precision to important blocks, lower precision to less important retained blocks, and skips the rest under configurable budgets. Our analysis separates sparsification error from attention-weighted quantization error, establishing when recovering skipped interactions with low-bit computation tightens the output-error bound. This analysis motivates retaining more interactions at low precision while reserving higher precision for blocks with larger attention mass. To translate these fine-grained assignments into practical speedups, we further develop fused operand preparation and a single attention kernel with precision-specific phases, sharing data movement, softmax statistics, and output accumulation across precisions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior quality-efficiency trade-off over existing efficient video generation methods. Notably, its advantage is particularly pronounced for few-step video diffusion, where jointly combining sparsity with 4- and 8-bit mixed-precision computation substantially improves generation quality while retaining significant acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/anemoi-project/anemoi

AI.tldr: DraftAttention2 是一个无训练的注意力加速与压缩框架：用低分辨率草稿注意力图来选择哪些注意力块保留、用何种数值精度计算，并通过融合算子与单核多精度阶段实现实际加速；在保证视频质量的同时显著降低时空注意力的计算开销，尤其在少步扩散生成中效果突出。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的时空注意力代价会随分辨率与时长急剧上升，现有稀疏或低精度方法难以同时把控质量与效率。需要一个能在不重新训练模型的前提下，自适应挑选重要交互并匹配合适精度、还能转化为真实端到端加速的方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用低分辨率“草稿”注意力：对查询/键进行2D平均与最大池化以获得互补区域统计，生成块级重要性估计；2) 共享排序与预算分配：重要块用高精度，次要块用低比特精度，不重要块直接跳过；3) 误差分解理论：将稀疏化误差与注意力加权量化误差分离，给出在何种条件下用低比特恢复被跳过交互可收紧输出误差上界，推动“更多交互低精度+少量高精度”的策略；4) 系统实现：融合操作数准备与单一注意力内核，分精度阶段共享数据搬运、softmax统计与输出累加，实现实际速度提升。
AI.result: 在多种视频生成基准上，相比现有效率方法获得更优的质量—效率权衡；在少步视频扩散场景中优势最显著：将稀疏与4/8位混合精度结合，可在保持显著加速的同时大幅提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: DraftAttention2 通过训练外的块级重要性评估与混合精度分配，并配合工程级单核多精度实现，兼顾理论误差控制与系统效率，显著降低视频扩散注意力成本，特别适用于少步扩散的高效高质视频生成。

title: InterTab: Interleaved Visual-Structure Alignment for Multi-Modal Table Reasoning
summary: Table images preserve structural information that are often lost in text serialization, and reasoning over them requires locating relevant rows, columns, and cells step by step. Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode the whole image once before reasoning, so they cannot pick up row-, column-, and cell-level evidence as the question unfolds. Encoder-side table structure and generic interleaved visual chain-of-thought still do not bind each reasoning step to that structure. We propose \textbf{InterTab}, an \textbf{Inter}leaved structure-aware framework for CoT reasoning over \textbf{Tab}le images, interleaves chain-of-thought with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions. First, we build InterTab-22K, includes reasoning trajectories in which each step is tied to both a structural location and a bounding box. InterTab is trained in two stages: supervised structure-aware alignment (SSA) on InterTab-22K teaches the model to interleave reasoning with structure-aligned crops, and active localization optimization (ALO) further optimizes answer correctness, localization IoU, and output format, while penalizing missing or excessive tool calls. Experiments on nine table benchmarks show that InterTab improves the average accuracy of its backbone from 68.28% to 73.17% and achieves the best average performance among all compared methods. Code and data will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出InterTab：在表格图像上将链式思维与结构对齐裁剪工具调用交替进行的框架；通过SSA与ALO两阶段训练，在9个数据集上将基线从68.28%提升到73.17%。
AI.motivation: 表格图像包含行、列、单元格等结构信息，序列化为文本会丢失结构。现有MLLM一次性编码整图，难以在逐步推理中精确定位并利用结构化证据；已有结构编码或通用多模态CoT也未将每一步与具体结构位置绑定。
AI.method: 提出InterTab：在推理过程中交替进行自然语言CoT与“结构对齐的裁剪”工具调用。构建InterTab-22K数据集，标注每步推理对应的表格结构位置与边界框。两阶段训练：1) 监督式结构感知对齐（SSA），学习在每一步生成并调用与结构对齐的裁剪；2) 主动定位优化（ALO），联合优化答案正确性、定位IoU与输出格式，并惩罚缺失或过多的工具调用。
AI.result: 在9个表格基准上，相比骨干模型，平均准确率从68.28%提升至73.17%，为对比方法中的最佳平均表现。
AI.conclusion: 将推理步骤与表格结构位置显式绑定，并在推理中动态裁剪相关区域，可显著提升表格图像推理效果；所提两阶段训练与新数据集支持这一范式且达到了SOTA平均性能。

title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
summary: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出RCVLA框架与两大数据集，将4D雷达有效融入视觉-语言-行动模型，在语义推理与轨迹裁决上显著提升，含多项定量改进与消融验证。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA多依赖相机与语言，缺乏能稳定提供几何与运动信息的4D雷达融合方案；需要既能实现雷达-语言对齐用于语义推理，又能在运动规划中显式利用雷达量测以改进轨迹生成与选择。
AI.method: 构建两套数据：Cap4DR(8.6万雷达-图像-文本对)用于对齐预训练；OmniHD-QA(52万QA)用于指令微调（场景描述、关键目标推理、占用理解、轨迹规划）。提出两阶段RCVLA：1) RCVLA-Sem：相机/雷达token门控双向交互，回答驾驶问题并生成参考轨迹；辅以物体与占用查询头。2) RCVLA-Phys：以截断扩散在查询与雷达簇级量测条件下细化候选轨迹，并用雷达导出的TTC风险校准候选评分。
AI.result: 在OmniHD-QA上，RCVLA-Sem相比OmniDrive，CIDEr+9.92，关键目标速度误差降21.9%。加入RCVLA-Phys后，平均L2误差从0.348降至0.259 m，开环碰撞率从0.576%降至0.175%。
AI.conclusion: 语言对齐的雷达token显著提升语义推理；簇级雷达量测与基于TTC的风险校准提升轨迹仲裁效果。整体框架有效将4D雷达融入VLA，带来显著性能与安全性收益。

title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

AI.tldr: 作者发现：把图像换成其描述/代码等符号化输入，MLLM 在多项数据集与模型规模上反而提升10.2%~23.6%。他们将此称为“符号视觉鸿沟”，并提出MM-OPD：用符号条件的行为去蒸馏纠正图像条件策略，在残差token级别传递监督，显著提升感知、图表/文档理解、数理推理与通用VQA。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM通常假设“感知→推理”顺畅衔接，但实测显示即便感知与推理单项能力不差，图像输入到推理之间在“证据选择”上存在瓶颈；而符号化视图（caption/code）似乎能聚焦正确证据，启发利用其作为可规模化的监督来源，无需人工证据标注。
AI.method: 1) 经验现象：在同一模型、问题与解码下，以图像描述/代码替代原图，性能显著提升，定义“符号视觉鸿沟”。2) 诊断：对比思维链与注意力，发现符号输入能更聚焦正确证据；图像输入虽含有正确线索，但注意分配不佳。3) 提出MM-OPD：多模态on-policy自蒸馏，将“符号条件行为”对“图像条件策略”进行校正；以残差token级目标在生成过程中传递细粒度指导，实现从符号到视觉的证据选择矫正。
AI.result: 跨基准与不同模型规模，MM-OPD带来广泛提升：视觉感知、图表/文档理解、数学推理、通用VQA均有增益；相较基线缩小甚至弥合符号视觉鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 问题不在单纯的感知或推理能力，而在二者之间的证据选择瓶颈。符号化视图可作为可扩展监督源。MM-OPD通过符号到视觉的在策略自蒸馏与残差token级校正，有效引导模型聚焦正确视觉证据，提升多模态推理泛化能力。

title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

AI.tldr: 提出DPAMixerSR：一种考虑退化模式的自适应稀疏计算框架，用PDR划分重退化与轻退化区域，分别走ASP稀疏结构对齐路径与轻量卷积分支，在多尺度双向细化中提升结构与感知质量，同时显著降低算力开销。
AI.motivation: 现有内容自适应SR多依据纹理复杂度分配计算，忽视模糊核、噪声等内在退化差异，导致资源分配与重建质量次优；需要一种能感知退化模式并动态调度计算的框架。
AI.method: 1) 设计轻量的感知退化排序（PDR）模块，对图像块进行退化程度判别并路由；2) 对重退化块采用自适应稀疏处理（ASP）：结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化；3) 对轻退化块采用轻量卷积分支以提高效率；4) 通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理耦合，形成自调节的计算-质量平衡机制。
AI.result: 在多种SR任务与数据集上，相较现有方法实现更优的结构恢复与感知保真，同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 退化模式感知与结构对齐稀疏处理的结合，可在保持或提升重建质量的同时减少计算，提供了可扩展的、资源高效的SR新范式。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
summary: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

AI.tldr: ProDyGS 通过单目视频与单目深度先验，在无多视角监督的条件下，构建深度引导的代理多视图并结合可变形3D高斯，实现动态场景的新视角合成，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单静态相机拍摄的动态场景缺乏多视角几何约束，现有方法通常需要多相机或强相机运动，或依赖更强先验（如场景流）。作者希望在完全无多视角监督下，仍能高质量地进行动态新视角合成。
AI.method: 1) 用单目深度基础模型估计时间一致的深度；2) 以此构建场景的3D高斯表示，并从任意视角渲染“代理图像”形成合成多视图监督；3) 设计变形网络，将规范帧中的高斯通过学习到的时变形形场进行时序形变；4) 以真实观测与代理多视图共同监督，端到端优化渲染质量与时序一致性。
AI.result: 在 DyNeRF 数据集上达到SOTA，仅依赖单目深度作为外部监督，优于依赖更强先验（如场景流）的对手。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度引导的代理多视图与可变形3D高斯，ProDyGS 在无多视角监督条件下有效学习动态几何与运动，实现高质量新视角合成，并以更弱先验取得更好性能。

title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出一种区域-局部copula证据融合方法，在保持超像素区域决策框架的同时，引入空间可变的局部依赖异常以提升异质遥感变化检测的定位与边界表现；在两个数据集上显著提升Kappa并揭示门控/校准的场景依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于超像素的copula模型能提供稳定的区域证据，但每个超像素仅有单一标签，导致混合超像素内部变化难以精细定位，尤其在边界与异质区域；需要方法兼顾区域稳健性与局部细粒度信息。
AI.method: 在区域copula框架下，引入独立拟合的局部模型以刻画相邻时相影像间未变化关系的偏离（局部依赖异常）；通过参考排序与上尾门控（upper-tail gate）将局部异常转换为可与连续区域置信度融合的量；推导区域依赖的局部决策阈值，并给出门控与无门控融合在特定条件下等价（参数重参数化）的理论结果；在Lake与UK数据上采用整幅图像优化配置与四折空间回溯验证评估。
AI.result: 整图优化下，Kappa分别达0.78136（Lake）与0.90817（UK），在混合区域与边界处的决策更优；四折空间回溯验证显示局部信息与区域证据互补：无门控参考融合平均Kappa提升0.00693（Lake）与0.01793（UK）；固定门控在UK提升0.03353，但在Lake仅0.00041，表明场景依赖。
AI.conclusion: 区域-局部依赖交互有效提升异质场景下的变化检测，且门控与校准收益依赖于场景；建议在应用中根据场景选择是否门控与如何校准，以平衡稳定的区域证据与精细的局部定位。

title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

AI.tldr: 提出REALIS数据集与评测协议，覆盖42个生成器和多种后处理，减少数据集捷径，提供高难度子集与鲁棒性测试，以更真实地评估并提升AI生成图像检测器的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器常在基准上借助内容/质量/伪影差异取巧，遇到新生成器或图像处理后泛化差；现有数据集难以在多样内容下同时评估这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建REALIS：1.43M张真实与合成图像，来自42个文本生成图像模型（含最新商用如Nano Banana 2）；用从真实图像提取的提示、质量过滤与分层采样以降低类别捷径并保持内容多样。提出REALIS-Expert高难子集：严格匹配真实与合成样本的语义与视觉特征，强调高质量合成。制定鲁棒性协议：35种图像变换×5级强度，分析后处理下的检测表现。基于REALIS对预训练检测器、微调模型与零样本视觉语言模型在生成器转移与后处理转移场景下进行评测。
AI.result: 在最难的“处理后”划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器ROC-AUC为0.550；在REALIS上训练的最佳检测器达0.752，显著提升泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: REALIS与其协议统一了对生成器与后处理转移的评测框架，减少数据集捷径影响，并通过高难子集与系统化鲁棒性测试，更贴近真实应用场景，能有效衡量与提升AI图像检测器的可靠性。

title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出G2DA框架，通过梯度感知的任务解耦与排序来提升Geo-VLM多任务适配性能，在三大基准与多种模型组合上均显著超越现有方法。
