We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出PolicyWeave：在共享动作接口下，通过上下文引导的稀疏合并，将多任务VLA中独立SFT/RL专家的LoRA更新稳定地合并，显著提升多任务性能与可部署性。
AI.motivation: 多任务VLA常用协同训练，但往往不及逐任务单独训练的表现。直接模型合并独立专家也常失效，原因之一是各任务对动作接口（归一化、编码器/解码器）的任务特定改动导致不兼容。研究动机是在不进行昂贵的联合后训练下，保留单任务增益并实现强健的多任务合并与部署。
AI.method: 1) 合并兼容的后训练：固定共享基础策略的动作接口；各任务仅在动作模型的隐层上用LoRA进行适配，从而使专家之间在接口上对齐。2) 上下文引导的稀疏合并：用初始视觉-语言上下文为每个专家的LoRA更新打分；通过逐层留一稳定性排名确定专家集合；对选中专家的LoRA权重进行稀疏加权合并，并在当前任务期间保持不变。
AI.result: 在GR00T N1.5与RoboCasa365的18个任务上，仅用目标任务10%示例进行SFT：保持共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从17.0%提升到52.8%。PolicyWeave在SFT专家下达64.7%，经任务特定RL后达74.1%，优于联合RL的60.7%。在LIBERO-10与AgileX Piper真实机械臂上进一步验证了长时程与现实部署能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享动作接口下限制适配到LoRA并采用上下文驱动的稀疏合并，PolicyWeave缓解了专家不兼容与任务干扰问题，实现了无需联合后训练即可保留并集成独立技能，在多任务与真实场景中取得显著提升。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出DroneWAM：一种高效用于无人机视觉导航的世界-动作模型（WAM），在新建的DroneNav-6D数据集上达最佳轨迹精度，并通过自适应rollout以更少预测步数取得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 无人机需要在严格的精度与算力约束下进行视觉导航与前瞻性规划。现有WAM多依赖显式未来图像生成或高开销推理，难以满足机载平台实时性与鲁棒性；同时现有数据集/任务对6-DoF飞行动态和风扰动等现实因素覆盖不足。
AI.method: 1) 架构：基于JEPA的世界-动作模型，直接在表征空间预测未来状态，避免生成未来图像的开销。2) Resampler：用预训练重采样器将稠密编码特征压缩为更少潜在token，减少每个想象步的重复计算。3) 自适应rollout：通过偏好训练的Gate，根据当前场景自适应分配预测深度。4) 数据：构建DroneNav-6D模拟数据集，含同步RGB、6-DoF轨迹、控制指令与随机风扰动。
AI.result: 在DroneNav-6D上，DroneWAM在比较方法中获得最佳轨迹精度；自适应rollout将平均预测深度由8降至4.58的同时提升轨迹精度，显示预测计算可更有效地按场景分配。
AI.conclusion: 在无人机视觉导航中，用基于JEPA的表征空间预测与重采样压缩能显著提升效率与精度；引入自适应rollout能在减少计算的同时提升性能。DroneNav-6D为更丰富的空中运动与扰动提供了训练与评测基准；代码和数据将开源。

title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Interactive benchmark dashboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/focus-retina-benchmark/focus-retinal-benchmark-arena
summary: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

AI.tldr: 提出FOCUS：一个针对眼底图像的跨数据集评测基准，统一多任务与多模型家族，系统评估排序、校准、公平性与图像质量鲁棒性，发现无单一模型家族全面占优，微调提升域内但跨域校准不稳定。
AI.motivation: 单一数据集成绩无法反映医学影像模型在数据集偏移、临床定义差异与人群子组上的表现；安全部署需要鲁棒性、校准性与公平性度量，因此需要一个跨数据集、跨任务、跨模型类型的统一评测框架。
AI.method: 构建FOCUS基准：统一三类任务（DR二分类、可转诊DR、青光眼性视神经病变）与10个公开数据集的标签与评测标准；覆盖VM、VLM、MLLM三类模型；通过统一分析层评估排名性能（如AUC/排名指标）、概率校准、子组差异（公平性）与图像质量鲁棒性；对532个基础配置与228个MLLM LoRA微调配置进行大规模评测，比较端到端与轻量适配效果与跨域迁移。
AI.result: 没有模型家族在所有任务/数据集上占优：通用视觉编码器VM平均排名最好；医学MLLM具有竞争力但方差大；双编码VLM在轻量适配后收益显著。监督微调能提升域内性能，但对外部数据集的迁移不均衡，尤其在校准上波动明显。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜模型评测是多维度问题，单一数据集排行榜不足以反映真实可靠性。FOCUS提供了实用的公共基准与统一框架，以系统评估泛化、可靠性与鲁棒性，指导更安全公平的临床部署与未来研究。

title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
summary: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

AI.tldr: FloodDiffusion 2（FD2）在FD1基础上显著提升效率与可控性：通过部分注意力实现KV缓存与共享历史打包训练；提出保持扩散条件均值速度场的Bregman充要判据并据此设计FK诱导二次回归损失；加入精确路径条件控制根部轨迹而不牺牲自然肢体动作。训练算力降4.6倍、推理加速11.29倍（长序列每步2.303 ms），并在SEED与HumanML3D上达流式SOTA的FID（0.048/0.053）。
AI.motivation: FD1尽管能生成可信动作，但因注意力需反复计算全历史而效率低，且缺乏对现实应用关键的精确轨迹控制；同时希望在提升可控性的同时进一步改善生成质量与可扩展的长序列流式推断。
AI.method: 1）Partial Attention：将已定型的历史表示与活动窗口解耦，支持KV缓存推理与共享历史打包训练，显著减少重复计算。2）Bregman充要判据：形式化给出回归损失在扩散框架下保持条件均值速度场的必要且充分条件；据此提出无需在线FK计算的FK诱导二次损失，注入运动几何先验。3）精确路径条件（path conditioning）：强约束角色root轨迹，同时保持上层肢体的自然运动。
AI.result: - 训练计算开销降低4.6×；- 去噪速度提升11.29×，长序列每步2.303 ms；- 运动质量较FD1提升；- 在流式方法中取得SOTA：SEED FID=0.048，HumanML3D FID=0.053。
AI.conclusion: FD2通过结构化注意力、理论驱动的回归损失与路径级可控，兼顾效率、可控性与质量，在流式动作生成上达到新的SOTA，并适用于长序列与实际应用场景。

title: ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification
summary: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 ABO-Med：在医疗少样本分类中，将一阶双层优化范式无缝融入 MAML，配合面向医学影像的自适应增强 MedRAug；理论上给出 MAML 类元学习的最优性结果；实证上在多数据集显著超越基线并具备高效训练。
AI.motivation: 双层优化在机器学习广泛应用，但以往方法依赖二阶信息，计算和扩展性受限。近期一阶双层优化有近最优理论，但缺少面向具体任务（如医疗少样本学习）的可扩展实现与系统验证。医学影像有模态差异，通用增强策略不一定合适，亟需模态感知的数据增强。
AI.method: 1) 设计 ABO-Med：把一阶双层优化范式嵌入 MAML，避免二阶梯度，专注医疗少样本分类；2) 提出 MedRAug：基于模态（如放射、超声等）自适应的 RandomAugment 变体，按模态调整增强操作与强度；3) 理论分析证明 ABO-Med 下 MAML 类方法的最优性；4) 通过跨域实验、消融与效率评估验证。
AI.result: 在多个公开医学数据集上，ABO-Med 相比既有基线提升约 1.99%–18.76%；在此基础上加入 MedRAug 进一步平均提升约 2.20%–6.34%。还展示了跨域泛化更好、增强与骨干消融有效、训练更高效。
AI.conclusion: 以一阶双层优化实现的 ABO-Med 为 MAML 型元学习提供了理论最优性与可扩展实践路径；结合模态感知的 MedRAug，在医疗少样本分类上取得显著、稳健且高效的性能提升。

title: Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?
summary: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

AI.tldr: 提出ProSlide框架，通过蛋白质组先验与跨模态蒸馏提升全切片病理WSI表征；在乳腺、肺、肾癌12项任务上达最高平均准确率与AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型难以直接利用大规模分离的分子组学语料：多数分子模型面向蛋白序列或单细胞而非与WSI成对的患者级整体表达；跨模态监督局限于成对样本，导致分子知识仅间接传入病理编码器，形成“成对支持瓶颈”。
AI.method: 三阶段：1) 以12,695条样本级蛋白质表达谱预训练蛋白质组基础编码器PFE，使用虚拟谱生成与表达空间多视角预训练以弥合模态差距；2) 以成对WSI-蛋白数据预训练ProSlide的patch-region-slide分层编码器，预测蛋白表达；3) 通过Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏，将每个成对样本的WSI与其蛋白谱在共享、冻结的PFE编码库（含成对与独立样本）上的相似度分布对齐，从而利用独立分子语料缓解成对瓶颈。
AI.result: 在乳腺、肺、肾癌的12个下游任务中，尽管仅使用2,229张WSI与12,695条蛋白谱进行预训练，ProSlide在各癌种组内均取得最高的平均准确率与AUC。
AI.conclusion: 通过将蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移解耦，并引入关系蒸馏对齐WSI与蛋白表达在共享嵌入库上的相似结构，ProSlide有效突破成对样本限制，显著提升病理WSI的下游性能。

title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

AI.tldr: 提出FocusDrive：以显式视觉聚焦为核心的多模态端到端驾驶推理与规划框架，利用对象描述+图像补丁引用联通场景理解与动作生成，在W3DA与NAVSIM上实现有竞争力的注视预测与端到端规划，优于纯文本CoT。
AI.motivation: 传统文本理据（链式思考）可描述驾驶决策但难将推理与具体视觉证据对齐；驾驶需要明确“看什么、在哪、如何行动”。缺乏将决策相关视觉注意与规划紧密耦合的结构化方法，限制了可解释性与性能。
AI.method: 提出FocusDrive结构化多模态框架：1) 用显式视觉聚焦表示，给出与决策相关的目标对象描述并指向对应图像补丁位置；2) 将该聚焦嵌入端到端规划推理，生成驾驶计划与轨迹；3) 通过驾驶员凝视预测评估聚焦表示质量；4) 在含有驾驶聚焦标注的NAVSIM场景中研究其在规划中的作用；5) 在W3DA与NAVSIM上实验，与文本CoT对比。
AI.result: 在W3DA与NAVSIM数据集上，FocusDrive在凝视预测与端到端规划指标上取得有竞争力甚至更优表现，相比纯文本链式思考在规划上有提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式视觉聚焦（对象+图像补丁引用）可有效桥接场景理解与驾驶动作，提升可解释性与性能；作为端到端规划推理的组织中枢，优于仅依赖文本理据的方法。

title: ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead
summary: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出ReAL，一种无需再训练的flow-matching采样器，通过一次共享前瞻（lookahead）自适应选择步长与校正端点，实现单次新评估/步的高效采样；在多种图像与视频生成任务上以≈5×加速保持接近原始质量。
AI.motivation: flow-matching/ODE类生成在采样阶段需多次网络前向，成本高；简单跳步依赖局部速度一致性但难以确定步长，且为验证端点需额外模型调用，抵消加速收益。需要一种能在不增加端点评估的情况下，稳健地确定可用长步并进行校正的方法。
AI.method: 引入一次共享lookahead：先在当前位置做一次前瞻评估得到速度。基于“未校正端点”和“经lookahead校正的端点”之间的差异，可用已观测到的速度不匹配和候选跨度（超过lookahead的部分）解析地估计二者差距，从而定义随跨度变化的判别准则，无需对每个候选端点再做模型调用。选通过判据的最长跨度，应用校正更新，并将其速度作为下次迭代的初始估计；初始化后每步只需一次新评估。无需改动预训练模型或噪声日程，也不访问内部特征。
AI.result: 在四个图像生成骨干、视频生成与图像编辑上验证：在FLUX.1-dev上实测4.91×加速，保留97.0%密集采样的ImageReward；在HunyuanVideo上达5.49×加速，VBench分数与密集采样接近。
AI.conclusion: ReAL用单次共享lookahead将自适应大步长选择与端点校正合一，实现几乎“1评估/步”的采样，显著加速flow-matching生成同时维持高保真与任务通用性，且为零训练、即插即用。

title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出在Diffusion Transformer中将残差连接从被动求和改为可学习的跨层“检索”机制，通过选择性关注早期层特征，以极少参数开销显著提升收敛速度与FID。
AI.motivation: DiT通常使用统一的残差流，将所有前序层混合为单一状态，缺乏像U-Net那样结构化、可控的信息通道。作者观察到DiT内部存在对早期特征复用与层间对称指导的偏好，动机是将这种隐性偏好显式化，构建高效的跨层信息路径以更好支持去噪任务。
AI.method: 对DiT内部表示做系统分析后，设计“自适应跨层连接”：在每个Transformer块中加入局部残差与远程跨深度路径的显式结构，并用可微的选择性注意机制，让当前层主动“检索”关键早期表示（空间与语义线索），而非静态跳连或全层密集路由；形成既稀疏又可学习的跨层注意路由。
AI.result: 在几乎不增加参数（<0.1%）的情况下，实现更快收敛（训练迭代减少至原来的约1/1.73），FID与视觉质量显著提升：在REPA-XL/2模型上无引导FID从5.9降至4.34，使用classifier-free guidance达到1.39 FID。
AI.conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是DiT提升性能和可扩展性的关键但被低估的维度。通过结构化信息通道与可学习的跨层检索，可在极小开销下带来更快训练与更高生成质量，为扩展可扩展生成模型提供简单有效的方向。

title: Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching
summary: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer. Directly scaling the displacement also changes copying without further training. The post-removal copying effects of reciprocal transfer are reproduced across datasets and architectures. Together, these results identify the background gradient response as a mechanism through which same-class training data shape the retention of target learning and the reproduction of target images.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在类别条件的flow matching训练中，背景（同类但非目标图像）如何影响对目标图像的记忆与复制。关键发现：把重复的同类背景替换为多样的同类背景，显著降低目标提取/复制率（80.7%→18.0%）；提出“成对轨迹”框架，揭示目标诱导的参数位移与背景梯度响应的相互作用；通过可交换的响应转移与移除实验，确定背景响应在目标保留与复制中的因果作用，并表明仅缩放位移或在移除后沿位移方向校正即可重现大部分复制效应。
AI.motivation: 生成模型中“重复→记忆”的关系已知，但不清楚非目标的同类训练样本如何塑造对特定目标的保留与复制。作者动机是量化并解释：在相同目标重复度下，背景数据的多样性为何会强烈改变目标被“抽取/复制”的概率，并寻求可解释的机制。
AI.method:
在类别条件flow matching设定中：
- 设计对照：保持目标重复与同类背景行数不变，用重复背景 vs. 多样背景替换；测量目标提取/复制率。
- 提出“成对轨迹（paired-trajectory）”分析：分解训练更新为“目标诱导的参数位移（displacement）”与“背景对该位移的梯度响应（response）”。
- 给出背景响应的路径积分曲率表述，将背景损失几何与目标学习联系。
- 做“互易响应转移”（repeated↔distinct）与“移除后校正/缩放位移”实验，评估因果性与是否需进一步训练。
AI.result:
- 将重复同类背景替换为多样同类背景，目标提取率从80.7%降至18.0%。
- 背景梯度响应具有精确的路径积分曲率表示，可预测目标保留/复制变化。
- 在重复与多样背景间做响应的互易转移，会双向改变目标保留与复制，确立其因果作用。
- 移除目标后，仅沿目标位移方向做响应校正，能保留约90%的完整响应转移带来的复制效应；直接缩放位移无需再训练也能调控复制强度。
- 上述后移除效应在多数据集与架构上复现。
AI.conclusion: 同类背景数据通过其对目标诱导参数位移的梯度响应，系统性地塑造了目标学习的保留与复制。重复背景增强、而多样背景抑制目标复制；该效应可由成对轨迹框架定量解释，并可通过响应转移或位移缩放在训练后操控复制风险，对缓解记忆化与数据泄露具有方法学指导意义。

title: RepFlow: Reciprocal Supervision Improves Generation and Representation in Flow Models
summary: Generative models learn visual structure through denoising, yet their internal states are entangled with both noise level and network depth, making it difficult to obtain a stable visual representation from the generator itself. We introduce RepFlow, which learns such a representation from the generator's evolving computation and uses it to guide generation. Specifically, a separate timestep-free encoder is trained, through a timestep-conditioned predictor, to recover generator states across depths and noise levels from masked clean images. By excluding the reference noise and masked-out content from the encoder's input, we encourage the encoder to distill visual information that is recoverable from the visible image context and predictive of generator states. The representation learned from the generator's evolving states is then fed back to guide and improve the generator, whose updated states provide supervision for further representation learning, forming a reciprocal learning process. This reciprocal process improves multi-step generation and representation quality, as measured by frozen linear probing on ImageNet with latent-space SiT and pixel-space JiT, without an externally pretrained representation teacher. Across the two unconditional settings, FID decreases by $19.2$--$40.8\%$ relative to native training, while linear-probe accuracy improves by 6.80--10.04 percentage points over the best searched raw generator features. The learned representation also serves as a distributional metric for one-step JiT post-training, extending its role from instance-level alignment to distribution-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出RepFlow：从生成器演化计算中学习时间步无关的视觉表示，并反哺生成过程，提升生成质量与可线性探测的表示能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散/去噪式生成模型的内部状态同时受噪声水平与网络深度纠缠，难以直接获得稳定、可用的视觉表示；现有改进多依赖外部预训练教师或仅利用原始生成器特征，效果与稳定性受限。
AI.method: 训练一个与时间步无关的编码器E，但通过时间步条件预测器P进行监督，使E从带掩膜的干净图像中预测生成器在不同深度与噪声水平下的中间状态；输入显式排除参考噪声与被遮挡内容，迫使E仅基于可见上下文提炼可恢复且可预测生成器状态的视觉信息。随后将该学得表示回馈给生成器引导多步生成，并用更新后的生成器状态继续监督E，形成相互促进的“互惠学习”闭环。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，针对潜空间SiT与像素空间JiT的无条件设置：FID较原生训练降低19.2–40.8%；线性探测Top-1较最佳原始生成器特征提升6.80–10.04个百分点；此外，该表示可作为一步JiT后训练的分布度量，用于分布级监督。
AI.conclusion: RepFlow无需外部教师即可从生成器演化中提炼稳健表示，并通过互惠学习同时提升生成质量与可迁移表示；所学表示还扩展为分布级度量，兼顾实例与分布对齐场景。

title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
summary: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.

AI.tldr: 提出Scope-WM：在视觉世界模型中通过“选择+稀疏预测+复用好动作序列”实现高效规划，显著降低显存与时间开销，同时保持任务表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型用于机器人规划，但密集潜变量传播与采样密集的轨迹优化带来高时延与内存占用；现有稀疏化方法要么无指导丢失关键信息、稀疏率受限，要么依赖重型辅助模块与繁琐多阶段训练，难以在资源受限平台实时部署。
AI.method: 1) 相关性蒸馏：用轻量的动作条件选择器从教师中学习“预测相关性”，只对被选中的少量token执行完整动力学预测；2) 背景高效更新：未选token用前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要进行更新，使背景能感知前景动态而无需昂贵的token两两交互；3) 规划阶段复用：在初始MPC搜索中保留并复用高质量动作序列，后续在缩减的rollout预算下聚焦搜索；4) 训练：一次性选择器蒸馏后，与稀疏世界模型进行单阶段联合训练。
AI.result: 在Push-T任务上，峰值GPU显存降至密集DINO-WM的18.1%，规划时间降至14.3%，实现约6.97×规划加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率；在五个多样视觉规划任务上也验证了通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将计算聚焦于与预测和规划最相关的潜在区域与动作，Scope-WM在不牺牲性能的情况下大幅降低内存与延迟，训练流程简单，适合资源受限平台的实时视觉规划。

title: AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception
summary: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.

AI.tldr: 提出并公开了一个大规模FMCW LiDAR数据集与基准，包含多任务评测（检测、场景流、分割）并验证多普勒速度能显著提升远距离识别与场景流精度，尤其在单帧低时延设置下。
AI.motivation: 传统ToF激光雷达缺乏每点径向速度信息，限制了远距离与低时延感知性能；FMCW LiDAR提供的多普勒速度信号在长距离场景中的价值尚未系统研究与量化。
AI.method: 构建并发布包含575段序列（5.75万帧）、800万+3D框、16类检测、24类语义点标签的数据集，来自6台商用FMCW雷达与6台配对4K相机，覆盖8个湾区城市与237段夜间序列，标注最远至400m。设立三项任务基准：3D检测、场景流、语义分割；在至400m的三个距离分段评测，并提供公开评测服务器。系统对比是否使用多普勒量测对各任务性能的影响，特别关注单帧低时延设置。
AI.result: 引入多普勒后，远距离车辆与行人检测平均精度最高可提升约2倍；场景流在各距离段均显著提升精度；语义分割亦受益（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: FMCW LiDAR的多普勒速度在长距离与低时延感知中价值突出，可显著提升检测与场景流性能；所发布的数据集与基准为社区研究与公平比较提供了基础设施。

title: PARSEE-VAD: Efficient Training-Free Online Video Anomaly Detection via Proposition-Aware Reasoning and Streaming Evidence Escalation
summary: Training-free online video anomaly detection (VAD) with frozen multimodal language models faces two coupled challenges: extracting reliable current-window semantics under causal and computational constraints, and maintaining temporal continuity without repeatedly transmitting high-dimensional history. Encoding history through text can compress visual evidence and introduce semantic bias, whereas retaining visual history expands multimodal context. We introduce PARSEE-VAD, a two-module framework that separates semantic evidence acquisition from score-state evolution. Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) extracts structured propositional evidence from the current causal window and conditionally activates more specific queries when coarse evidence warrants further refinement. By sharing a reusable causal visual prefix across queries, PAR reduces redundant computation through selective execution. Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) maps the acquired proposition evidence into a compact score-domain event state through current evidence escalation, then propagates only the resulting bounded state across decisions to support temporal continuity. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong training-free online performance while selective routing reduces specialist computation and score-state propagation remains sparse. These results support a current-first principle for streaming multimodal inference: resolve present semantics first, then use compact historical state only to repair residual continuity gaps.

AI.tldr: 提出PARSEE-VAD：在无需训练的在线视频异常检测中，用命题化证据提取与紧凑分数态传播实现“当前优先、历史稀疏”的推理，兼顾实时性、鲁棒性与低计算。
AI.motivation: 冻结多模态大语言模型做在线VAD面临两难：1) 因因果与算力限制，难以在当前时间窗内稳定获取可靠语义；2) 需要保持时序连续，但又不能反复传输高维历史。文本化历史会压缩但引入语义偏差，保留视觉历史则上下文胀大、成本高。
AI.method:
提出两模块框架PARSEE-VAD：
- PAR（Proposition-Aware Reasoning）：在当前因果窗口内提取结构化“命题证据”；当粗粒度证据提示需要细化时，条件触发更具体查询。通过跨查询共享可复用的因果视觉前缀，并选择性执行以减少冗余计算。
- SEE（Streaming Evidence Escalation）：将命题证据映射为紧凑的“分数域事件状态”，进行当前证据的“升级/汇总”，并仅传播有界的分数态以维持时序连续性。
AI.result: 在四个基准上实现强劲的零训练在线性能；选择性路由减少专用模块计算，且分数态传播保持稀疏。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“先解当下、后补连续”的流式多模态推理原则：先解析当前语义，再用紧凑历史状态仅修补剩余的时序连续性缺口。

title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
summary: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.

AI.tldr: VGGT-Diff 通过将几何潜变量路由进预训练视频扩散模型，在稀疏多视角下实现稳健的新视角合成，兼顾几何一致性与生成能力，并在多种插值/外推难度上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有NVS方法两难：重建式方法几何保真但难合成不可见区域；扩散式方法生成先验强但缺乏显式对应关系，导致几何不稳与多视角不一致。需要一种既利用几何约束又发挥扩散生成力的框架。
AI.method: 提出VGGT-Diff，将来自VGGT-Ω的视觉几何token（每个含3D点与置信度）输入到预训练视频扩散模型。通过置信度感知的Visual Geometry Router（VGR）将源视几何潜变量变换为与目标查询对齐的条件，显式保留前后表面证据；在去噪过程中联合多目标视图生成。引入Point-Track Residual Consistency（PTRC）在可靠3D轨迹上正则化预测的clean residual，提高多视图稳定性。提出鲁棒几何条件化策略，结合训练期正则与推理期引导，提升对几何噪声的抗性。
AI.result: 在不同视点难度下的插值与外推任务上取得有竞争力或SOTA表现；对稀疏视角、遮挡与未观测区域有更好合成质量与一致性（具体数据未在摘要给出）。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何路由+扩散生成的协同，VGGT-Diff在保持观测几何的同时显著提升对不可见区域的生成与多视角一致性，展现出在稀疏多视角NVS中的有效性与鲁棒性，并提供代码实现。

title: EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning
summary: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

AI.tldr: 论文提出EngIntervene基准，评测多模态模型从状态理解到约束下干预推理的能力，涵盖7域、3229题，分四级（T1-T4）。结果显示：良好感知不等于良好干预；开放权重模型在T2-T4落后闭源14.7个百分点；去除/打乱视觉证据显著降分；专项微调只提升T1；T4揭示满足局部标准与全局有效干预间巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工程基准主要测静态理解，缺少检验模型能否在已知系统状态下进行关系、约束和设计变更后果推理的“中间环节”，这对实际工程设计与迭代至关重要。
AI.method: 构建EngIntervene数据集与评测框架：7个工程领域、3229问；统一工程状态表示（对象、关系、约束、目标）；四级任务T1（状态定位）、T2（关系/机理推理）、T3（约束感知诊断）、T4（干预推理：修改是否达成目标且保持约束）；T2-T4以结构化原子标准打分；对开源与闭源多模态模型进行对比、证据消融（移除/打乱视觉）、以及基准特定监督微调实验。
AI.result: 强状态定位不必然带来更好诊断/干预；最佳开源模型在T2-T4平均较最佳闭源低14.7个百分点；去除或打乱视觉证据均稳定降分；专项微调提升T1但对T2-T4无显著帮助；T4显示模型能满足部分修订标准却难以给出整体有效干预。
AI.conclusion: 工程推理不仅需准确恢复当前状态，还要稳健利用该状态进行约束推理与干预后果预测。EngIntervene揭示现有模型在从感知到干预的迁移上存在显著鸿沟，为未来方法提供系统化评测与研究基准。

title: VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.

AI.tldr: VehDyn是一个面向自动驾驶视频世界模型的“车辆动力学”评测与数据集：用CARLA+CarSim共仿真生成高保真视频与同步车辆状态，在独立可控的车辆/路面/机动/速度/场景/光照条件下，提出分层指标（轨迹、运动学、一致性）系统评估12个SOTA模型。结果：轨迹层面接近饱和，但动力学一致性普遍不足，与视觉质量弱相关；DrivingWorld得分最高。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型多以视觉质量和粗略物理为主，缺乏能检验“是否遵守真实车辆运动学与动力学”的基准；同时缺乏可独立控制车辆、路面摩擦、机动、速度、场景与光照，并提供视频与真值状态同步的开放数据。
AI.method: 构建CARLA（渲染）+CarSim（多体动力学、经验证）的共仿真平台，进行全因子实验：5种车辆×4种路面摩擦×3种机动×4种目标速度×14个场景×3种光照，共10,080种配置；为每个样本提供同步的位置、速度、姿态序列。基于此提出分层评估框架：1) 轨迹对齐；2) 运动学一致性；3) 动力学一致性；并在12个SOTA视频世界模型上基准测试；另用两种既有视频质量协议并与VehDyn分数相关性分析。
AI.result: - 轨迹级指标几近饱和：12个模型中有10个在距真值20%以内；- 动力学一致性无模型达到92%真值水平，存在明显差距；- 视觉质量与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关；- 排名：DrivingWorld最高，其次Cosmos 3 Nano、LTX-Video 2.5；- VehDyn得分与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: VehDyn提供了系统化的数据与评测框架，能区分“看起来真实”与“物理上真实”。当前视频世界模型在轨迹层面已接近上限，但在动力学一致性上仍显不足；未来应将动力学约束纳入模型训练与评价，以推动既物理一致又视觉真实的驾驶世界模型发展。

title: InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing
summary: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

AI.tldr: 提出InfoEdit基准，专测信息图编辑中的“重排（reflow）”推理；现有多模态编辑器普遍失效，仅少数模型表现合格；并展示代码级编辑与像素级编辑的互补。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑模型在自然照片上表现优异，但在包含逻辑关系与全局版式约束的信息图（infographics）上表现不佳。信息图的编辑往往牵一发而动全身，需要全局版式重排（reflow）能力；然而缺乏专门数据集与评测协议来衡量这一能力。
AI.method: 构建InfoEdit基准：包含1000张信息图、覆盖8类逻辑关系族；配套4000条编辑指令，涵盖4类编辑任务；设计“考虑重排”的评测协议。对8个前沿编辑器进行系统评测，并在理想目标定位（perfect localization）条件下分析上限。同时比较代码级（如SVG/结构化表示）编辑与像素级编辑的表现。
AI.result: 在8个编辑器中，只有GPT-Image-2平均成功率超过60%；大多数模型低于7%。即便给出完美定位，在Swap-Block任务上无模型超过36%。代码级编辑在某些任务上可匹敌最强的像素级编辑，显示二者具有互补优势。
AI.conclusion: 信息图编辑的核心难点在于全局版式重排（reflow）推理。InfoEdit作为诊断型基准揭示当前模型短板，并为后续方法改进（包括结合像素级与代码级编辑）提供评测与研究方向。

title: Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Supplementary video is provided as an ancillary file
summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对全景图的视角选择方法用于开放词汇情景记忆式EQA，通过立方体投影生成透视视图、用问题条件的BLIP-2评估相关性并进行多样性贪心选择，在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上取得SOTA，同时在减少65.5%旋转帧后仍基本保持准确率。
AI.motivation: 全景（等距矩形）图像虽能一次性覆盖周围环境、便于回顾历史观测以回答问题，但存在两大问题：投影畸变削弱VLM识别能力；直接把全景输入VLM引入大量无关背景和视觉token负担，导致答案准确率下降与推理成本增加。
AI.method: 将等距矩形观测通过立方体投影转为多视角透视图；微调BLIP-2以问题为条件估计各视角相关性；采用兼顾信息量与多样性的贪心选择策略挑选少量关键视角用于回答。
AI.result: 在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上，相比基于等距矩形输入的已报道模型达到新的SOTA；在移除旋转视角（观测帧减少65.5%）的情况下，答案准确率基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 面向全景EM-EQA，基于立方体投影+问题条件相关性评估+多样性贪心选择的视角筛选，能缓解畸变与无关背景带来的性能和开销问题，实现更高准确率与更高效率。

title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
summary: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.

AI.tldr: 提出ExpActivator：通过在决策时仅激活“可适用”的个人历史经验（而非简单拼接相关历史）来提升GUI代理的个性化与主动性效果。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化GUI代理把检索到的“任务相关”历史一次性附加到策略上下文，假设对整个任务过程都有帮助；但实证发现，这种帮助几乎只在首步显著，后续多数步骤与是否应主动建议都收效甚微，原因是“相关性≠可适用性”。
AI.method: 将个性化问题重构为“经验激活”。执行时：用冻结的GUI骨干网络的潜在空间，把当前屏幕与历史状态匹配，并提供对应历史动作作为参考；执行前：仅在时间与场景证据充分时激活重复意图，否则保持克制。框架为训练自由（training-free），能接入多种GUI骨干。
AI.result: 在四种GUI骨干上，ExpActivator平均提升轨迹内逐步成功率约28%；在使用约1/5历史token的同时，在各骨干上取得最佳个性化执行；其主动触发检测的Matthews相关系数约为最强基线的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 个性化效益源于在恰当时机“激活”可适用经验，而非在上下文中“附加”相关历史。ExpActivator以更少历史成本，带来更稳健的逐步执行与更可靠的主动触发。

title: LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopTrack：通过循环共享参数的Transformer块实现高效目标跟踪，结合目标感知循环与门控目标记忆，在大幅减少参数的同时保持/提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer跟踪器堆叠多层、参数量大，难以在资源受限设备部署；需要在不显著牺牲精度的前提下降低参数与计算成本，并缓解长期跟踪中的漂移问题。
AI.method: 构建循环式共享参数的Transformer框架LoopTrack：同一组Transformer块在多轮交互中重复使用，实现模板与搜索区特征的渐进式融合。提出两项轻量设计：1) 目标感知循环（TAL），利用上一轮产生的中间目标信息引导下一轮交互；2) 门控目标记忆（GTM），在跨帧维护紧凑记忆并在循环中注入，提供长期信息并抑制时间漂移。提供不同深度配置：LoopTrack_One（单共享块）、LoopTrack_Three（三共享块）。
AI.result: 在多数据集上展现优良的精度-参数权衡：LaSOT上，LoopTrack_One以仅3.4M参数达66.2% SUC；LoopTrack_Three以6.4M参数达69.3% SUC，优于同等或更大模型的参数高效方法。支持多轮交互且参数更少，适于资源受限部署。
AI.conclusion: 共享参数的循环式Transformer能以极低参数量实现强竞争力的跟踪性能；TAL与GTM进一步提升鲁棒性与长期稳定性。LoopTrack为参数高效Transformer跟踪提供了简单而强的基线，代码与模型将开源。

title: PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.

AI.tldr: PIC-UIE 提出一种轻量级“预测器—执行器”框架：用256×256缩略图预测全图校正参数，并在YCbCr空间对原分辨率图像执行分段校正，实现高效高质的水下图像增强。
AI.motivation: 现有UIE多依赖大模型与密集像素级重建，算力消耗高且难以边缘部署；同时在单一颜色空间处理会把退化估计与亮度/色度校正耦合，影响效果与效率。
AI.method: 采用预测器-执行器架构：预测器仅基于256×256 RGB缩略图输出7类校正量，涵盖空间校正、非线性亮度与耦合色度映射、全局颜色标定；执行器在原始分辨率的YCbCr空间应用这些校正。训练时用深度图对传输代理进行正则化，但推理仅需RGB输入。模型仅9486参数、0.094 GFLOPs@256×256。
AI.result: 在UIEB-90上PSNR 24.137 dB、SSIM 0.9216；在LSUI零样本PSNR 21.320 dB；在对比协议下处理原生4K图像达55.0 FPS，显示出良好的效率与跨数据泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化校正预测替代密集RGB重建，可在极低计算成本下实现高质量水下图像增强，适合边缘端与高分辨率场景。

title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
summary: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.

AI.tldr: 提出VisionHOPE：一种自修改学习视觉主干，在单张图像扫描过程中同时更新“记什么”和“如何学”，并通过稳定性匹配的步长控制保证记忆动力学非扩张，四向扫描适配2D特征，ImageNet/COCO/ADE20K上具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 视觉主干从CNN到ViT、SSM、以及TTT逐步增强对输入的自适应性，但适应规则仍多由预训练权重固定，缺乏在推理时随上下文自我修改的通用框架。作者希望构建一个在单张图像内共同演化记忆与学习规则的通用主干，同时解决自引用更新带来的不稳定性。
AI.method: 基于Nested Learning（NL）的自指构造，引入五类耦合记忆：内容记忆、生成key/value的记忆、控制学习率与保留率的记忆；在图像扫描过程中共同演化。为抑制不稳定，提出稳定性匹配步长控制：对自指注入使用软上限（soft cap），对记忆保留转移施加谱钳制（spectral clamp），并证明每次扫描下记忆动力学非扩张。为2D特征将NL的chunk与图像行列对齐，进行四个方向的扫描以整合上下文。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K分类、COCO检测/分割、ADE20K语义分割上取得与主流主干相当的性能，验证该自修改学习系统在通用视觉任务中的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: VisionHOPE展示了将自修改学习机制引入视觉主干的可行路径：在推理中共同更新记忆与学习规则，并通过理论上有保证的稳定性控制实现稳健训练/推理；为通用视觉骨干提供新的基础。

title: FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: FeCoSplat通过压缩中间多视图特征并使用渲染反馈进行两阶段压缩，在低码率下以更低接收端开销重建3D高斯，实现更优的率失真权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有稀视角前馈式3DGS要么压缩输入图像导致接收端重建负担大，要么直接压缩重建的高斯原语但其属性异构不规则、难以高效编码；需要一种既高效压缩又降低接收端复杂度的方案。
AI.method: 提出FeCoSplat：压缩“中间特征”而非图像或最终高斯。流程为两阶段：1) 压缩多视图特征，解码得到中间3DGS；用其渲染视图作为反馈信号。2) 在反馈指导下进行第二阶段压缩以细化；最终比特流解码为紧凑的隐式状态，再用轻量预测器重建最终高斯原语。
AI.result: 在实验中，FeCoSplat在率失真上优于现有方法，尤其在低码率下表现突出；接收端仅需约3.45M参数即可完成高斯重建。
AI.conclusion: 压缩中间特征并结合渲染反馈的两阶段框架能在保持接收端低复杂度的同时提升3DGS压缩效果，是面向前馈3D视图合成的有效权衡方案。

title: OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation
summary: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出OPERA，一个统一的MLLM驱动的渐进式时空推理代理，用于异质多模态（文本/音频/参考图像）指代视频分割；沿时间与空间双轴分三阶段逐步筛选并定位目标，达成SOTA并可零样本迁移到标准RVS基准。
AI.motivation: 指代视频分割需要跨模态理解与精确时空定位，现有方法难以同时高效缩小时间搜索空间并进行细粒度空间指代，且对多模态查询（文本/音频/参考图像）统一处理不足，泛化与效率受限。
AI.method: 构建单一MLLM为核心的统一代理OPERA，进行双轴（时间/空间）渐进式推理：1）时间轴：Temporal Reasoning Agent以由粗到细的过滤策略缩小帧搜索并选出关键信息帧；2）空间轴：Distillation Agent执行跨模态语义蒸馏，明确“找什么”；3）Grounding Agent（结合GRPO强化/偏好优化）执行“在哪儿”的空间定位；最终通过稠密掩码传播获得像素级分割结果。
AI.result: 在OmniAVS与Ref-AVS数据集上取得新的SOTA表现，并可在标准指代视频分割基准上实现零样本迁移，显示出强泛化性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过单一MLLM驱动的三阶段双轴渐进推理，OPERA实现了对异质多模态查询的鲁棒跨模态理解与精确时空指代，显著提升指代视频分割性能并具备良好零样本迁移能力。

title: ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization
summary: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context. Second, we introduce an attention-based local feature enhancement module to mitigate the impact of noisy local features while encouraging context-consistent structures, yielding more robust local feature representations. Experimental results on two large-scale outdoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy over previous SCR-based methods while maintaining real-time inference performance.

AI.tldr: 提出ReLoc，一种改进的场景坐标回归用于LiDAR定位，通过更判别的全局嵌入与注意力增强的局部特征，提升精度与稳定性，并保持实时推理。
AI.motivation: 现有SCR依赖基于场景分类的全局嵌入，难以区分相邻位置；且训练时对局部特征均匀采样，让动态/不稳定区域的噪声同等进入训练，影响稳定性与精度。
AI.method: 1) 重新设计全局嵌入：引入可学习的上下文token并配合特征聚合器，编码更丰富且可判别的场景上下文；2) 注意力驱动的局部特征增强：抑制噪声局部特征，鼓励与上下文一致的结构，得到更鲁棒的局部表示；整体为改进的SCR架构ReLoc，无需显式3D地图。
AI.result: 在两个大规模户外数据集上，相比以往SCR方法达到SOTA定位精度，同时保持实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化全局场景语义判别力与抑制噪声局部特征，ReLoc提升了LiDAR定位的准确性与训练稳定性，并在不牺牲速度的前提下优于现有SCR。

title: Focus and Supplement: Dual-Enhanced Vision Transformer for Multi-Class Anomaly Classification
summary: Multi-class anomaly classification in industrial vision remains challenging due to noisy/incomplete anomaly representations and the unknown number of anomaly classes. To overcome this, we propose MACO, a novel multi-class anomaly classification framework that learns comprehensive representations and dynamically estimates class number without prior knowledge. First, a soft-focus attention uses anomaly maps to concentrate on relevant abnormal regions, while suppressing background noise. Second, auxiliary classification ([A-CLS]) tokens complement the [CLS] token. They collectively attend to diverse anomaly sub-regions, yielding more holistic and discriminative features. These [A-CLS] tokens are also effective across more tasks and domains. To infer the class number, we propose Correlation-based Number Estimation strategy. It computes the average correlation among labeled classes and transfers its separability cue to the unlabeled set. Experiments on MVTec AD and MTD datasets demonstrate our superiority. Under known class number, MACO improves ARI by 6.5% and $\textbf{16.3%}$ on both datasets, respectively. In the more challenging unknown number scenario, it achieves an $\textbf{11.2%}$ NMI gain on MTD and outperforms existing number estimation strategies by $\textbf{24.1%}$ UPS on MVTec AD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/MACO.

AI.tldr: MACO提出一种无需已知类别数的多类工业视觉异常分类框架：用软聚焦注意力抑制背景噪声、引入多个[A-CLS]辅助token以覆盖多样异常子区域，并用基于相关性的类别数估计在未标注集上推断类别数量；在MVTec AD与MTD上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉中的多类异常分类常面临两难：异常区域表示嘈杂/不完整，且真实异常类别数未知；现有方法要么依赖已知类别数、要么学到的特征对细粒度异常区不够判别，导致聚类/分类性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 软聚焦注意力以异常图为引导，聚焦异常区域并抑制背景；2) 引入多个辅助[A-CLS] token，与主[CLS]协同，分别关注不同异常子区域，获得更全面、可迁移的表征；3) 相关性驱动的类别数估计：计算已标注类别间平均相关性作为“可分性线索”，并迁移到未标注集以动态推断类别数。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD与MTD数据集上，若类别数已知，ARI分别提升6.5%与16.3%；在未知类别数场景，MTD上NMI提升11.2%，在MVTec AD上类别数估计的UPS指标超现有方法24.1%。
AI.conclusion: MACO通过区域聚焦和多token表征获得更完整、判别的异常特征，并以相关性估计实现无先验的类别数推断，跨任务/领域也有效，在两大数据集上取得显著优势并将开源实现。

title: When Does Geometric View Synthesis Help Wine Label Retrieval? A Public One-Shot Benchmark Across Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Backbones
summary: Geometric view synthesis can expand a single wine-label photograph into a training set, but its value with pretrained image encoders is unclear. We study this on a public WineSensed-derived benchmark of 1,000 classes, one enrollment photograph per class, and 4,295 real queries. With the earlier DINO vision transformer (ViT-S/16) recipe, geometric views raise top-1 accuracy from 34.1% to 62.6-63.7%, about three times the gain from two-dimensional (2D) augmentation. Frozen SigLIP 2-B already reaches 94.7%. A linear head over its frozen features gains 1.2-1.3 percentage points with the two geometric pipelines localized by the Segment Anything Model (SAM), while the other pipelines gain an inconclusive 0.3-0.6 points. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and validation-selected full fine-tuning show no clear gain within the reported confidence intervals; fixed-budget full fine-tuning loses 9-24 points. SAM localization supplies all six views for 99% of sources, compared with 43% for the edge-based front end. Recognition differences between the two cylinder constructions depend on the training recipe and are confounded by their crop and canvas conventions. Rendered-cylinder tests show different responses to source tilt, but an uncalibrated rim-ratio proxy establishes no corresponding trend in recognition on real photographs. An author-confirmed audit of 50 residual errors identifies 21 query-enrollment appearance mismatches, without establishing an irreducible error rate. These results support geometric synthesis for the tested self-supervised recipe and a smaller benefit through frozen-feature adaptation of the text-supervised encoder.

AI.tldr: 研究评估在单张酒标照片场景下，几何视图合成对识别的价值；对老的自监督ViT显著增益，对强大的文本监督SigLIP 2-B仅带来小幅收益；LoRA/微调无明显好处。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中每个类别只有一张登记图片（one-shot），希望通过从该单图生成多视角训练样本提升识别鲁棒性，但不清楚在已有强大预训练编码器（自监督/文本监督）下几何合成是否仍有价值、以及与2D增强相比如何。
AI.method: 在WineSensed衍生基准上（1000类、每类1张注册图、4295真实查询），对比：1）几何视图合成两种“圆柱”展开管线，并结合SAM做前景定位；2）2D数据增强；3）冻结特征+线性头、LoRA、全量微调（含验证选择与固定预算）；4）不同前端定位（SAM vs 边缘法）；5）渲染圆柱测试不同倾斜与裁剪/画布差异；并审核50个残差错误定位误因。
AI.result: 在DINO ViT-S/16配方上，几何视图将top-1从34.1%提升到62.6–63.7%，增益约为2D增强的3倍；SigLIP 2-B冻结即达94.7%，在线性头上几何合成仅再增1.2–1.3个百分点（SAM本地化），其他管线仅0.3–0.6点且不确定；LoRA与（经验证选择的）全量微调在置信区间内无明显收益；固定预算全量微调反而下降9–24点；SAM能为99%样本提供6视图，边缘前端仅43%；两种圆柱构造的识别差异受训练配方与裁剪/画布约定混杂；渲染测试显示对倾斜敏感性不同，但用未标定的rim-ratio在实拍中未见一致趋势；审计50个残差错例中21起为查询与注册外观不匹配，未能界定不可约误差率。
AI.conclusion: 几何视图合成对早期自监督ViT显著有效；对强大的文本监督SigLIP 2-B，在冻结特征基础上仅带来小幅但可测的收益；端到端/LoRA微调未见优势且可能有害。SAM的可靠定位对几何管线效果与覆盖率至关重要。

title: PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出PulseQuant：一种针对视频扩散Transformer的4-bit后训练量化方法，通过“轨迹敏感度+激活几何”引导离线校准，以减少量化误差最终对潜变量的影响。核心包括块-步干预评估传播风险、按行半径选择与响应子空间校正，在不改变4-bit权重量化格式下显著提升一致性与参考相关等指标。
AI.motivation: 局部重建误差无法可靠预测量化误差在扩散过程中的最终影响；扩散去噪迭代会放大或衰减早期误差。需要一种能依据误差传播动态而非仅本地误差的量化校准方法。
AI.method: 提出PulseQuant后训练量化流程：1) 轨迹敏感度驱动的校准——对单个block在特定扩散步的“隔离块-步干预”，估计误差传播风险，据此在按行选择量化半径（row-radius），优先处理对轨迹更敏感的状态；2) 激活几何引导的响应子空间校正——在固定半径后，通过邻码编辑（neighboring-code edits）对残余误差在主导激活方向上的分量进行抑制；两阶段均保持原始4-bit权重量化表示不变。并通过“短视野传播误差”而非即时块输出误差来做校准信号。
AI.result: 受控干预显示：短期传播后的潜在误差比即时块输出误差更能预测最终潜在误差。实证在Wan、Self Forcing、MiniMax-H3等模型与多种生成范式和尺度上，关键一致性（key consistency）与dense-reference指标显著提升，其他属性上保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 面向扩散Transformer的量化需关注误差传播轨迹与激活子空间。PulseQuant在不改变4-bit权重格式的前提下，通过传播敏感度优先级和子空间校正，较传统局部重建导向的PTQ得到更稳健的最终生成质量。

title: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
summary: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证一个用于“科学类图像生成”可解释性校验的新基准与新验证器：SciGen-Verify 与 SciGen-Verifier，实现从二元判定到原因解释与可修正指令的三级输出，在多学科指令与推理场景下优于或接近更大的专有模型，并能在线迭代纠错。
AI.motivation: 科学教育/科研场景中，答案常以图形呈现（电路图、几何作图、函数图），需要像评阅文字一样严格判分。现有多模态生成虽能产出科学图像，但难以判断其“是否正确”，错误多源自结构与多步推理而非表面像素。已有验证器多面向自然图像，且将判断压缩成单一分数，缺少面向科学任务的覆盖与可解释反馈。
AI.method: 1) 构建SciGen-Verify基准：覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与常识/世界知识，设计三级协议：二元正确性判定→错误解释→修正编辑指令。2) 训练SciGen-Verifier：先冷启动监督微调SFT，再采用课程式两阶段强化学习；第一阶段以“rubric引导”的过程奖励促进科学推理探索，第二阶段以结果奖励与标注对齐。3) 将验证器作为在线批评者用于迭代图像纠偏。
AI.result: 在SciGen-Verify上，SciGen-Verifier取得与更大专有模型相竞争的表现；能提供可解释判定与可执行的纠错指令，并在在线迭代校正流程中有效提升生成图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 面向科学图像生成的可解释校验可通过专门基准与推理驱动的验证器实现；分层输出与课程式RL训练提升了可靠性与可用性，为自动化批改与交互式纠错提供实用路径。

title: Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection
summary: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. A stateful variant enables feature-streaming inference with zero neural look-ahead, one-sample peak confirmation, and bounded memory. Downstream systems can subsequently assign s

AI.tldr: 提出一种在预提取视频特征上运行的动作边界检测适配器，通过组式选择扫描学习时序表征，解码为边界时间戳；在Breakfast、GTEA、50Salads上获得较高F1，并提供无前瞻、低内存的流式变体。
AI.motivation: 动作边界检测需在无类别标签的情况下将长视频分割为动作片段，但现有方法在特征复用、实时性与内存开销上存在不足，亟需一种可在通用特征上高效学习时序转变、并支持流式推理的模型。
AI.method: 在预提取视频特征上引入“边界检测适配器”：1) 组式选择扫描（groupwise selective scans）学习多组时序表示；2) 学习式组融合与时序建模将其转化为转移/边界分数；3) 通过解码得到边界时间戳；4) 以边界时间监督训练（与类别无关）。此外给出有状态(stateful)流式变体，零神经前瞻、单样本峰值确认、内存有界。
AI.result: 在Breakfast、GTEA、50Salads数据集上，以容忍度+二分图匹配评估，边界F1分别为0.457、0.622、0.611；流式变体在严格的实时与内存约束下仍能工作。
AI.conclusion: 该适配器无需类别信息即可高效、准确地检测视频中的动作边界，并可直接接入下游系统做后续片段分类；流式版本适合在线应用，兼顾零前瞻和低内存。

title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出VaME：将潜在推理建模为分布并在多模态检索中通过变分与强化学习联合优化，获得更紧凑、可解释且高效的通用嵌入，显著超越多项基线并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态检索需要跨模态保持任务相关语义的紧凑嵌入。现有将“潜在推理”引入嵌入学习的方法多为确定性单一路径，难以探索更优潜在轨迹，限制了语义保真与检索性能与效率。
AI.method: 提出VaME框架：1) 变分潜在推理（VLR），在潜在空间中自回归地采样与探索，利用轻量解码器的答案重建作为训练信号；2) 在读出时将原始embedding token与“潜在融合嵌入”结合，便于后续RL探索；3) 在随机变分轨迹上用强化学习优化，设计语义解码奖励（SDR）以偏好具有可解释解码结果的语义有效轨迹。
AI.result: 在包含图像、视频、文档的78任务MMEB-V2上，优于多数显式CoT方法与全部潜在推理基线；在MRMR等推理密集基准上表现稳健，且RL后增益显著；相较确定性潜在自回归基线，推理速度至少提升4.25倍。
AI.conclusion: 将潜在推理从确定性路径推广为可学习分布，并以变分+RL+语义奖励联合优化，可在保证可解释性的同时显著提升多模态检索的准确率与效率。

title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
summary: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.

AI.tldr: 提出SSVR，将静态视觉-文本上下文与递归潜在状态解耦，用GRU按动作更新状态，在VLA开放环规划中实现稳定长程推理与大幅提速，在FrozenLake/Maze/MiniBehavior上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA在开放环规划中需要内部模拟状态转移，但基于文本、像素或潜在空间的推理各自存在信息压缩、生成误差累积或越过中间表征的问题，导致长程规划不可靠。
AI.method: 一次性编码初始图像与指令，构造三分部：静态视觉上下文、语言约束、可递归更新的潜在状态。以Qwen2.5-VL为骨干，每步动作预测均以当前潜在状态为条件，并通过动作条件化的GRU更新该状态；复用前缀缓存以提高多步推理效率。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake、Maze、MiniBehavior上分别获得EM/PR：99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6，显著优于先前方法；对多种输入变换与迁移设定表现稳健；在Maze上以预构前缀缓存实现最高约98.58倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 递归状态建模与静态上下文复用可有效缓解状态表示失配，提升开放环规划的可靠性与效率；SSVR为VLA长程推理提供了高效、可扩展的解法。

title: TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.

AI.tldr: 提出TTRSD，一种在测试时通过多视角自蒸馏与视觉敏感token选择来优化VLM感知并保持推理能力的方法；用少量无标注样本显著提升多基准、多模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时强化学习对VLM适应常因固定视觉条件下反复采样而放大神经网络共有的感知错误；且序列级奖励无法定位视觉感知这一限制多模态推理的关键瓶颈，可能破坏预训练的推理能力。需要一种在无标注、无外部验证与无独立教师条件下，精确将学习信号对准感知问题、同时保护推理能力的方案。
AI.method: 提出TTRSD框架：1) 多视角答案级自蒸馏：在原图、裁剪、降采样等不同视角下得到“教师”分布，并聚合为答案分布；2) 学生仅基于原图生成轨迹，根据其最终答案在教师分布中的支持度获得奖励；3) 视觉对比token选择：在固定相同文本前缀下，比较原图与视觉消融输入对同一采样token的log-prob差异，选出对视觉敏感的位置，仅在这些位置进行策略梯度更新；4) 将更新“方向”（由组内相对优势决定）与更新“位置”（由视觉敏感度决定）解耦；无需真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师。
AI.result: 在仅用20个无标注适应样本的条件下，TTRSD在7个基准与3个VLM上提升表现；例如将InternVL3-2B在MMMU上的准确率从35.79%提升到49.32%，增幅+13.53%，并展示跨数据集的泛化与对固有推理能力的保持。
AI.conclusion: 通过多视角自蒸馏与视觉敏感token定位，TTRSD在测试时将强化学习信号精准施加到视觉感知瓶颈，避免损伤推理，且在低样本、无标注设置下实现显著且可泛化的性能提升。

title: TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining
summary: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. HMDB51, IARD, and EPIC-Kitchens bound the claim.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TT-VidT，一种以运动为优先的视频自监督学习方法，在统一控制的24种架构×目标组合对比中显著领先，并以更低FLOPs超过多种强基线，在多项下游视频动作识别数据集上取得大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督比较常把架构、目标函数、训练配方、数据规模、解码器容量等因素混在一起评估，难以分离“方法本身”对学习到的表征（尤其是偏重帧间变化的运动表征）的贡献。作者希望通过严格匹配的实验设计，识别哪些设计选择能产生以运动为主而又保留外观信息的表示。
AI.method: 进行4种架构×6种目标的24格对照实验，在约170M~190M参数规模的编码器上、用约170万段OpenVid与MiT-v2视频、训练8个epoch。提出TT-VidT：采用DINOv3初始化的ViT-B/16逐帧空间路径；引入紧凑的Temporal Transfer Layer（将运动信息从帧特异token转移）；并用Diff Compression训练目标，从首帧外观锚点与帧特异运动token重构目标帧。作者还对解码器进行消融，偏向使用紧凑的、视频预训练的解码器。
AI.result: 实验表明：TT3D与Diff Compression的组合（而非任一单独组件）进入最强的运动敏感区间；解码器消融显示小型且经视频预训练的解码器更优。最终对比中，TT-VidT在Jester、Something-Something V2、ARID、Diving48上同时领先，相比最强的非TT方法提升约54%~121%；其编码器FLOPs比DisMo低48%，比VideoMAE或V-JEPA2低55%。在HMDB51、IARD、EPIC-Kitchens上效果边界更紧（未完全优势）。
AI.conclusion: 通过严格匹配的对照与新方法TT-VidT，作者表明将Temporal Transfer Layer与Diff Compression结合，能学习到以运动为主且兼顾外观的表示，以更低计算开销在多项动作识别任务上显著超越现有方法；但在部分数据集上优势受限，提示泛化边界仍需探索。

title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

AI.tldr: 提出TC-ADA：在一次性选择并密集标注少量目标域图像后，进行连续自适应的主动域适应方法；在多种驾驶场景迁移上，以极少标注接近全监督表现。
AI.motivation: 在驾驶场景中语义分割的人工密集标注成本高；现有主动域适应通常需要多轮采样-标注-再训练，流程复杂、代价高且不利于实际部署。需要一种一次性选择少量最有价值的目标域图像并高效适配的实用方案，兼顾代表性与信息量，并在有限目标标注下有效校准监督。
AI.method:
提出两阶段框架TC-ADA：
- 阶段1（一次性整图获取）：利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的视觉表示与一个固定的无监督域适应模型的语义预测，评估目标域图像的代表性与信息性，选出需密集标注的少量完整图像，无需目标域标注即可完成选择。
- 阶段2（目标校准自适应）：联合使用源域有标注数据、所选目标域有标注数据以及其余未标注目标域数据，在训练中对源与目标监督进行校准，以缓解有限目标标注带来的偏差，实现持续适配。
