Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

AI.tldr: ASPECT是一种面向数字病理的视觉-语言模型增强方案，通过显式监督细胞形态与数量感知来提升视觉落地的推理能力，并在新基准PathoVernier上显著超越现有最强模型与自身骨干。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在病理场景中常能给出正确结论，但对细胞层面的细粒度感知不足，导致中间观察（形态、计数、组成）不准确，隐藏错误不易被仅看最终答案的评估发现。需要一种方法既提升最终答案，又约束并评估中间视觉测量的正确性。
AI.method: 提出ASPECT：1）通过病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐和细胞计数监督来训练中间视觉token，使模型显式学习细胞外观与丰度；2）三阶段SFT：先感知（学习视觉token）、再生成视觉token、再进行多步推理；3）随后用强化学习，同时奖励答案正确性与与中间测量一致性；4）发布PathoVernier基准，包含五个病理数据集、四类细胞组成任务的759个专家审阅问题，评估最终答案与中间测量（并定义RAWR以度量在正确回答中的计数误差）。
AI.result: 在PathoVernier上，ASPECT相对最强基线Gemini-3.1-Pro提升约19.2%准确率，相对其骨干Qwen3-VL-8B提升约99.3%；同时RAWR分别下降28.1%与42.7%。在三项外部病理基准（分类与QA，超出细胞组成范围）上，相较骨干亦有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过对细胞级视觉信号的显式监督与对中间测量一致性的强化学习，ASPECT显著提升病理VLM的可感知性与推理可靠性；新基准PathoVernier揭示仅看最终答案会掩盖的误差，并为评估视觉落地推理提供了更全面的框架。

title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
summary: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

AI.tldr: 提出DTWM：将双手触觉手套信号融入视频扩散变换器的操控世界模型，用于自我视角未来帧预测，相比纯视觉模型显著减少手部运动低估与感知误差，优势随预测时长增加，并优于其他视触模型；触觉幅值与空间分布均关键，二值化接触退化性能；即便推理时无触觉，带触觉训练仍提升预测。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型难以可靠捕捉操控中的关键事件（接触/分离、滑动等），而这些更易通过触觉感知；需要一个能整合触觉与视频、并在未来帧预测中利用触觉因果信息的模型，以提升手部运动与交互动态的准确性和时序一致性。
AI.method: 在预训练视频扩散Transformer上，按手部在视频token中的位置注入对应手套触觉信号，通过零初始化残差进行条件化，并使用因果mask避免信息泄露；对比同架构纯视觉基线与其他视触模型；进行多次训练与消融（触觉幅值/空间位置、二值接触替换等），评估未来帧的手部运动低估、手部区域感知误差、随时间地平线变化的改进幅度。
AI.result: 与匹配的纯视觉模型相比：手部运动低估从23%降至9%；手部区域感知误差平均降低7.4%（每模型三次训练）；改进随预测地平线增长，后段预测的提升约为首段的4.1倍；在相同设置下优于其他视觉-触觉世界模型；用触觉参与训练即使推理无触觉也改进预测。消融：保留触觉的幅值与空间位置最优，改为手级或像素级二值接触均增大误差；力的时间进程揭示交互是否持续或改变。
AI.conclusion: 将触觉以位置对应、幅值保真的方式注入视频扩散世界模型可显著提升操控未来帧预测，尤其在更长时域；触觉提供关于接触与施力演化的因果信号，是超越纯视觉预测的关键；训练时利用触觉带来泛化收益，即便推理阶段无触觉也有效。

title: Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings
summary: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为SMC的无监督可见光-红外跨模态行人重识别方法，在无配对且身份不匹配严重时，通过语义补偿合成缺失模态的语义对应，显著提升跨模态识别表现。
AI.motivation: 现有无配对USL-VI-ReID方法常通过生成/映射特征弥合模态差异，但未显式解耦身份判别语义与模态风格，导致生成特征可能扭曲身份线索或带入源模态偏差，弱化跨模态监督可靠性。亟需一种能在缺失配对和身份不完全对应时，仍能稳定补偿语义信息的框架。
AI.method: 将无配对跨模态学习表述为“语义补偿”问题，提出基于提示组合的Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC)。步骤：1) 通过增强的双重对比学习构建判别性的ReID特征空间，获得各模态的伪标签、簇原型与记忆库；2) 在CLIP语义空间中学习可见光与红外的模态提示（prompts），并将伪标签聚类映射为身份语义token；3) 对于在另一模态中缺乏可靠匹配的簇，将其身份token与目标模态提示组合，合成该簇在缺失模态中的语义对应；4) 将合成语义投影回ReID空间，并通过置信门控注入“补偿记忆库”，以参与后续训练监督。
AI.result: 在配对与无配对设置下的广泛实验表明，SMC在各数据集上均优于现有SOTA，且当身份不匹配程度较高时取得更大幅度的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享视觉语义空间中解耦身份语义与模态风格，并对缺失模态进行语义补偿，SMC有效提升了USL-VI-ReID的跨模态对齐与判别能力，在身份不完全对应的无配对场景尤其有效。

title: PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出按难度进行精细统计匹配（PSM）的数据集蒸馏方法：用全局精度分数(GPS)度量样本难度，把每类样本按难度分组；蒸馏时用原数据分组更新教师BN统计量（SUA）并用对应难度组的原图初始化蒸馏样本（ISS），实现难度特异的监督与初始化，从而扩展蒸馏样本的难度覆盖并提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有去耦统计匹配类DD方法用全数据的BN运行统计来监督所有蒸馏样本，只刻画平均特征分布，忽略样本难度差异，导致无法反映原数据的难度结构，限制了蒸馏数据的表达力与泛化。
AI.method: 1) 预训练阶段：计算每张图的Global Precision Score(GPS)作为难度估计；在每个类别内按GPS排序，并按IPC将其划分为若干难度组。2) 蒸馏阶段：- SUA：对每个难度组，用该组原样本前向通过教师模型以更新其BN运行统计，得到组特异的统计量，用于监督对应的蒸馏批次。- ISS：用对应难度组的原始图像对蒸馏样本进行初始化，以便更精确地匹配组特异统计。整体仍属于解耦的统计匹配框架，但引入“难度特异”监督与初始化。
AI.result: 在多数据集与多模型架构上，PSM使蒸馏样本覆盖更广的难度范围，并在大多数评测设置下带来更优的下游训练性能，同时保持较低的时间与内存开销（未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 把“难度结构”显式纳入统计匹配蒸馏能改进蒸馏数据的代表性与效用。PSM通过GPS估计难度、组内排序与分组、组特异BN统计更新（SUA）和难度一致初始化（ISS）实现精细监督，通常提升性能；代码将开源。

title: CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering
summary: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出CAT-Free：无需相机标定、位置标注与场景特定训练的多相机行人定位方法，仅用同步RGB视频自动估计相机配置并融合多视角观测，通过自适应几何滤波剔除不可靠定位，在多数据集上取得接近有监督方法的MODA表现，并可零改动迁移，且不确定性可无标签预测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有多相机行人定位系统在新场景部署成本高，通常需相机标定、地面位置标注或目标场景再训练；这些场景特定信息获取昂贵且不易泛化，限制了大规模实用。
AI.method: 1) 输入：仅需各相机同步RGB视频；2) 从视频直接估计相机配置（内外参/相对布局）；3) 融合多相机观测得到行人位置估计；4) 针对自动相机估计不准的问题，提出两个自适应几何滤波器，基于每段输入序列自适应阈值，剔除不可靠的定位；5) 估计定位不确定性并用于可靠性评估。
AI.result: 在WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD上分别达成82.5/84.5/65.7 MODA；与使用场景特定信息的方法（在各自协议下）相比略低（WildTrack 88.2–95.0，MultiviewX 83.9–96.5），但无需标定/标注/再训练。迁移性强：在4个额外序列上74.9 MODA，在一个未见过的8机位安装上78.6 MODA，无需调参。定位不确定性与MODA强负相关（r=-0.98），可作为无标签可靠性指标。
AI.conclusion: CAT-Free显著降低多相机行人定位的部署门槛，仅依赖视频即可完成相机配置与定位，并通过自适应几何滤波提升鲁棒性；尽管性能略低于使用场景先验的方法，但具备良好零样本迁移与可解释的不确定性度量，适合现实大规模部署。

title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
summary: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.

AI.tldr: 提出MaLiang-Harness框架，面向可执行程序驱动的图像/视频生成，闭环组织“构建-检查-修订”，以缩小程序到视觉(P2V)鸿沟，并在两套基准上系统评测多款闭源MLLM。
AI.motivation: 仅生成可运行代码并不保证视觉结果满足构图、外观、运动等要求，存在P2V落差；缺乏统一机制把程序构建、渲染证据、版本修订与验证贯通，且通用大测分数与视觉生成能力不一致，需要专门框架与基准衡量与提升。
AI.method: 提出MaLiang-Harness：1) PEG（Persistent Executable Generation）保存程序与任务上下文，维持持久状态；2) TGP（Traceable Generation Process）把编辑操作与渲染证据关联，实现可追踪生成；3) REV（Revision-aware Editing and Verification）在完成前进行基于修订的恢复与校验。统一修订参考协调规划、执行与视觉反馈，适配多种渲染后端。构建两套基准：MaLiang-IBench（图像）与MaLiang-VBench（视频），评估生成成功率、质量与计算成本；对多款闭源MLLM进行对比。
AI.result: 在MaLiang-IBench与VBench上，GPT-6-Astra均达100%生成成功；图像任务96.0%与视频任务76.9%达成全部质量阈值。对比显示通用能力分数与视觉生成表现不一致，模型在满足视觉需求上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: MaLiang-Harness为MLLM将可执行代码转化为视觉结果提供了系统化基础，证明可编程生成的潜力，并揭示通用基准不足以预测视觉生成能力；公开项目与基准有助于持续研究与改进。

title: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
comment: 53 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://playlisteval.github.io
summary: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.

AI.tldr: 引入PlaylistEval：一个无需人工标注、面向超长（百小时级）播放列表的视频-语言评测基准与流水线，用于检验“视频法官”在跨长时程检索与判别中的可靠性。结果显示现有前沿 judge 仅达75.4%成对准确率，人类一致性子集显示基准可靠（与人类93.0%一致，IAA 0.781）。
AI.motivation: 当前视频-语言模型常被当作“法官”评估视频理解或训练奖励模型，但现有基准多为分钟级视频、可由文本抄本分离回答、且人工标注难以扩展至超长视频，因而无法验证当证据散布在百小时级内容中时，judge 是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 提出PlaylistEval：在100+小时播放列表集合上，构建无人工标注的评测基准。核心是自动生成问题及成对答案，并通过“因果退化”控制两答案差异，保证每对都需要在整个集合中检索视频证据；覆盖7大领域、静态与动态知识。以分层抽样的152对进行人工核验，衡量与人类判断一致性。随后评测17个多模态/全模态模型，分析多模态检索与判决的重要性，以及随着播放列表规模扩大会出现的退化。
AI.result: 得到含630个问答对的基准，在人工核验的152对上与人类一致率93.0%（IAA=0.781），证明基准可靠。评测显示：最强前沿 judge 仅有75.4%成对准确率，开源模型显著落后；多模态输入对检索与最终判决均关键；随着播放列表规模增长，judge 准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 视频法官在超长时程检索与判决上仍有显著不足，现有前沿水平远未达到人类一致性。PlaylistEval提供可扩展、无需人工的评测流水线与数据，证明多模态融合与可扩展检索至关重要，并为未来提升超长视频理解与评测方法提供了标准化基准与工具。

title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.

AI.tldr: 提出TVCache：一种无需训练的视觉-语言-动作模型推理加速缓存方法，通过文本-视觉协同过滤注意力头并按层选择重用，较现有缓存在相同保留率下显著提升任务成功率并降FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA缓存方法未充分利用文本-视觉协同这一归纳偏置：文本语义应指导对与任务相关视觉区域的精准定位；但当前方案在注意力聚合时未区分不同头的可靠性，且在跨层复用缓存时忽视表征稳定性，导致定位不稳与计算资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache)。核心包括：1) 基于文本-视觉信息聚焦度筛选注意力头，仅保留对任务相关且物理一致的头以改进视觉落点；2) 基于文本-视觉熵差的重用层选择，跳过不稳定层以避免错误缓存并优化缓存资源分配；整体为训练-free、即插即用，在给定token保留率下调度缓存。
AI.result: 在4个代表性VLA模型、2个仿真基准与真实机器人任务上验证：在相同token保留率下，相较现有VLA-Cache，TVCache以相当计算成本取得更高任务成功率；在OpenVLA-OFT上，12.5%保留率下平均成功率提升最多14.5个百分点，相比全token推理FLOPs降低约2.45倍。
AI.conclusion: 利用文本-视觉协同进行头级筛选与层级复用选择可在不训练的前提下稳定提升VLA推理效率与任务成功率；方法通用、可插拔，并在多模型多场景中优于现有缓存基线。

title: DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.

AI.tldr: DORA是一种针对冻结ViT的动态在线剪枝策略学习方法，用强化学习在推理时按需决定是否、剪多少、剪哪些token，并用训练期影子评估与闭环精度反馈实现稳定、可控的精度-速度权衡。实测在ImageNet-1K上以接近原精度（≤1%下降）实现显著FLOPs与吞吐增益。
AI.motivation: ViT自注意力在token数上为二次复杂度，现有降token方法多依赖固定层级压缩或离线静态掩码，限制了对输入与中间状态的在线自适应；需要一种可在推理过程中动态决定何时与如何剪枝且对最终精度有可控影响的方法。
AI.method: 将逐层token剪枝建模为有限时域MDP：在可剪枝的Transformer block处，分层actor依次决策是否剪枝、剪多少以及具体剪哪些token；采用complete-prefix影子评估将最终预测保真度分解为逐步回馈；通过闭环精度反馈把保真度惩罚校准到统一的精度下降目标；引入仅训练期可见的“特权”critic与影子计算；部署时保留冻结主干与轻量actor，执行硬删除并用可变长度FlashAttention实现真实加速。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上基于DeiT-Base，相比未压缩主干，FLOPs降低38.4%，准确率损失≤1个百分点；在四类ViT骨干上，于匹配精度下平均FLOPs再降13.2%，吞吐提升32.4%；零样本迁移到ImageNet-A时优势扩大到FLOPs再降20.3%、吞吐提升45.6%。
AI.conclusion: DORA可在不改动已训练ViT的情况下，学习输入自适应、逐层动态的token剪枝策略，实现稳定可控的精度-效率权衡，并在标准与分布外数据上带来显著算力与吞吐收益。

title: MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.

AI.tldr: 提出MiCo，一种无需训练的两阶段视觉token裁剪方法：先以视觉信号选代表候选池，再进行任务感知子集选择；以互信息覆盖目标建模为单调次模覆盖函数，贪心优化。在多种MLLM与多基准上，在极高裁剪率下仍保持性能并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM需处理大量视觉token，计算代价高。已有裁剪方法多依赖启发式，易误删关键信息，导致性能下降。作者希望以更有理论依据且稳健的方式，在大幅减少视觉token的同时尽量保持任务性能。
AI.method: 从任务log-loss出发，通过语义抹除模型推导出一般化的“互信息覆盖”目标；用可观测代理将该目标实例化为单调次模覆盖函数，并在token预算下做贪心优化。提出MiCo的两阶段无训练流程：1) 预LM阶段用视觉信号选出代表性的候选token池；2) 候选池内进行与任务相关的子集选择，实现更精准的保留。
AI.result: 在7B到13B的多种MLLM及广泛图像/视频基准（通用视觉推理、细粒度OCR与定位、幻觉检测、长视频理解）上，MiCo在各种裁剪比例下几乎总是优于对比方法。在LLaVA-NEXT-13B上，仅保留5.6%视觉token即可保留97.5%基线性能，并获得约3.8倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 互信息覆盖目标为视觉token裁剪提供统一且有效的理论与实践框架。MiCo无需训练、可泛化到不同MLLM，在高压缩比下能最大化保留关键信息并显著提速，验证了该目标和方法的有效性。

title: SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering
summary: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .

AI.tldr: SkillPE 是一个面向文本生成视频的提示工程框架，从专家种子中进化出可复用的“电影技能”，以提升非专家生成的电影感与叙事质量，并在多维评估上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 非专业用户的文本提示缺乏专业化的叙事与电影语言设计，导致生成视频在构图、镜头组织、光影与声音等方面欠缺“电影感”。需要一种既能保持用户意图（保真度），又能提供创造性表达（创造力）的系统化提示工程方法。
AI.method: 提出 SkillPE：1) 将镜头逻辑、构图、光照、声音设计等电影线索以细粒度技能表示；2) 基于专家撰写的种子技能进行进化与检索；3) 引入电影参考的三分类：共振（匹配良好）、失谐（弱匹配）、偏离（创造性近似但不完全匹配），前两者用于细化适用时机与方式，偏离用于启发在不同改写尺度下的替代实现；4) 通过生成视频对候选技能进行多维评估（提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力、创造力），构建最终技能库。
AI.result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，SkillPE 相比最强外部基线最高提升 1.40 分；相对种子技能提升 0.51 分（基于四维、7 分制评价）；同时在基准自带指标上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SkillPE 提供了一种在文本生成视频中权衡保真度与创造力的实用提示工程框架，通过可复用的电影技能与参考检索机制，系统性提升电影感与叙事品质；代码已开源。

title: E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding
summary: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: E-WAVE提出一种无需相关体的事件相机高时序光流方法，通过全局注意力与贝塞尔轨迹引导变形，实现任意时间戳查询，较SOTA在轨迹误差降25%，端点误差相当，并在头戴式原型上表现稳健。
AI.motivation: VR/AR对快速头手物体运动的连续捕获需高时序光流。帧相机光流受帧率/算力权衡限制；事件相机具高时效与能效，但现有方法依赖代价高的全对相关体，导致内存与计算开销大。因此需要一种既能高时序、又避免相关体开销的事件光流框架。
AI.method: 提出E-WAVE：1) 不构建全对相关体，使用全局注意力建模远程特征依赖；2) 用贝塞尔曲线进行轨迹引导特征反向/前向变形，实现沿轨迹聚合与对齐；3) 迭代更新轨迹参数，使得轨迹可在任意时间戳上被查询，无需重复前向推理；4) 以事件流为输入，学习端到端的HTR光流与轨迹估计。
AI.result: 在MultiFlow与DSEC-Flow上，相比当前SOTA：轨迹误差降低约25%；端点误差（EPE）达到可比水平；资源方面因去除了相关体而显著降低内存/计算（摘要强调质变而未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: E-WAVE通过全局注意力+贝塞尔轨迹的无相关体设计，有效提升高时序光流的轨迹精度并维持端点精度，同时支持任意时间戳查询与更低的资源占用；在自采头戴式原型上验证了在真实复杂场景中的鲁棒性，适合VR/AR动态感知。

title: SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models
summary: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出SyncRA，一种轻量级的同步指导对比学习方法，利用视频内的时间戳对齐音频与视觉中间表征，显著提升模型对音视时序对应的敏感度与多基准上的AV-QA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽然能处理音频与视觉，但常把听到的与看到的错误对应；在进行时间错位（swap）测试时，模型答案未随配对变化，暴露出时序对应薄弱，导致“似是而非但错配”的回答。
AI.method: 提出Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA)：在同一视频的全局上下文中，对比学习中间层的音频—视觉表征。将时间上匹配的片段彼此拉近，不匹配的片段拉远；监督信号直接由输入的时间同步信息产生，无需额外标注；训练期间加入该目标，推理流程和开销保持不变。
AI.result: 在四个不同规模与架构的开放全模态模型、五个公共视频基准上评测：SyncRA在所有模型—基准组合上均优于仅基于答案的微调；在受控的时序交换实验中显著提升模型追踪音视配对变化的能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量、针对性的时序对齐监督，可有效强化音视模态的时间对应关系，并转化为更广泛的音视频问答性能提升。

title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
summary: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.

AI.tldr: OIC-GS 是一种面向全景（VR）场景的高斯喷溅压缩编码器，通过分层 HEALPix 球面网格锚定高斯原语、视口相关选择与轻量熵模型，在保证高画质的同时显著提升解码与渲染速度，并支持渐进与视口自适应传输。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型图像/场景编解码（LIC/GS）在 VR 应用中存在矛盾：LIC 画质高但解码慢，不适合沉浸式渲染；GS 渲染快但画质与码率效率落后，且原语分配未考虑编码代价。需要一种同时兼顾高画质、快速解码/渲染、并可视口/渐进友好的全景编码方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计分层 HEALPix 球面原语网格：将高斯原语锚定在预定义球面坐标，免去显式坐标编码；细层细化粗层，实现自粗到细重建与分层传输。2) 视口解码：基于预定义网格快速筛选与视图相关的原语，加速首视口加载。3) 轻量熵模型：对量化后的原语参数进行建模，采用球面率失真目标优化。4) 自适应稀疏化：当量化不透明度为零时自动移除原语，从而自适应原语密度与细节层级，无需固定预算。5) 单一比特流同时支持全球、视口依赖与渐进式解码。
AI.result: 在 100 张全景数据集上，相比现有 GS 编解码器，OIC-GS 在 WS-PSNR BD-rate 上优于 GaussianImage++ 49.6%，优于采用学习熵模型的 SGI 68.6%。首个视口仅解码 52% 比特流即达到最终质量，并以约 1,270 FPS 渲染。
AI.conclusion: OIC-GS 通过球面分层网格锚定与轻量熵模型，实现了面向 VR 的高效全景高斯喷溅编码：高画质、高速解码/渲染、支持视口与渐进传输，并在客观率失真指标与实际交互性能上显著领先。

title: From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 提出MILD框架：用图像专家以最低成本蒸馏到视频扩散学生，同时保留原有运动动力学；通过可学习线性连接器对齐异构潜空间，并在局部校正与光流奖励下提升时序一致与运动质量，性能优于基于视频教师的OPD。
AI.motivation: 视频生成专精化常依赖大视频模型作为教师，但数据与训练昂贵、推理延迟高；而图像专家便宜易得，适合美学、OCR等帧级能力。然而图像与视频潜空间异构、图像专家缺乏跨帧监督，直接迁移会破坏时序一致与运动。需要一种能把图像专家能力安全迁移到视频学生且保留视频动态的方法。
AI.method: 提出MILD：1) 用可学习线性connector对齐学生视频潜表示与图像专家（含状态与预测更新），实现跨异构潜空间的监督迁移；2) 约束图像指导的校正在预训练学生预测周围的局部邻域内，避免破坏固有视频动态；3) 引入基于光流的运动奖励，显式优化运动质量与跨帧一致性；4) 在多种图像专家与多种视频学生骨干上进行OPD式在线蒸馏。
AI.result: 在多类图像专家与多种视频学生骨干上，MILD稳定优于以视频教师为监督的OPD基线；消融显示connector设计与跨架构迁移均有效，运动质量与时序一致性显著提升，同时保持较低成本与延迟。
AI.conclusion: 图像到视频的潜空间蒸馏是可行且高效的路径：利用丰富的图像生成生态，将其专长迁移到视频模型，同时通过对齐与约束机制保留视频动力学。MILD证明了无需昂贵视频教师也能提升视频生成质量与一致性。

title: Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence
summary: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories. For reinforcement learning, cold-started model performs real-world execution through harnesses in independent sandboxes during rollout process, effectively facilitating the acquisition of genuine ultra-long-horizon execution capability. We further propose a novel reward strategy, Later Stage Bonus Reward, which explicitly encourages model to perform meaningful maneuvers during later stages of execution. Through extensive evaluation on 5 benchmarks containing ultra-long-horizon tasks, Marathoner achieves consistent and substantial performance improvements over base model and even surpasses performance of strong proprietary model. Further analysis shows that Marathoner can consistently work for 10+ hours and conduct 1000+ tool calls on highly challenging tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Marathoner，一个具备超长时程执行能力的自主智能体，经由综合后训练流程显著提升在超长任务上的持续执行与成功率。
AI.motivation: 人类能为长期目标持续数月甚至数年努力，而现有模型在超长时程、复杂多阶段任务上的持续性与稳健性不足；作者希望让基础模型获得真实世界“长跑式”执行能力。
AI.method: 构建完整后训练管线：1) 超长任务合成：以GitHub大型PR（新增1000+行代码）为源，自动合成高难度“任务级”数据；并通过多任务链式组合（Multi-Task Chaining）把多个子任务串成更具前沿难度的复合任务。2) 拒绝采样微调：用强教师模型+多样化harness在合成任务上生成轨迹，对基础模型进行监督微调，仅保留高质量（拒绝采样）轨迹。3) 强化学习：让冷启动模型在独立沙盒中真实执行以获取长期策略；提出“后期阶段加分奖励”（Later Stage Bonus Reward）鼓励在执行后期做出关键推进动作，促进超长时程能力习得。
AI.result: 在包含超长时程任务的5个基准上，相比基础模型取得持续且显著的提升，并在部分场景超越强大的闭源模型；还能在高难任务上稳定工作10+小时并完成1000+次工具调用。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于真实复杂软件变更与链式任务构造的数据、结合拒绝采样微调与强化学习并配以后期奖励设计，Marathoner学得了可泛化的超长时程自主执行能力，显著缩小甚至超过现有强力模型在此维度的差距。

title: Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy
summary: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.

AI.tldr: 论文综述联合音视频生成/编辑：提出统一表述与分类法，从时间与语义一致性角度梳理联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑的方法、数据与评测，并总结九大编辑类别（28种编辑类型）与未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型多将音频与视频割裂处理，导致跨模态时序与语义失配。需要系统化框架与分类，统摄联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑，回答如何在多模态间保持时序与语义的一致性，并为研究与应用提供结构化路线图。
AI.method: 提出统一概率分布视角，将联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑视为定义在同一音视频对分布上的三类问题；构建五个设计轴的分类法比较方法；首次系统性编目联合音视频编辑，提出九大编辑类别、28个编辑类型；并综述各设定下的方法、数据集与评测指标。
AI.result: 形成一套统一问题定义与分类框架，系统盘点现有方法、数据与评测；给出联合音视频编辑的完整分类图谱（九类、28型），梳理保持跨模态时序与语义一致性的主流技术路径与权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为联合音视频生成/编辑提供统一范式与分类基线，凸显一致性维度的核心挑战，指出数据配对质量、对齐机制、评测标准化与可控编辑等关键开放问题，为后续研究与应用落地奠定基础。

title: CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git

AI.tldr: CAR-VLA 将“场景复杂度”和“动态风险”联合建模，按四类情境映射到三种推理模式（快速直觉、慢速思考、反射响应），并通过分阶段监督学习与推理增强强化学习训练，实现在不同驾驶情境下既快又安全的风险感知推理与轨迹生成，取得有竞争力的导航驾驶成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶VLA的自适应推理多只判断“是否需要推理”，忽视“在不同情境下如何变化推理方式”。尤其在高风险、时效性强的场景中，单纯加深或缩短推理不足以保证安全与效率，需要将推理深度、紧迫度与聚焦点与场景复杂度、动态风险共同耦合。
AI.method: 提出CAR-VLA：以“复杂度×风险”情境评估驱动三种推理模式选择——(1) Fast Intuition：简单低风险，直接给出轨迹；(2) Slow Thinking：复杂低风险，进行更深层、全面的链式推理后规划；(3) Reflex Response：高风险（不论复杂度），以最关键危险体为中心，进行短小而聚焦的应急推理与即时安全响应。训练上先进行渐进式监督学习，将场景评估、模式选择与轨迹生成联结，再以推理增强的强化学习提升驾驶质量与推理行为。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1 达到91.1 PDMS、NAVSIM v2 达到90.3 EPDMS、Navhard 达到35.0 EPDMS，表现具竞争力；在navtest与自建高风险场景的质性对比中展示了更强的风险感知与面向危险的轨迹响应。
AI.conclusion: 将场景复杂度与动态风险联合用于驱动“深度—紧迫—聚焦”的自适应推理，可在多样驾驶情境中兼顾效率与安全；Reflex Response 不只是减少思考步数，而是将推理重心锁定在关键危险与即时安全动作上，带来更稳健的风险应对。

title: VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking
summary: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 提出VastMAT，一个覆盖337类动物、2947段视频、百万帧的大规模多动物跟踪基准，并引入CDA关联模块提升低重叠场景下的关联性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT基准主要面向行人和车辆，专用的多动物跟踪数据集在规模、物种多样性和同视频多实例关联上均不足，难以系统评估跨物种泛化与跟踪难点。
AI.method: 构建VastMAT数据集：2947视频、100万余标注帧、366万检测框、22883条ID轨迹，覆盖337动物类别；采用迭代专家审阅与独立复标审计保证标注质量；制定“已见类别”和“类别不交的未见类别”两种评测协议评估跨类别泛化；基于八种代表性MOT方法做系统评测；提出中心距离增强关联（CDA）模块，自适应融合IoU与按框尺度归一的中心相似度，无需额外训练可插拔使用。
AI.result: 在Seen/Unseen协议下，最高基线HOTA分别为66.37%/52.90%，表明对未见动物的跟踪更具挑战；将CDA集成到TrackTrack中，HOTA分别提升1.58和1.31个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VastMAT显著填补MAT基准在规模与多样性上的空白，并通过标准化协议揭示跨物种泛化难点；CDA为低重叠场景下的轻量关联改进提供有效方案。基准与代码将公开，促进后续研究。

title: HyperDAM: Hyperspectral Distractor-Aware Memory with Amodal Expansion for SAM 3 Tracking
summary: Hyperspectral video provides material cues that can disambiguate targets with similar false-color appearance, yet foundation-model trackers update memory primarily from spatial and appearance evidence. We present HyperDAM, a DAM4SAM3-based hyperspectral tracker with three principal contributions. First, HOTC2026-Modal adds human-verified frame-wise modal masks and mask-tight boxes to all 481 organizer-provided HOTC 2026 videos. Second, a frame-zero-calibrated HSI gate rejects spectrally inconsistent updates to the distractor-resolving memory (DRM) without altering the current prediction. Third, a causal spatiotemporal expander adds outward-only amodal corrections from frozen SAM features. Static-scene recovery and empty-mask RTS smoothing address target switches and full occlusion. Model selection prioritizes cross-domain robustness over leaderboard-specific optimization. The final system ranked second in HOTC 2026, achieving 68.0093% AUC and 87.7703% DP@20 in the organizer's private evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperDAM：一种基于DAM4SAM3的高光谱视频跟踪器，通过光谱门控与因果时空扩展提升在相似外观干扰和遮挡下的鲁棒性，并在HOTC 2026私有评测中获第二名（AUC 68.01%、DP@20 87.77%）。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型跟踪器主要依赖空间与外观信息更新记忆，难以在伪彩下区分材质相近目标；高光谱视频可提供材质/光谱线索，但尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: 1) 构建HOTC2026-Modal：为481段HOTC 2026视频提供人审的逐帧模态掩膜与紧边框；2) 设计帧零校准HSI光谱门，阻止与首帧光谱不一致的更新进入DRM（不改变当下预测）；3) 因果时空扩展器：基于冻结的SAM特征，进行仅向外的无形体（amodal）校正；并加入静态场景恢复与空掩膜的RTS平滑，缓解目标切换和完全遮挡；以跨域鲁棒性为导向进行模型选择。
AI.result: 在HOTC 2026官方私有评测中获得第二名，AUC 68.0093%，DP@20 87.7703%。
AI.conclusion: 融合高光谱门控更新与因果时空扩展能有效提升基础模型跟踪器的跨域鲁棒性与遮挡/干扰下的稳定性；所建HOTC2026-Modal数据与方法在大型基准上验证有效。

title: Distilling Visual Reasoning into Text Space
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong promise for multimodal reasoning, yet often struggle with tasks requiring concepts beyond what is directly observable in the input image. Existing methods generate intermediate images or latent visual tokens to guide reasoning, but these representations can introduce errors and increasingly interfere with textual reasoning as reasoning progresses. We propose Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T), a framework that enables LVLMs to internalize visual reasoning without generating intermediate visual representations at inference time. V2T first trains a teacher LVLM using interleaved visual and textual chains of thought, and then uses knowledge distillation to train a student LVLM using the teacher's logits and cross-entropy supervision from ground-truth textual reasoning. When reasoning images can be mapped to the original image, V2T can additionally distill the teacher's attention to corresponding regions, while ground-truth bounding boxes can further guide a subsequent reinforcement learning stage. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that V2T consistently outperforms the teacher and existing baselines, improving average accuracy by 14.3% on a held-out set and 2.7% on the broader visual evaluation suite. Moreover, lightweight SFT and substantially reduced RL make V2T up to 42x faster to train than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: V2T通过将视觉推理“蒸馏”为纯文本链路，在推理时不再生成中间视觉表示，从而提升多模态推理准确性与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM在需要超出图像表面内容的高阶推理时易受中间生成的图像/潜在视觉token误导，随着推理展开对文本推理干扰加剧；需要一种既保留视觉推理能力又避免中间视觉表征噪声与高训练成本的方法。
AI.method: 两阶段蒸馏框架V2T：1) 教师模型以“视觉-文本交织”的Chain-of-Thought进行训练；2) 学生模型用教师logits蒸馏+来自真实文本推理的交叉熵监督进行训练。若可将推理图像对齐到原图，则蒸馏教师的注意力到对应区域；若有GT框则在后续RL阶段进一步引导。整体以轻量SFT与大幅减少的RL替代重训练。
AI.result: 在多项多模态推理基准上，V2T稳定优于教师与现有基线：在保留集上平均准确率提升14.3%，在更广视觉评测套件上提升2.7%；训练效率最高可比SOTA快42倍。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉推理内化为文本化链路并以注意力与少量RL对齐，可在降低训练成本的同时显著提升LVLM的多模态推理性能，避免中间视觉表征带来的误差与干扰。

title: HUMAN-TCI: Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network with Torso-Centered Interaction for Text-to-Motion Retrieval
summary: Accurate retrieval of human motions is a crucial first step in text-guided human motion modeling and synthesis, as it selects semantically relevant sequences from large datasets and provides grounded references for downstream tasks. Retrieving motions from natural language descriptions remains challenging because sentences can describe multiple actions, overlapping movements, and intricate dependencies between body parts. Existing methods often focus on simple, single-action descriptions and typically process body parts independently or by merely concatenating features, without explicitly modeling how torso movements influence other parts. In addition, their processing pipelines often rely on computationally heavy models, introducing considerable overhead, particularly when modeling longer or more complex motion sequences. This limits learning discriminative motion-pattern representations, reducing retrieval accuracy, interpretability, and efficiency in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose HUMAN-TCI, a Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network for text-guided human motion retrieval. HUMAN-TCI employs a three-stream architecture that separately models upper-body, lower-body, and torso motions while explicitly capturing their interactions, allowing torso-related movements to influence the positioning and dynamics of other body parts. By incorporating tailored torso attention, our model effectively recognizes complex human motion patterns, captures fine-grained motion relationships and handles complex multi-action descriptions. Our framework supports retrieval for both simple, single-action sentences and long, compositional descriptions containing sequential or overlapping actions without relying on complex models.

AI.tldr: 提出HUMAN-TCI：一种分层多流、躯干感知的文本引导人体动作检索网络，通过上肢/下肢/躯干三流与躯干注意显式建模部位交互，在不依赖复杂大模型的前提下，提升对多动作、重叠与细粒度关系的检索准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多针对单一动作、忽视身体部位间（尤其躯干对四肢）的影响，常将部位独立或简单拼接，且依赖计算开销大的模型，难以在长序列与复杂多动作描述中学到判别性模式，导致检索准确性、可解释性与效率受限。
AI.method: 设计HUMAN-TCI分层多流网络：上肢、下肢、躯干三条并行流分别编码运动；通过定制的躯干注意机制显式建模躯干对其他部位的影响与交互；捕捉细粒度关系与多动作时序/重叠结构；在轻量化架构下完成文本-动作对齐与检索。
AI.result: 在处理简单单动作与长的组合性描述（顺序或重叠动作）时均能更稳健地识别复杂模式与细粒度关系，相比依赖重模型的流水线具备更高的检索准确性与效率与更好可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过三流躯干感知与定制注意机制，HUMAN-TCI在不依赖昂贵模型的情况下有效提升文本到人体动作的检索性能，适用于复杂多动作与长序列场景，兼顾准确性、效率与可解释性。

title: Clinical Trajectory Alignment for Medical Vision-Language Pre-training
summary: Medical vision-language pre-training largely follows a visit-level image-report matching paradigm, aligning paired images and reports at individual visits. While effective for static cross-modal correspondence, this paradigm provides limited supervision for longitudinal clinical change, such as whether abnormalities improve, remain stable, or worsen over time. Learning such change is challenging because temporal semantics are implicit in free-text reports, and different abnormalities within the same patient may evolve asynchronously or even in opposite directions. We propose MedCTA, which reframes medical vision-language pre-training from visit-level cross-modal matching to learning clinical change. Rather than compressing a patient history into a single temporal representation, MedCTA models clinical change at two complementary scopes. At the abnormality scope, clinically grounded queries construct abnormality-conditioned visual and textual trajectories to capture heterogeneous abnormality evolution. At the patient-course scope, global image and report sequences are modeled to capture overall clinical progression beyond any individual abnormality. Structured trend supervision is extracted from longitudinal reports by an offline LLM parser, removing the need for manual temporal annotations. Combined with static image-report alignment, MedCTA learns representations that preserve visit-level cross-modal correspondence while encoding longitudinal change semantics. Experiments on temporal image classification, image-text retrieval, and zero-shot classification show consistent gains over strong medical vision-language baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MedCTA，将医学视听预训练从“就诊级图文匹配”扩展为“学习纵向临床变化”，在保持单次就诊对齐的同时编码异常与患者病程层面的时间变化语义，显著提升时间分类、检索与零样本任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言预训练主要做单次就诊的图文对齐，难以体现患者随时间的病情变化（改善/稳定/恶化）。报告中的时间语义隐含且同一患者的多种异常可能不同步甚至相反演化，缺少可扩展的时间监督信号。
AI.method:
提出MedCTA：
- 异常层面：用临床驱动的查询（如病灶/征象）构建“异常条件”的图像与文本轨迹，捕捉各异常的异质演化。
- 病程层面：对整段图像与报告序列进行全局建模，学习超越单一异常的总体进展。
- 监督来源：用离线LLM解析纵向报告抽取结构化趋势（改善/稳定/恶化等），无需人工时间标注。
- 训练：在保持静态图文对齐的同时，联合优化时间变化表示学习。
AI.result: 在时间序列图像分类、图文检索与零样本分类任务上，相比强基线取得一致增益，表明所学表示更好地编码了纵向变化与跨模态对应。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练范式从静态匹配扩展到变化建模可行且有效；通过异常与病程双尺度建模、结合LLM生成的结构化趋势监督，可在无需人工标注的前提下显著提升多种下游任务表现。

title: When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑将驾驶基准分数作为优化目标的可靠性，指出得分提升可能不等价于真实驾驶改进；提出将评分流程分解并用干预与闭环比较验证，发现优化收益依赖执行与反馈接口，可能在条件变化时失效。
AI.motivation: 在自动驾驶研究中，基准分数逐渐被用于系统优化目标，但尚不清楚当分数被直接优化时，分数提升是否还能可靠代表真实驾驶能力提升。作者希望阐明分数、被测行为与执行接口之间的关系，以评估“在优化压力下”的度量有效性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 将评分流程分解为四环节：执行、测量、子分数映射与聚合。通过两类实验：1）受控干预，系统性改变驾驶行为，观察评分对行为差异的敏感度（是否因区分缺失、阈值化或衰减而被弱化）；2）闭环对比，改变执行接口（执行与反馈返回方式），评估在重复执行与重新规划条件下，优化得到的得分增益是否保持或反转。
AI.result: 发现显著的行为变化常被分数弱响应，因为在从“请求运动”到“实际执行”再到“评分”的链路中，许多差异被忽略、阈值截断或被映射过程稀释；当更换执行接口后，先前通过优化获得的分数提升可能反向，显示得分高度依赖请求被如何执行与反馈。
AI.conclusion: 基准度量在作为优化目标时的有效性并非理所当然。要判断分数增益能否迁移，需要同时审视度量保留了哪些行为区分，以及被优化行为在何种执行与反馈条件下实现。只有把“测什么”和“如何被执行”一起验证，才能确保在优化压力下的度量有效性。

title: Modeling Whole-Slide Images as Dynamic Tumor Microenvironment Fields
summary: Due to the gigapixel-scale nature of whole-slide images (WSIs), weakly supervised WSI analysis is commonly formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem, where patch-level features are aggregated into slide-level representations. However, diagnostic and prognostic evidence often arises from spatially coherent tumor microenvironment regions and their interactions, rather than isolated patches alone. Existing patch-level or static region-based methods usually overlook how tissue regions should be adaptively formed and subsequently evolved through microenvironment interactions across heterogeneous boundaries. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve), a reaction-diffusion-inspired framework that models WSIs as latent tumor microenvironment fields over discrete patch graphs. TMEvolve instantiates this view as a learnable graph-discretized evolution process over patch neighborhoods. It first forms adaptive soft tissue regions as coherent microenvironment units, then performs pseudo-time evolution through two complementary local dynamics: intra-region diffusion, which stabilizes latent states within coherent tissue compartments, and concept-guided boundary flux, which propagates visual feature signals and language-derived concept signals across heterogeneous region interfaces. The evolved microenvironment regions are finally aggregated for slide-level prediction. We evaluate TMEvolve on six datasets across three weakly supervised WSI tasks: survival prediction, gene expression prediction, and histological subtype classification. TMEvolve consistently improves over representative MIL methods, pathology foundation models, and concept-guided baselines. Ablation studies and visualizations further support the effectiveness and interpretability of TMEvolve, highlighting the value of dynamic region modeling and boundary interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出TMEvolve：在WSI弱监督场景下，将补丁图建模为潜在肿瘤微环境场，经由可学习的反应-扩散式演化，形成自适应组织区域并进行边界交互，以提升生存、基因表达与分型预测。
AI.motivation: WSI为吉像素级，弱监督通常用MIL将patch聚合为slide表示，但真实诊断证据来自空间一致的微环境区域及其跨边界交互。现有基于patch或静态区域的方法忽略了组织区域应如何自适应形成、并在异质边界间如何通过微环境交互演化。
AI.method: 构建TMEvolve：将WSI离散为patch图，视为潜在微环境场；先通过学习得到自适应的软组织区域（连贯微环境单元），随后在伪时间上执行两类局部动力学：1) 区域内扩散，稳定一致组织内的潜在状态；2) 概念引导的边界通量，在异质区域接口上传播视觉特征信号与由语言概念得到的信号。最终对演化后的区域进行聚合，得到slide级预测。
AI.result: 在跨三类弱监督任务的六个数据集上（生存预测、基因表达预测、组织学亚型分类），TMEvolve较代表性MIL方法、病理基础模型与概念引导基线均有一致提升；消融与可视化表明动态区域建模与边界交互的有效性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 动态、概念引导的微环境区域建模与边界交互可显著提升WSI弱监督分析性能与可解释性；将WSI视作可演化的微环境场是优于静态patch/区域聚合的有效范式。

title: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
summary: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

AI.tldr: EditWorld 是一种用于可交互世界的可编辑视频世界模型，通过在自回归生成期间流式输入编辑指令与参考图像，实现精确修改与灵活引用，并在新基准 WBench-Editing 上取得最佳编辑性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型多侧重“导航/探索”，对已有世界内容的精确编辑与引用支持不足，难以在长时序交互中稳健地执行随时间变化的编辑需求，因此需要一种既能生成又能精确编辑、并可处理长时程条件与参考的世界模型。
AI.method: 1) 在自回归生成中引入流式编辑条件与参考图像；2) 设计 Gated Causal Attention 以处理时间变化的编辑/引用信号；3) 提出 Sparse Context，将历史上下文稀疏保留以实现长程推理的有界记忆；4) 采用联合自回归+双向训练并配合退火式自重采样；5) 构建专用的数据合成与标注管线，为世界编辑提供监督；6) 发布系统评测基准 WBench-Editing。
AI.result: 在 WBench-Editing 上总体得分 73.8、编辑得分 80.0，在与现有方法的编辑相关指标上显著领先，整体性能最佳。
AI.conclusion: EditWorld 将世界模型从纯探索扩展到可精确编辑与灵活引用，得益于门控因果注意力、稀疏上下文与联合训练策略，并通过新基准验证其在流式世界编辑任务中的领先性能。

title: VL-AcneSeg: A Vision-Language Framework for Region-Aware Acne Lesion Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
summary: Acne assessment is crucial for clinical decision-making, yet traditional grading and counting are subjective and fail to account for lesion size. While area-based assessment has emerged as a promising alternative, acne segmentation has continued to rely on general-purpose architectures. To address this gap, we propose VL-AcneSeg, a multimodal framework for acne lesion segmentation that leverages CLIP and region-level text prompts to incorporate spatial priors, enabling lesions to be localized across the whole face. Because region-level prompts indicate which facial areas contain lesions, we report a single global prompt, which requires no such information, as our primary setting. On our internal clinical dataset, VL-AcneSeg achieves a Dice score of 0.5082 and an IoU of 0.3407 under this protocol, the highest among all compared methods, including recent vision-language segmentation methods that are themselves given region-level prompts; region-level prompting raises these to 0.5296 and 0.3602. Moreover, lesion area measurements derived from our segmentation correlate with IGA scores at a level comparable to expert annotations (Pearson r = 0.719 versus 0.658). Notably, our framework maintains consistent performance across external validation datasets, performing reliably even on uncontrolled smartphone images without requiring additional training or fine-tuning. By pairing a protocol that requires no lesion-location information with area-based severity estimation, this work provides a foundation for objective acne assessment outside the clinic. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/sukjuoh/VL-AcneSeg

AI.tldr: 提出VL-AcneSeg：基于CLIP与区域级文本提示的痤疮分割框架，在无需病灶位置信息的全局提示设定下即达SOTA（Dice 0.5082/IoU 0.3407），区域提示进一步提升；分割得到的病灶面积与IGA严重度高度相关（r=0.719），对外部与手机非受控图像具稳健泛化，为客观的院外痤疮评估奠基。
AI.motivation: 传统痤疮评估依赖主观分级与计数，难以反映病灶大小；尽管面积化评估更客观，但现有分割多用通用架构，缺少对面部空间先验与语言先验的利用。需要一种能在全脸范围内准确定位病灶、兼容面积化严重度估计且具跨域泛化的方法。
AI.method: 构建多模态分割框架VL-AcneSeg：利用CLIP的视觉-文本对齐能力，将“全局提示”或“面部区域级提示”作为文本先验，注入分割网络以引入空间与语义约束，从而在不提供或提供粗粒度位置信息两种协议下实现病灶定位与像素级分割；随后基于分割掩膜计算病灶面积并与IGA评分相关分析。
AI.result: 在内部临床数据集上，全局提示设定取得Dice 0.5082、IoU 0.3407，优于包括近期视觉-语言分割方法在内的对比方法（这些方法甚至使用了区域提示）；采用区域级提示进一步提升至Dice 0.5296、IoU 0.3602。基于分割的病灶面积与专家IGA评分相关性达r=0.719（专家标注为0.658）。在外部验证集与非受控手机图像上无需额外训练/微调也保持稳定表现。
AI.conclusion: VL-AcneSeg通过简化的全局提示协议与面积化严重度评估，实现了可客观量化、可泛化到院外场景的痤疮分割与评估。该方法在不依赖详细病灶位置先验的情况下取得SOTA，并在开放环境下表现稳健，具备临床与远程监测应用潜力；代码已开源。

title: SentZero: An Enhanced Sentence-Centric Vision-Language Pretraining for Multi-Task Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Analysis
summary: Vision-language (VL) pretraining using paired chest X-ray (CXR) images and radiology reports has shown strong potential for medical image understanding. However, existing methods often remain dependent on task-specific finetuning because radiology reports are lengthy, clinically dense, and difficult to align with simple zero-shot prompts. Recent sentence-level approaches partially address this limitation using clinical phrases extracted by large language models (LLMs), but they largely overlook the intrinsic characteristics of radiology discourse. In particular, limited positive-pair diversity constrains further gains, while clinically equivalent sentences frequently recur across patients, creating false negatives in contrastive learning. To address these issues, we propose SentZero, an enhanced sentence-centric VL pretraining framework for zero-shot, multi-task CXR analysis. SentZero introduces LLM-based abstract-level sentence structuring and mapping to expand positive-pair diversity, together with an additional loss term to mitigate false negatives. We further introduce sentence-conditioned residual modulation of visual embeddings, enabling visual features to adapt to the semantic characteristics of each input sentence. Across diverse downstream tasks and datasets, SentZero improves zero-shot generalization and outperforms prior multi-task zero-shot methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SentZero：以句子为中心的胸片视觉-语言预训练框架，通过LLM驱动的摘要级句子结构化与映射扩充正样本多样性、引入抑制伪负样本的损失，并以句子条件残差调制视觉特征，从而在多任务零样本CXR分析上优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 放射科报告冗长、语义密集，难以与简单零样本提示对齐，现有方法仍需任务微调；句子级方法虽进步，但正样本多样性不足且跨患者等价句子在对比学习中被当作负样本，限制泛化与对齐质量。
AI.method: 1) LLM进行摘要级句子结构化与映射，生成/聚合同义临床句以扩充图文正对多样性；2) 新增损失项，识别并减轻跨报告的临床等价句造成的伪负样本；3) 句子条件的残差调制（对视觉嵌入进行条件化），使视觉特征随输入句语义自适应。整体构成面向多任务零样本的句子中心VL预训练框架SentZero。
AI.result: 在多种下游任务与数据集上，SentZero显著提升零样本泛化能力并超过既有多任务零样本方法（未给出具体数值，但报告全面优于SOTA基线）。
AI.conclusion: 面向CXR的句子级VL预训练若结合LLM的句子结构化/映射、伪负样本抑制及句子条件特征调制，可显著改善零样本多任务性能；利用放射学话语特性是关键。

title: When Does an Image Determine the Answer? Benchmarking Visual Answerability across Charts and Scenes
summary: Reliable visual question answering requires correct answers when evidence is sufficient and abstention when it is not. We introduce a benchmark that connects complete-question evaluation with explicit evidence for its labels across PlotQA charts, CLEVR rendered scenes, and GQA photographs. Each question groups original and edited images, presented independently; success requires every supported answer and every required abstention to be correct. For chart missing-information labels, executable witnesses establish that admissible complete charts give different answers but identical pixels after masking. Scene labels follow source programs and edits, with a residual-cue analysis for photographs. Across 72,000 responses from six model configurations, the highest observed complete task success rates are 57.0%, 43.5%, and 33.7%, respectively. On charts, the strongest configuration achieves 96.2% per-view decision accuracy, yet 265 of its 835 groups with every decision correct still contain incorrect answers. Evaluating supported answers and necessary abstentions together exposes failures that answerability decisions alone conceal.

AI.tldr: 提出一个VQA基准，要求在有证据时答对、无证据时弃答，跨PlotQA图表、CLEVR场景、GQA照片，联合评估“受支持答案+必要弃答”，揭示仅做可答性判定所掩盖的失败。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA常单评答案或只评“是否应回答”，缺少将答案正确性与应否作答在同一任务中联合考察，且缺乏对标签证据的显式支撑，导致模型在不确定情境下的表现被高估。
AI.method: 构建包含成组问题的基准：每组包含原始与编辑后的多张图像，独立呈现；要求对每个视图都做出“回答或弃答”的决策，并在可回答时给出正确答案、在不可回答时必须弃答。对图表数据，用可执行见证（witness）证明缺失信息下存在不同可行完整图表导致不同答案，但在掩膜后像素一致；场景数据遵循CLEVR程序与编辑；照片数据进行残余线索分析。以六种模型配置在PlotQA、CLEVR、GQA上评测。
AI.result: 六种配置共72,000个响应中，最高完整任务成功率：PlotQA 57.0%，CLEVR 43.5%，GQA 33.7%。在PlotQA上，最强配置单视图决策准确率达96.2%，但在835个所有视图决策全对的分组里，仍有265组存在错误答案，显示仅看“是否应回答”会高估性能。
AI.conclusion: 联合评估“受支持答案”和“必要弃答”能更真实反映VQA的可靠性，揭示仅评可答性或仅评答案正确性无法发现的失败模式；当前模型距离可靠VQA仍有明显差距。

title: PACER: Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing for Radiology Report Generation under Incomplete Clinical Context
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) increasingly incorporates heterogeneous clinical evidence, such as multi-view radiographs and previous reports, whose availability varies across examinations. However, accommodating different input combinations does not ensure effective evidence use: generated reports may still omit or inaccurately describe clinically relevant findings. To address this problem, we propose PACER, a Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing framework for structured incomplete-context RRG that follows a Refine-Calibrate-Commit pipeline. It first refines observed visual representations through endpoint-preserving patchwise routing across frozen encoder depths, incorporating complementary cues while retaining the pretrained terminal representation. It then calibrates the language-model prefix according to the observed evidence and availability state, adapting the shared generator's conditioning as the available source set changes. Finally, it generates polarity-structured clinical commitments before the report in the same autoregressive trajectory, providing structured clinical context for subsequent generation. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art clinical efficacy across all four MIMIC-RG4 settings and strong MIMIC-CXR performance, while maintaining competitive language-generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出PACER框架，通过“精炼-校准-承诺”三步，针对输入证据异质且不完整的放射学报告生成，提升临床发现的准确覆盖与一致性，在MIMIC-RG4全设定达SOTA并在MIMIC-CXR表现强劲，同时保持语言质量。
AI.motivation: RRG任务中证据来源多样（多视角影像、既往报告）且可用性随检查变化，现有方法虽能处理不同输入组合，但仍常遗漏或误述关键临床发现，缺乏对“证据可用性状态”的有效利用与稳健路由。
AI.method: 提出PACER：1) Refine：在冻结编码器的不同深度间进行端点保留的patch级路由，融合互补线索同时保持预训练末端表征；2) Calibrate：依据观测到的证据与其可用性状态校准语言模型前缀，使共享生成器在证据源集合变化时自适应条件化；3) Commit：在正式报告前、同一自回归轨迹中先生成带极性的结构化临床“承诺”，为后续文本生成提供结构化上下文。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-RG4四种设定下取得SOTA临床效能；在MIMIC-CXR上也有强劲表现；同时维持具有竞争力的自然语言生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 面向不完整上下文的RRG，PACER通过进阶式证据路由与可用性条件化，显著提升临床相关性的覆盖与准确性，并不牺牲语言质量，可作为整合异质临床证据的有效范式。

title: HPMD: A Historical Persian Manuscript Dataset for Word Spotting with Line-Level Annotation
summary: Large collections of historical Persian manuscripts have been digitized, but searching them is still slow and mostly manual. Historians usually want to find where a specific name, date, event, or topic appears, which is a word spotting problem. Progress on this task is limited by two things. First, there is almost no public dataset of historical Persian handwriting; the only notable resource, OpenITI MAKHZAN, contains a relatively small Persian portion. Second, word spotting models usually need word-level bounding boxes, which are very expensive to annotate. In this paper we introduce a new dataset of 223 pages, 3,678 lines, 37,631 words, and 130,630 characters, collected from diverse historical Persian books of poetry and prose and annotated at the region, line, and text level. We also propose a baseline that is trained only with line-level annotations but returns word-level locations. A fine-tuned line detector finds text lines, and a fine-tuned CRNN recognizer trained with CTC produces a frame-by-character posterior matrix for each line. Instead of decoding the most probable character at each frame, the query is scored directly against this matrix, so visually similar characters in Persian such as be and pe no longer cause hard failures. The frame alignment also gives the horizontal position of the word inside the line. On the test set, the fine-tuned line detector reaches an F1 of 0.892, and posterior-based search raises the word spotting F1 from 0.487 to 0.558 compared with exact matching on the decoded text, with the decision threshold selected on a held-out validation set. A PHOC attribute-embedding baseline that additionally receives oracle word boundaries at test time reaches an F1 of 0.449, below the proposed method. We also report a distributional analysis of the dataset, a taxonomy of retrieval errors, and a per-conditionbreakdown of performance.

AI.tldr: 他们发布了一个新的历史波斯文手稿数据集，并提出仅用行级标注训练却能返回词级定位的词定位方法，利用CTC后验直接与查询匹配以提升鲁棒性和定位精度，实验显著优于解码精确匹配和PHOC基线。
AI.motivation: 历史波斯手稿检索（名字、日期、事件、主题）依赖词定位，但缺乏公开大规模波斯手写数据集，且词框标注成本高，限制了模型进展。
AI.method: 构建含223页/3,678行/37,631词/130,630字符的新数据集，具区域、行、文本级标注；训练：1) 微调行检测器做行切分；2) 微调CTC-CRNN行级识别器，输出逐帧按字符的后验矩阵；检索时不做硬解码，而是将查询词直接在后验矩阵上打分，并由帧对齐得到词在行内的水平位置。
AI.result: 测试集上：行检测F1=0.892；后验匹配的词定位F1=0.558，较基于解码精确匹配的F1=0.487显著提升；带“真值词边界”的PHOC属性嵌入基线仅F1=0.449，仍低于所提方法。并给出数据分布分析、错误分类与条件分解性能。
AI.conclusion: 行级监督即可实现有效词定位；基于后验的匹配避免视觉近似字符导致的解码错误，性能优于常见基线。新数据集与基线为历史波斯手稿检索提供了可复现基准与方法参考。

title: ConCAD: Constraint-Aware Image-to-CAD Generation with Dual-Granularity Rewards
summary: Image-to-CAD generation seeks executable parametric programs that recover both the geometry and design intent of a reference object. Existing systems are commonly evaluated by validity and shape overlap, although two solids with similar volume can encode different CAD relations. We introduce ConCAD, a constraint-aware image-to-CAD framework optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rewards at two complementary granularities: a code-level constraint reward and an execution-level geometric reward. This complementary design disambiguates structurally distinct yet volumetrically similar shapes while ensuring valid 3D geometry. To verify that these rewards recover geometry and design intent, we introduce a B-rep geometric constraint satisfaction rate (G-CSR), which analytically extracts and evaluates geometric constraints from boundary representations. Experiments on the DeepCAD and Zero2CAD demonstrate that ConCAD achieves the best IoU and Chamfer Distance over competitive baselines, while also outperforming them on G-CSR, validating its superior recovery of both geometric fidelity and parametric design intent.

AI.tldr: 提出ConCAD：一种面向约束的Image-to-CAD生成框架，结合代码级约束奖励与执行级几何奖励，通过GRPO优化，同时最大化几何一致性与设计意图恢复；并提出G-CSR指标评估B-rep约束满足率，在DeepCAD与Zero2CAD上显著优于基线（IoU/CD与G-CSR均更好）。
AI.motivation: 现有Image-to-CAD方法多以有效性与形状重叠度评估，但体积分布相近的实心体可能对应不同的CAD约束与设计意图，导致对参数化关系的忽视与歧义；缺乏能同时度量几何与约束满足的训练信号与评测指标。
AI.method: 构建约束感知框架ConCAD，使用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行强化学习式优化，设计两类互补奖励：1）代码级约束奖励，度量生成的参数化程序中约束（如相等、平行、同心、尺寸等）的正确性/可满足性；2）执行级几何奖励，在程序执行后基于生成B-rep与目标形状的几何一致性（如IoU、Chamfer）给予反馈。为客观评测，提出B-rep几何约束满足率（G-CSR），从边界表示中解析并检验几何约束的满足情况。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD与Zero2CAD数据集上，ConCAD在IoU与Chamfer Distance上均优于现有强基线，并在新指标G-CSR上显著更高，显示其在几何精度与参数化设计意图恢复方面同时领先。
AI.conclusion: 组合代码级约束奖励与执行级几何奖励的GRPO训练，可有效消除仅靠体积相似导致的结构歧义，既保证3D几何有效性又更好地恢复设计意图；G-CSR为评估CAD约束恢复提供了可解析的客观指标。

title: Can Attack Difficulty Be Characterized Before Optimization? A Study of Pre-optimization Difficulty in Person-Vanishing Attacks
summary: Adversarial attacks against object detectors are traditionally studied from an optimization perspective, where attack difficulty is regarded as an outcome observed only after adversarial optimization. This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出Quad-CLEVER，在优化前估计目标检测中“行人消失”对抗攻击的难度，用以自适应分配计算预算，提升成功率并降低迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击多把“难度”视为优化后才观测到的结果，缺乏在优化开始前对不同输入相对难度的刻画与利用，导致计算资源分配低效。
AI.method: 提出“预优化攻击难度”概念；基于对最相关攻击方向上局部行人消失边际的二次近似，构造几何型难度估计器Quad-CLEVER，快速估计输入样本的潜在优化难度；据此设计难度感知攻击框架，在固定计算预算下为基础攻击自适应分配迭代/计算资源。
AI.result: Quad-CLEVER与实际优化成本高度相关；在BDD100K上，难度感知框架将图像级攻击成功率最高提升5.78%，平均优化成本减少最多11.42次迭代；在更具挑战性的EventPed数据集上，节省约2.25次迭代且保持相当性能。
AI.conclusion: 对抗攻击难度在优化前具有可预测结构；利用Quad-CLEVER进行难度估计并自适应分配预算，可在不增加总体计算的前提下提高效率与效果。

title: SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling
summary: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.

AI.tldr: SubjectAnchor提出一种面向多镜头故事生成的“主体感知”记忆到视频范式，通过从先前镜头提取显式视觉记忆来引导当前镜头生成，以在分镜可控的前提下保持人物与场景的一致性。方案基于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，含主体记忆构建、主体感知时序RoPE、与记忆感知注意力分区三大模块，显著提升跨镜头身份一致性且画质竞争力不减。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头视频生成在分镜可控的脚本驱动下，常出现跨镜头的人物身份漂移与场景不连贯；全局式生成难以灵活控制每镜头内容，基于文本或隐式状态的记忆又不足以稳定主体外观。需要一种既保留分镜可控性，又能以强显式约束稳定主体与场景一致性的机制。
AI.method: 在Wan2.2-I2V-A14B骨干上：1) 主体相关记忆构建：对目标镜头中每个主体，追踪其历史出现并检索最相关的预计算关键帧，形成紧凑记忆库；将这些记忆帧作为显式视觉条件编码进输入。2) 主体感知时序旋转位置编码（Temporal RoPE）：为不同主体分配独立的“负时间槽”，在时序位置空间中分离不同主体，降低身份干扰。3) 记忆感知注意力分区：在共享骨干中对记忆token与生成内容的交互进行分区与调度，既让记忆锚定外观，又避免过度干扰新内容生成；整体仍兼容逐镜头脚本驱动。
AI.result: 相较代表性的基于记忆方法与整体式基线，SubjectAnchor在跨镜头身份一致性指标上显著提升，同时保持与对标方法相近或更优的画面质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式视觉记忆与主体感知时序/注意力机制结合，可在多镜头视频生成中有效锚定主体与场景，从而在不牺牲分镜可控性的前提下提升跨镜头一致性；该范式为可扩展到更复杂叙事与多主体场景提供了实践路径。

title: XFlow: A Workflow Model for Instruction-Guided Lesion Segmentation in Chest X-rays
summary: Existing text-guided segmentation models in the medical domain cover only a narrow set of anatomical structures and lesions in chest X-rays (CXRs), and most of them assume that the queried target is always present in the image. Instruction-guided lesion segmentation (ILS) was introduced to overcome these limitations by segmenting diverse lesion types from simple user instructions while also recognizing when the queried lesion is absent, and ROSALIA was proposed as the first model for this task. However, the masks produced by ROSALIA remain of limited quality, often carrying scattered noise. Moreover, ROSALIA predicts the mask in a single shot, which differs fundamentally from how radiologists perceive and delineate lesions in practice. A radiologist first surveys the entire thorax, then localizes the approximate region of abnormality, and only then refines the lesion contour. Motivated by this coarse-to-fine, multi-level perception process, we present XFlow, a workflow model for ILS that combines box-based localization with multi-turn point refinement. XFlow detects the lungs, decides whether the queried finding is present in each of them, and prompts a fine-tuned SAM with the lesion box for an initial mask. It then corrects that mask through point prompts until its boundary follows the lesion, leaving every intermediate decision visible. Our experiments show that XFlow achieves the best segmentation quality on both internal and external evaluation. Notably, it surpasses ROSALIA in segmentation quality even when the two are trained on the same lesion annotations. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出XFlow，用“检测肺—判断是否存在—框选—多轮点式细化”的可见工作流，在胸片上完成指令引导病灶分割，显著优于ROSALIA，且能识别病灶缺失。
AI.motivation: 现有文本/指令引导分割覆盖解剖与病灶种类有限，且常默认目标存在；ROSALIA虽首提ILS但掩膜质量噪声多、单步预测不符放射科医师由粗到细圈定病灶的工作流。
AI.method: 设计工作流式XFlow：1）检测左右肺；2）对每侧判断所查询病灶是否存在；3）若存在，用病灶框作为提示调用微调的SAM生成初始掩膜；4）通过多轮点提示逐步修正，直到边界贴合。全流程中间决策可见。
AI.result: 在内部与外部评测上分割质量最佳；在相同病灶标注条件下也超过ROSALIA；能更稳定地拒识不存在的病灶并减少掩膜散点噪声。
AI.conclusion: 模仿放射科由粗到细的多级感知与交互提示，XFlow在ILS上实现更高质量与可解释的分割，且具有更好的缺失识别与泛化；代码与权重将开源。

title: Evidence Before Accuracy: A MRI-PET Fusion Network for Alzheimer Disease Classification with Causal Regional Validation
summary: Deep learning models for Alzheimer disease (AD) classification routinely report near-perfect discrimination, yet few are shown to rest on AD-relevant neurobiology rather than on dataset artifacts, subject-level leakage, or non-brain image content. We present a fusion network combining T1 MRI and FDG PET across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes, trained on ADNI consists of 554 paired subjects. The fusion model reaches AUC 0.962, accuracy 0.909, and F1 0.891, competitive with recent 3D CNN and multimodal transformer systems at substantially lower cost. We first quantify how much modality, plane and slice geometry matter. A validation-only search over slice centres and neighbour spacings moves AUC by 0.180 for MRI and 0.078 for PET, selecting narrow spacing for MRI and wide spacing for PET, with the chosen coronal centres falling on the hippocampal body and on the posterior cingulate respectively. The contribution, however, is the evidence layer built around that number. Shortcut controls collapse the model to AUC 0.622 (silhouette), 0.608 (exterior), and 0.500 (blank), and a label-permutation null yields 0.456.
