Forward region-of-interest (ROI) ablation shows that masking medial temporal cortex in MRI and the posterior default-mode network (DMN) in PET produces the largest shift in the AD logit, while area-matched controls remain indistinguishable from that null. Reverse ROI ablation shows that the medial temporal lobe alone retains 89.2% of above-chance discrimination in MRI and the posterior DMN alone retains 79.0% in PET. A quantitative comparison of attribution methods shows occlusion sensitivity reaching 3.5-5.0* enrichment inside a priori AD regions against 0.10-0.43* in controls. Ablation and attribution independently establish a biologically correct double dissociation: hippocampal evidence is carried by MRI, posterior cingulate evidence by PET.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合T1 MRI与FDG-PET、跨三正交切面的深度学习网络，在ADNI 554例配对数据上以较低计算成本实现AD分类（AUC 0.962，准确率0.909，F1 0.891），并通过系统化控制、消融与归因分析证明模型依赖与阿尔茨海默病相关的神经生物学而非数据捷径。
AI.motivation: 现有AD影像分类模型常报高分，但缺乏证据证明其依据真正的脑生物学信号；可能受数据集伪迹、泄漏或非脑内容影响。需要一种既具竞争性能、又能严谨验证生物学有效性的框架。
AI.method: 构建融合网络，输入为T1 MRI与FDG-PET在轴向、冠状、矢状三平面的切片；在ADNI 554对受试者上训练。通过验证集搜索切片中心与邻近间距评估几何/采样的重要性；设计捷径对照（轮廓、外部、空白）与标签置换；进行前向ROI消融与反向ROI保留，比较多种归因方法并量化在先验AD区域内的富集度。
AI.result: 融合模型AUC 0.962、Acc 0.909、F1 0.891，低成本下可与3D CNN与多模态Transformer匹敌。切片几何对性能影响显著：仅验证集选择即可使MRI AUC变动0.180、PET变动0.078，MRI偏好窄间距、PET偏好宽间距，最佳冠状中心分别落在海马体与后扣带。捷径对照使AUC降至0.622（轮廓）、0.608（外部）、0.500（空白），标签置换为0.456。前向消融显示遮挡MRI的内侧颞叶与PET的后默认网络使AD对数似然变化最大，面积匹配对照接近空白基线；反向保留显示仅内侧颞叶即可保留MRI超随机判别力的89.2%，仅后DMN即可保留PET的79.0%。归因中遮挡敏感性在先验AD区的富集为3.5–5.0倍，对照仅0.10–0.43倍。
AI.conclusion: 该融合模型不仅性能优异，还通过多重证据链证明其判别依赖与AD相关的双重解剖-模态分离：MRI承载海马/内侧颞叶证据，PET承载后扣带/后DMN证据；排除了非脑捷径与标签偏置，提供可解释、神经生物学一致的AD分类。

title: SAGE: Subspace Alignment for Classifier-Free Guidance in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing are a leading recipe for scaling generative models. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for generation quality, yet excessively high guidance scales trigger collapse. We identify a previously unreported failure mode in their combination: the two CFG branches route independently, so their realized activations occupy different subspaces. The unconditional write then leaves the conditional subspace, and CFG amplifies that residual linearly in the guidance scale. We propose SAGE, a training-time regularizer that aligns unconditional MoE activations to the conditional subspace without restricting routing diversity, at zero inference cost. Toy experiments show that SAGE dramatically suppresses extreme drift by 9.2x. When scaled to a 1B-parameter text-to-image model, SAGE significantly improves generation quality, delivering a 9.3% boost in peak DPG-Bench performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE正则，解决MoE扩散Transformer与CFG结合时的“子空间漂移”导致高指导崩溃问题；通过训练期对齐无条件激活到条件子空间，在不牺牲路由多样性且推理零开销的前提下，提高稳定性与生成质量。
AI.motivation: MoE扩散Transformer为扩展生成模型的主流方案，但与CFG结合时，高指导系数常引发崩溃。作者发现新失败模式：CFG的有/无条件分支独立路由，导致激活落在不同子空间；无条件写出离开条件子空间，CFG以指导系数线性放大该残差，诱发极端漂移与退化。需要在不限制MoE路由多样性的情况下，抑制这种子空间错位。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（训练期正则）：在训练时约束无条件MoE激活与条件子空间对齐，使两分支激活分布在相同子空间内，同时不强制相同路由选择，从而保持专家多样性。该正则不改变推理流程，零额外推理成本。通过玩具实验和扩展到10亿参数文本到图像模型进行验证。
AI.result: 在玩具实验中，SAGE将极端漂移抑制9.2倍；在1B参数T2I模型上，DPG-Bench峰值性能提升9.3%，并在多项实验中稳定优于基线。
AI.conclusion: SAGE有效对齐CFG两分支的MoE激活子空间，从根源缓解高指导引起的崩溃与漂移；无需额外推理开销，维持路由多样性，且在小规模与大规模设置中均带来稳定的性能增益。

title: RRG-SLAM: Real-time Reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Scenes
summary: We introduce the first real-time reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM system for indoor scenes. The system features a reflection-aware TSDF-Gaussian hybrid representation that explicitly separates diffuse scene appearance from reflection components. The base scene is modeled by a TSDF volume and a set of base Gaussians capturing geometry and diffuse appearance, while planar reflections are represented by reflection Gaussian groups associated with detected reflective planes. The rendering is performed in three passes: TSDF raycasting first yields surface color, depth, plane IDs and reflection masks; base Gaussians are then rendered order-independently with depth culling and combined with the TSDF output to form the base image; finally, under the guidance of the plane ID map, reflection Gaussians from different reflection groups are rasterized only into their corresponding planar regions to generate the reflection image, which is subsequently composited with the base image via the reflection mask to produce the final output. For online reconstruction, our system first estimates the camera pose through reflection-aware tracking to suppress interference of reflection-dominated regions. It then identifies reflective planes using geometric, semantic, and temporal cues, and fuses the observations into the augmented TSDF volume with reflection-aware attributes. Afterwards the base and reflection Gaussians are initialized, optimized, and pruned online to maintain both reconstruction quality and efficiency. Experiments on a variety of datasets show that our method outperforms existing SLAM systems in reconstruction quality, tracking robustness, and novel-view rendering for indoor environments with reflections, while preserving real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可实时运行、对反射敏感的室内高斯SLAM：用TSDF+高斯的混合表示显式分离漫反射与镜面反射，并在三通道渲染与反射感知跟踪/重建管线下，实现更稳健的位姿、重建与新视角渲染。
AI.motivation: 传统SLAM在室内存在大量镜面/玻璃等反射体时，易被反射主导的观测扰乱，导致跟踪漂移、几何伪影与渲染质量差。现有Gaussian/NeRF/TSDF方法多将反射当作噪声或统一外观建模，难以实时且清晰地区分与处理反射，从而影响鲁棒性与真实感。需要一种在在线重建中显式识别与建模反射、且保持实时性的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出反射感知TSDF-高斯混合表示：基础场景由TSDF体和“基础高斯”(几何+漫反射外观)表示；镜面平面以“反射高斯组”表征，并与检测到的反射平面绑定。渲染三步走：1) TSDF光线投射得到颜色、深度、平面ID、反射mask；2) 深度裁剪下无序渲染基础高斯并与TSDF合成基础图像；3) 按平面ID仅在对应平面区域光栅化各组反射高斯，生成反射图，再用反射mask与基础图像复合。在线重建管线：先用反射感知跟踪估计位姿以抑制反射干扰；结合几何/语义/时序线索检测反射平面并将观测融合进带反射属性的TSDF体；随后在线初始化、优化、裁剪基础与反射高斯，平衡质量与效率。
AI.result: 在多种室内数据集上，相比现有SLAM，在重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性与新视角渲染方面显著优于对手，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离漫反射与镜面反射并在TSDF-高斯混合框架与反射感知渲染/重建中协同，能有效解决反射场景对SLAM的干扰，实现实时、稳健且高保真地重建与渲染室内环境。

title: Preference-Guided Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Prompt Disagreement
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables pixel-level prediction over arbitrary text-specified vocabularies and has shown strong generalization on common benchmarks. However, OVSS performance often degrades in specialized domains such as medical imaging, remote sensing, and industrial inspection, where dense pixel-level masks for adaptation are costly to obtain and require domain-specific expertise. We propose a preference-guided adaptation framework that replaces dense mask supervision with binary preferences. We observe that different prompt templates produce systematically different segmentations for the same image, a phenomenon we call prompt disagreement, and we repurpose it as a built-in source of preference supervision. Building on this, we mine localized preference queries from regions of high cross-template uncertainty, and adapt the OVSS model with Region-Localized Preference Optimization (RLPO) together with consistency regularization that stabilizes updates outside the queried region. Across extensive experiments on the MESS benchmark, the proposed method achieves consistent gains across diverse OVSS backbones without any pixel-level annotation, and remains effective under noisy preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/pref-ovss.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需像素级标注即可将开集语义分割适配到专业领域的方法：利用不同文本提示模板在同一图像上的分割不一致，挖掘局部偏好查询，并用区域本地化偏好优化与一致性正则进行训练，在MESS基准上对多种骨干稳定提升，且对偏好噪声鲁棒。
AI.motivation: OVSS 在通用数据上泛化好，但在医疗、遥感、工业等专用域退化明显；获取像素级掩码昂贵且需专家。希望用更廉价的监督信号替代密集标注以实现域适配。观察到不同提示模板对同图像产生系统性不同分割（提示分歧），可将其转化为偏好监督来源。
AI.method: 1) 发现并利用“提示分歧”：对同一图像用多种提示模板，定位跨模板高不确定区域；2) 从这些区域挖掘局部偏好查询，收集二元偏好而非像素掩码；3) 提出区域本地化偏好优化（RLPO），在被查询区域根据偏好更新OVSS；4) 结合一致性正则，在未查询区域对模型输出施加稳定约束；5) 在不同OVSS骨干上进行无像素级标注的适配训练。
AI.result: 在MESS基准的大量实验中，无需任何像素级注释即可在多种OVSS骨干上取得一致增益；在存在噪声的偏好反馈下仍保持有效和稳健。
AI.conclusion: 利用提示分歧驱动的局部偏好学习可成为专用域OVSS适配的有效替代监督信号。RLPO加一致性正则在无掩码、甚至噪声偏好下也能带来稳定提升，显示出在成本受限场景中的实用价值。

title: TSGate: Timestep-Aware Gated Attention for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image and video generation. Recent DiT systems increasingly use structured prompts for training, improving caption quality and prompt adherence. However, their generation quality can degrade severely under out-of-domain (OOD) prompts, including the free-form descriptions supplied by users at inference time. Although LLM-based rewriting can convert these prompts into structured formats, it does not guarantee that the rewritten prompts align with the training distribution. Our analysis links this degradation to attention sinks and reduced early-step image-to-text attention and shows that sink suppression alone is insufficient to restore generation quality. Despite effective sink suppression, models trained with standard gated attention exhibit reduced early-step image-to-text attention and suboptimal generation quality. Based on these insights, we propose Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate), which injects a timestep-conditioned bias into the gate signal so that gating behavior adapts across denoising steps. Extensive experiments show that TSGate consistently outperforms both the baseline and standard gated attention across multiple benchmarks, improving the raw-prompt DPG score by 9.5% over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出TSGate：在DiT中对注意力门控加入与扩散步数相关的偏置，缓解OOD自由文本提示下的注意力汇聚与早期图像→文本注意力不足问题，显著提升生成质量（原始提示DPG提升9.5%）。
AI.motivation: DiT在训练时依赖结构化提示，但推理时用户常给出自由形式、域外的提示，导致注意力汇聚（attention sinks）与早期步骤图像→文本注意力降低，从而生成质量崩溃。现有用LLM重写提示或仅做sink抑制都不足以恢复性能。
AI.method: 分析DiT在OOD提示下的注意力行为，发现标准门控注意力在早期去噪步骤对文本关注不足；提出TSGate：在门控信号中注入与扩散timestep相关的偏置，使门控随去噪进程自适应调整，提高早期图像→文本注意力；并与基线和标准门控进行对比实验。
AI.result: TSGate在多项基准上稳定优于基线与标准门控；在原始（未重写）提示下的DPG分数较基线提升9.5%，并在OOD自由提示上恢复和提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 扩散早期的图像→文本注意力对OOD鲁棒性至关重要；单纯抑制注意力汇聚不够。通过timestep感知的门控偏置，TSGate能在去噪各阶段动态分配注意力，系统性提升DiT在自由提示下的对齐与画质。

title: ActionLens: Diagnosing Spatial-Temporal Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
summary: Video-capable vision-language models score above 80\% on popular benchmarks yet struggle with spatial-temporal binding: associating the right action with the right person at the right moment. We introduce ActionLens, a diagnostic benchmark of 6,701 multiple-choice video questions spanning five targeted diagnostics: transition detection, actor-specific identification, concurrent action binding, directed interaction reasoning, and gaze detection. Ground-truth answers are derived deterministically from 1.58 million per-second, per-person annotations. Fourteen rounds of human quality engineering raised answer clarity from 53% to above 90% human accuracy. Across 20 VLMs, the full-set leader scores 68.8%; on the human-reviewed subset, it scores 65.9% versus 91.0% for the pooled human reference. Gaze detection remains near chance against 89.6% human accuracy. On actor disambiguation, reference-interface controls show that relational descriptions recover 5.55--13.25 points over static coordinates, confirming a substantial numeric-parsing penalty; yet visual boxes still lead every model by 1.15--6.50 points, exposing a residual unboxed actor-resolution gap. A binding-trap analysis shows models systematically select the wrong actor's action. ActionLens provides diagnostic measurements of these distinct failure modes across model families and scales for direct comparison. We release all data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lmms-eval-2276

AI.tldr: ActionLens是一个聚焦“时空绑定”问题的视频VLM诊断基准，含6701道多选题与细粒度逐秒逐人标注；当前最强模型在全量/人工审核子集上仅得68.8%/65.9%，显著低于人类（约91%），暴露凝视、演员歧义与动作绑定等系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型在常见基准上高分，但在将“正确动作-正确人-正确时刻”绑定上表现脆弱。缺乏能分解并量化这些失败模式（过渡检测、特定演员识别、并行动作绑定、定向交互推理、凝视检测）的诊断工具，阻碍模型研究与改进。
AI.method: 构建ActionLens：基于158万条逐秒逐人标注，以确定性规则生成6701道视频多选题，覆盖五类诊断；通过14轮人工质量工程将题目可判定性从53%提升至>90%人类准确率。对20个VLM统一评测，并设计对照实验比较“关系式描述 vs 静态坐标 vs 视觉框”在演员消歧上的影响；进行“绑定陷阱”分析，观察模型是否选错演员的动作。
AI.result:
- 全量集最佳模型68.8%，人工审核子集65.9%，显著低于人类参考91.0%。
- 凝视检测接近随机，人类为89.6%。
- 演员消歧：使用关系式描述较静态坐标提升5.55–13.25分，说明坐标解析带来数值解析惩罚；但直接给出视觉框仍领先所有模型1.15–6.50分，显示仍存“未框出时的演员解析缺口”。
- 绑定陷阱分析显示模型常把错误演员的动作与目标绑定。
AI.conclusion: ActionLens能细分并量化视频VLM在时空绑定上的关键失败模式，提供可复现实证与跨模型可比评估。当前模型与人类在凝视、演员消歧和动作绑定上仍有显著差距；改进方向包括更强的时空对齐与实体跟踪、鲁棒的数值/关系解析，以及更有效的无框演员解析机制。

title: ACPruner: Visual Token Pruning as Biased Attention Coverage Maximization in LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) face significant computational inefficiencies caused by the large number of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly focus on either retaining individually important tokens or selecting mutually diverse ones. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from a coverage perspective and formulate it as a biased attention coverage maximization problem. The key idea is to select a compact token subset whose encoder-side outgoing attention can jointly cover the image while assigning higher coverage priority to more informative regions. From this perspective, we propose ACPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient LVLM inference. ACPruner first estimates token importance by combining intra-modal saliency and inter-modal relevance, then derives token-wise coverage from attention patterns within the vision encoder, and finally performs greedy selection to maximize the proposed coverage objective. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM backbones, including LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, show that ACPruner consistently achieves strong performance retention while delivering substantial end-to-end inference speedups.

AI.tldr: 提出ACPruner：一种从“注意力覆盖”视角出发、训练无关的视觉token剪枝方法，通过结合显著性与跨模态相关性估重要性、基于视觉编码器注意力估计覆盖，并用贪心最大化带偏置的覆盖目标，实现在多种LVLM上大幅提速且性能保持良好。
AI.motivation: LVLM推理受大量视觉token牵制，现有剪枝要么重单点重要性、要么重多样性，忽视“选出少量token即可覆盖关键信息区域”的整体覆盖视角；需要一种兼顾信息优先级与全图覆盖的更有效剪枝范式。
AI.method: 将视觉token剪枝表述为“带偏置的注意力覆盖最大化”问题：1) 以视觉编码器内部注意力和跨模态信号估计token重要性（结合模态内显著性与模态间相关性）；2) 由编码器注意力模式推导token对图像区域的覆盖度，并对信息更丰富区域赋予更高权重；3) 采用贪心选择少量token，使其外向注意力联合覆盖最大化；全流程训练无关、直接用于推理前剪枝。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B等多种LVLM上，ACPruner在显著加速端到端推理的同时，保持了强劲的任务性能（精度基本不降或小幅下降）。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖视角的带偏置注意力最大化可有效指导视觉token剪枝；ACPruner作为训练无关框架，在多种LVLM中实现稳定的性能-速度权衡，是高效LVLM推理的通用实用方案。

title: Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence
summary: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ReaLVR, which brings visual-evidence supervision to the model's own free-running latent trajectories. ReaLVR contrasts correct and model-generated wrong answers to determine where stronger supervision is needed, and relevant and mismatched visual evidence to specify what to preserve. Across three model families, ReaLVR consistently outperforms evaluated LVR baselines, achieving the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, we are the first to scale visual reasoning in latent space, showing that our framework continues to deliver robust improvements at frontier model scales up to 235B. Further analyses show more question-sensitive latent-token positions, stronger alignment with relevant visual regions, and greater fixed-context dependence on the most attended latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReaLVR，用显式视觉证据监督弥补潜在视觉推理中的“证据-归因缺口”，在多模型多任务上显著提升，并可扩展至235B规模。
AI.motivation: LVR让MLLM在连续潜在token中进行中间推理，但潜在过程不可观测、难以监督。作者发现潜在token对影响答案的图像扰动反应弱，即“潜在证据-归因缺口”。仅用最终答案奖励（如GRPO）无法指导应保留何种视觉证据及如何在潜在token间分配奖励。
AI.method: 提出ReaLVR：对模型自由运行的潜在轨迹施加视觉证据监督。核心做法是对比正确与模型生成的错误答案以定位需更强监督的位置，并对比相关与不匹配的视觉证据以指定应保留的内容。将此监督融入训练以纠正潜在token的注意与表示，使其更敏感于问题相关的图像区域与变动。
AI.result: 在三大家族模型上均优于LVR基线；Qwen2.5-VL-7B在五任务平均达63.7%，并首次将潜在空间视觉推理扩展至235B规模仍获稳健增益。分析显示：潜在token位置更随问题而变化；与相关视觉区域对齐更强；对最受关注潜在token的固定上下文依赖更高。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖最终答案奖励不足以塑造潜在视觉推理。通过对比正确/错误答案与相关/不相关证据的显式监督，ReaLVR有效缩小证据-归因缺口，提升跨规模与任务的表现，并改善潜在token与视觉证据的对齐与敏感性。

title: GLF-Q: Global-Local Feature-based Quantization for Vision Transformers
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) efficiently compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) without retraining, yet suffers severe accuracy degradation at low bit-widths. Existing optimization-based PTQ methods guide block reconstruction via either soft logits or second-order Hessian proxies. Logit supervision is prone to overfitting on limited calibration data, while Hessian approximations incur structural truncation errors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GLF-Q}, a novel PTQ framework guided by Global-Local Feature alignment. GLF-Q propagates quantized block outputs through downstream full-precision layers to align penultimate-layer representations under local output regularization, providing downstream feature supervision without explicitly approximating the Hessian or using a Taylor expansion. Furthermore, offline Hadamard transformations are introduced with zero runtime overhead to disperse activation outliers across channels, effectively contracting dynamic ranges and reducing quantization errors. Meanwhile, optimizing this loss via a Straight-Through Estimator (STE) achieves rapid convergence, bypassing continuous relaxation rounding formulations such as AdaRound. Extensive experiments across representative ViT architectures demonstrate that GLF-Q with standard uniform quantizers substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods under 3-bit quantization on image classification. In addition, GLF-Q exhibits strong out-of-domain calibration robustness and achieves speedups under 8-bit GPU deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出GLF-Q，一种利用全局-局部特征对齐的PTQ框架，在不引入Hessian近似或泰勒展开的情况下，显著提升ViT在低比特（尤其3-bit）量化下的精度与鲁棒性，并在8-bit部署上带来加速。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法在低比特对ViT压缩时精度大幅下降：基于logit的监督易在少量校准数据上过拟合；基于二阶信息的Hessian近似存在结构性截断误差与计算负担。需要一种既不过拟合、又不依赖不准近似的监督信号来指导块级重建，并降低激活离群值带来的量化误差。
AI.method: 1) 全局-局部特征对齐：对每个量化块，仅量化该块并将其输出继续通过后续全精度层，最小化与全精度模型在倒数第二层的表示差异；同时施加局部输出正则，作为下游特征监督，无需Hessian或泰勒展开。2) 离线Hadamard变换：在不增加推理时延的前提下，将激活通过Hadamard变换打散，分散离群值，收缩动态范围以减小量化误差。3) 用STE优化离散量化参数，避免AdaRound等连续松弛，收敛更快。4) 采用标准均匀量化器实现。
AI.result: 在多种代表性ViT上，3-bit图像分类量化显著优于现有SOTA PTQ方法；在跨域校准场景中表现稳健；在8-bit GPU部署上获得推理加速。
AI.conclusion: GLF-Q通过全局-局部特征对齐与离线Hadamard变换，在无需二阶近似与复杂 rounding 松弛的前提下，为ViT提供高精度、快速、鲁棒的PTQ方案，特别在低比特下效果显著，并兼具实际部署效率。

title: Recent Advances in Agentic Agri-Robotic Phenotyping: A Perspective Review from Fragmented Multimodal Sensing to Unified PhenoAgent Intelligence
summary: This review examines the evolution of plant phenotyping from conventional manual trait measurement to high-throughput, robotic, and artificial intelligence-driven crop monitoring. Despite significant advances in imaging, autonomous platforms, multimodal sensing, and deep learning, current phenotyping systems remain fragmented across sensing modalities, crop traits, growth stages, environments, and management objectives. We therefore frame phenotyping as an integrated \emph{seed-soil-plant-environment-management} (SSPEM) intelligence problem, where crop performance reflects interactions among seed quality, root-zone conditions, plant development, environmental exposure, and management actions. The review synthesizes conventional, high-throughput, robotic, and AI-driven phenotyping approaches, highlighting their capabilities and persistent limitations in temporal integration, multimodal reasoning, biological interpretation, and actionable decision support. Building on this analysis, we introduce a conceptual PhenoAgent framework that extends phenotyping beyond the estimation of isolated traits to evidence-based crop-state interpretation, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and management-oriented support. The PhenoAgent concept primarily brings together scattered advances in phenotyping to deliver insights ranging from detailed to high-level, such as what is happening in the crop, why it might be occurring, what evidence is missing, and what actions or additional measurements should be considered. We also discuss challenges in dataset scarcity, annotation, benchmarking, model generalization, and explainability. By linking multimodal phenotyping with agentic AI and closed-loop decision support, this review outlines a path to interpretable, scalable, and deployment-oriented crop intelligence.

AI.tldr: 综述从传统手工表型测量到高通量、机器人与AI驱动的作物监测演进，提出将表型定义为“种子-土壤-植株-环境-管理”(SSPEM)一体化智能问题，并概念化PhenoAgent框架以实现多模态融合、因果解释、决策支持与不确定性感知，指向可解释、可规模化、可部署的作物智能。
AI.motivation: 现有表型平台虽在成像、自动化与深度学习上有显著进步，但在不同模态、性状、生育期、环境与管理目标之间碎片化严重，难以支撑跨时空整合、可解释推理与可操作决策需求。
AI.method: 进行系统性综述，对比传统、高通量、机器人与AI驱动表型方法的能力与局限；将表型问题重构为SSPEM一体化智能；提出PhenoAgent概念框架，联接多模态感知、证据整合、不确定性建模、因果/机理解释与闭环管理建议。
AI.result: 形成对当前表型技术差距的综合诊断，总结其在时间整合、多模态推理、生物学解释与可操作建议方面的不足；提出PhenoAgent作为统一框架，可输出“发生了什么、为何发生、缺什么证据、应做何行动/追加测量”等层次化洞见。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多模态表型与具身/代理式AI及闭环决策支持相结合，可推动表型从孤立性状估计迈向面向管理的作物状态理解与行动建议；未来需解决数据稀缺、标注与基准、模型泛化与可解释性等挑战。

title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
summary: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.

AI.tldr: GenNVS 结合3D高斯点渲染与视频扩散模型，通过前景/背景解耦与几何对齐以及双流遮罩引导，实现单张图像的高保真且几何一致的新视角合成，并支持灵活编辑。
AI.motivation: 单视图新视角合成因3D几何不确定性大而困难；扩散方法虽逼真但易出现前景几何结构与空间一致性破坏，缺乏稳定的几何先验与显式引导。
AI.method: 1) 以3D Gaussian Splatting分别表示前景对象与背景，并通过由粗到细的几何优化将二者对齐成统一场景；2) 以该场景为条件驱动视频扩散模型；3) 提出Dual-Stream Masking：利用渲染的有效性掩码与基于几何的扭曲场双重引导合成过程，提高几何一致性与遮挡处理；4) 天然支持对前景/背景的独立编辑与重组。
AI.result: 相较最新方法，在视觉质量与几何精度上均有提升；生成结果具有更好的结构保持与空间连贯性，并展示了灵活场景编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何先验与扩散生成相结合，通过解耦建模与双流遮罩引导，可有效缓解单图NVS的几何歧义问题，提升质量与准确性，同时增强可编辑性。

title: Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Temporal video grounding is a key capability of advanced \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) for the thorough understanding of video events, which is however often limited by repeated actions and visually similar contexts in long videos. In this paper, we study this issue from the perspective of \emph{On-policy distillation} (OPD) and propose a new training regime for MLLMs termed \emph{Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation} (CAPD). In particular, OPD is a viable solution for MLLMs via providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. But its next-token based teacher-student distillation is hard to identify the specific video segments supporting each predicted timestamp, which is critical for temporal grounding. In this case, CAPD measures how masking each temporal group changes the teacher's output distribution. The resulting counterfactual influence calibrates the teacher's attention and weights token-level distillation, allowing the student to learn the temporal evidence that affects boundary prediction. To validate CAPD, we trained it on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using only 2,500 samples for one epoch, and evaluated it on the TimeLens and multiple general video benchmarks. Experimental results show that CAPD improves average recall by 12.0\% relative to GRPO on TimeLens while preserving general video understanding, achieving comparable accuracy to the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出CAPD，一种针对MLLMs的时序视频定位训练策略，通过反事实注意力来改进在长视频中重复动作/相似场景下的定位鲁棒性；在Qwen3-VL-8B上仅用2500样本一轮训练，即在TimeLens上较GRPO平均召回提升12%，同时保持通用视频理解精度。
AI.motivation: MLLM在长视频的时序定位易受重复动作和相似视觉语境干扰，现有基于OPD的next-token蒸馏难以将教师信号精确归因到触发时间边界的具体视频片段，导致学生难以学习真正影响时间戳预测的证据。
AI.method: 在OPD框架下提出Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation：将视频划分为时间组，依次遮蔽每个组，测量教师输出分布的变化作为反事实影响，从而校准教师在各token上的注意力并对token级蒸馏加权；学生沿自身轨迹获得密集监督，重点学习影响边界预测的证据。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上仅用2500条样本训练1个epoch；在TimeLens与多项通用视频基准上评测，CAPD相对GRPO在TimeLens平均召回提升12.0%，且通用视频理解精度与基线（原始模型）相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实遮蔽来重加权token级蒸馏，可在不牺牲通用能力的前提下，显著提升MLLM的时序视频定位；CAPD为基于OPD的时序证据对齐提供了有效途径。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Intermediate Renders for Image-to-Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to post-train vision-language models for image-to-code generation, such as generating SVG code from a reference image, by optimizing rewards computed from the final rendered output. However, relying on a single terminal reward provides sparse feedback that is poorly aligned with the contribution of individual tokens. A generated program may contain operations that accurately reproduce some parts of the target image alongside others that introduce errors, yet all tokens are trained from the same final outcome. We observe that many intermediate code prefixes are not only executable, but already produce meaningful partial renders that reflect progress toward the target. This property provides a natural source of denser supervision during generation. Based on this observation, we introduce IR4RL, an RL framework with a token-level render-progress reward that turns changes between intermediate renders into localized feedback for the generated sequence. We evaluate our approach on Image-to-SVG and Image-to-TikZ generation. Across both tasks, our method improves over supervised fine-tuning and standard GRPO, yielding new state-of-the-art open-source models. This shows that intermediate rendering provides a simple and effective source of process supervision for RL post-training of image-to-code models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出IR4RL：利用中间渲染进度作为逐token奖励的强化学习框架，显著提升图像到代码（SVG/TikZ）生成性能，优于SFT与标准GRPO，达成开源SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到代码的RL后训练通常只用一次性终端渲染奖励，反馈稀疏且与各token贡献错配。同一程序既可能包含正确局部也含有错误，但所有token都被同一最终结果监督，学习低效。作者观察到许多前缀程序可执行并产生有意义的部分渲染，可作为更密集、过程性的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出IR4RL：在生成过程中对可执行的代码前缀进行渲染，比较相邻中间渲染与目标图像的差异，将“进度改变量”转化为逐token的局部奖励，从而训练策略。适用于Image-to-SVG与Image-to-TikZ；与标准基线（如SFT、GRPO）对比评估。
AI.result: 在两个任务上，IR4RL较SFT与标准GRPO均有一致提升，达成新的开源SOTA。方法简单、通用，能更好对齐token级贡献并提高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 利用中间渲染作为过程监督可有效缓解终端奖励稀疏与错配问题。IR4RL为图像到代码模型提供更细粒度、对齐的RL信号，带来稳定且显著的性能提升。

title: Temporal Modelling for Burn Scars on Sentinel-3
summary: Rapid and accurate burn scar delineation from satellite imagery is essential for post-fire damage assessment. Sentinel-3 OLCI, with daily revisit and 21 spectral bands, suits rapid mapping, yet most pipelines treat acquisitions independently, leaving the pre/post-fire change signal unexploited. We present a dataset of 246 wildfire activations (2016-2025) from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, with Sentinel-3 OLCI temporally paired acquisitions. We benchmark spatial and temporal (ConvLSTM-augmented) variants of three backbones (U-Net, SegFormer, ConvNeXt-UPerNet) under two input modes and spectral configurations. Temporal modeling improves segmentation only when pre-fire frames are included, and a 5-band subset matches the full 21-band OLCI configuration.

AI.tldr: 构建了包含哨兵‑3 OLCI 预/后火成对影像的野火数据集，评测多种语义分割架构与时序建模；发现仅当加入火前帧时时序模型才带来提升，且5波段即可媲美21波段。
AI.motivation: 现有快速烧毁斑块制图多将单次影像独立处理，未充分利用火前/火后变化信息；OLCI具高重访与多光谱优势，但缺少成对时序数据与系统性基准，限制了应急评估的效率与准确性。
AI.method: 汇编2016–2025年CEMS的246次野火案例如期配对的Sentinel‑3 OLCI影像；在两种输入模式与不同光谱配置下，对U‑Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt‑UPerNet的空间版与加入ConvLSTM的时序版进行基准测试，比较预/后火帧组合与波段子集（含5波段与全21波段）。
AI.result: 时序建模仅在提供火前帧时显著提升分割性能；若无火前帧，时序优势不明显；使用精选的5个波段即可达到与全部21个波段相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: 利用成对时序（含火前帧）是提升OLCI烧毁分割的关键；在成本与效率上可优先采用5波段配置，结合合适的时序架构以实现快速、准确的火烧斑映射。

title: Summarize Before Grounding: Query-Guided Chunk Condensation for Long-Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the video interval corresponding to a language query. Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) show great potential in solving such a multi-modal reasoning task. However, long videos often contain large amounts of redundant information that disturbs LVLMs to mine query-relevant evidence. Instead of dense frame sampling which incurs prohibitive training memory, previous reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) works typically utilize sparse sampling, which makes training feasible but may miss critical evidence. In this paper, we propose a ``summarize before grounding'' framework (named ``SumGround'') for long-video temporal grounding. The key of SumGround is to perform query-guided chunk condensation to aggregate and retrieve query-relevant evidence. Specifically, we split the video into several chunks and perform two-level chunk condensation. First, we introduce query-guided latent summaries, which is represented as KV states of query-guided prompts, to compress redundant visual tokens into compact query-relevant chunk summaries. Furthermore, we design an associative summary retrieval scheme to rank and select chunk summaries that are most likely to contain the event interval. Both query-guided latent summary and associative summary retrieval schemes are enabled by RLVR. To reduce memory consumption, we propose a length-aware gradient gating module to selectively stop gradient back-propagated to visual tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SumGround performs favorably against previous state-of-the-art methods across multiple downstream datasets, with remarkable gains on long videos.

AI.tldr: 提出SumGround：在长视频文本定位中先摘要再定位，通过查询引导的分块凝练与摘要检索，在保持关键信息的同时显著降低冗余与内存开销，跨多数据集取得SOTA，长视频提升尤为明显。
AI.motivation: 长视频包含大量与查询无关的冗余，干扰LVLM的多模态推理。密集采样内存代价高，RLVR的稀疏采样虽省内存却可能漏掉关键信号，亟需在可控内存下保留与查询强相关的证据以提升定位精度。
AI.method: SumGround“先总结后定位”。1) 将视频划分为多个chunk。2) 两级分块凝练：a) 查询引导的潜在摘要：用查询引导的提示生成KV状态作为压缩表示，把冗余视觉token压缩成紧凑的chunk摘要；b) 关联式摘要检索：对各chunk摘要进行相关性排序并选择最可能包含事件的摘要。两者均以RLVR优化，确保可验证奖励驱动选择更相关证据。3) 长度感知的梯度门控：根据序列长度选择性阻断回传到视觉token的梯度，降低显存与训练成本。最终在选中摘要上执行时间定位。
AI.result: 在多个下游VTG数据集上优于现有SOTA，特别是在长视频场景中有显著性能增益，同时降低训练内存消耗。
AI.conclusion: 通过查询引导的分块摘要与检索，并结合RLVR与长度感知梯度门控，SumGround能高效过滤冗余、保留关键证据，实现对长视频的更准确、资源友好的时间定位，普适且可扩展。

title: WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldAttention：通过混合稀疏注意力与分层KV缓存，使文本条件交互式视频世界模型在长时程生成中兼顾低延迟与历史保留，并以定制内核将理论效率转化为实测优势，显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归扩散式视频世界模型为控制复杂度常用滑动窗，导致历史丢失、长程交互下降；而全历史缓存又因注意力二次复杂度和KV线性增长而在算力与显存上不可承受，需要一种既保留长期上下文又高效可部署的注意力/缓存体系。
AI.method: 系统层面的注意力与缓存共设计：1) 混合稀疏注意力HSA，将线性全局注意力与按头自适应的稀疏注意力结合，兼顾全局依赖与计算稀疏性；2) 分层KV缓存HKV，将历史KV按语义索引分页，组织在多层内存中，实现细粒度检索与GPU驻留可控；3) 为两者定制高效内核以消弭工程开销，将理论复杂度收益落地。
AI.result: 在VBench-Long与InterVBench上优于现有方法，主体一致性分别达到0.9472与0.9668，验证了长时程、交互式视频生成中的效率与效果提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过HSA与HKV的协同，以及配套内核优化，WorldAttention实现了可扩展、低延迟且保持长程上下文的交互式视频世界模型，提供了兼顾性能与资源占用的实用方案。

title: Does Native 3D Texture Generation Necessarily Require 3D Assets for Training?
summary: Native 3D texture generation synthesizes colors directly in 3D space for a given geometry, conditioned on multi-view reference images. It is generally believed that training such models requires large-scale, high-quality real 3D asset data, whose acquisition remains a long-standing and challenging problem. In this work, we propose Tex-Zero, demonstrating that a high-fidelity native 3D texture generation framework can be trained without 3D assets. Our key observation is that only high-quality and fine-grained color information is essential for 3D texture training, while the required geometric information is less critical and can be manually constructed rather than obtained from real 3D assets. This finding makes it possible to transform abundant, high-quality 2D images into effective training samples for 3D texture generation. Specifically, we convert high-quality 2D images into 3D training samples by representing each image as a plane in 3D space and applying patch-wise random rotations and aggregation to construct complex geometric structures. Using these constructed image data, we train the Tex-Zero VAE, which can reconstruct real 3D assets with high quality despite never observing them during training. Building upon the Tex-Zero VAE, we train the Tex-Zero DiT also exclusively on the constructed image data, where the conditioning 2D multi-view images are transformed into planes in 3D space and also encoded by the Tex-Zero VAE, thereby reducing the representation gap and improving generation quality. Extensive experiments show that Tex-Zero generates high-fidelity 3D textures with fine-grained details solely using images as training data, offering a promising perspective on the data paradigm for scaling 3D texture generation.

AI.tldr: Tex-Zero表明无需真实3D资产即可训练高保真原生3D贴图生成：用高质量2D图像替代3D数据，通过将图像嵌入3D平面并做局部随机旋转与聚合来构造“伪几何”，训练VAE与DiT以实现多视角条件的3D纹理合成。
AI.motivation: 真实高质量3D资产稀缺、采集昂贵且困难，限制了原生3D贴图生成模型的训练与扩展。作者发现纹理学习的关键在于细粒度颜色信息而非真实几何，于是探索仅用2D图像与可构造的几何近似来替代3D资产。
AI.method: 1) 将高质量2D图像表示为3D空间中的平面；2) 进行patch级随机旋转与聚合，构造复杂几何结构的训练样本；3) 基于这些构造数据训练Tex-Zero VAE，使其在从未见过真实3D资产的情况下可重建真实资产的纹理；4) 在此基础上训练Tex-Zero DiT：把条件多视图图像同样转为3D平面并经Tex-Zero VAE编码，缩小表示差距，提升生成质量。
AI.result: 在仅使用2D图像作为训练数据的情况下，Tex-Zero能生成高保真、细节丰富的3D纹理并良好重建真实3D资产；实验验证其在多视角条件下的生成质量与细节表现。
AI.conclusion: 高质量纹理学习可绕开对真实3D资产的依赖，通过构造几何与2D图像即可有效训练原生3D贴图生成模型，为3D纹理生成的数据范式与可扩展性提供新路径。

title: BMND: Direct Poisson Denoising by N-Dimensional Block Matching and Collaborative Filtering
summary: Poisson denoising of scientific data requires methods that account for signal-dependent noise while accommodating different data dimensionalities and preserving quantitative intensity information. We present BMND, a dimension-independent extension of block matching and collaborative filtering for Gaussian and Poisson observations. Building on the two-stage structure of BM3D and BM4D, BMND processes Poisson data directly, without a variance-stabilizing transform, by combining noise-aware patch matching with propagation of signal-dependent noise variances through collaborative filtering and aggregation. A dimension-independent reference-patch traversal scheme supports arrays with an arbitrary number of axes. An optional aggregation-aware mass conservation preserves the observed total intensity after weighted overlap-add. We evaluate the framework on one-dimensional physiological signals, two-dimensional images, and three-dimensional volumes, using controlled noise experiments and measured fluorescence microscopy acquisitions. The experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality from noise-aware matching and Wiener filtering, while low-count phantom experiments show reduced denoising-induced intensity loss through mass conservation. The framework provides a unified, non-learning-based approach to denoising across arbitrary data dimensions and is released as an open-source library.

AI.tldr: BMND 是一个适用于任意维度数据的非学习型泊松去噪框架，直接在泊松域进行噪声感知的补丁匹配、协同滤波与聚合，并可选“质量守恒”以保持总强度；在1D/2D/3D数据与显微实验中优于传统方法并减少低计数场景下的强度流失。
AI.motivation: 科学数据常含泊松(信号依赖)噪声，且数据维度多样(1D/2D/3D+)；现有BM3D/BM4D主要针对高斯噪声，常借助方差稳定变换，可能破坏定量强度且对维度不通用。需要一种能直接处理泊松噪声、保持定量性、并统一适配多维数据的去噪方法。
AI.method: 提出BMND：在BM3D/BM4D两阶段架构下，直接在泊松观测域操作。关键点：1) 噪声感知的补丁匹配，利用信号依赖方差进行匹配与分组；2) 在协同滤波(包括Wiener阶段)中显式传播并使用信号依赖的噪声方差；3) 维度无关的参考补丁遍历策略，支持任意轴数数组；4) 聚合阶段可选“聚合感知的质量守恒”，在加权重叠相加后保持观测总强度不变；5) 提供开源实现。
AI.result: 在1D生理信号、2D图像、3D体数据上，受控噪声实验与荧光显微测量显示：噪声感知匹配与Wiener滤波带来更好的重建质量；在低计数仿真中，质量守恒显著减少去噪引起的强度损失。
AI.conclusion: BMND为跨任意维度数据的统一、非学习型泊松去噪方案，能在不做方差稳定变换的情况下提升重建质量并更好保持定量强度，适合科学成像等需要强度守恒的应用，并已开源发布。

title: Long Time No See: Benchmarking VLMs for Out-of-Sight Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world AI systems must reason about objects that are no longer visible: an AR assistant guiding a user back to an object used earlier, a household robot retrieving an item someone put away. This requires not just recalling where an object was last seen, but updating its state when it is moved and retaining that update once it leaves view. We refer to this as out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning. We introduce Beyond3D, the first VQA benchmark to isolate this ability in dynamic egocentric video: every query targets an object that has been relocated and has since left the field of view. We create our questions from HD-EPIC annotations, building a visibility track for each dynamic object from its 3D position, the camera pose, and the scene geometry to understand at each moment whether it is visible, occluded, or out of view. Beyond3D comprises 9,000 questions in eight types over 135 videos from nine participants, organized as one reasoning chain: visual grounding (is the target observable now), temporal grounding (when it was last visible and last placed), scene localization (which fixture anchors that location), and 3D spatial perception (where it lies relative to the current viewpoint or another object in the scene). We benchmark nine general-purpose and spatially specialized VLMs. The best model reaches 42.2% against 29.7% chance and text-only baselines reaching 31.9%, with the largest failures in recovering when an object was last visible, showing that tracking object movement out of sight remains far from solved for current VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出Beyond3D数据集与基准，专测“视域外时空推理”：物体离开视野后的位置与状态追踪。含9k问题、8类任务、135段自摄视频。九种VLM评测，最好42.2%，显著低于满分，表明出视野后的时间定位与跟踪仍是难点。
AI.motivation: 现实AR/机器人需要在物体离开视野后仍能推理其位置与状态，仅记忆“最后看见处”不足，还要更新移动后的状态并长期保持。现有基准未系统隔离与评测这种能力，需有针对性的测评集。
AI.method: 构建Beyond3D：基于HD-EPIC数据，为每个动态物体利用其3D位置、相机位姿与场景几何生成可见性轨迹（可见/遮挡/出视野），围绕被重新放置且已离视野的目标生成VQA问题。问题组织成单一推理链：视觉定位（当前是否可见）、时间定位（何时最后可见/被放置）、场景定位（与固定设施的锚定关系）、3D空间感知（相对当前视角或他物的空间关系）。共9000问、8类型、135视频、9名参与者。对九个通用/空间特化VLM进行基准测试。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅达42.2%准确率；机会水平为29.7%，文本基线31.9%。主要失败在“何时最后可见”的时间恢复，显示在看不见后跟踪物体移动的能力不足。
AI.conclusion: Beyond3D揭示当前VLM在视域外时空推理上的显著缺陷，尤其是最后可见时间与跨视野运动追踪。该基准为评估与推动具备长时记忆与3D时空推理能力的模型提供了针对性挑战。

title: Backdoor as Probe: Test-Time Adversarial Defense for CLIP
summary: Test-time adversarial defense improves the robustness of vision-language foundation models such as CLIP without retraining. However, adversarial activation shifts are typically treated as distortions to suppress, rather than signals to exploit. We turn these shifts into defense signals by repurposing the trigger-to-target mechanism of backdoors. The key is to implant a defender-controlled backdoor as a probe that is weakly activated by clean inputs but strongly activated by adversarial shifts. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Backdoor as Probe} (BaP), a test-time adversarial defense for CLIP. BaP constructs the probe through a closed-form model edit to a selected MLP layer. It projects the average adversarial activation shift and a defender-specified semantic direction onto the layer's low-energy input and output activation subspaces to obtain the trigger and target directions, respectively. At inference time, adversarial inputs produce measurable responses along the target direction for detection. BaP then selectively rectifies detected inputs by optimizing a small perturbation that steers their representations away from adversarial shifts and toward the clean subspace. Experiments across 16 benchmarks show that BaP improves average robust accuracy from 1.0\% to 52.3\% while retaining clean accuracy, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods with up to a \(5.7\times\) inference speedup. BaP further shows the generalization to adversarial attacks on large vision-language models. Project page: https://robin-wzq.github.io/Backdoor-as-Probe/

AI.tldr: 提出Backdoor as Probe（BaP），在CLIP上把“后门触发-目标”机制改造为探针，将对抗激活偏移转化为可检测与可修复的信号，显著提升测试时鲁棒性且无需重训。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时防御多将对抗引起的激活偏移视作噪声去抑制，忽视其可被利用的结构信号；希望在不重训基础模型的前提下，将这些偏移转化为可检测与可校正的线索，提升大规模视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性与推理效率。
AI.method:
在CLIP的选定MLP层进行闭式模型编辑，植入受防御方控制的“后门探针”：
- 计算并投影平均对抗激活偏移到该层的低能量输入子空间，得到触发方向；
- 将防御者指定的语义方向投影到低能量输出子空间，得到目标方向；
- 推理时，若输入为对抗样本，其在目标方向上响应增强，可用于检测；
- 对被检测的样本，优化小幅输入扰动，使表示远离对抗偏移并回到“干净”子空间，实现选择性校正。
AI.result: 在16个基准上，平均鲁棒准确率从1.0%提升到52.3%，基本不损失干净准确率；与SOTA相当的性能同时带来最高约5.7倍的推理加速；方法可泛化到更大的视觉-语言模型的对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: 通过把后门机制转化为测试时探针，BaP利用而非抑制激活偏移，实现无重训、可检测与可校正的一体化对抗防御，在效率与鲁棒性上兼具优势并具备良好泛化。

title: DirectUV: Image-Conditioned UV Texture Generation with Surface-Aware Positional Encoding
summary:
Generating high-quality UV textures for 3D meshes remains challenging. Multi-view projection pipelines suffer from occlusion and view inconsistency, and recent methods that generate textures directly in UV space still rely on auxiliary modules to supply 3D information, leaving the attention mechanism tied to UV-grid positions rather than to the underlying surface geometry. This mismatch limits coherence across seams and disconnected UV islands.
  We propose DirectUV, an image-conditioned UV texture diffusion framework that operates in the latent UV space of a pretrained image VAE, in which a Diffusion Transformer denoises the UV latent given a single input image and a coarse UV map. At its core, Surface-Aware Positional Encoding (SAPE) replaces the standard 2D-grid positional encoding with encodings derived from per-token 3D surface coordinates obtained via UV-to-surface correspondence. As positional encodings define the distance metric used by attention, SAPE enables tokens to interact according to 3D positional proximity derived from surface correspondence rather than UV-grid distance, restoring coherence across seams and disconnected islands. A multi-level extension further assigns different attention heads to progressively finer subdivisions of the same latent UV patch, allowing the model to reason about surface structure at multiple granularities.
  Experiments show that DirectUV produces sharper and more globally consistent textures than other baselines, with the largest improvements in occluded and view-unseen regions where projection-based methods leave gaps or stretched textures.

AI.tldr: DirectUV提出在图像条件下直接在UV潜空间进行扩散生成，并用基于3D表面坐标的SAPE替代2D网格位置编码，从而跨接缝与分离UV岛保持一致性，显著提升遮挡与未见视角区域的纹理质量。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角投影法受遮挡与视差不一致影响，UV空间直接生成的方法又依赖外部3D模块，注意力仍受UV网格位置束缚，导致跨接缝与分离UV岛的纹理不连贯。需要一种将注意力对齐至底层3D表面几何而非UV坐标的生成框架。
AI.method: 提出DirectUV：在预训练图像VAE的UV潜空间中进行扩散（Diffusion Transformer），输入为单张图像与粗UV贴图。核心是SAPE（Surface-Aware Positional Encoding），用由UV到表面对应得到的每个token的3D表面坐标来替代标准2D位置编码，使注意力以3D邻近性为度量而非UV距离；并提出多层级扩展，将不同注意力头分配给同一潜在UV块的逐级细分，以多粒度感知表面结构。
AI.result: 在基准实验中，DirectUV生成的纹理更清晰、全局一致性更好，尤其在遮挡与未见视角区域优于投影法与其他UV空间基线，减少空洞与拉伸。
AI.conclusion: 将位置编码从UV网格切换到表面几何的SAPE有效恢复跨接缝与分离UV岛的一致性；结合多层级注意力，DirectUV在单图条件下生成高质量UV纹理，优于现有方法，特别是在困难区域。

title: Revitalizing Medical Time Series with Vision-Informed Retrieval: A Vision-Language Perspective
summary: Medical time series (MedTS) underpin many clinical classification tasks, yet existing methods usually represent them only as numerical sequences and underuse the morphology that is explicit in waveform inspection. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vision-Informed Retrieval (ViRe), which uses a frozen VLM-derived waveform representation as a morphology-aware Query to guide retrieval from raw numerical MedTS features. Specifically, a Vision Query is extracted using pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to obtain morphology-aware priors from waveform plots. A tailored attention-based cross-modal retrieval mechanism then uses the Vision Query to select morphology-relevant temporal and channel evidence from the numerical representation. ViRe demonstrates strong effectiveness against ten established baselines, yielding an overall 6.42% relative improvement over the previous state of the art across six public benchmarks. Code, training scripts, and reproducibility materials are publicly available in the GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Levi-Ackman/ViRe.

AI.tldr: ViRe通过引入来自预训练视觉语言模型的“视觉查询”来指导对医学时间序列的数值特征检索，从而利用波形形态信息，跨六个公开基准比前SOTA相对提升6.42%。
AI.motivation: 现有MedTS方法多将数据当作纯数值序列，忽视在波形可视化中显性的形态学信息；作者旨在把波形形态先验引入到数值序列建模中，缓解形态信息缺失导致的分类性能不足与可解释性欠佳。
AI.method: 1) 将时间序列绘制为波形图并输入预训练VLM，提取冻结的视觉语言表征作为“Vision Query”（形态先验）。2) 设计基于注意力的跨模态检索模块，用Vision Query从原始数值时间序列的时序与通道维中检索与形态相关的证据。3) 以此检索到的证据进行分类决策。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准、相对十个强基线与前SOTA比较，整体相对提升6.42%，显示方法在多任务/多数据集上的稳定有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用VLM衍生的形态先验可显著增强MedTS分类性能；冻结的视觉查询与跨模态注意力检索为在不额外训练VLM的前提下融合波形形态与数值特征提供了高效途径。

title: CapField-OPD: Learning Continuous Capability Fields via Joint-Anchored Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow Models
summary: Reward-specialized post-training produces strong experts for flow-based generative models, while multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates their capabilities into a single student. Existing methods, however, route each prompt to a single teacher according to its semantic category, implicitly binding the desired capability to prompt content. This coupling makes capability invocation vulnerable to prompt perturbations and prevents users from explicitly adjusting the strength of the desired capability at inference time. In this work, we introduce CapField-OPD, an OPD framework that integrates multiple teachers into a continuous capability field through explicit capability coordinates. We use teacher models as anchors to construct this field, with the coordinates determining how their outputs are combined. Each capability configuration thus receives a unique supervision target, and capability control no longer depends on prompt semantics. Since the training anchors may not be optimal at inference time, we further profile the learned field on a small calibration set. The coordinate with the highest mean reward serves as the recommended default, while coordinates that are frequently optimal offer a promising candidate set for test-time scaling. Extensive experiments on compositional generation, text rendering, and visual aesthetics demonstrate that CapField-OPD consolidates multiple specialized teachers into a single student while preserving or surpassing their performance, reliably invokes the desired capabilities under semantics-preserving prompt variations, and supports continuous capability control and coordinate-based test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出CapField-OPD：把多位奖励特化教师整合为连续“能力场”的坐标控制学生模型，摆脱按语义分配教师的脆弱性，实现稳健、可调的能力调用与测试时尺度化，且性能达专长教师水平或更好。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD通常按提示语的语义类别为其路由至单一教师，等同把“所需能力”绑定到“提示内容”。这种耦合导致：1）对语义保持的轻微提示扰动不稳健；2）用户无法在推理时显式调节能力强度；3）多教师整合后的学生难以细粒度控制与扩展。
AI.method: 构建CapField-OPD：以多位奖励特化教师为锚点，显式定义连续能力坐标，并用坐标加权组合教师输出，形成“能力场”。训练中，每个坐标（能力配置）对应独特监督目标，学生学习从坐标到输出的映射，从而将能力控制从提示语语义解耦。为弥补训练锚点与推理最优点可能不一致，提出基于小型校准集的场谱测：估计各坐标的平均奖励，选平均奖励最高的坐标为默认推荐；统计经常最优的坐标，作为测试时扩展/缩放的候选集合。
AI.result: 在组合生成、文本渲染与视觉审美三类任务上，单一学生模型在性能上与多位专长教师持平或更优，且在保持语义的提示扰动下仍能稳定调用目标能力；支持连续能力强度调节与以坐标为核心的测试时扩展（scaling）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式能力坐标把多教师知识整合为连续能力场，可同时获得：稳健的能力调用、细粒度可控性与可扩展性，并在多项任务上达到或超越专长教师表现。

title: Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires models to recognize small details within complex images. Multimodal on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this challenge by using a teacher conditioned on evidence-centered crops to supervise a student conditioned on original images along student-generated trajectories. Ideally, teacher corrections, the distributional changes from the student toward the privileged teacher, should be driven by task-relevant visual evidence. However, the designs that make the teacher effective also introduce other interference. Using a lagged or frozen teacher improves training stability but introduces a model-state gap from the evolving student, while cropping enhances task-relevant evidence but also loses the visual context. These two sources of interference make the teacher corrections not purely rely on the visual evidence. We introduce Evidence-Aligned multimodal on-policy self-Distillation (EAD), which retains the crop-conditioned teacher as the target but constructs a separate evidence reference for weighting the corrections. To exclude the effect of lagged model-state from this reference, EAD measures prediction changes using the current student. To avoid crop-induced context changes, EAD masks the evidence region in the original image while preserving the other visual context. The change from the student's masked-image prediction to its original-image prediction provides a controlled reference for the direction in which the visual evidence shifts the student's prediction. EAD weights each teacher correction by its cosine alignment with the reference, i.e., retaining aligned corrections and downweighting the rest. Retaining only 6\% of the supervision mass of dense OPSD, EAD consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EAD方法，通过证据对齐来缓解OPSD中教师滞后与裁剪丢失上下文带来的干扰，在仅保留约6%的监督量下仍超过SOTA。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉理解需要模型依赖局部证据，但现有OPSD靠“裁剪条件教师→原图条件学生”的校正会受到两种额外干扰：教师与学生状态不一致（滞后/冻结）和裁剪导致上下文缺失，使教师校正不再纯粹由任务相关证据驱动。
AI.method: 保留裁剪条件教师作为目标，同时构建独立“证据参考”来加权教师校正：用当前学生避免模型状态差异，用“原图遮蔽证据区域”的输入避免裁剪引起的上下文变化；以学生在遮蔽图与原图上的预测差异，作为证据推动方向；根据教师校正与该参考的余弦对齐度对每个校正加权，仅保留对齐的校正、抑制其余。
AI.result: 在仅使用密集OPSD约6%的监督质量/质量（监督质量密度）下，EAD在多项基准上稳定优于以往SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过证据对齐选择性吸收教师信号，可在减少监督量的同时提升细粒度多模态理解性能，缓解教师滞后与上下文缺失带来的干扰。

title: V-Gym: Enhancing Agentic Visual Reasoning via Skill-Data Co-Evolution
summary: Advances in multimodal understanding, reasoning, and tool use enable agents to tackle increasingly complex visual reasoning tasks. By distilling past execution experience into reusable skills, agents can transfer lessons from both successes and failures into future reasoning, reducing repeated errors and improving capabilities. However, limited experience may produce unreliable, poorly generalizable skills, while static datasets may lack the targeted and diverse practice needed for refinement. To address this gap, we introduce V-Gym, an autonomous framework that iteratively co-evolves procedural skills and multimodal practice data from execution trajectories. During skill evolution, V-Gym analyzes trajectories to distill and refine hierarchical skills, updating procedural guidance and applicability conditions while retaining an update only if it improves validation performance. During data evolution, V-Gym selects generation seeds by balancing data utility and exploration, then translates trajectory-identified bottlenecks into diverse, targeted practice data that expand the data bank after quality checks. The resulting practice outcomes feed back into subsequent skill updates, closing the loop for continual skill refinement. Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show substantial improvements over baselines with multiple backbone models. Its evolved skills generalize across domains and models, while evolved data support more effective skill refinement, enabling autonomous diagnosis, targeted practice, and continual self-improvement.

AI.tldr: V-Gym提出一个自进化框架，将多模态代理的执行轨迹转化为可复用的分层技能，并同时生成有针对性的练习数据，形成技能—数据闭环迭代，显著提升跨任务与跨模型的视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态代理可从经验中学技能，但受限于经验稀缺与静态数据集缺乏针对性练习，导致技能不稳健、泛化弱，且难以持续改进。需要一种能自动从执行中提炼技能、并生成高价值练习数据的机制，实现有反馈的持续自我提升。
AI.method: 提出V-Gym：1) 技能进化：分析执行轨迹，蒸馏并细化分层程序化技能，更新步骤指引与适用条件，仅在验证集性能提升时保留更新；2) 数据进化：基于效用与探索平衡选择种子，依据轨迹瓶颈生成多样化、针对性的练习数据，质量控制后加入数据库；3) 闭环：新数据促进下一轮技能更新，形成持续共演化。
AI.result: 在多种多模态推理基准与多种骨干模型上，相比基线取得显著提升；进化得到的技能可跨领域、跨模型迁移；进化的数据能更有效地支持技能精炼，实现自主诊断、定向练习与持续自我提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过技能与数据的共演化闭环，V-Gym为多模态代理提供了可持续的自我改进路径，缓解经验稀缺与数据静态性的局限，带来更强的泛化与稳健性。

title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
summary: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.

AI.tldr: 提出Uni-TMPO：用前向KL的轨迹分布匹配替代奖励最大化，以避免后训练中的模式坍塌，并在T2I与VLA上同时提升奖励/成功率与多样性和泛化。
AI.motivation: 奖励最大化RL在扩散/流式T2I与VLA后训练中即使有KL或熵正则也会模式坍塌，导致图像同质化、奖励作弊、丧失多策略与弱泛化，实际机器人会因路径受阻而失败。需要一种保持高性能同时保留分布多样性的训练方法。
AI.method: 统一的后训练框架Uni-TMPO：1) 将标准化奖励在每个轨迹组内映射为目标分布；2) 用策略的轨迹对数概率诱导其分布；3) 通过前向KL将策略分布匹配到目标分布，而非最大化期望奖励；4) 为T2I设计进度条件的由粗到细调度高效构造轨迹；5) 在统一框架下，对VLA用反馈条件采样用更新观测扩展轨迹。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，Uni-TMPO优于最强基线：更高的T2I奖励与VLA ID成功率；在T2I上实现更佳的奖励-多样性-效率权衡；在VLA上对保留任务与场景的泛化更强；真实机器人评估显示在高奖励目标被阻挡时，保留多策略带来更好完成度。
AI.conclusion: 用轨迹分布匹配（前向KL）替代奖励最大化能缓解模式坍塌，在T2I与VLA统一后训练中同时提升性能、多样性与泛化，并在真实机器人中更稳健。

title: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
summary: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.

AI.tldr: 提出三角重采样（TR），在运动扩散模型后训练阶段，通过基于三角去噪调度的回放与阈值替换，缓解长时程误差累积并显著提升HumanML3D 120秒生成的FID AUC与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 长时序运动生成中，扩散模型在推理时会与基于真值窗口的训练分布失配，导致误差在长时间滚动窗口内累积；现有仅替换已完成历史的做法无法覆盖处于部分去噪状态的活动窗口。
AI.method: 在FloodDiffusion的三角去噪日程上，引入回放式训练：对每个样本抽取单一去噪阈值，跨潜变量位置与多次回放共享；无梯度执行多步三角去噪回放；每步后将低于阈值的状态用噪声匹配的真值钳制替换，阈值以上保留模型预测；得到的潜在窗口再进入常规训练更新。该构造支持监督训练（TR）与分布匹配版本（TR-DMD）。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D测试文本提示的120秒运动生成中，TR与TR-DMD在各自（非DMD与DMD）比较组内实现SOTA的FID AUC；监督TR相较于匹配但无回放的后训练，FID AUC降低40.9%，FID退化斜率降低55.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在活动窗口的部分去噪状态上进行回放与阈值钳制，TR缓解训练-推理分布失配与长程误差积累，稳定长时序生成并显著提升客观指标；方法通用于监督与分布匹配范式，且为纯后训练，可无缝集成现有三角去噪框架。

title: From Pixel Generation to Topological Inference: Structural Dual Super-Resolution for Trustworthy Cross-Physical-Domain Trabecular Morphology Learning
summary: Clinical CT and UHRCT cannot resolve individual trabeculae, whereas synchrotron radiation microCT (SRμCT) provides 3.2μm high-resolution references but is not applicable for in vivo imaging. The two domains differ by 31.25x in resolution, are only coarsely paired, and have drastically different data volumes. Moreover, clinical UHRCT suffers from severe partial volume effects, strong noise, and beam hardening/scatter artifacts, while SRμCT is nearly free. Existing super-resolution networks and pretrained-prior methods underperform because they target pixel generation--diverse details and SSIM/PSNR--and do not explicitly model these physical differences. This indicates that 32x super-resolution via pixel generation is intrinsically ill-posed. We propose a paradigm shift from pixel generation to topological inference: deterministically predicting invariant microstructures from macro-scale low-resolution inputs, evaluated by morphological parameters. We realize this paradigm via structural dual super-resolution, coupling forward physical degradation (micro-to-macro) with inverse structural inference (macro-to-micro) through structural duality constraints. The method is an end-to-end, few-shot, compact structural dual network (SDN), comprising a bidirectional modeling network for forward degradation and inverse reconstruction, a pyramid structural consistency discriminator, and four structural duality constraints. On the testset, SDN achieves morphological parameters largely consistent with SRμCT across 7 metrics, enabling clinical UHRCT with micro-imaging-level morphological quantification, with SSIM reaching 0.8. Trained on 3.2μm SSRF data, the model generalizes well to 3.25μm BSRF data from an independent source, validating cross-source generalization and confirming that the designed network achieves trustworthy structural inference rather than pixel generation.

AI.tldr: 提出从像素生成转向拓扑推断的“结构双超分辨”范式，用物理退化与结构重建的双向耦合和结构一致性约束，在32×跨域（UHRCT→SRμCT）下稳定恢复微结构形态学指标，少样本端到端网络在跨源数据上也保持一致，SSIM约0.8。
AI.motivation: 临床CT/UHRCT分辨率不足、强噪声与伪影导致微骨小梁不可分辨，而SRμCT虽有3.2μm金标准但无法体内应用；两域配准粗糙、尺度相差31.25×，传统超分与先验方法追求像素/感知指标（SSIM/PSNR）且未建模物理差异，导致32×像素级重建本质不适定，需要能直接推断形态学不变量的方案。
AI.method: 提出结构双网络（SDN）：将微→宏的物理退化建模与宏→微的结构推断重建在同一端到端、少样本、紧凑网络中双向学习，辅以金字塔结构一致性判别器及四项结构对偶约束，目标从生成像素转为预测拓扑/形态学不变量，训练于SRμCT参考并以形态学参数度量。
AI.result: 在测试集上，SDN在7个形态学指标上与SRμCT高度一致，同时SSIM达到约0.8；在3.2μm SSRF上训练后，可泛化到独立来源的3.25μm BSRF数据，表现稳定，显示对结构的可信推断而非仅像素拟合。
AI.conclusion: 结构对偶的拓扑推断范式能在极端尺度差与强物理域差下，可靠复原临床UHRCT的微结构形态学量化，实现接近SRμCT级别的定量评估，并具跨源泛化能力，优于传统像素导向超分方法。

title: DBCF: Dual-Branch Complementary Fusion of Foundation Models for Generalized Deepfake Detection
summary: As image generation and editing technologies have progressed substantially, facial forgeries pose significant challenges to privacy and public safety. Due to limited ability to capture forgery cues, existing small-scale forgery detection models often struggle to generalize across various domains and unseen manipulations. To address this limitation, researchers have turned to large-scale foundation models, which can provide richer representations and better generalization. Nevertheless, relying on a single foundation model alone remains insufficient for effective forgery detection. While models like CLIP offer robust global semantic cues, they lack the capacity to capture detailed local facial features. In contrast, DINO excels at capturing local structural features of faces, but provides weaker global semantic context. To fully utilize the synergies among multiple foundation models, we propose a hierarchical multi-granular framework that integrates complementary pretrained representations. Specifically, a Global Context Branch (GCB) based on CLIP captures holistic semantic cues, while a Fine-grained Cue Branch (FCB) built on DINOv3 captures localized structural irregularities. In addition, we design a feature fusion module that enables parameter-efficient adaptation of the frozen foundation backbones by adaptively extracting and integrating complementary features from the two models. By jointly leveraging global context and fine-grained cues, our method learns more comprehensive forgery representations and achieves strong cross-manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the benefit of the proposed design, particularly under cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层次化多粒度框架，融合CLIP的全局语义与DINOv3的局部结构特征，通过参数高效的特征融合模块实现冻结骨干的自适应整合，在跨数据集/跨操控的人脸伪造检测上显著提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 小规模伪造检测模型捕捉伪造线索能力有限，跨域和未知操控泛化差。单一大模型也存在偏科：CLIP擅长全局语义但缺乏细粒度局部，DINO擅长局部结构但弱全局语义，亟需协同利用多模型互补性。
AI.method: 构建层次化多粒度框架：1) 全局上下文分支（GCB）基于CLIP提取全局语义；2) 细粒度线索分支（FCB）基于DINOv3提取局部结构与伪造不规则；3) 设计参数高效的特征融合模块，在冻结的基础模型上自适应抽取并融合两者互补特征，学习更全面的伪造表示。
AI.result: 在多项基准上进行广泛实验，特别是在跨数据集与跨操控设置下，方法优于现有方法，显示更强的泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多基础模型的互补融合能同时捕获全局语义与局部细节，显著提升人脸伪造检测的跨域与跨操控泛化能力；参数高效的融合策略使得在冻结骨干上即可获得强性能。

title: Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation requires recovering previously observed content from an ever-growing visual history. Existing approaches either search historical context implicitly or reconstruct it into persistent 3D memory, facing inefficient memory access or accumulated geometric errors. Our key insight is that geometry need not explain the scene--it only needs to determine where visual memory should be read from, while attention decides what should be recovered. Based on this insight, we introduce GEAR, a Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing framework that uses geometry as an explicit token-level address for visual memory. Rather than fusing historical observations into a persistent global 3D representation, GEAR retains them as frame latents and uses per-frame geometry only to establish token-level correspondences with target views, thereby avoiding persistent error accumulation from global fusion. Guided by these correspondences, Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) selectively injects geometrically matched historical features into noisy target patches during denoising. We further introduce an Invisible Octree to accumulate visibility evidence and reject geometrically plausible but occluded correspondences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEAR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality, precise camera control, and revisit consistency, enabling minute-long video generation along challenging trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出GEAR：用几何做地址、注意力做读写的长时程相机可控视频生成框架，避免全局3D融合误差，利用几何对应与可见性过滤实现分钟级高质视频与精确相机控制。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频生成需从不断增长的历史中稳定取回先前内容。以往或隐式搜索历史导致记忆访问低效，或构建持久化3D记忆导致几何误差累积与漂移，影响相机可控与重访一致性。
AI.method: 将“几何仅用于寻址”而非解释场景：保留历史为逐帧潜变量，不做全局3D融合。利用每帧几何建立与目标视图的token级对应；提出GCA（几何对应注意力）在扩散去噪中将几何匹配的历史特征选择性注入目标patch；引入“不可见八叉树”积累可见性证据，剔除几何上可行但被遮挡的对应，提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多组实验中实现SOTA的视觉质量、精确相机控制与重访一致性，支持沿复杂相机轨迹生成分钟级视频。
AI.conclusion: 几何作为显式寻址信号与注意力耦合，可在不构建全局3D内存的前提下高效读写视觉记忆，避免误差累积并显著提升长时程相机可控视频生成的质量与稳定性。

title: What Visual Generators Need from Teachers: Rethinking Representation Alignment
summary: Representation alignment speeds up diffusion transformer training by pulling an intermediate block of the model (student) toward features of a frozen pretrained encoder (teacher). Which teacher layer to align, and for how long, is still set by convention, and each alternative costs a training run. We find that alignment helps where the student cannot linearly recover the teacher's features, not where it already resembles them. Since a deep teacher layer is largely predictable from the one below, we isolate what each layer adds, its increment, and measure how much of it an unaligned student recovers. The student fills the teacher's hierarchy from the bottom up and stalls near the top, which we call hierarchy filling: even after 400K steps it recovers almost none of the deepest. The recoverability gap is the unrecovered share of an increment, read from one unaligned checkpoint. In short runs that each align one teacher layer at one block, the gap nearly reproduces their ranking by FID improvement, and CKA, a measure of feature similarity, largely reverses it. Representation Alignment and Recoverability Estimation (RARE) picks the teacher layer with the largest gap before training. During training, it tracks each token's remaining distance to that layer, the online counterpart of the gap, weights tokens by it, and phases out the loss once the average distance stops falling. With SiT-B/2 on ImageNet $256\times256$, RARE reaches an FID of 18.02 without guidance and 4.46 with it, ahead of seven alignment baselines including REPA, iREPA and HASTE. It also trains in 14% fewer GPU-hours than iREPA. Its FID stays below iREPA's across model scales, teachers, datasets and backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出RARE方法：通过估计与利用“可恢复性缺口”来自适应选择并逐步淘汰表示对齐目标，从而更快更好地训练扩散Transformer，FID优于多种基线且更省GPU时长。
AI.motivation: 表示对齐能加速学生模型训练，但选择对齐哪一层、对齐多久通常靠经验且代价高；现有相似度指标（如CKA）与实际收益不一致。作者观察到学生对教师表示的“可线性恢复性”决定对齐是否有益，尤其在高层存在未恢复部分。
AI.method: 提出“层增量”与“可恢复性缺口”概念：将教师相邻层的新增信息定义为增量，度量未对齐学生对该增量的可恢复比例缺口。RARE在训练前用未对齐检查点估计各层缺口，选择缺口最大的教师层进行对齐；训练中在线跟踪每个token到该层表示的剩余距离，以此加权损失并在平均距离不再下降时逐步停用对齐项，实现自适应分阶段对齐。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256 上，SiT-B/2无指导FID 18.02，有指导FID 4.46，优于REPA、iREPA、HASTE等七个基线；相较iREPA节省约14% GPU小时；在不同模型规模、教师、数据集与骨干上均保持更低FID。
AI.conclusion: 对齐应针对学生难以线性恢复的教师层，并按在线进度自适应退场。RARE以单次前期估计与在线权重/退火机制，高效选择与调度对齐目标，稳定优于主流方法并降低训练成本。

title: SurgGMF: Fully Causal Gaussian Motion Forecasting for Anticipatory Surgical Scene Rendering
summary: Dynamic surgical scene modeling is essential for robotic perception, simulation, and decision support. Although existing neural rendering methods enable efficient reconstruction and rendering of deformable surgical scenes, they remain primarily focused on observed-frame reconstruction rather than forecasting future scene states. To this end, we present SurgGMF, a fully causal Gaussian motion forecasting framework for anticipatory surgical scene rendering. Rather than predicting future RGB images directly, SurgGMF forecasts future Gaussian motion states represented by position, scale, and rotation residuals (X/S/R) from historical Gaussian motion fields. To prevent target leakage, we introduce a full-causal-last rendering protocol, where future Gaussian states are rendered without accessing target-frame Gaussian attributes while preserving causal appearance propagation. We evaluate SurgGMF on 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS video slices using neural temporal learners and classical dynamics baselines under a unified forecasting protocol. Learned Gaussian motion forecasting consistently outperforms classical dynamics baselines in render space, demonstrating gains beyond hand-crafted state extrapolation. Latency analysis further reveals an accuracy--efficiency trade-off: under the current implementations, TKAN achieves the highest accuracy, whereas GRU and LSTM provide more favorable module-level latency profiles. These results establish SurgGMF as a reproducible framework for causal Gaussian motion forecasting and advance surgical Gaussian representations from retrospective reconstruction toward predictive scene modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgGMF：一种因果高斯运动预测框架，用过去的高斯运动场预测未来的位姿（位置/尺度/旋转）残差，并用全因果最后渲染协议避免目标泄漏；在EndoNeRF与StereoMIS上，学习式时序模型在渲染误差上优于经典动力学外推，展现准确率-延迟权衡（TKAN最准，GRU/LSTM更快）。
AI.motivation: 现有神经渲染在可变形外科场景上多偏重重建已观测帧，缺乏对未来状态的预测能力；而手术机器人感知、仿真与决策需要对未来场景进行因果、可复现实的预测与渲染。
AI.method: 1) 将外科场景表示为动态高斯（Gaussian Splatting）集合；2) 不直接预测未来RGB，而是从历史高斯运动场中预测未来高斯状态的X/S/R残差；3) 设计全因果-最后渲染协议：渲染未来帧时不访问目标帧的高斯属性，确保无信息泄漏，同时保持外观的因果传播；4) 在统一预测协议下，使用神经时序学习器（如TKAN、GRU、LSTM）与经典动力学外推作对比。
AI.result: 学习式高斯运动预测在渲染空间的表现稳定优于经典动力学基线，说明超越手工外推的收益；延迟分析显示准确率与效率权衡：当前实现中TKAN最准确，但GRU/LSTM具有更好的模块级时延。
AI.conclusion: SurgGMF提供了可复现的因果高斯运动预测框架，将外科高斯表示从回顾性重建推进到前瞻性建模，为手术场景的预测渲染与下游机器人任务奠定基础。

title: Do Emotion Concepts Generalize Across Sources, Modalities, and Architectures in Vision-Language Models?
summary: Recent studies suggest that large language models encode emotion concepts as structured internal representations, but most existing work focuses on text and a single architecture. Therefore, we ask, do emotion concepts generalize across sources, modalities, and architectures in vision--language models (VLMs)? To address this, we construct CMES (Cross-Modal Emotion Stimuli), a multi-source collection of emotion-conditioned stories, real facial expressions, synthetic portraits, and synthetic emotion-evoking scenes. For each stimulus source, we extract a separate set of six Ekman emotion vectors from each of three VLMs. We report four main findings as follows: 1) Image-derived emotion vectors form a low-dimensional geometry similar to that of text-derived vectors. Valence is relatively stable across sources, while arousal varies more. 2) Text- and image-derived emotion vectors have modest cosine similarity but still show held-out cross-modal correspondence. Text-derived vectors can also steer image interpretation. 3) Cross-architecture correspondence remains even when native cosine is near zero. Transformations estimated from generic ImageNet activations recover both correspondence and causal transfer without using the six emotion vectors or their labels. 4) After aligning representations across architectures, we construct a shared emotion subspace that preserves affective geometry and selective steering effects. The corresponding consensus emotion vectors also generalize to a held-out fourth architecture at two model sizes. These results suggest that emotion representations can share relational structure and causal effects across sources, modalities, and architectures, even when individual vector directions differ.

AI.tldr: 论文研究情绪概念在多来源、多模态、多架构的视觉-语言模型中是否具备可泛化的内部表示，并构建CMES数据集验证：情绪向量在文本与图像间呈相似低维几何结构，跨模态与跨架构存在对应与可因果迁移，通过对齐可得到共享情绪子空间并泛化到未见架构。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多聚焦于文本与单一LLM架构，缺乏对视觉-语言模型、不同数据来源与不同架构间情绪表示是否共享及如何迁移的系统性检验。作者希望回答：情绪表征能否跨来源（故事、真实表情、合成肖像/场景）、跨模态（文本/图像）、跨架构（不同VLM）保持关系结构与可操控性。
AI.method: 构建CMES数据集，包含多来源情绪刺激（情绪条件故事、真实面部表情、合成肖像、合成情绪场景）。在三种VLM上，对每个来源分别提取六类Ekman情绪向量（文本派生与图像派生）。分析其几何结构、跨模态余弦相似与保持集外对应；用文本向量引导图像解释（steering）。研究跨架构对应：即使原始余弦近零，也通过从通用ImageNet激活估计的线性变换来恢复对应与因果迁移，且不使用六类情绪向量或其标签。对齐后构建共享情绪子空间，评估保留的情感几何与选择性操控，并测试对第四个未见架构（两种规模）的泛化。
AI.result: 1) 图像派生情绪向量呈现与文本相似的低维几何；效价相对稳定，唤醒度变化更大。2) 文本与图像向量余弦相似度中等，但在保留集上仍具跨模态对应；文本向量可引导图像解释。3) 跨架构对应在原生余弦近零时仍存在；利用从通用ImageNet激活估计的变换可在不使用情绪向量/标签的前提下恢复对应与因果迁移。4) 架构对齐后可得到共享情绪子空间，既保留情感几何又保留选择性操控；共识情绪向量还能泛化到第四个架构的两种规模。
AI.conclusion: 情绪表征在不同来源、模态与模型架构间共享相对稳定的关系结构与可因果操控效应；即便各模型的具体向量方向不同，通过对齐与变换可恢复并在新架构上泛化出一致的情绪子空间。

title: CoDrive: Cross-Vehicle World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Trajectory Control for Cooperative Driving
summary: Real-world driving is inherently multi-agent, yet most existing driving world models generate observations from a single ego vehicle. Independently extending them to multiple vehicles does not ensure that different agents observe a consistent shared world. We present CoDrive, a cross-vehicle, multi-view driving video generation framework that jointly generates observations of vehicles sharing the same dynamic scene with precise camera-trajectory control. CoDrive interleaves local self-attention, which models spatiotemporal dependencies among the views of each vehicle, with global self-attention, which enables information exchange and consistency modeling across vehicles. To explicitly encode their spatial relationships, all camera trajectories are represented in a shared world coordinate system and injected into the attention layers through projective relative positional encoding. We further adopt a progressive mixed-task training strategy that combines large-scale real-world single-agent data with synthetic cross-agent interaction data, allowing the model to benefit from real-world appearance distributions while learning cross-agent consistency from simulation. For systematic evaluation, we introduce CoDrive-Bench, a benchmark covering real and synthetic multi-vehicle scenarios and evaluating trajectory controllability, scene geometry consistency, and instance-level consistency. Experiments show that CoDrive improves trajectory controllability and cross-agent geometric and instance consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出CoDrive，一个跨车辆多视角驾驶视频生成框架，同时生成共享动态场景下多车的观测，并能精确控制各摄像机轨迹；通过交替的本地/全局自注意力与投影相对位置编码，结合真实单车与合成多车数据的渐进混合训练，在新基准CoDrive-Bench上实现更好的轨迹可控性与跨车辆几何/实例一致性，同时保持视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型多为单车视角，简单扩展到多车会导致多智能体间的世界不一致与视图不协同，缺乏对共享场景和跨车辆一致性的生成能力与评测体系。
AI.method: 1) 设计CoDrive生成器：在时空维度上交替使用本地自注意力（聚焦单车多视角内部依赖）与全局自注意力（在多车之间交换信息，建模一致性）。2) 将所有相机轨迹统一到共享世界坐标，用投影式相对位置编码注入到注意力层中，显式刻画车与相机的空间关系。3) 训练上采用渐进式混合任务：用大规模真实单车数据学习外观分布，用合成多车交互数据学习跨车一致性。4) 构建评测基准CoDrive-Bench，覆盖真实与合成多车场景，评估轨迹可控性、场景几何一致性与实例级一致性。
AI.result: 在CoDrive-Bench上，CoDrive显著提升了轨迹可控性、跨车辆几何一致性与实例一致性，同时保持与现有方法相当的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模多车多视角并在注意力中显式注入共享几何先验，再配合真实+合成的渐进混合训练，可在不牺牲画质的前提下，实现更一致、更可控的多智能体驾驶视频生成，并提供了系统化评测基准。

title: PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.

AI.tldr: 提出PanoVLN：在全景视觉输入下，通过长视野规划、分支监督与语义-几何融合，显著提升VLN导航成功率，并在真实四足机器人上更快更稳。
AI.motivation: 全景比单目视角提供更完整的环境上下文，可提前看到通路与障碍，减少无谓探索；但直接替换为全景收益有限，需要在动作预测、训练监督与视觉表征上做针对性设计以充分利用更宽可视域。
AI.method: 1) 长视野动作规划：基于单帧全景一次性预测更长的动作序列，并提出置信度引导执行（CGE），按预测置信度动态决定执行多少步再重规划。2) 监督设计：构建含高频分岔与清晰指令的训练路线，强化路线选择能力。3) 表征融合：从RGB全景同时提取语义与几何特征，建模多视向间空间关系与场景布局，且不增加视觉token。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE与RxR-CE Val-Unseen上，使用4B骨干与仅RGB输入，成功率分别超越前SOTA 11.9%与8.7%。真实世界四足机器人实验显示比以往VLN更快、停顿更少。
AI.conclusion: 充分利用全景可视域需配套的长序列预测、针对性监督与语义-几何联合表征。PanoVLN在模拟与真实环境均显著提升导航效率与成功率。

title: Beyond Reconstruction Loss in Post-Training Quantization: Balanced Fitting for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large vision-language models (LVLMs), but is typically calibrated on a small set while expected to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Although recent PTQ methods for LVLMs incorporate sensitivity signals, they still minimize reconstruction loss with respect to the full-precision model, potentially over-preserving FP behavior and calibration-specific bias. Rather than treating quantization solely as an error to be minimized, we observe that it can also provide beneficial regularization for certain layers and modalities. Motivated by this observation, we propose Balanced Fitting, a quantization effect-based framework that balances precision and regularization beyond reconstruction-based optimization. By measuring layer- and component-wise quantization effects for weights, vision activations, and text activations, Balanced Fitting combines fine-grained fitting for sensitive components with coarser fitting to exploit potential regularization benefits. Experiments on multiple LVLMs show that our method consistently outperforms prior PTQ approaches under both weight-only and weight-activation quantization, while lower reconstruction loss does not reliably translate into better downstream performance. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/BFQ

AI.tldr: 提出“Balanced Fitting”用于大规模视觉-语言模型的后训练量化，通过在层与模态粒度上权衡精确拟合与正则化效应，优于单纯最小化重构误差的PTQ方法，并在权重量化与权重+激活量化下均取得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM的PTQ通常在小规模校准集上对齐全精度模型，假设能泛化到多样下游任务。但即使加入敏感性信号，主流方法仍以最小化对FP模型的重构损失为目标，可能过度保留全精度行为与校准集偏差。作者观察到量化并非纯粹的误差来源，它在某些层或模态上可起到有益的正则化作用，激发了在保精度与利用正则化之间取得平衡的新框架。
AI.method: 提出Balanced Fitting（BFQ）：1）度量层级与组件级（权重、视觉激活、文本激活）的量化效应与敏感度；2）对高敏感组件执行更细粒度、更高精度的拟合；对低敏感或可能受益于正则化的组件采用更粗粒度或更强量化；3）在优化上不单以重构损失为导向，而是结合量化效应指标，动态平衡精确拟合与正则化；适用于权重量化和权重+激活量化设置。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM上，BFQ在权重量化与权重-激活量化两种场景下均稳定超过现有PTQ基线。实验证明较低的重构损失并不总对应更好的下游任务表现，而BFQ在下游评测中取得更佳、且更稳健的结果。
AI.conclusion: 将量化视为可利用的正则化而非纯误差，结合组件级量化效应评估与差异化拟合策略，可在PTQ中取得更优的下游性能与稳健性；重构损失不应作为唯一优化目标。

title: When VLMs Trust Context: Evaluating Scene Text Recognition under Misleading Context
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can read text in natural scenes, but their predictions may be influenced by the surrounding context. When the printed text conflicts with what the scene suggests, a model may return a more plausible word instead of the shown text. We introduce SceneFaith, a benchmark of 781 generated scene images for studying this behavior.
