summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需双向扩散教师与在线score模型的少步自回归视频生成后训练方法，通过在冻结的自监督视频表示空间中最小化MMD来直接配对真实视频与模型rollout分布，配合Nyström–Monte Carlo混合估计与内存/梯度优化，实现在同等架构下提升VBench得分并保持高速；还支持大规模14B后训练及从参考视频习得新风格/语义/空间先验。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成多依赖DMD蒸馏：需要训练/推断双向扩散教师与在线fake-score，带来额外复杂度、算力与耦合到特定教师分布的局限。作者希望直接从参考视频学习rollout分布，减少依赖与成本，并能迁移新风格与概念，无需目标任务专用的扩散教师。
AI.method: 在后训练阶段，冻结表征网络（自监督视频表示），以模型生成的rollout与参考视频在该表征空间中的分布差异作为目标，最小化最大均值差异（MMD）。为降低MMD的计算与统计误差，引入混合Nyström–Monte Carlo估计器以折中核近似偏差与采样方差；并通过内存高效回放与梯度子采样使目标可扩展。方法完全移除双向扩散教师和在线score模型。
AI.result: 在与Self-Forcing相同的架构与初始化下，1.3B参数模型的VBench Total从83.80提升到84.64，同时保持17 FPS实时性。由于去除了辅助score模型，作者实现了在8张H200上对14B模型的后训练。
AI.conclusion: 直接在表示空间用MMD对齐生成rollout与真实视频，能在不借助扩散教师/score的前提下提升质量与效率，并具备可扩展性；该范式不仅可视为蒸馏替代，还能从参考视频中学习新的风格、语义与空间先验，为大模型视频生成后训练提供更通用的路径。

title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

AI.tldr: 提出Sprout：在回答问题的同时动态构建视频记忆的“时序树”，以降低长视频问答的上下文成本并保持/提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解多采用“先构建记忆、后推理”的离线管线。实务中同一长视频常被多个问题复用：问题少时，整视频离线记忆构建成本远高于答题；问题多时，记忆静态且不会被后续学习更新，浪费已获得的信息。需要一种能随问随建、可持续更新且具低上下文占用的记忆机制。
AI.method: 提出Sprout智能体框架：以低帧率按段观看视频，能回答当前问题即停止；将每段以粗粒度节点写入“时间树”，并在关键区间以高帧率回看补细节，生长出更细节点。被转写为文本的片段会从对话上下文中移除视频输入，仅保留文本记忆；原始视频仍可通过工具按需访问。记忆树与历次问答记录在多轮问题间持久化，实现在线、动态更新。
AI.result: 在三种模型、多个基准上的实验显示：用累积的文本记忆替代视频输入显著降低上下文占用，同时基本保持甚至小幅提升准确率。相较代表性的离线记忆方法，Sprout在无前期构建阶段的情况下取得相当或更优准确度，并显著降低每题的上下文成本。
AI.conclusion: 动态生长的文本化记忆树可在长视频多轮问答中有效取代冗长的视频上下文，实现更低成本与竞争性甚至更优的性能；在线、可持续更新的记忆机制优于静态离线记忆管线。

title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
summary: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SolveEpIT基准与SolveEdiT-PLAN方法，评估并提升以目标为导向的视觉场景变换能力：模型需在不破坏无关内容的前提下，根据图像与目标/规则推断并执行编辑。引入原子转移约束与SolvEScore，无需单一参考答案即可量化完成度与副作用。现有最强模型仅57.0%，两阶段规划方法平均+9.1分，GPT-Image-2从57.0%升至71.6%。
AI.motivation: 现实问题常是视觉的、需对场景进行目标驱动变换（如摆放、修复布局、路径标注），但既有基准多聚焦于感知、生成或显式变换指令，缺少对“理解目标—推断必要改动—保持其他内容不变”的系统评测。为填补这一空白，提出新的评测框架与数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建SolveEpIT数据集（2,728例），任务为：给定图像与目标/规则，推断合法变换并执行，同时保护无关区域；2) 设计“原子转移契约”，显式标注必须满足与需保护的条件；3) 提出SolvEScore指标，无需唯一参考即可度量完成度与非预期更改；4) 提出两阶段方案SolveEdiT-PLAN：先在规划阶段实例化所需转移，再调用任意生成式编辑器执行，单次生成设置下评估。
AI.result: 在基准上，当前最强模型SolvEScore仅57.0%。引入SolveEdiT-PLAN后，在三种编辑器/生成器上平均提升9.1分，其中GPT-Image-2从57.0%提升到71.6%，且无需修改底层编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解在现有模型中仍具显著挑战。通过原子转移契约和SolvEScore，可更公平、细粒度地评测编辑完成度与副作用；两阶段规划能在不更改编辑器的前提下显著提升性能，表明显式规划对视觉场景变换至关重要。

title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA

AI.tldr: 提出ReVA：一个用于遥感视频问答的新基准，覆盖2438段无人机视频与2.2万QA，评测MLLM在时空与场景推理上的能力，并显示现有视频LLM存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准主要基于模板化问题与静态图像，导致问题单一且忽视无人机/航拍的时间维度，缺乏对视频时空推理能力的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建ReVA数据集：收集18座城市的2438段无人机视频（约58万帧），设计11类高难度QA任务；采用“文本LLM+多模态LLM”的半自动标注流水线生成问答，并由人工核验；随后对23个专有与开源视频LLM进行系统评测。
AI.result: 得到包含2.2万高质量问答对的视频遥感基准；广泛评测显示当前视频LLM在时空理解、场景中心与复杂推理方面存在基础性局限。
AI.conclusion: ReVA填补了遥感视频问答评测空白，成为推动MLLM提升视频时空与推理能力、面向真实世界应用的重要基准，并开放代码与数据以促进研究。

title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef, which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness, which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoRef：自动优化多参考图像生成代理的“harness”（执行流程与诊断代码），在不改动模型的前提下显著提升多参考合成质量，并具有跨模型与设置的迁移性。
AI.motivation: 多参考图像生成常出现漏检/重复主体与“拼贴感”，且需要同时满足多维标准（对各参考的忠实度与整体自然度）。以往“图像生成代理”依赖人工编写的harness来组织参考处理、生成与诊断，但人工harness设计难、性能差异大、改动影响难以预测。需要一种自动方法系统性优化harness。
AI.method: 提出AutoRef：固定图像生成与推理模型，仅通过“编码代理”迭代重写harness代码；将用于产生改进建议的反馈任务与用于最终排序选择的任务解耦；采用beam保留在选择任务上得分最高的一组harness并继续搜索，逐步逼近更优方案。
AI.result: 自动搜索得到的AutoRef-Harness在MultiBanana基准的四参考任务上，将开源权重FLUX.2 [klein] 4B的得分从5.72提升到7.37，达到或超过专有模型（如Nano Banana Pro与GPT-Image-1.5）。在不重新优化的情况下，同一harness对不同生成器、参考数量、基准、评测器与推理模型也带来改进。
AI.conclusion: 自动化优化harness能够在冻结模型下显著提升多参考图像生成的保真度与自然度，并具备良好的泛化与可迁移性，优于手工编写的harness；AutoRef为构建更强的多参考生成代理提供了通用框架。

title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出“Look Before You Judge (LBYJ)”：在不训练、不改参数的前提下，为多模态大模型的深伪判别提供以证据为先的、可解释且局部扎根的流程；通过先找证据区、再逐区检查、最后整合做出判决，显著提升准确率并降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM能用自然语言解释深伪判决，但解释常不依赖真实图像证据，容易凭语言先验胡诌；已有增强grounding的方法多在整幅图上加权，难以捕捉细微、局部且与图像内容相关的取证线索。需要一种无需训练、能在局部寻找并利用取证证据的框架。
AI.method: 将可解释深伪检测表述为“顺序取证”过程：1) 用原图与高斯模糊图的解码器到视觉注意力（decoder-to-visual attention）对比，定位图像特定的候选证据区域；2) 对这些局部区域分别检查与推理；3) 将局部证据与全局上下文融合后再给出最终判决。全流程无需操纵掩码、外部取证模型或参数更新，可直接用于现成开源MLLM。
AI.result: 在TriDF与MMTD-Set上，跨5个开源MLLM：检测准确率最高提升12.8%；CHAIR最高下降33.4%；幻觉率最高下降21.3%；整体优于代表性的零训练解码与注意力干预方法。
AI.conclusion: LBYJ以训练无关、逐步取证、局部到全局融合的方式，使MLLM的深伪判别解释更依证据、更少幻觉，并在多基座与数据集上稳定带来显著收益，可直接作为现成MLLM的即插即用增强方案。

title: Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation
summary: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.

AI.tldr: POSReasoner 是一个可训练、可插拔的推理模块，用于在视频分割中“何时更新/不更新”实例的持久状态，通过验证后再写回，显著降低遮挡、重现与相似目标交互时的身份漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有视频目标/实例分割依赖逐帧传播的实例状态；在长时遮挡、重现或相似目标互作时，错误观测会覆盖正确历史，导致持久的ID漂移，缺乏显式的“是否应更新内存”的决策机制。
AI.method: 提出 POSReasoner：在稀疏的状态-观测图上执行“提议-验证”(Propose-Verify)推理。每个持久状态记录身份、置信度与缺席历史；对新观测先生成临时关联，再结合对象历史、存在预测与多身份竞争进行验证。仅通过验证的转移才更新持久状态；并由学习到的门控控制证据写回强度。决策涵盖保留、更新、再激活与抑制。框架可训练、可插拔，冻结底座模型，只用标准视频标注。
AI.result: 在长时 VOS/VIS 基准上，相比强基线一致提升，尤其在遮挡与目标重现情形下收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式、可学习的验证后更新机制，POSReasoner可靠维护跨帧身份，减少ID漂移，可无缝集成到多种 VOS/VIS 架构并在长时场景中带来稳健增益。

title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
summary: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: WorldPlay2提出一种交互式世界模型，通过因子化的混合控制接口、压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏协同设计，实现对多样控制的实时响应与长时一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型难以同时处理异构控制、保证长时一致性并保持实时性；长序列上下文爆炸与不稳定的蒸馏流程使问题加剧。
AI.method: (1) 因子化混合控制接口：将逐帧对齐的动作控制与结构化语义控制结合，显式解耦场景外观、角色身份与动态语义事件，提升可控性与学习效率。(2) 压缩记忆：把历史上下文压缩为紧凑记忆token，由自回归学生与双向教师共享，用于基于片段的、记忆条件的评分与训练，避免对整段长回放联合处理，降低蒸馏开销。(3) 稳定强制(Stable Forcing)：以少步策略初始化学生，并使用全回放重放维持长时展开质量，提升蒸馏稳定性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，该模型表现出强泛化能力，且在性能上优于现有方法，同时兼顾实时响应与长时一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合控制、压缩记忆和稳定蒸馏的协同，WorldPlay2有效解决异构控制与长时建模难题，为交互式世界模型提供更强的可控性、稳定性与效率。

title: Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers
summary: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.

AI.tldr: 论文复现伴随报告：复现并核对原ICPR 2026美式橄榄球危险擒抱检测的关键指标与脚本/折次输出；最佳设置为“run_15”（高斯噪声+静态变暗，无旋转/翻转），折均危险召回0.667、F1为0.588，与原文四舍五入后一致；增亮/变暗中的“亮度”是主导因子；无增强时ViViT低于C3D基线。
AI.motivation: 提供可审计、可重复的证据链，确保原研究关于危险擒抱检测（少数类“危险”）的性能声明（召回、F1）可被独立验证；同时在无法公开全部隐私视频数据的前提下，给出合规的复现与审核路径。
AI.method: 沿用原工作：ViViT在733段SATT-3标注视频上微调，使用focal loss、Taguchi L18数据增强设计与5折交叉验证；复现实验定位到具体脚本、折次输出与聚合文件；对增强因子做消融（亮度、旋转、翻转、噪声），并报告主效应范围；对无增强与C3D基线进行对比。
AI.result: 最佳可复现配置为run_15：高斯噪声+静态变暗，无旋转/翻转；折均危险召回0.667、危险F1=0.588，与已发表数值在四舍五入后一致。亮度的主效应范围为0.055，超过旋转、翻转与噪声。无增强时ViViT危险召回0.545，且不超过C3D基线0.583。
AI.conclusion: 原研究 headline 指标被成功复现并可溯源；亮度调整是最关键的数据增强因素；若缺乏恰当增强，ViViT在少数类“危险”上不及C3D。受隐私限制，提供公开样本用于流程校验与受控访问全数据以支持独立审核。

title: Less Is More: Genetic Frame Selection for Efficient Novel View Synthesis
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis reconstructs a scene from many input images in a single forward pass, yet more views do not necessarily improve performance: redundant or poorly chosen frames increase computational cost and may degrade reconstruction quality. We address the problem of selecting, from an already captured sequence, a fixed-size subset of input views that is most informative for reconstructing specified target viewpoints. We propose a render-free view selector that scores candidate frames based on three complementary criteria: target-view coverage, measured against observed frames that stand in for the targets, redundancy with previously selected views, and image sharpness. A lightweight scoring network then selects the most informative frames without rendering, reconstruction, or per-scene optimization at inference time. To train the selector, we distill an expensive offline search procedure in which a genetic algorithm identifies high-quality subsets by directly optimizing reconstruction performance on training scenes. The selector learns to reproduce these choices from geometric and image-level features alone. Across six datasets and multiple input budgets, our method consistently outperforms both geometric and reconstruction-aware view-selection baselines while incurring significantly lower selection costs than reconstruction-based alternatives. Moreover, carefully selected subsets can outperform feed-forward reconstruction from the full input sequence. The learned selector generalizes across diverse reconstruction paradigms (feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF), to object-targeted reconstruction and to a cross-capture setting in which the target views come from a separate acquisition pass. More broadly, our results indicate that explicitly reasoning about target relevance and inter-view redundancy is a fundamental factor in efficient scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种渲染无关的视角选择器，在给定目标视角下，从已采集序列中快速选出最有信息量的固定数量视图，以提升前馈式新视角合成与其他重建方法的质量与效率。通过遗传算法离线蒸馏学习评分网络，综合覆盖度、冗余度与清晰度三准则，实现低成本且跨范式泛化的优选。
AI.motivation: 在前馈式新视角合成中，更多输入视图并不必然提升效果，反而会因冗余或质量不佳而增加计算并降低重建质量。现实应用常需面向特定目标视角进行重建，因此亟需一种能在不渲染/不重建的前提下，从已拍摄序列中选择固定预算且对目标最有用的子集的方法。
AI.method: 提出“渲染无关”视角选择框架：以目标视角为中心，设计三类互补评分指标——(1) 目标覆盖度：用与目标相近的观测帧作代理，评估候选帧对目标区域的几何/可见性覆盖；(2) 冗余抑制：惩罚与已选帧的重合信息，提升多样性；(3) 清晰度：度量图像锐度以避免模糊输入。构建轻量评分网络，仅用几何与图像级特征给候选帧打分与子集选择，推理时不做渲染、重建或按场景优化。训练上采用离线昂贵搜索：以遗传算法在训练场景中直接最大化重建质量，找到高质量子集；再将这些选择蒸馏给评分网络，使其学习到仅凭特征即可复现近似最优选择。
AI.result: 在六个数据集、多个输入预算下，相较几何启发式与基于重建感知的选择基线，方法在重建指标上稳定更优，同时相对“重建驱动”的选择方法显著降低选择成本。精挑子集甚至可超越使用完整输入序列的前馈重建表现。所学选择器还能跨重建范式泛化（前馈方法、3D Gaussian Splatting、NeRF）、支持以对象为目标的重建与跨采集（目标视角来自独立扫描）设定。
AI.conclusion: 面向目标视角的相关性评估与跨视角冗余控制是高效场景重建的关键。通过离线遗传搜索蒸馏得到的渲染无关视角选择器，可在不牺牲推理效率的情况下，稳定提升多种重建范式的质量，并在有限预算下尤为有效。

title: What Paired Evaluations Reveal under Visual Perturbations
summary: Robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, while benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, capturing changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance beyond aggregate accuracy. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing. To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct-correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image's synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨在鲁棒性评估中利用“成对对应”（同一图像在干净与扰动条件下的预测配对）来解释评估结果并优化物理测试优先级。结论：若目标是给出可靠性边界，按类别的“正确-正确”计数已足够；若目标是挑选样本做昂贵的物理测试，则需要利用图像级的合成响应（如在多种合成腐蚀下的真类概率均值）来更好地发现高风险样本。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒性基准覆盖的真实场景有限，且物理测试昂贵；简单的整体准确率难以揭示在扰动下正确性、置信与被接受性如何变化。需要一种利用同一图像跨条件信息的框架，既可解释评估统计，又能更高效地挑选物理测试样本。
AI.method: 1) 将同一图像在干净与扰动条件下的预测配对，研究类内不同配对方式对评估指标的影响；在固定两组预测记录的前提下，变化其类内对应关系，推导关于接受度损失与在保留正确样本上的真类概率下降的“最紧界”。并分析将“持续错误”与“变化错误”区分对接受错误转移的额外约束，以及共享对应关系在策略排序上的作用。2) 用图像级的合成响应来优先级排序物理测试：对每张干净-正确的图像，依据其在多种合成腐蚀下的真类概率均值（并引入A3Rank打分变体）进行排序，比较与基线（清洁置信度、等规模的自然变换平均）在物理重拍（屏幕与打印再捕获）下的失效召回。
AI.result: 在44个分类器上，挑选最高风险前20%样本进行物理重拍测试，能找回的失败占比：屏幕再捕获为67%（基线：清洁置信58%，自然变换均值60%），打印再捕获为45%（基线：36%、37%）。采用概率均值与A3Rank时，基于“合成腐蚀”的集合在平均失败召回上优于“自然变换”集合；不同打分间差异随来源与预算而异。理论上，类内正确-正确计数即可达到与任意可行的五状态细化同样紧的界；区分持续错/变化错可进一步收紧对“被接受错误”的转移约束；共享的对应关系可在仅靠分离成本区间无法判定时确定策略优劣。
AI.conclusion: “对应”的价值依目标而异：若为给出鲁棒性与可靠性界，类内的正确-正确计数已足够；若为高效分配昂贵的物理测试预算，应利用图像级的合成响应来排序样本，从而显著提升失效发现率。

title: ReSS: Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention for 3D Vision Transformers
summary: 3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows. To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability. However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model's behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases. In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve. Code is available at https://github.com/libary753/ReSS.

AI.tldr: 提出ReSS方法，通过最小化注意力稀疏化对残差流造成的“漂移”来选择和还原注意力块，在多骨干与多数据集上以相同稀疏率保持更好性能，并给出证据表明“漂移”是稀疏代价的核心量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉Transformer（如VGGT）在多视图场景中需对所有视图token做全局注意力，计算量随视图数增长而爆炸。已有稀疏化方法（SparseVGGT、HeSS）用注意力概率来挑选保留块，但作者发现注意力概率并不反映移除该块对模型行为的真实影响，导致在高稀疏度下性能崩塌。需要一种与实际行为变化更一致的度量来指导稀疏选择。
AI.method: 将块选择从“最大化保留的注意力质量”改为“最小化对残差流的漂移”。1) 定义漂移分数：衡量移除某块对残差向量的位移大小。2) 认识到删除集合的总漂移取决于贡献向量的方向组合而非仅幅值，提出迭代残差恢复：全局地细化要丢弃的块集合，使总漂移最小。3) 在不同骨干与数据集上以给定稀疏率进行对比评测。
AI.result: 在三个骨干网络与五个数据集上，ReSS在相同稀疏率下较SparseVGGT和HeSS更好地保持与致密推理相当的性能。额外实验显示：按最大漂移优先删除会比随机更快劣化；将性能按“实现的漂移”而非稀疏率作图，各方法曲线近似重合，指向漂移为主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 注意力稀疏化的关键代价由对残差流的漂移所支配。通过以最小化漂移为目标并用迭代残差恢复全局优化删除集合，ReSS在不增加稀疏率的情况下更好地保留模型性能，且实验性证据支持“漂移”作为统一度量刻画各方法性能变化。

title: Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages
summary: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可同时（流式）手语到手语翻译系统，基于两种wait-k策略，并引入考虑计算的流式延迟指标；在六个方向上显著降低延迟，精度小幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有手语到手语系统需离线整句输入，无法满足直播解说、视频通话等实时场景对同时输出的需求；不同手语间词序差异使同时翻译更具挑战。
AI.method: 提出两种同时S2S方案：（1）在整句模型上直接进行测试时wait-k推理；（2）通过随机多路径监督训练显式的wait-k模型。并提出考虑计算成本的流式延迟指标ca-Stream-AL。通过六个翻译方向、含人工验证测试集与大规模合成语料进行评测；还做词序不匹配个案分析。
AI.result: 相较整句基线，平均实现38%的ca-Stream-AL降低；代价为DTW-PA-MPJPE增加约9%、BLEU-4下降约2.1分；在六个S2S方向、两个数据集上验证。
AI.conclusion: 在保证较小精度损失的前提下，大幅降低流式延迟，证明同时S2S手语翻译可行；wait-k与多路径训练有效，应对跨手语词序差异有一定能力。

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing
summary: Instruction-based image editing has achieved strong performance in single-turn settings, yet practical editing is often iterative, with each instruction applied to the output of the previous turn. We find that existing editing models degrade rapidly under recursive editing and attribute this failure to a train-test mismatch in the conditioning distribution: models are trained on clean source images but must repeatedly condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference time. To address this, we propose MT-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that trains the model on self-generated conditioning states with editing supervision from a clean-conditioned teacher, without requiring multi-turn annotations. We further introduce LME-Bench, a benchmark of 100 ten-turn editing sessions for evaluating long-horizon robustness. Experiments across three editing backbones show that MT-OPSD substantially improves long-horizon editing success and reduces multi-turn collapse while largely preserving single-turn editing quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在多轮指令图像编辑中性能劣化的原因是训练-测试条件分布不匹配，并用自策略蒸馏MT-OPSD解决；并发布十轮会话基准LME-Bench，跨多种骨干显著提升长程鲁棒性且保持单轮质量。
AI.motivation: 实际编辑往往是多轮迭代，现有模型在递归编辑中迅速崩溃；原因在于训练时只见到干净源图，推理时却要反复以自身不完美输出为条件，导致分布偏移与误差累积。
AI.method: 提出MT-OPSD：让学生模型在训练中以自身生成的中间状态作为条件（on-policy），而监督信号来自以干净图像为条件的教师模型（self-distillation），无需多轮标注数据。并构建LME-Bench：包含100个十轮编辑会话，用于评测长程鲁棒性。方法在三种编辑骨干上验证。
AI.result: 在三种编辑骨干上，MT-OPSD显著提高多轮编辑成功率，减少多轮崩溃（collapse），同时基本不损伤单轮编辑质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中对齐推理时的条件分布，并借助教师监督，MT-OPSD有效提升长程迭代编辑鲁棒性；LME-Bench为该问题提供标准化评测。

title: Remote Sensing Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Depth Image-Based Rendering
summary: Remote sensing novel view synthesis under sparse observations remains challenging due to insufficient geometric constraints and limited cross-view supervision. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods are prone to overfitting and face challenges of depth ambiguities, missing cross-view information, and insufficient constraints in under-observed regions. To address these challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian Splatting framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) to generate pseudo views for cross-view consistency supervision. Specifically, reliable geometric initialization is constructed by aligning monocular depth priors with sparse SfM reconstruction, and cross-view appearance priors are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to enhance appearance modeling under sparse observations. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive DIBR-based pseudo-view supervision strategy to provide additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling more complete reconstruction of weakly observed regions. In addition, a height-constrained anchor growth strategy is designed to suppress unreasonable Gaussian expansion. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over existing approaches when training with only 3 input views. Compared with the previous best-performing method, it improves PSNR by 6.83 dB, with relative gains of 14\% in SSIM and 60\% in LPIPS, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS

AI.tldr: 提出DIBR-GS：在稀疏视角（仅3视图）下，通过DIBR生成伪视图进行跨视一致性监督，结合单目深度与稀疏SfM对齐初始化、外观先验融入高斯、渐进式伪视图监督与高度约束锚点生长，显著缓解几何/外观歧义与过拟合，性能大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景下视角稀疏、几何约束不足、跨视监督有限，导致NeRF/3DGS在深度歧义、弱观察区域重建不全与过拟合等问题突出，需要在少视角条件下引入可靠几何与外观先验并创造额外监督信号。
AI.method: 1) 几何初始化：将单目深度先验与稀疏SfM对齐，构建可靠初始几何；2) 外观先验：将跨视外观先验融入神经高斯表征以提升稀疏观测下的外观建模；3) 渐进式DIBR伪视图监督：利用DIBR生成高置信伪视图，逐步加强监督，提供额外几何与外观约束，特别覆盖弱观察区域；4) 高度约束的锚点生长：限制不合理的高斯扩张，稳定训练与重建。
AI.result: 在仅3个输入视角训练下，较前SOTA提升PSNR 6.83 dB，SSIM相对提升14%，LPIPS相对提升60%，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过DIBR生成伪视图并结合深度/外观先验与高度约束，高效缓解稀疏视角下3DGS的几何与外观不足，实现更完整、稳定的遥感新视角合成，并显著优于现有方法。

title: EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold
summary: Interactive 3D head generation requires coordinated speaking and listening motion that responds to an evolving conversation. Existing generators use incoming observations as context but keep their parameters fixed, leaving conversational patterns unused as a learning signal. We introduce EvolvingAvatar, a causal generator that uses test-time training to adapt to user face video and dyadic audio during interaction. Its dyadic context prediction objective provides a self-supervised learning signal from audiovisual context without target motion labels at test time. Persistent fast weights accumulate these updates within each conversation to guide motion generation, while transient jaw adaptation responds to current audiovisual context. Predicted speech activity controls how persistent adaptation guides motion. We also introduce InterHead-Bench, a unified 455.95-hour benchmark built from single-view and dual-view conversation videos. Experiments show improved conversational motion statistics over strong baselines. On the hardest out-of-distribution split, generation improves as conversations unfold, reducing mismatch with recorded user-avatar expression statistics by up to 11.1% from the first interval.

AI.tldr: 提出EvolvingAvatar：一种在互动中自适应的因果3D头部生成器，通过测试时训练从双人对话的视听上下文学习，无需目标运动标签；并发布455.95小时的InterHead-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式3D头部生成在推理时参数固定，只把输入当上下文，无法利用对话过程中的交互模式作为学习信号，导致难以生成随对话演变而协调的说话与倾听动作。
AI.method: 提出测试时训练框架EvolvingAvatar：以“二人对话上下文预测”作为自监督目标，在推理中从用户面部视频与双向音频学习；引入两类适配参数：会话内累积的持久快速权重与对当前上下文敏感的瞬态下颚适配；用预测的语音活动来调度持久适配对动作生成的影响。并构建统一基准InterHead-Bench（单/双视角对话，时长455.95小时）。
AI.result: 在多个强基线之上显著改善对话动作统计；在最困难的OOD划分上，随着对话推进，生成质量持续提升，相对用户-化身表情统计失配从第一个时间段起最高降低11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 测试时自监督适配能将对话中的视听上下文转化为有效学习信号，使3D头部生成随对话演进而改进；所提方法与新基准共同推动交互式头部生成的表现与评测。

title: RT-Super: Learning Tumor Segmentation from Longitudinal Images and Reports
summary: Multi-tumor segmentation is important for early cancer detection and allows radiologists to visualize, verify, and understand AI predictions. However, tumor segmentation masks are expensive, time-consuming, and unavailable for many tumor types in public data. Instead, hospitals have vast, readily available data that can guide segmentation: radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. We use this readily available data to substitute for tumor masks in training AI for tumor segmentation. To this end, we propose a new architecture, RT-Super. It has a teacher network, which analyzes the patient's longitudinal images and reports to create high-quality tumor masks. These masks train a student network, which sees a single image and no report. At inference, when longitudinal images and reports are unavailable, we use the student. RT-Super uses a new CNN-Transformer architecture and novel Consistency Losses that exploit tumor location consistency across longitudinal images. We train RT-Super to segment esophagus, uterus and spleen tumors, which have few or no public masks. Even without training masks, RT-Super can segment these tumors and surpass public AI models. Overall, we demonstrate that learning from longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and reports can overcome mask scarcity and advance multi-cancer detection and segmentation. Code: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super

AI.tldr: 提出RT-Super：用纵向影像与报告作为弱/替代监督，生成伪分割掩膜训练学生模型，实现在缺少标注掩膜时的多肿瘤分割，并在食管、子宫、脾脏肿瘤上优于现有公开模型。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中肿瘤分割掩膜昂贵且稀缺，尤其多肿瘤类型缺乏公开标注；但医院普遍拥有丰富的纵向影像、多期相位影像与放射学报告。这些信息可蕴含肿瘤位置与演变线索，若能转化为监督信号，可缓解掩膜短缺并提升早癌检测与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出RT-Super师生框架：教师网络输入患者的纵向影像（多时点、多期相位）及放射学报告，生成高质量伪掩膜；学生网络仅用单时点影像、无报告进行训练，以教师伪掩膜为监督。在推理阶段仅用学生模型。模型采用CNN-Transformer混合架构，并引入新的一致性损失，约束纵向影像间肿瘤位置与形态一致性以提升伪掩膜质量。
AI.result: 在缺乏或极少公开掩膜的肿瘤（食管、子宫、脾脏）上，RT-Super在无真实掩膜训练条件下仍能进行有效分割，且性能超过公开的现有AI模型。
AI.conclusion: 利用纵向/多期影像与放射学报告可替代昂贵的分割掩膜监督，RT-Super证明了这种弱监督/替代监督策略可缓解标注稀缺，推进多癌种分割与早期检测；代码公开以促进复现与扩展。

title: Many Eyes, One World: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Mixed Cameras
summary: Real-world capture is heterogeneous: perspective, fisheye, and $360^\circ$ panoramic images can coexist within a single reconstruction task, yet most feed-forward 3D reconstruction models assume perspective imagery and a uniform input representation. Recent models handling several camera types are either informed of the camera type for each view or reconstruct one image pair at a time. No single-pass method reconstructs mixed-camera tuples containing full panoramas from images alone. We present MEOW, a feed-forward system that jointly reconstructs metric pointmaps and camera poses from one N-view tuple mixing perspective, fisheye and full-panorama images, in a single forward pass from images alone: no calibration, distortion parameters, camera-type labels or poses are supplied for any view. Our guiding design philosophy is to treat heterogeneous-camera reconstruction as a data-adaptation problem rather than an architectural redesign. MEOW retains a perspective-pretrained backbone and learns heterogeneous cameras entirely from a procedural data engine, which renders each scene across a continuous manifold of camera models with exact rays and depth, and certifies covisibility for every camera-sampled training tuple. Trained on synthetic tuples only, MEOW transfers zero-shot to real captures: on heterogeneous 2D3DS tuples it achieves 79.9 mAA@30 against 53.8 for Wid3R given the camera type of every view; on our laser-scanned mixed-camera benchmark it registers every four-view mixed tuple with 79.4 AUC@30. The data engine, benchmark, and complete evaluation pipeline will be released.

AI.tldr: MEOW提出无需相机类型与标定信息，单次前向就能从混合相机（透视、鱼眼、全景）N视图中同时回归度量点图与相机位姿；以数据引擎适配而非网络大改为核心，通过程序化渲染连续相机模型与共视证据，仅用合成数据训练，零样本迁移到真实数据并在多基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实重建常含多种相机（透视、鱼眼、360°），而主流前馈3D重建假设统一透视模型；现有能处理多相机的方法需提前知道相机类型或仅两两重建，缺少能在单次前向中处理含全景的混合相机元组的方法。
AI.method: 提出MEOW：保留透视预训练主干，将“异构相机重建”视为数据适配问题。构建程序化数据引擎，在连续相机模型流形上为同一场景渲染精确射线与深度，确保训练元组的共视性；网络从仅图像输入中联合预测度量点图(pointmap)与相机位姿，无需提供标定、畸变、相机类型或初始位姿。
AI.result: 在异构2D3DS元组上，无需相机类型先验实现79.9 mAA@30（对比Wid3R在已知相机类型条件下为53.8）；在自建激光扫描混合相机基准上，四视图元组注册AUC@30达79.4；合成数据训练能零样本泛化到真实采集。
AI.conclusion: 通过以数据引擎驱动的训练来吸收相机异质性，MEOW在无需任何相机先验的单次前向中实现强健的混合相机重建，并在真实场景上取得领先表现；相关数据引擎、基准与评测管线将开源。

title: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
summary: Tool-based image editing (image retouching) is commonly formulated with autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that sequentially generate reasoning, tool selections, and parameter values. In this work, we present a novel approach to tool-based image editing by framing the task as a flow matching problem. We introduce FlowTool, a framework that directly models the distribution of high-quality tool parameters conditioned on the input image and user instruction using conditional rectified flow. FlowTool combines a vision-language model backbone for multimodal understanding with a Diffusion Transformer parameter generator that transforms Gaussian noise into an editing plan. We train FlowTool with a two-stage supervised flow-matching curriculum, followed by reward-based post-training. Across MMArt-Bench, FlowTool-Eval, ArtEdit-Bench, and MIT-Adobe5K, FlowTool achieves significantly stronger reference-based performance than specialized MLLM editing agents and proprietary MLLMs, while remaining competitive with proprietary models under reference-free evaluation. Moreover, FlowTool significantly improves inference efficiency, reducing latency by at least $50\times$ while requiring nearly $2\times$ less memory than the compared baselines. These results demonstrate that tool-based image editing can be effectively modeled as conditional generation over structured continuous editing parameters, without autoregressive reasoning.

AI.tldr: FlowTool将工具型图像编辑从“自回归推理+工具调用”的离散决策流程，改为“条件连续参数生成”的流匹配问题，直接一次性生成高质量编辑参数，速度更快、内存更省、效果更好。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM编辑代理需要逐步产生思考链、选择工具、设定参数，推理冗长、易积累误差、延迟高且资源占用大；而图像编辑的本质输出往往是结构化且连续的参数。作者动机是用连续生成范式直接建模参数分布，提升效率与稳定性，并在参考对齐任务上提高质量。
AI.method: 提出FlowTool：以条件rectified flow为核心，将高斯噪声通过Diffusion Transformer映射为编辑计划（结构化连续工具参数），由VLM骨干负责编码图像与指令；训练采用两阶段监督式flow-matching课程学习，随后进行基于奖励的后训练，以对齐人类偏好/评估信号；推理时一次性采样参数而非自回归步骤。
AI.result: 在MMArt-Bench、FlowTool-Eval、ArtEdit-Bench、MIT-Adobe5K上，参考基准下显著优于专用MLLM编辑代理与商业MLLM；无参考评测下也具竞争力。推理效率显著提升：≥50×更低时延、≈2×更少内存占用，相比基线更高效稳健。
AI.conclusion: 将工具型图像编辑表述为条件连续参数的流匹配生成可替代自回归推理路径，既提升质量（尤其参考对齐）又大幅降低时延与内存，验证了“无自回归推理的连续参数生成”在图像编辑中的有效性。

title: DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time
summary: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

AI.tldr: 提出DynaTokens：在冻结相机可控视频生成基础模型上，加入少量可学习、场景特定的token，通过跨注意力从少量示例轨迹学习局部动态，从而在新相机路径下同时保持正确相机运动与逼真场景动态，优于LoRA与部分微调等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有相机可控视频模型在静态场景下能处理相机诱发的全局运动，但在动态场景中常出现物体静止、运动错误或画质退化。观察到相机运动是全局影响，而物体动态是空间局部的，这种不对称性提示应采用与目标结构匹配的可训练接口。
AI.method: 在冻结的世界模型中引入一组轻量、可学习的场景特定token（DynaTokens），通过跨注意力参与生成；用少量该场景的示例轨迹训练这些token，使其捕获局部时空动态；推理时在新的相机路径下使用已学token以驱动正确的对象动态，同时保持相机控制。
AI.result: 在VBench2与WorldScore上，DynaTokens在“动态-相机”权衡上优于LoRA、块级微调和专门可训练层等基线；并通过注意力可视化、消融与时间性分析表明其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将可训练接口对齐到学习目标结构（局部动态）能高效适配动态场景；DynaTokens以极小开销为相机可控视频模型注入场景动态，实现在新相机路径下的高质量生成。

title: Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing
summary: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.

AI.tldr: RefGAP是一种无需训练的参考注意力校正方法，通过在扩散编辑模型的每层前向中测得参考注意力质量并自适应地对logits加偏置，强化编辑区域对参考的使用、抑制保留区域的参考泄漏，从而显著提升身份一致性与保真度，且只需两个全局系数、可跨多种图像/视频编辑器泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有参考引导的扩散编辑器在忠实复现参考（如人脸/身份）方面表现不佳，关键瓶颈是编辑区域对参考的注意力分配过低（例如LoomVideo中编辑查询对参考注意力<1%），导致参考特征无法被充分利用或在非编辑区域产生不期望的改动。
AI.method: 提出RefGAP：在推理时、逐层在线测量到参考的注意力质量，并根据测得值为注意力logits添加自适应偏置。对编辑区域查询施加正偏置以提高其对参考键/值的注意力；对保留区域查询施加负偏置以抑制参考驱动的越界修改。仅用两个全局系数控制强度，这两个系数在四个开发用扩散编辑器的验证集上一次性选定后固定，用于不同编辑器/任务，无需训练与逐方法网格搜索。
AI.result: 在七种扩散式图像/视频编辑器上，RefGAP在换头、换脸任务中提升身份保真与一致性；在总体保真—保持原图权衡上，达到与单独调参的常数偏置相当的效果，但无需为每个方法做强度扫描。还在虚拟试穿与背景替换中展示了跨任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 参考注意力不足是参考引导扩散编辑的核心瓶颈；RefGAP通过简单的推理期自适应logit偏置，有效提升参考利用并控制编辑外泄，具备强泛化与低调参成本，在多种编辑任务中提升身份保真与编辑质量。

title: Lagrangian--Hamiltonian Flows for Video Prediction and Image Generation: A Symplectic Perspective
summary: We introduce LHFM, a geometric framework for learning image dynamics. Drawing on structures central to classical mechanics, symplectic geometry, and geometric quantization, LHFM represents each image as an exact Lagrangian graph and models its evolution through image-dependent Hamiltonian flows, which yield a transport--source parameterization of image velocities. Our primary application is deterministic video prediction: LHFM-V is a recurrent model that advances frames by integrating predicted transport and source fields, and achieves the lowest reported FLOP count among the compared recurrent models with similar prediction accuracy. The image variant, LHFM-I, shows that the same construction is compatible with flow matching: in a matched experiment, it attains a lower FID than the flow-matching baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出LHFM：将图像视为精确拉格朗日图，通过图像依赖的哈密顿流建模其随时间的演化，用于视频预测与生成，计算高效且效果佳。
AI.motivation: 现有图像/视频动力学建模多依赖黑箱网络或欧氏空间参数化，难以同时保证物理一致性、可解释的速度分解与计算效率；作者希望用几何与力学结构来更自然地描述与预测图像随时间的变化，并提升效率与质量。
AI.method: 以辛几何与几何量子化为灵感：把每帧图像表示为精确拉格朗日图；演化由图像依赖的哈密顿流驱动，诱导出“输运（transport）+ 源项（source）”的速度场参数化。构建两种模型：1) LHFM‑V（视频）：递归地预测并积分输运与源场以推进帧；2) LHFM‑I（图像）：将同一构造用于flow matching以训练生成模型。
AI.result: 在确定性视频预测任务上，LHFM‑V在与精度相近的递归模型中实现了最低的FLOP；在图像生成上，LHFM‑I在对齐的实验中取得低于flow‑matching基线的FID。
AI.conclusion: 几何化的哈密顿流框架可统一描述图像动力学并带来高效、精度优良的预测与生成；输运‑源项分解提供了可解释的速度建模，与现有训练范式（如flow matching）兼容。

title: Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision
summary: Frontier general-purpose systems are rapidly expanding beyond visual understanding into capabilities traditionally handled by dedicated computer-vision models. As these capabilities expand, a central question for the computer-vision community is how far this reach extends, and what remains hard. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra alongside five frontier general-purpose AI systems across 34 capabilities and 55 benchmarks spanning nine areas of computer vision. We compare their performance with dedicated models and humans where suitable references are available. Astra demonstrates broad visual capability, with substantial gains over other frontier systems in visual and spatial reasoning and several forms of structured prediction. Across the state-of-the-art systems, a consistent pattern emerges. Capabilities involving semantic interpretation, reasoning, and object-centric prediction increasingly approach or reach available reference levels. In contrast, larger gaps remain when tasks require metric geometric accuracy, faithful reconstruction, temporally consistent dense prediction, or specialized fine-grained visual knowledge. Additional reasoning and specialist tools close selected gaps, but their benefits vary across capabilities. These results map a changing landscape of computer vision in which increasingly sophisticated visual tasks are accessible through a general-purpose interface, while precise and fidelity-sensitive perception remains an important frontier.

AI.tldr: 评测六个前沿通用AI（含GPT‑6 Astra）在34项能力、55个基准、涵盖9个视觉领域的表现。Astra在视觉/空间推理与若干结构化预测上领先，同类系统在语义理解与推理接近人类或专用模型，但在几何度量精度、真实重建、时序一致的密集预测、细粒度专业知识上仍有显著差距。结合推理与专家工具可部分弥补，但收益因能力而异。总体：通用接口能胜任更复杂视觉任务，精确与保真感知仍是前沿难点。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型正快速扩展至传统由专用计算机视觉模型承担的任务。社区关切：这些系统到底能做多远、哪些仍困难？需系统刻画通用系统与专用模型/人类在不同视觉能力上的边界与差距。
AI.method: 选取GPT‑6 Astra与其他五个通用系统，覆盖9大视觉领域、34项能力、55个公开基准；在可得参考处与专用SOTA模型与人类对照；分析语义/推理/结构化预测与几何精度/重建/时序密集预测/细粒度知识等维度差异；评估在外接推理与专家工具加持下的增益。
AI.result: Astra在广泛视觉能力上表现强，尤其在视觉与空间推理、若干结构化预测显著优于其他通用系统。总体趋势：涉语义解释、推理、以目标为中心的预测接近或达到参考水平；但在度量几何精度、忠实重建、时间一致的密集预测、专业细粒度视觉知识上仍存在较大性能缺口。外接工具能缩小部分差距，但收益不均。
AI.conclusion: 计算机视觉版图正变化：许多复杂视觉任务可通过通用模型接口高效访问，但需要高精度与高保真的感知任务仍依赖专用方法或更强机制。未来应在几何/时序一致性、重建保真与领域知识注入，以及通用模型与专家模块的协同方面发力。

title: Superquadric Primitive Decomposition of 3D point clouds via Geometric-Aware Inlier Refinement
summary: The decomposition of 3D point clouds into interpretable geometric primitives remains a longstanding challenge in Computer Vision and Computer Graphics. Among the available representations, superquadrics offer a compact and expressive model capable of capturing a wide range of shapes. However, their estimation is inherently challenging, as it requires solving a non-linear optimization problem and is particularly sensitive to noise, outliers, and overlapping structures. While robust estimation methods such as RANSAC and its variants achieve strong performance, they rely primarily on spatial proximity and residual-based criteria, often leading to incorrect inlier assignments across adjacent or complex arrangements of primitives. In this work, we introduce a geometric-aware framework for primitive decomposition that explicitly incorporates local surface properties into the fitting process. Specifically, we propose an inlier refinement step formulated as an energy minimization problem and solved via graph-cut optimization. Our formulation integrates geometric priors, such as normal consistency, enabling more reliable inlier selection beyond purely residual-based criteria. The approach naturally applies to both single-model estimation and multi-model decomposition. By leveraging geometric information beyond point-wise residuals, our method reduces erroneous inlier propagation and stabilizes parameter estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show consistent improvements in geometric accuracy, robustness to noise and outliers, and convergence efficiency compared to state-of-the-art RANSAC-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将几何先验（如法向一致性）显式融入拟合过程的图割能量最小化内点精炼框架，用于超二次体的单/多模型分解，较RANSAC类方法在噪声、离群与重叠结构下更稳健、精度更高、收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 传统用超二次体分解点云可表达力强但估计困难，非线性优化对噪声/离群/重叠结构敏感。现有RANSAC主要依赖空间距离与残差阈值，容易在相邻或复杂原语间发生错误内点分配，影响参数稳定与分解质量。
AI.method: 在RANSAC式初始拟合后，引入一个基于图割的能量最小化内点精炼：能量项同时考虑数据残差与几何先验（如局部法向一致性、邻域平滑），通过构建点与邻接图、设置数据项与平滑项，求解最小割得到更可靠的内点集合；该流程可在单模型和多模型分解中迭代应用以稳定参数估计。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，相比SOTA RANSAC变体，本方法在几何精度更高、对噪声与离群点更鲁棒、在重叠结构下更少错误内点传播，并表现出更快或更稳定的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 将局部几何信息（法向、邻域一致性）纳入内点选择的图割优化能有效提升超二次体拟合与分解的可靠性与稳定性，可作为RANSAC框架的通用增强模块，适用于单/多模型场景。

title: Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring
summary: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm's ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9\,\% over the commonly used $0^\circ$ frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1\,\%. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 引入REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集与新的可分离性指标，系统评估不同相机视角与多视方案对康复动作质量评估中RGB人体姿态估计的影响；结果显示优化2D视角优于常见正面视角并常胜过单目3D，双视角进一步提升。
AI.motivation: 现有康复质量评估依赖视频姿态估计，但对“相机摆放/视角”如何影响临床相关错误检测研究不足；缺少覆盖多视角、含正确与错误动作的数据与客观量化指标。
AI.method: 构建包含正确与错误康复动作、覆盖广泛机位角度的数据集REHAB26-ViewAngles；提出新的“可分离性”指标衡量算法区分正确/错误重复的能力；比较多种RGB姿态策略：单相机2D、单相机3D，以及四种多相机：正交双2D、3D三角化、加权3D融合、基于双相机同步训练的Transformer姿态模型；在不同视角与组合下评估可分离性。
AI.result: 最佳放置的单目2D相机相较常用0°正面视角可提升可分离性16.9%，且经常优于单相机3D；双视角组合在最佳情况下可在此基础上再提升最多13.1%。
AI.conclusion: 在康复监测部署中，合理选择相机视角至关重要；精心放置的2D相机即可获得显著收益，且常优于单目3D；若条件允许，使用两视角可进一步提高对错误动作的检测与评估准确性，为居家与临床应用提供实用指南。

title: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning
comment: Project page: https://bone-11.github.io/Flowact-R2; Hugging Face Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ProAudience/FlowAct-R2
summary: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.

AI.tldr: FlowAct-R2 是一个用于交互式类人视频生成的系统，结合连续多模态控制与前瞻式代理规划，实现实时、高分辨率、长时段的直播式生成与互动。
AI.motivation: 现有参考驱动的视频生成在长时互动中易漂移、缺乏连续多模态操控，且对直播/互动场景的突发输入与长程行为规划支持不足。需要一个既能稳定外观与动作，又能主动规划与响应用户的系统。
AI.method: 提出两大耦合模块：1) 流式多模态参考扩散Transformer（基于Seedance 2.0 Mini 改造），接收滚动动作提示、流式音频以及动态更新的图像/音频/视频参考；通过视频驱动旋转位置编码对齐参考片段与时间轴，并用“参考+图像”条件与部分加噪的历史运动帧维持外观与抑制累积漂移。2) 主动交互代理，将预上线规划与在线调度响应分离：事先构建人设、长时议程与可复用多模态技能；上线后自主调度行为、响应观众输入并处理中断。
AI.result: 系统支持实时720p生成与小时级流式会话，在娱乐直播、带货、视频聊天、视频播客等场景中实现连续互动与稳定外观动作。
AI.conclusion: 通过流式多模态条件与主动代理规划的结合，FlowAct-R2 实现高稳定性、强互动性与长时可用性的类人视频生成，适配多种实时应用场景。

title: GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space
summary: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model. Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion. To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoVerse：在预训练3D基础模型的几何潜空间中进行扩散生成，并通过视频生成模型注入外观先验，结合全局空间记忆实现跨视角一致的新视图合成；在多个数据集上实现更高画质与更优几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下的新视图合成需要在保持已观测区域的真实重建与未观测区域的合理补全之间取得平衡，并维持跨视角的世界一致性。现有几何方法结构忠实但补全差；视频生成模型有强外观先验但顺序生成易累积不一致。
AI.method: 1) 在预训练3D基础模型（几何潜扩散模型）的潜空间中进行生成；2) 从视频生成模型Wan2.2 VACE提取多层外观特征，通过类似ControlNet的适配器注入几何模型，提升未观测区域的结构与纹理补全；3) 设计全局空间记忆，持续聚合已观测与已生成内容，并重投影到目标视角提供对齐引导，确保跨视角一致性。
AI.result: 在DL3DV上PSNR提升2.23 dB；在Mip-NeRF360上相较GLD的ATE降低32.4%；主观视觉质量与几何一致性均显著提升，跨数据集稳健。
AI.conclusion: 将视频外观先验与3D几何潜空间生成相结合，并配合全局空间记忆的跨视角约束，可在稀疏视角条件下实现更一致、更高质量的新视图合成，优于现有几何或视频生成单一路线。

title: InfiniHand: Streaming World-Space Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
summary: World-space hand motion estimation from egocentric video requires recovering 3D articulated hand geometry while tracking camera egomotion. Existing approaches heavily rely on cascading independent hand pose estimators and SLAM systems, resulting in error accumulation, complex pipelines, and severe computational overhead. To address these limitations, we present InfiniHand, an end-to-end streaming feed-forward framework that jointly estimates MANO parameters, camera trajectories, and hand locations directly from uncalibrated egocentric video. InfiniHand integrates persistent spatiotemporal memory with hand-centered visual features, explicitly coupling camera motion with local hand geometry within a unified architecture. We train InfiniHand in two progressive stages by first learning robust camera-space hand priors and then extending to streaming world-space reconstruction. To support this process, we aggregate a pretraining corpus of approximately 5,000 hours of egocentric data across multiple public datasets. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that InfiniHand outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain benchmarks, achieving a 21.4% reduction in ARCTIC PA-p compared to ViDiHand while substantially mitigating world-space drift. Furthermore, InfiniHand generalizes robustly to in-the-wild videos and operates at 11.19 FPS, delivering more than twice the throughput of HaWoR.

AI.tldr: InfiniHand 提出一个端到端、流式前馈的单目自体视角手部重建框架，同时估计MANO参数、相机轨迹与手部在世界坐标中的位置，避免传统级联手姿+SLAM的误差累积与高开销；在大规模（约5000小时）egocentric数据上分两阶段训练，并在精度、抗漂移与速度上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖手姿估计与SLAM级联，导致误差传递、系统复杂与推理慢，且难以在未经标定的自体视角视频中稳定地在世界坐标系下重建手部。需要一个统一、端到端、可流式处理的方案，显式耦合相机运动与局部手几何，提高鲁棒性、精度与效率。
AI.method: 提出InfiniHand：1）统一架构同时回归MANO手部参数、相机位姿轨迹与手的世界坐标位置；2）利用持久时空记忆与以手为中心的视觉特征，将相机运动与手几何显式耦合；3）两阶段训练：先学习相机坐标系下的稳健手先验，再扩展到流式世界坐标重建；4）预训练语料由多个公开数据集汇聚，约5000小时的自体视角视频；5）端到端、前馈、流式推理以降低延迟与计算开销。
AI.result: 在域内基准上优于SOTA：相较ViDiHand，ARCTIC PA-p降低21.4%，显著缓解世界坐标漂移；在野外视频上具有良好泛化；速度11.19 FPS，吞吐量超过HaWoR两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相机自运动与手几何在统一网络中联合建模，并结合时空记忆与大规模预训练，InfiniHand在精度、抗漂移与推理效率上均显著优于现有级联方案，适用于未经标定的自体视角视频的实时或准实时手部重建。

title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
summary: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨如何高效复用基于Softmax注意力预训练的ViT权重到线性注意力ViT，以避免从零训练并提升性能。结论是：MLP权重可直接拷贝（操作符无关），注意力需通过蒸馏重建路由行为（操作符相关），从而使线性ViT缩小甚至超越Softmax ViT性能差距。
AI.motivation: 线性ViT以线性复杂度注意力替代Softmax注意力以提升效率，但通常需从头训练且性能落后；同时大量基础模型都基于Softmax注意力。如何有效地初始化线性ViT、并复用Softmax预训练权重，尚无清晰答案。
AI.method: 系统评估Softmax→线性ViT的权重迁移策略：直接拷贝注意力与MLP；以及通过特定损失设计对线性注意力进行蒸馏以恢复token路由行为。比较不同线性ViT变体、模型规模与数据集下的效果。
AI.result: 发现注意力权重具有操作符特异性：直接拷贝对线性注意力无效甚至劣化；而MLP权重是操作符无关的，直接拷贝即可带来大部分收益。通过针对路由行为的蒸馏损失，可使线性ViT逼近并匹配/超越Softmax模型性能。该结论在多种线性ViT、不同规模与数据集上稳定成立。
AI.conclusion: 跨注意力算子复用预训练权重的有效策略是：对保持不变的部分（MLP）直接拷贝，对变化的部分（注意力）用蒸馏恢复行为，实现Softmax→线性边界上的性能迁移与提升。

title: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
summary: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informative input (66.6 mm vs. 79.0 mm head-only) and the firmware-fused foot orientation as the liability that destroys the gain. We therefore let the model learn how much to trust each channel of each stream: one temporal gate per stream per channel block, trained with an auxiliary reliability objective on synthetically corrupted pretraining data. The channel-gated model is the most accurate of our learned fusion arms on clean data (69.4 mm vs. 83.7 static, 86.6 ungated) and under every simulated fault (bias in training; drift, dropout eval-only); its gates suppress the natively biased foot-orientation channels on clean real data without test-time supervision and flag dropout bursts at 0.92-0.999 AUROC. Two contrasts: dropping a channel known a priori to fail is flat across foot faults but collapses when an unanticipated stream fails (head dropout: 92.9 vs. 79.3 mm); and a fine-tuned HMD-Poser is more accurate on clean data (64.4 mm) and nominally under drift, with no significant paired difference under bias or dropout, but a larger worst-case degradation from clean (+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm, single seed). Learning to gate reliability instead of sensor count is the lever for deployable sparse inertial capture. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/reliability-gated-imu-fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对稀疏IMU人体姿态估计的“通道级可靠性门控”方法，在单主体耳机头IMU+双脚鞋垫IMU数据集上提升鲁棒性与精度，并能自动抑制不可靠的传感器通道与识别故障。
AI.motivation: 消费级IMU容易出现融合姿态偏置、佩戴/安装变动、漂移与掉包，导致稀疏IMU姿态估计在实际部署中不可靠。作者发现问题主要在通道层级：某些通道（如脚部加速度）信息量大，而某些（如固件融合的脚部朝向）反而有害。需要一种能动态衡量并利用各通道可靠性的融合机制。
AI.method: 在每个传感器流的每个通道块上引入时间门（temporal gate），学习对通道的信任度。以合成故障（偏置、漂移、掉包）预训练一个辅助可靠性目标，使门控学会在噪声/故障下降低权重。比较无门控、静态权重、以及本方法的门控融合；并进行通道消融分析。
AI.result:
- 通道消融：脚部加速度最有信息（头部仅66.6mm对比79.0mm），但脚部固件融合朝向会破坏收益。
- 门控模型在干净数据上最准（69.4mm，优于静态83.7与无门控86.6），在所有模拟故障（训练含偏置；评测含漂移/掉包）下都最稳。
- 在真实干净数据上，门控自动抑制先天带偏的脚部朝向通道；对掉包检测AUROC达0.92–0.999。
- 预先丢弃“已知会坏”的通道对脚部故障平稳，但遇到意外（头部掉包）性能崩塌（92.9 vs 79.3mm）。
- 与微调的HMD-Poser相比：干净数据上HMD-Poser更准（64.4mm），名义上对漂移略好；在偏置/掉包下无显著差异，但其最坏情形退化更大（+16.1 vs +3.5mm，单次随机种子）。
AI.conclusion: 部署稀疏IMU捕捉的关键不是增加传感器数量，而是学习“按通道”门控可靠性。该方法在干净与多类故障场景中均更稳健，能在无测试监督下抑制有偏通道并高准确率识别掉包。代码已开源。

title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
summary: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在统一多模态模型中用强化学习联合优化“自反思—再生成”全闭环，从而显著提升图像生成的可修复性与通用性。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态（看图+出图）模型具备自我诊断与修复潜力，但：1）仅用SFT学习反思轨迹难以找到高成功率的修复路径；2）天真实践中只优化渲染器或单一头的RL无法充分挖掘增益；3）逐轮信用分配带来组合爆炸；4）依赖外部裁判/单轮编辑限制信用传播与推理时可用性。需要一种在同一模型内、跨轮次联合学习反思文本与图像修订的高效RL方法。
AI.method: 提出UMM-Reflection：在单一统一模型内完成整条反思—修订—渲染—观测的闭环RL训练。关键设计：1）同起始图的“兄弟轨迹”并行，使用组相对优势（group-relative advantage）比较不同反思策略；2）对整条轨迹计算单一轨迹级优势（trajectory-level advantage），同时更新反思token与基于流的图像修订参数，避免逐轮信用分配的组合爆炸；3）不依赖外部验证器，信用跨轮次与跨模型角色（诊断者与生成者）流动。
AI.result: 在BAGEL基准上，相比SFT，GenEval提升+12.05分；在未参与训练的WISE、OneIG-Bench、T2I-CompBench++上分别转移提升+10.97、+3.48、+4.63分，显示出显著的泛化与迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化反思文本与图像修订的闭环RL，在无需外部裁判的统一模型内实现高效信用分配与跨轮次学习，显著优于SFT和单头RL，且带来稳健的跨基准迁移收益。

title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student-critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic's endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video-audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出PDMD，通过在DMD中对学生更新做投影，稳定少步视频扩散蒸馏训练，减少过饱和与伪影，并在多基准上以4步推理取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: DMD虽将扩散采样NFE降到极少，但在训练后期常出现画面过饱和、纹理不自然等退化。作者将根因归结为批评器（critic）误差在逐次学生更新中累积。需要一种简单且无额外开销的方法抑制该误差传递。
AI.method: 提出Projected DMD：在固定噪声查询下，计算学生-批评器端点残差，并将标准DMD更新在该残差方向上的分量投影剔除。作者证明该残差是不偏估计的端点误差；在高维假设下，此投影可去除常数比例的critic误差，同时只损失可忽略的理想信号。实现上仅一行代码改动，无新增损失、网络、数据或训练阶段。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1上，4 NFE得到VBench总分83.73，比匹配的DMD高1.03；在MiniMax-H3视频-音频联合生成上，VideoGen-Eval视觉总分83.17，较最强蒸馏基线高0.41；同时在对比的4-NFE模型中，在六项音频指标上均为最佳。定性与用户研究显示在视觉质量、运动与音频质量上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过对DMD更新进行基于端点残差的正交投影，PDMD有效过滤critic误差，稳定训练并提升样本质量，且几乎零额外成本，适用于低NFE视频与视听生成蒸馏。

title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
comment: 14 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://toshi2k2.github.io/fure
summary: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. Fur usually covers most of an animal's body, with large inter-species and intra-species variability. We present FurE, an efficient strand-based animal fur reconstruction method that recovers a per-strand, editable groom by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field, decoded into strand geometry via a PCA-based decoder. We reconstruct a defurred animal body using local fur-thickness cues from a surface-constrained Gaussian Frosting representation together with part-based priors. We further show that a PCA-based decoder learned from human-hair strand data can alleviate animal-data scarcity while enabling substantially faster optimization. FurE achieves a 10x speedup in strand training over current SOTA dense per-strand optimization while retaining strand fidelity and generalizing across synthetic and real-world sequences, with quantitative and qualitative validation despite the reduction in training time.

AI.tldr: FurE提出一种高效的基于发丝（strand）的动物毛发重建方法，从多视图图像恢复可编辑的逐根毛发造型，速度较现有逐根密集优化快约10倍且保持细节与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 动物毛发重建困难：细尺度细节、遮挡与混杂严重，且缺乏类似人发的大规模训练数据；动物毛发覆盖全身、跨物种/同物种差异大，现有方法慢且不易编辑。
AI.method: 1) 用“以根为条件”的潜在场表示每根毛发，通过PCA解码器将潜表示解码为毛发几何；2) 通过受表面约束的Gaussian Frosting表征并结合身体部件先验，重建去毛化的动物身体与局部毛厚度线索；3) 采用基于人发数据学习的PCA解码器，缓解动物数据稀缺并加速优化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实序列上实现与SOTA相当的发丝保真度，同时将逐根训练加速约10倍；给出定量与定性验证，尽管训练时间显著减少仍保持质量与可泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 根条件潜在场+PCA解码与表面约束厚度先验，使FurE在数据稀缺下实现高效、可编辑、跨域泛化的动物毛发重建，兼顾速度与细节保真。
